papers.title: QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuantWAMs，一种面向 World Action Models (WAMs) 的后训练量化 (PTQ) 框架，针对 WAM 迭代去噪和闭环执行部署成本高、现成 PTQ 方法不匹配的问题，将量化决策与模型结构、 rollout 分布和任务目标定义的校准上下文对齐。方法包含共享基座异常值校准、联合训练目标显著性、固定干预 rollout 审计三个策略。在 Fast-WAM 与 LingBot-VA 上，W4A4 主导设置下仿真结果与 FP16 相差 0.2–0.7 个百分点，并将目标块峰值权重-激活内存降至 FP16 的约 29%，带来 1.4–1.6 倍块级加速。
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法因依赖开环目标、同质模型假设和与部署不符的校准分布，难以适用于同时预测未来观测与动作的 WAMs，导致高效部署成本过高。
Method: QuantWAMs 提出三个策略：shared-basis outlier calibration（仅在坐标兼容模块间共享激活证据）、co-training-objective saliency（用视频-动作联合梯度的经验 Fisher 分数分配权重精度）、fixed-intervention rollout auditing（利用可达闭环状态修正去噪步保护调度而不改变精度预算）。
Result: 在 Fast-WAM 和 LingBot-VA 上，跨 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 及 AgiBot G2 真机评测，W4A4 主导设置下仿真均值偏差 0.2–0.7 个百分点；真机三项操作任务验证可部署性；目标视频与动作块峰值内存约为 FP16 的 29%，块级加速 1.4–1.6 倍。
Conclusion: 论文认为将量化调度与部署时的校准上下文对齐，可在不改变精度预算的前提下提升 WAM 部署效率并保持精度；其评估范围限于所列举的机器人操作基准与真机任务。

papers.title: Large scale cross-regional remote sensing flood monitoring framework for operative mapping and impact analysis
papers.abstract_en: Effective flood monitoring is critical for minimizing the impacts of flood disasters on populations and infrastructure. Yet reliable remote sensing across extensive and environmentally diverse regions remains challenging, as most segmentation algorithms lack the generalisation capacity required for large-scale application, while annotated flood data are scarce and unevenly distributed. This study presents an end-to-end multimodal framework for Russian Federation territories sustainable flood monitoring and damage assessment based on synthetic aperture radar data, multispectral imagery, and digital elevation models with their derivatives, forming a 21-channel input. Using a self-collected multimodal dataset covering seven Russian regions, two strategies for water surface detection under limited data conditions were compared: a supervised U-Net++ model and the self-supervised AnySat architecture pre-trained and fine-tuned for the segmentation task. Under the data conditions of this study, supervised learning proved more effective, while the AnySat-based approach offered greater stability and retains advantages for settings where larger unlabelled data or missing modalities at inference are expected. The best flood area predictions were used to estimate flood impact in urban areas in terms of the area affected, material damage, casualties, and ecological and agricultural impact. The estimations were conducted following the official methodology of the Russian Ministry of Emergency Situations. Applied to the 2019 Tulun flood, the obtained results closely matched official assessments, except for material damage, due to the open-source databases usage. The results demonstrate the potential of deep learning and multimodal satellite data integration for scalable, reliable flood monitoring across diverse environmental and data-limited conditions.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Preprint submitted to Earth Systems and Environment. This version has not been peer reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向俄罗斯领土的大规模跨区域洪涝监测与影响评估框架，基于合成孔径雷达 (SAR)、多光谱影像和数字高程模型 (DEM) 及其衍生物构成 21 通道输入。作者使用覆盖七个俄罗斯地区的自建多模态数据集，比较了监督 U-Net++ 与自监督 AnySat 两种水体分割策略，发现本文数据条件下监督学习更有效，而 AnySat 稳定性更高。将最佳洪泛区预测用于按俄罗斯紧急情况部官方方法评估城市影响，2019 年 Tulun 洪水的评估结果与官方评估接近，仅材料损失估计存在差异。
Motivation: 大规模且环境多样的区域中，可靠的遥感洪水监测仍具挑战：多数分割算法缺乏大范围应用所需的泛化能力，而标注洪水数据稀缺且分布不均。
Method: 提出端到端多模态框架，输入包括 SAR、多光谱影像、DEM 及其衍生物共 21 通道；在数据有限条件下对比监督 U-Net++ 与预训练并微调的自监督 AnySat 分割策略，并用最佳洪泛区预测按照官方方法估算城市区域受影响面积、材料损失、伤亡及生态与农业影响。
Result: 摘要报告在本文数据条件下监督学习更有效，而 AnySat 方法更稳定，且在拥有大量未标注数据或推理时缺失模态的场景下仍有优势；将方法应用于 2019 年 Tulun 洪水时，结果与官方评估接近，仅材料损失因使用开源数据库而存在差异。
Conclusion: 结果表明深度学习和多模态卫星数据集成能够支撑多样化环境和数据受限条件下的可扩展、可靠洪水监测。
Relevance: 28

papers.title: Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents often fail on transient GUI events because they produce the correct action only after the relevant window has already closed. We identify the main cause as expensive autoregressive decoding on the decision-time critical path. We propose Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT), which eliminates this delay without modifying the underlying model. During idle screen periods, the same frozen multimodal model constructs a bounded conditional policy tree with observable guards, pre-authorized actions, and branch-specific deadlines. The tree is sized to cover the model's own decoding latency. When an event occurs, a lightweight observer matches change-gated frames to a prepared branch and immediately executes the corresponding action without generating new text. In paired trials with pre-registered endpoints and exact McNemar tests, AAPT improves the success rate from 0.50 to 0.79 within a contested decision window ($p=1.8\times10^{-3}$), while producing no incorrect actions. Both open-loop and predict-and-replan baselines achieve zero success because they still decode during execution. A preparation-time sweep shows that the gain emerges where the latency-based tree-sizing rule predicts, and ablations reveal three key requirements: fast observer decoding, valid tree planning, and accurate branch routing. A pre-registered oracle probe rejects our initial hypothesis and instead points to branch routing as the causal bottleneck. We further reproduce the effect on an independent general-purpose multimodal model over 126 paired trials ($p=4.9\times10^{-13}$). On an external benchmark, AAPT matches the overall performance of a reactive baseline, although the two methods exhibit complementary strengths. Together, these results suggest that AAPT performs best when candidate actions can be enumerated in advance, whereas reactive execution remains stronger when they cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GUI 智能体在瞬时 GUI 事件上决策滞后的问题，指出代价高昂的自回归解码位于决策时间关键路径上是主要原因。作者提出 Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT)，在空闲屏幕期用同一个冻结多模态模型构建有界条件策略树，事件发生时由轻量观察者匹配预授权分支并立即执行动作，无需生成新文本。配对试验中 AAPT 将成功率达到 0.79（对照 0.50，p=1.8×10^-3）且未产生错误动作，并在独立通用多模态模型上以 126 对试验复现（p=4.9×10^-13）。
Motivation: 现有 computer-use agent 常常在相关时间窗口关闭之后才产出正确动作，导致对瞬时 GUI 事件的应答失败；作者将根因定位为决策关键路径上的昂贵自回归解码。
Method: AAPT 在不修改底层模型的前提下，利用空闲屏幕时段让同一冻结多模态模型构建带有可观察守护条件、预授权动作和分支级截止时间的有界条件策略树，树的大小按覆盖模型自身解码延迟来设定；事件发生时，轻量观察者将变化门控帧匹配到已准备分支并立即执行相应动作。
Result: 在预先注册端点的配对试验中，AAPT 将受限决策窗口内的成功率从 0.50 提升到 0.79（精确 McNemar 检验 p=1.8×10^-3），且不产生错误动作；开环和 predict-and-replan 两种基线因执行期间仍在解码而成功率为 0。预注册的 oracle 探针拒绝了初始假设，指向分支路由是因果瓶颈；消融显示快速观察者解码、有效树规划和准确分支路由三者缺一不可。在独立通用模型上的 126 对试验中重现效果（p=4.9×10^-13），外部基准上 AAPT 总体性能匹配反应式基线但两者优势互补。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AAPT 在候选动作能够预先枚举的场景下表现最佳，而在候选动作无法预先枚举时，反应式执行仍然更强。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图语言模型 (GLM) 的检索器，并系统比较 GLM-based、GNN-based 和传统向量检索在单跳与多跳 RAG 场景下的表现，重点关注跨域迁移能力。摘要报告微调后的 GLM 检索器在域外泛化上更强，在两个多跳基准上达到 SOTA；在域内多跳问答上与先前工作相当，并随参数和子图覆盖增加呈现有前景的扩展趋势。
Motivation: 知识图谱上的检索增强生成 (RAG) 需要同时建模图结构和语义信息的检索器；已有工作多依赖 GNN 建模图拓扑，而图语言模型 (GLM) 成为整合图推理与语言模型语义能力的新范式，但缺乏对不同检索器在单/多跳及跨域设置下的系统比较。
Method: 提出一个 GLM-based 检索器，并在单跳和多跳 RAG 设置下与 GNN-based 检索器及传统向量检索基线进行比较，特别考察其到未见领域的迁移能力。
Result: 微调的 GLM 检索器在域外泛化上更优，在两个多跳基准上取得 SOTA；在域内多跳问答数据集上与先前工作相当，且随参数规模与子图覆盖增加呈现有前景的扩展。GNN-based 检索器以高效训练设置达到更高图覆盖，而向量检索基线在单跳数据集上表现最佳。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GLM-based 检索器在跨域多跳 RAG 中的迁移优势，同时指出不同检索器各有适用场景：GNN 适合图覆盖与训练效率，向量检索擅长单跳。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models:Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Hand-object interaction (HOI) modeling remains challenging because it requires joint reasoning about hand articulation, object geometry, contact, semantics, and dynamics under severe visual uncertainty. Foundation models introduce transferable prior knowledge learned from large-scale cross-domain data, offering new ways to address these challenges beyond task-specific data and models. However, the rapidly growing literature remains fragmented, and existing studies typically describe these methods simply as ``using large models'' without systematically characterizing what knowledge is introduced, where it enters the HOI pipeline, or which HOI uncertainty it helps reduce. This survey presents the first systematic review of foundation-model priors for HOI. We organize the literature into six HOI tasks spanning reconstruction and generation. More importantly, we establish a taxonomy of eight foundation-model sub-priors grouped into geometric, semantic, and visual families. Geometric priors encompass shape retrieval, shape reconstruction, and spatial reconstruction; semantic priors include semantic grounding and language reasoning; and visual priors cover visual representation, image generation, and video generation. Based on this taxonomy, we systematically analyze how different priors are represented, injected, and adapted across HOI pipelines and tasks. Beyond how foundation models empower HOI, we further examine how HOI-derived knowledge is used in robot learning, including human-data pretraining, human-to-robot skill transfer, and HOI-to-robot data generation. Finally, we summarize datasets and evaluation protocols, and discuss limitations and future directions toward more generalizable HOI systems. To support long-term progress, we curate a live repository that continuously aggregates emerging methods and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首个系统综述 foundation-model priors 用于手-物交互 (Hand-Object Interaction, HOI) 建模的工作。作者将文献组织为覆盖重建与生成的六类 HOI 任务，并提出一个包含八种子先验的 taxonomy，按几何、语义、视觉三大类归组。文章还分析了这些先验在 HOI 管线中的表示、注入与适配方式，并进一步讨论 HOI 知识如何用于机器人学习，包括人类数据预训练、人-机器人技能迁移和 HOI-机器人数据生成。最后总结了数据集、评测协议与未来方向，并维护一个持续更新的仓库。
Motivation: HOI 建模需要在严重视觉不确定性下联合推理手部关节、物体几何、接触、语义与动力学，挑战很大。虽然基础模型带来的跨域先验知识提供了新思路，但相关文献快速增长且碎片化，已有研究通常只笼统地说‘使用大模型’，没有系统刻画引入了什么知识、在 HOI 管线的哪个环节起作用、以及帮助减少了哪种不确定性。
Method: 通过系统性综述建立分类框架：将 HOI 任务归纳为六类（覆盖重建与生成），将 foundation-model 先验细分为八种子先验并归入几何（形状检索、形状重建、空间重建）、语义（语义锚定、语言推理）和视觉（视觉表示、图像生成、视频生成）三个家族。基于该 taxonomy，作者分析了不同先验在 HOI 管线中的表示、注入与适配方式，并考察 HOI 派生知识在机器人学习中的三种应用路径。
Result: 作为综述，本文不报告新的实验数据，其核心产出是首次系统化的 HOI 基础模型先验分类体系，以及对六类任务、八种子先验和机器人迁移应用的统一梳理。文中还总结了现有数据集与评测协议。
Conclusion: 作者认为该 taxonomy 有助于厘清基础模型先验在 HOI 中的角色，并指出未来应朝向更具泛化性的 HOI 系统发展；同时通过活体仓库持续收录新方法与基准以支持长期进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs
papers.abstract_en: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无限时域平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中神经评论家的收敛问题，提出一种分层多级蒙特卡洛（Multilevel Monte Carlo, MLMC）神经评论家估计器，并基于它构建原-对偶自然演员-评论家（Natural Actor-Critic）算法。摘要称该算法同时达到最优性间隙与约束违反均为 O~(T^{-1/2}) 的阶最优收敛，且无需已知混合时间。这是首次在一般策略参数化和神经评论家条件下，为平均奖励 CMDP 建立阶最优收敛保证。
Motivation: 现有原-对偶演员-评论家方法在采用线性评论家时已有深入理解，但将阶最优收敛保证扩展到神经评论家的平均奖励 CMDP 仍是开放问题；核心障碍是神经正切核（NTK）分析下评论家偏差与优化成本之间存在根本性权衡，降低偏差会显著增加优化成本，从而阻碍阶最优收敛。
Method: 引入分层多级蒙特卡洛（MLMC）神经评论家，在轨迹采样和评论家优化两个维度同时进行去偏（debiasing）。该估计器以对数期望样本成本获得长评论家优化运行对应的偏差水平；在此估计器基础上，作者提出原-对偶自然演员-评论家算法。
Result: 所提算法的最优性间隙（optimality gap）和约束违反（constraint violation）均达到 O~(T^{-1/2}) 量级。摘要强调这是无限时域平均奖励 CMDP 中首个针对一般策略参数化与神经评论家的阶最优收敛保证，且消除了对底层混合时间（mixing time）的依赖；即使在无约束设定下，结果也是新的。
Conclusion: 摘要指出所提出的 MLMC 神经评论家解决了神经评论家估计中的偏差-成本瓶颈，并首次在平均奖励 CMDP 中建立阶最优收敛保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explaining Image Similarity with Automatically Extracted Concept Activation Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Image similarity underlies many computer vision applications, yet it is often unclear why two images receive a high or low similarity score. Existing explainability methods often rely on gradient-based attribution maps to provide local justifications for similarity. These approaches struggle to provide global insights into what specifically drives similarity in regions of an embedding space, such as texture, shape, or color. We introduce a model- and metric-agnostic framework that explains image similarity using Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) extracted automatically via Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). Given a pair of images, we perturb their embeddings along discovered concept directions and measure the resulting change in a chosen similarity function, yielding concept importances. For image pairs, we provide localization with concept attribution maps. We extend this procedure to group-level settings, explaining what drives similarity across a cluster of images rather than a single pair, and further, we introduce Exemplar Retrieval, aiming to recover samples with similar reasons contributing to similarity. Our experiments show that our latent perturbations are more faithful to the underlying data distribution than pixel-space baselines, and that concept importances linearly recover the true similarity score. Qualitative results further confirm the usefulness of our methods in understanding a model's individual and group similarity judgments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种与模型和相似度度量无关的解释框架，利用稀疏自编码器 (Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs) 自动提取概念激活向量 (Concept Activation Vectors, CAVs)，通过扰动图像嵌入并测量相似度函数变化来得到概念重要性。该框架支持单对图像的概念归因图定位，并扩展到群组级解释以及 Exemplar Retrieval 示例检索。实验显示潜在空间扰动比像素空间基线更忠实于数据分布，且概念重要性能够线性恢复真实相似度分数。
Motivation: 现有图像相似性解释方法多依赖基于梯度的归因图，只能提供局部解释，难以在嵌入空间区域层面给出纹理、形状或颜色等具体驱动因素的全局洞察。
Method: 引入模型与度量无关的框架，先用 SAE 自动提取 CAV，再对图像对的嵌入沿概念方向进行扰动并测量所选相似度函数的变化，得到概念重要性；同时提供概念归因图，并将流程扩展到群组级相似性解释与 Exemplar Retrieval。
Result: 摘要报告潜在空间扰动比像素空间基线更忠实于数据分布，概念重要性可线性恢复真实相似度分数；定性结果也支持该方法在解释个体与群组相似性判断上的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架有助于理解模型在个体和群组层面判断图像相似性的具体原因。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Specifications Conflict: A Symmetry-Based Framework for Measuring LLM Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly required to integrate multiple sources of information that may be inconsistent or conflicting. However, there is still a lack of controllable and attributable methods for analyzing how models resolve conflicts between competing specifications. We propose a controlled experimental framework for studying model preferences under conflicting specifications. By constructing specifications with explicit conflicts, the framework enables model choices between competing specifications to be directly observed and analyzed. A symmetry-based design further reduces confounding factors, allowing preferences across representation types to be compared systematically. We evaluate the framework on an executable mathematical benchmark with 550 conflict instances spanning 11 function families, comparing four representation types: pure natural language, formal language, naturalized formal language, and input--output examples. Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family. We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受控实验框架，用于研究LLM在相互冲突的规格（conflicting specifications）下如何做出选择。框架通过构建显式冲突的规格，直接观察模型在竞争规格之间的偏好，并用对称性设计减少混杂因素。在包含550个冲突实例、11个函数家族的可执行数学基准上，比较了纯自然语言、形式语言、自然化形式语言和输入输出示例四种表示类型，发现系统性偏好顺序为形式语言约等于自然化形式语言，优于纯自然语言，后者又优于输入输出示例。该框架还扩展到布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域的异构规格冲突。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地需要整合可能不一致或冲突的多源信息，但现有方法缺乏可控且可归因的手段来分析模型如何解决竞争规格之间的冲突。
Method: 提出一个受控实验框架，构造显式冲突的规格使模型选择可直接观察，并采用对称性设计（symmetry-based design）减少混杂因素，从而系统比较不同表示类型下的偏好。
Result: 在550个冲突实例、11个函数家族的可执行数学基准上，模型表现出系统性偏好而非随机行为，偏好顺序为Formal ≈ Naturalized Formal > Pure Natural Language > Input–Output Examples；示例效应还取决于模型能力和函数家族。

papers.title: HyperClaim: Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Hypergraph Reasoning for Video Misinformation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video misinformation detection is often approached through global multimodal fusion or free-form multimodal reasoning. Both paradigms can under-represent localized authenticity cues that arise from coupled interactions among query phrases, contextual text, and short temporal spans of frames. Because such interactions are inherently higher-order, pairwise graph formulations are insufficient to capture multi-way cross-modal dependencies, whereas hypergraphs offer a suitable representation for these relations. We propose HyperClaim, a discriminative temporal hypergraph framework for sample-level authenticity classification. Using the title or benchmark-provided paired text as a claim-like query, HyperClaim constructs a sparse heterogeneous hypergraph over query tokens, evidence tokens, and sampled frames; applies confidence-aware filtering and source budgeting to form compact text-frame and short-range temporal evidence units; performs adaptive soft-incidence reasoning with residual text-video calibration; and aggregates textual, visual, and hyperedge states through a discrepancy-aware readout. Without relying on generated rationales or external tool calls, HyperClaim preserves fine-grained cross-modal and temporal structure that global fusion tends to flatten. Under the FactGuard temporal protocol, it achieves 83.7%, 82.0%, and 87.3% accuracy on FakeSV, FakeTT, and FakeVV, respectively, outperforming strong discriminative and reasoning-centric baselines. Learned incidence and attention weights further reveal token- and frame-level structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperClaim，一个用于视频虚假信息检测的判别式时间超图框架，在样本级别对真实性进行分类。该方法以标题或基准提供的配对文本作为类查询，在查询词元、证据词元和采样帧上构建稀疏异构超图，并结合置信度过滤、源预算、自适应软关联推理与残差文本-视频校准。在 FactGuard 时间协议下，该方法在 FakeSV、FakeTT 和 FakeVV 上分别达到 83.7%、82.0% 和 87.3% 的准确率，优于强判别式与推理式基线，且无需生成解释或外部工具调用。
Motivation: 现有的全局多模态融合或自由形式多模态推理方法会低估由查询短语、上下文文本和短时间帧跨度之间的耦合交互产生的局部真实性线索；这类交互本质上是高阶的，成对图结构不足以建模多路跨模态依赖，而超图更合适。
Method: 构建一个稀疏异构超图，覆盖查询词元、证据词元和采样帧；应用置信度感知过滤与源预算形成紧凑的文本-帧和短程时间证据单元；执行带残差文本-视频校准的自适应软关联推理；并通过差异感知读出聚合文本、视觉和超边状态。
Result: 在 FactGuard 时间协议下，HyperClaim 在 FakeSV、FakeTT 和 FakeVV 上分别取得 83.7%、82.0% 和 87.3% 的准确率，超过强判别式和推理式基线；学习到的关联与注意力权重还揭示了词元和帧级结构。
Conclusion: 该方法在不依赖生成解释或外部工具调用的情况下保留了全局融合易压平的细粒度跨模态与时间结构，从而提升样本级视频虚假信息检测性能。

papers.title: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态智能体在视觉问答中仅以最终答案准确率评估而忽略轨迹忠实度的问题，提出将智能体轨迹视为 provenance 约束的状态机。工具输出被规范化为结构化证据账本 (Structured Evidence Ledger) 作为轨迹状态，推理与决策只能引用活跃账本条目，并在实体与数值层面检查 grounding。作者以 LedgerMind 实例化该设计，结合三层 grounding 协议、自适应双路径调度器以及带形式化 provenance 非放大保证的事件触发验证-修复引擎，在多个多模态推理基准和骨干 MLLM 上同时提升答案准确率与轨迹级忠实度。
Motivation: 多模态智能体的评估通常只关注最终答案准确率，无法区分正确答案是来自 grounded 证据、语言先验还是偶然的错误抵消；这种聚合信号掩盖了中间推理无依据、幻觉、过度推理和修复时信息放大等系统性问题。
Method: 将多模态智能体轨迹建模为 provenance 约束的状态机：工具输出被归一化为结构化的 Structured Evidence Ledger 作为轨迹状态，下游推理和决策只能引用活跃账本条目；提出 Three-Layer Grounding Protocol、根据问题复杂度匹配推理深度的 Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher，以及带形式化 provenance 非放大保证 (non-amplification guarantee) 的 Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair 引擎。
Result: 摘要报告在多个多模态推理基准和骨干 MLLM 上，LedgerMind 同时提升了答案准确率和轨迹级忠实度，并针对最终答案准确率常掩盖的四类失败模式（无依据的中间推理、Phantom Grounding 实体幻觉、简单问题过度推理、修复时放大）进行改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为 provenance 约束的轨迹状态设计能够使多模态智能体的推理过程可审计，并避免修复过程引入未经工具验证的新内容。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUA) are being deployed to browse the web and operate desktop software, yet their benchmark scores are still commonly produced by brittle scripted oracles. A score is the output of a pipeline in which tasks can be stale, trajectories can omit decisive visual evidence, evaluators can reject valid alternatives, and aggregate reports can hide the cause of failure. We organize these problems into a reliability framework spanning task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, and reporting. We then audit 150 public failure-scored trajectories from five web, enterprise-workflow, and desktop-control benchmarks, find that 15.3\% of FAIL verdicts are wrong: 10.7\% are evaluator false negatives and 4.7\% are broken tasks. For genuine failures, a three-tier diagnostic taxonomy shows that verification/feedback and planning failures dominate execution/grounding errors, while a single scalar success rate can not explain. We connect these findings to newer long-horizon CUA benchmarks and derive stage-specific design rules for CUA evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究计算机使用智能体 (computer-use agents, CUA) 基准评分中的可靠性问题。作者将评测管线中的问题组织为覆盖任务构建、轨迹观测、评分与报告的可靠性框架，并审计五个 web、企业工作流和桌面控制基准中的150条失败评分轨迹，发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的，其中10.7%为评测器假阴性、4.7%为损坏任务。针对真实失败提出三层诊断分类，表明验证/反馈与规划错误占主导，单一标量成功率无法解释失败。
Motivation: CUA 基准分数仍常由脆弱的脚本化 oracle 产生，任务可能过时、轨迹缺少决定性视觉证据、评测器会拒绝合法替代方案、聚合报告会掩盖失败原因，导致基准分数不可靠。
Method: 将评测问题组织为涵盖任务构建、轨迹观测、评分和报告的可靠性框架，并据此审计五个基准中的150条公开失败轨迹；同时对真实失败采用三层诊断分类法 (three-tier diagnostic taxonomy)，并与更新的长时程 (long-horizon) CUA 基准相联系。
Result: 审计显示15.3%的FAIL判定是错的：10.7%为评测器假阴性，4.7%为任务本身损坏；真实失败中验证/反馈和规划错误多于执行/接地错误，单一标量成功率无法解释这些失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者将发现与更新的长时程CUA基准关联，并推导出面向CUA评估的分阶段设计规则 (stage-specific design rules)。

papers.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
papers.abstract_en: We present ShadowDancer, a novel approach to any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models. The obstacle is representational: existing interfaces either encode an action loosely, leaving how it unfolds for the model to improvise, or encode it exactly through structured signals that serve one family and are hard to acquire, so precise control across diverse dynamics remains impractical. Demonstration videos are the natural remedy, specifying any dynamics frame by frame; yet a video shows its dynamics only through one particular appearance, a single shadow of the underlying dynamics, so actions learned from demonstrations transfer poorly to new scenes. ShadowDancer addresses this with two key innovations: (1) shadow pairs, video pairs that replay the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance, constructed at scale by our Shadow Library, so that a dynamics family becomes controllable exactly when such pairs can be constructed for it; and (2) cross-shadow prediction, which learns actions by predicting one shadow from the other, so that whatever the pairing resamples is discarded by construction and whatever it preserves becomes the action, yielding a unified dynamics representation that drives a block-causal world model. Any demonstrated clip thus becomes a reusable action asset, replayed in new environments without action labels, motion estimators, or fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate improved action transfer and long action rollout over strong latent-action and interactive world model baselines across diverse dynamics families, with an average blinded win rate of 86% in rollout comparisons. We show video results at https://ShadowDancer-1.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShadowDancer，一种面向交互式视频世界模型的任意动作、帧级控制方法。其核心思路是用影子对 (shadow pairs) 来表示同一动态在不同外观下的重放，并通过跨影子预测 (cross-shadow prediction) 从一段影子视频预测另一段，从而丢弃被重采样的外观、保留被保留的动态作为动作，得到统一的动态表示并驱动块因果世界模型。实验表明该方法在动作迁移和长动作 rollout 上超过强 latent-action 与交互式世界模型基线，盲评平均胜率达 86%。
Motivation: 现有动作接口要么对动作编码松散、由模型自行发挥，要么通过结构化信号精确编码但只能服务单一动态族且难以获取，导致跨多样动态的精确控制不实用；演示视频虽能逐帧指定动态，但其外观只是一次特定呈现，学到的动作难以迁移到新场景。
Method: 提出两个关键创新：一是影子库 (Shadow Library) 大规模构造影子对，即在同一动态下独立重采样外观的视频对；二是跨影子预测，通过从其中一个影子预测另一个来学习动作，从构建上丢弃配对过程中重采样的因素、保留的因素即成为动作，形成统一动态表示并驱动块因果世界模型。
Result: 摘要报告在多种动态族上，该方法相比强 latent-action 基线和交互式世界模型基线均取得更好的动作迁移与更长 rollout 效果，rollout 对比中的盲评平均胜率为 86%。
Conclusion: 任意演示片段由此可成为可复用的动作资产，无需动作标签、运动估计器或微调即可在新环境中重放；作者也指出一个动态族可被精确控制的前提是能够为其构造影子对。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有动作接口要么对动作编码松散、由模型自行发挥，要么通过结构化信号精确编码但只能服务单一动态族且难以获取，导致跨多样动态的精确控制不实用；演示视频虽能逐帧指定动态，但其外观只是一次特定呈现，学到的动作难以迁移到新场景。
summary_sections.method: 提出两个关键创新：一是影子库 (Shadow Library) 大规模构造影子对，即在同一动态下独立重采样外观的视频对；二是跨影子预测，通过从其中一个影子预测另一个来学习动作，从构建上丢弃配对过程中重采样的因素、保留的因素即成为动作，形成统一动态表示并驱动块因果世界模型。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在多种动态族上，该方法相比强 latent-action 基线和交互式世界模型基线均取得更好的动作迁移与更长 rollout 效果，rollout 对比中的盲评平均胜率为 86%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 任意演示片段由此可成为可复用的动作资产，无需动作标签、运动估计器或微调即可在新环境中重放；作者也指出一个动态族可被精确控制的前提是能够为其构造影子对。

papers.title: An unstructured-grid, nonhydrostatic, GVC ocean model Part I: Model description and application of vertical hybrid coordinates to internal solitary waves
papers.abstract_en: We present a nonhydrostatic ocean model with a horizontally unstructured, C-grid and a moving, generalized vertical coordinate (GVC) designed for the simulation of nonhydrostatic processes in realistic ocean domains. The GVC system can represent any of the well-known z-level, terrain-following, or isopycnal coordinates while also being able to employ hybrid vertical coordinates. In this paper we outline the specific steps needed to incorporate the GVC system into the unstructured, C-grid, nonhydrostatic, z-coordinate SUNTANS model of Fringer et al. (2006). The approach is adapted from the nonhydrostatic, isopycnal-coordinate method of Vitousek and Fringer (2014), yet our model differs from that implementation through the development of a conservative momentum advection scheme and a positivity-preserving layer height scheme for horizontally unstructured grids. We validate the momentum advection implementation with simulations of a turbulent channel flow and demonstrate the advantages of the hybrid vertical coordinate approach over z- or terrain-following coordinates through simulations of internal solitary waves and the associated bottom boundary layer instability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于水平非结构化 C 网格与移动广义垂直坐标 (GVC) 的非静力海洋模式，旨在真实海洋域中模拟非静力过程。该 GVC 系统可表示 z-level、地形跟随、等密度面等已知坐标，也可采用混合垂直坐标。作者将 GVC 引入 Fringer 等人 (2006) 的非结构网格非静力 z 坐标 SUNTANS 模式，并通过湍流槽道流、内孤立波及其底边界层不稳定模拟验证了方法。
Motivation: 现有非静力海洋模式的垂直坐标选择有限，难以在真实复杂地形域中兼顾非静力过程模拟的灵活性与保真度。
Method: 借鉴 Vitousek 和 Fringer (2014) 的非静力等密度面坐标方法，为水平非结构化网格发展了守恒动量平流格式和保正的层厚格式，从而将 GVC 系统整合进 SUNTANS 模式。
Result: 摘要报告湍流槽道流模拟验证了动量平流实现，并通过内孤立波及伴随底边界层不稳定的模拟表明混合垂直坐标优于纯 z 坐标或地形跟随坐标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该模型能够在非结构网格非静力框架下有效采用混合垂直坐标，适合模拟海洋非静力过程。

papers.title: Teffic-Audio: Tell Fact from Fiction
papers.abstract_en: Speech deepfake detection has expanded in scope with increasingly heterogeneous spoofing mechanisms, including speech synthesis, voice conversion, vocoder reconstruction, and neural-codec resynthesis. The resulting spoofing artifacts can be further shaped by variability in source speech, recording environments, and transmission channels. This variability makes robust generalization across heterogeneous conditions a central requirement for practical detection systems. This report presents Teffic-Audio, a general speech deepfake detection system designed for comprehensive evaluation environment. Teffic-Audio adopts a straightforward detector architecture consisting of a Conformer-based speech encoder, multi-head attentive statistics pooling, and a binary classifier. Rather than relying on additional architectural complexity, the system improves generalization through its training recipe, which integrates multi-source data, attack- and source-balanced sampling, and diverse audio augmentation. Trained only with open-source data, Teffic-Audio achieves a pooled EER of 1.454% on the 14 test sets of Speech-DF-Arena, outperforming all currently public systems on the leaderboard. It also obtains the lowest EER on five individual test sets and shows a favorable performance-complexity trade-off compared with larger leading systems. Overall, Teffic-Audio provides a strong and practical reference system for general speech deepfake detection.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Technical report. Project page: https://tefficlabs.com/teffic-audio
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Teffic-Audio，一个面向异构欺骗机制的通用语音深度伪造检测系统。系统采用 Conformer 语音编码器、多头注意力统计池化 (multi-head attentive statistics pooling) 与二分类器的简单架构，核心改进在于训练配方：多源数据、攻击与来源平衡采样、以及多样化音频增强。仅使用开源数据训练，该系统在 Speech-DF-Arena 的 14 个测试集上取得 1.454% 的 pooled EER，优于当前所有公开系统，并在 5 个单独测试集上取得最低 EER。
Motivation: 语音深度伪造检测面临的欺骗机制日益异构，包括语音合成、语音转换、声码器重建和神经编解码器重合成，且伪造伪影受源语音、录音环境和传输信道等可变性影响，因此跨异构条件的鲁棒泛化成为实用检测系统的核心需求。
Method: 采用简洁的检测器架构，即 Conformer 编码器加多头注意力统计池化和二分类器；不依赖额外架构复杂度，而是通过整合多源数据、攻击与来源平衡采样 (attack- and source-balanced sampling)、以及多样化音频增强的训练配方来提升泛化能力。
Result: 仅用开源数据训练，该系统在 Speech-DF-Arena 的 14 个测试集上获得 pooled EER 1.454%，在排行榜上超过所有当前公开系统；在 5 个单独测试集上取得最低 EER，并与更大的领先系统相比表现出良好的性能-复杂度权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Teffic-Audio 为通用语音深度伪造检测提供了一个强且实用的参考系统，表明训练配方而非架构复杂度是泛化提升的关键。

papers.title: Reflected diffusion, no-flux continuity equations and confined Lagrangian flows in bounded domains
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by marginal distribution flows of reflected diffusions in bounded domains, we investigate when a density/flux pair solving a no-flux continuity equation admits a regular Lagrangian flow that remains in the closed domain and generates the prescribed density flow. We give sufficient conditions in terms of interior bounded-variation regularity, bounded-variation control on a boundary collar, a one-sided bound on an absolutely continuous divergence, and vanishing normal trace of the velocity. The proof uses the fact that tangency removes the singular boundary contribution to the divergence of the zero extension, thereby making the extended velocity admissible for the Ambrosio-DiPerna-Lions theory. We show that these boundary assumptions cannot be jointly relaxed so as to admit a boundary current mechanism. We construct an explicit smooth density/flux pair carrying a boundary current. Its density evolution is unique in a weighted class and its characteristics are unique, confined and transport the marginals, yet it admits no regular Lagrangian flow because the compressibility bound fails arbitrarily close to the initial time. We also establish two uniqueness results for no-flux Fokker-Planck equations: a duality result for bounded measurable drifts and a weighted energy result for entrance-type drifts singular at the boundary. Our results provide a rigorous mathematical justification for using the ODE-based sampling of reflected diffusion models under minimal regularity assumptions on the coefficients, and also indicate when such ODE-based samplers may fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有界区域中反射扩散 (reflected diffusion) 的边际分布流：何时一组满足无通量连续性方程 (no-flux continuity equation) 的密度/通量对能存在一个停留在闭区域内并生成给定密度流的正则拉格朗日流 (regular Lagrangian flow)。作者给出基于内部有界变差正则性、边界 collar 上有界变差控制、绝对连续散度单侧界以及速度法向迹为零的充分条件，并构造携带边界电流 (boundary current) 的显式光滑反例，说明这些边界假设不能联合放松。文章还建立了无通量 Fokker-Planck 方程的两个唯一性结果。
Motivation: 反射扩散的边际分布流在数学理论和采样应用中都很基础；需要严格刻画基于 ODE 的采样方法（通过特征流传输边际分布）成立所需的最小边界正则性条件，并指出这些方法何时会失效。
Method: 利用速度场的切向性消除其零延拓散度中的奇异边界贡献，使延拓后的速度场满足 Ambrosio-DiPerna-Lions 理论的可容许性条件；同时构造显式光滑密度/通量对这一携带边界电流的反例，并通过对偶方法和加权能量方法分别证明两类无通量 Fokker-Planck 方程的唯一性。
Result: 摘要报告：所提充分条件成立时存在正则拉格朗日流；反之，构造的光滑反例其密度演化在加权类中唯一、特征唯一且被限制在闭域内并能传输边际，但由于压缩性界 (compressibility bound) 在初始时刻附近任意近处失效，该反例不存在正则拉格朗日流。此外还得到有界可测漂移的对偶唯一性与边界奇异入口型漂移的加权能量唯一性。
Conclusion: 这些结果在系统系数满足最小正则性假设的条件下，为反射扩散模型的 ODE 采样提供了严格的数学依据，同时表明此类采样器在边界电流机制存在时可能失败。

papers.title: Capturing Token Tendencies for Training-Free Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While visual token pruning is essential for efficient Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing training-free methods suffer from a critical limitation: they rely on static, instantaneous heuristics to perform irreversible filtering. This approach ignores the hierarchical nature of MLLMs, where token importance often evolves dynamically rather than remaining fixed across layers. Consequently, tokens essential for deep-layer reasoning are often prematurely discarded by shallow-layer estimates. To address this, we propose Trend-aware Pruning, a novel framework that elevates pruning from a local snapshot decision to a temporal trajectory modeling problem. Instead of relying on isolated scores, our method captures the momentum of attention flow. This enables a dynamic rectification mechanism that selectively reactivates "late-blooming" tokens, those initially undervalued but exhibiting rising semantic importance, thereby preventing the loss of critical visual cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior efficiency-performance trade-off across diverse multimodal tasks. Notably, it reduces visual tokens by over 77.8%, retaining only approximately 23 tokens in the final layer while maintaining competitive performance, offering a robust and reversible solution for high-efficiency multimodal inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trend-aware Pruning，一种针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的无训练视觉 token 剪枝框架。作者将剪枝从局部快照决策转为时间轨迹建模，通过捕捉注意力流的动量并动态修正，重新激活早期被低估但语义重要性上升的"晚开花" token。实验表明该方法在多模态任务上取得较好的效率-性能权衡。
Motivation: 现有无训练视觉 token 剪枝方法依赖静态、瞬时的启发式分数进行不可逆过滤，忽略了 MLLM 的分层特性：token 重要性往往跨层动态演化而非固定不变，导致深层推理所需的关键 token 被浅层估计过早丢弃。
Method: 提出 Trend-aware Pruning 框架，不以孤立分数为准，而是建模注意力流的动量 (momentum)，并引入动态修正机制选择性重新激活语义重要性上升的"晚开花" (late-blooming) token，从而保留关键视觉线索。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种多模态任务上实现更优的效率-性能权衡，可剪除超过 77.8% 的视觉 token，最终层仅保留约 23 个 token，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 该方法为高效多模态推理提供了一种稳健且可逆的 token 剪枝方案，核心在于将剪枝从瞬时决策升级为对 token 重要性动态演化轨迹的建模。

papers.title: Encryption-Compatible Clustered Federated Learning via Distributed Expectation-Maximization over Metadata
papers.abstract_en: Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) addresses data heterogeneity in federated settings by grouping clients with similar data distributions to enable effective training. Existing methods face a trade-off between privacy preservation, communication cost, and computational efficiency. We formalize this as the CFL trilemma, according to which improving two of these dimensions comes at the expense of the third. A prominent paradigm relies on metadata (i.e., low-dimensional representations of client datasets shared with the server) to enable communication- and computation-efficient clustering. However, such approaches are not compatible with standard FL privacy-preserving mechanisms. To address this limitation, we propose FLAMECHE, which reformulates metadata-based CFL as a distributed Expectation-Maximization (EM) procedure, restricting server updates to additive operations while preserving efficiency. This design enables compatibility with practical secure FL schemes. We conducted extensive experiments on multiple datasets under various heterogeneous scenarios. Results show that FLAMECHE improves the effectiveness of client models. It enables encryption-compatible metadata-based clustering, enhancing its positioning within the CFL trilemma.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FLAMECHE，一种面向加密兼容的聚类联邦学习 (Clustered Federated Learning, CFL) 方法。该方法将基于元数据的 CFL 重新表述为分布式期望最大化 (Expectation-Maximization, EM) 过程，并将服务器端更新限制为加法操作，从而兼容实用安全 FL 方案。在多个数据集上的异构场景实验中，FLAMECHE 提升了客户端模型的有效性，改善了其在隐私、通信成本和计算效率之间的权衡定位。
Motivation: 现有 CFL 方法在隐私保护、通信成本和计算效率之间存在权衡，即 CFL 三难问题 (CFL trilemma)。基于元数据的聚类方法虽然通信和计算高效，但不兼容标准的联邦学习隐私保护机制。
Method: 提出 FLAMECHE，将基于元数据的 CFL 建模为分布式 EM 过程，通过将服务器更新限制为加法操作来保持效率，从而支持加密兼容的元数据聚类。
Result: 在多个数据集和多种异构场景下的实验表明，FLAMECHE 提高了客户端模型的有效性，并实现了加密兼容的元数据聚类。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 FLAMECHE 通过加密兼容的元数据聚类，改善了聚类联邦学习在三难问题中的定位，但未给出具体量化结果或局限性讨论。

papers.title: Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出感知修正蒸馏 (Perception-Correction Distillation, PCD)，用于多模态推理模型的在线策略蒸馏。PCD 将下游失败信号与师生分歧作为互补证据，用二者的乘积构成软 AND 门，只在两个证据同时出现时加强蒸馏。摘要报告该方法在八个基准上显著提升 8B→2B 与 32B→8B 的宏平均性能，并通过消融验证各组件的作用。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏提供稠密监督，但轨迹级奖励无法判断回答失败是源于感知还是后续推理；感知成功率 (PSR) 因低成功率混淆了感知不足与推理难度，仍存在歧义。
Method: 提出 PCD，利用下游失败和师生分歧作为互补证据，二者乘积构成软 AND 门；从贝叶斯证据组合出发，证明乘法是唯一满足任一支柱缺失即归零的归一化双线性门。方法采用分离的感知-推理 rollout 和均值保持权重，不改变推理目标。
Result: 在八个基准上，8B→2B 宏平均从 OPD 的 44.50 提升到 47.28，32B→8B 从 56.94 提升到 61.22；匹配的 2B 消融中，移除 PCD 与分离 rollout 分别使留出集平均下降 2.22 和 0.88 点。
Conclusion: 有效的多模态蒸馏不仅取决于教师预测什么，也取决于识别何时感知才是合适的修正目标。

papers.title: Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 代理作为自主商家撰写商品列表时编造属性、且平台无法逐条核对真实性的问题，提出带死区 (deadband) 的声誉惩罚机制 CARP。CARP 不依赖产品级 ground truth，对噪声投诉信号和策略性博弈具有鲁棒性，能压制低评级撒谎者的销量并保护诚实卖家；配合 SPARC 反射机制后，可在不接触真实信息的情况下缩小与完美信息 oracle 的消费者福利差距。作者通过字节级代码门控反射实验表明，惩罚被行为性地感知：只有当编造带来销售损失时 LLM 商家才会自我约束，这是自利反应而非遵从指令。
Motivation: LLM 代理作为自主商家会为赢得销售而编造产品属性，即使在明确要求诚实的指令下，多数模型的多数列表仍存在编造。平台无法验证每个声明，只能观察到有噪声且有偏的投诉信号，因此需要一种不依赖真实信息的机制来抑制不诚实行为。
Method: 提出 CARP 声誉惩罚机制，包含用于容忍投诉噪声的死区和随状态变化的惩罚严重度，以对抗因声誉检测侵蚀导致的问题；同时提出 SPARC，一种字节干净 (byte-clean) 的代码门控反射机制，使惩罚在行为层面生效。
Result: 实验显示 LLM 商家在撒谎无成本时进行编造，但编造导致销售损失时会自我约束；CARP 配合 SPARC 在不访问真实信息的情况下弥补了与完美信息 oracle 之间的大部分消费者福利差距，并在对比政策中获得最佳福利，且该约束在不同模型上均成立并配有置信区间。
Conclusion: 作者强调这种自我约束是自利反应而非对指令的遵从，并将其归因于惩罚门控的自我修正推理；机制不需要产品级真实信息，对噪声和博弈具有鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same Branches, Different Trees: A Bifurcation Connectedness Metric for Coronary Artery Segmentation and FFR-CT Decision Agreement
papers.abstract_en: Fractional flow reserve derived from CT angiography (FFR-CT) simulates flow through a patient-specific vessel model, so its accuracy depends on the connectedness of the segmented tree, not only on volumetric overlap: a segmentation can reach high Dice yet sever a bifurcation, dropping the downstream subtree and reversing the treatment decision. Topology-aware losses such as clDice and Skeleton Recall act on the global centreline and can miss localised breaks. We study the Bifurcation Connectedness Score (BCS), which scores connectedness at each ground-truth bifurcation, and soft-BCS, its differentiable training surrogate. BCS captures a property of segmentation quality the standard metrics miss: it responds strongly to breaks in connectedness while staying largely unchanged under connectedness-preserving narrowing. Higher BCS accompanies closer agreement between the FFR-CT decisions a solver makes on predicted versus ground-truth geometry, most clearly in severe disease (OR 2.16, CI [1.23, 4.18]). Both decisions come from the same solver, so this reflects geometric, not clinical, fidelity. In training, soft-BCS and Skeleton Recall recover the same branches but build different trees. Recovering branches and keeping them connected are separable properties, so we recommend reporting a measure of each.
papers.comment: Accepted at STACOM 2026 (MICCAI workshop). 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究冠状动脉分割中分叉连通性对 FFR-CT 决策一致性的影响，提出 Bifurcation Connectedness Score (BCS) 及其可微训练代理 soft-BCS。摘要显示 BCS 能捕获标准体素重叠指标（如 Dice）遗漏的局部断支，且高 BCS 与预测/真实几何上 FFR-CT 决策一致性的提高相关（严重病变 OR 2.16）。训练中 soft-BCS 与 Skeleton Recall 能恢复相同分支但构建不同树，表明分支恢复与连通性是可分离性质。
Motivation: FFR-CT 的准确性取决于分割树的连通性而非仅体积重叠：高 Dice 仍可能切断分叉、丢失下游子树并逆转治疗决策；基于全局中心线的拓扑损失（clDice、Skeleton Recall）会漏掉局部断点。
Method: 研究在真实分叉 (ground-truth bifurcation) 处对连通性打分的 Bifurcation Connectedness Score (BCS)，并引入其可微训练代理 soft-BCS，用于训练时优化分叉连通性。
Result: 摘要报告 BCS 对连通性断裂响应强烈，而对保持连通性的管腔狭窄基本不变；高 BCS 与 FFR-CT 在预测与真实几何上的决策一致性更接近，在严重病变中最明显（OR 2.16，CI [1.23, 4.18]）。soft-BCS 与 Skeleton Recall 可恢复相同分支但构建不同树。
Conclusion: 作者认为恢复分支与保持其连通是可分离的性质，建议分别报告两类度量；由于两种决策来自同一求解器，该一致性反映几何保真度而非临床保真度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Distortion in the Empty Regions of Dimensionality Reduction Scatterplots with the Gap Index
papers.abstract_en: Quality metrics play a crucial role in the proper use of dimensionality reduction projections for visual analysis of high-dimensional data. They quantify the degree of distortion of a projection compared to the high-dimensional data and provide a reliable indication of how confident users can be in the structures they see in the resulting layouts. However, most popular metrics focus on capturing direct relationships between points (e.g., distances or neighborhoods) while neglecting distortions in empty areas of the layout, even though these often compose visually relevant features of a 2D layout. In this paper, we introduce the Gap Index (GI), a quality metric for 2D projections that captures visual distortion by measuring spatial distortion in empty areas of a projection. It does so by decomposing the space into empty triangles, which are then compared to their high-dimensional counterparts to compute the deformation. This per-triangle deformation can be aggregated into a single scalar value or overlaid on a projection to visualize regional distortion patterns. Results show that, contrary to popular quality metrics, the GI is sensitive to small structural deformations that have high visual impact. It is also fast to compute and interpretable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gap Index (GI)，一种用于 2D 降维散点图的质量度量，通过度量投影空白区域 (empty areas) 的空间变形来捕捉视觉失真。方法将布局空间分解为空三角形，并与高维空间中的对应三角形比较以计算变形，可聚合为单个标量或覆盖在投影上展示区域失真模式。摘要报告 GI 对具有高视觉影响的小结构变形敏感，且计算快、可解释。
Motivation: 现有流行质量指标大多只关注点之间的直接关系（如距离或邻域），忽略布局空白区域的失真，而这些区域往往构成 2D 布局中视觉上重要的特征。
Method: 将投影平面空间分解为若干空三角形 (empty triangles)，再将每个三角形与其高维空间对应物进行比较，计算逐三角形的变形量，并可聚合成单一标量或叠加显示区域失真模式。
Result: 摘要表明，与流行质量指标不同，GI 对具有高视觉影响的小结构变形敏感，同时计算快速且结果可解释。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GI 补充了现有质量指标对空白区域失真的忽视，为降维投影的可视化分析提供了一种快速且可解释的失真度量方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-partitioned e-detectors for nonparametric sequential change detection
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of sequential change detection over a general class of probability distributions ($\mathcal P$), where both the pre-change and post-change distributions are unknown and belong to $\mathcal P$. We do not assume a pre-specified partition of $\mathcal P$ into pre- and post-change families. We propose a general class of sequential change detectors obtained by aggregating point-null e-processes over possible changepoints and taking an infimum over candidate no-change distributions. The weights in the aggregation scheme determine whether they attain average run length (ARL) control and probability-of-false-alarm (PFA) control. Under suitable assumptions, we prove that our methods achieve first-order asymptotically optimal detection delay. Concrete examples include sub-Gaussian and bounded mean changes, Gaussian mean changes with unknown variance, as well as changes in Markov transition matrices.

papers.title: AdaAnchor4D: Anchor-Conditioned Spatiotemporal Feature Aggregation for Monocular UAV 4D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Monocular UAV videos provide valuable observations for dynamic reconstruction of complex urban scenes. However, such scenes exhibit pronounced spatiotemporal heterogeneity: different regions follow distinct temporal activity patterns, while the motion states of some dynamic regions may further evolve over time. Although dynamic Gaussian methods based on decomposed shared spatiotemporal feature fields have achieved efficient and accurate reconstruction in object-centric or relatively compact scenes, their commonly adopted fixed plane-wise feature combination mechanisms are less suited to the heterogeneous local dynamics of UAV scenes, often leading to ghosting artifacts and blurred dynamic details. To address this challenge, we propose AdaAnchor4D, an adaptive anchor deformation framework for monocular UAV dynamic scene reconstruction. At its core, Anchor-Conditioned Feature Aggregation (ACFA) adaptively aggregates shared spatiotemporal features using anchor-specific aggregation embeddings and temporal information, allowing different local units to obtain dynamic representations tailored to their local and temporal states. Decoupled Local Geometry Deformation (DLGD) separates anchor-state deformation from local Gaussian geometry deformation, while Density-Adaptive Coordinate Warping (DACW) reparameterizes feature-query coordinates according to the axis-wise anchor distributions, alleviating the mismatch between non-uniform geometric sampling and uniform grid parameterization. Experiments on UAV-Arc4D, VisDrone, and UAVDT show that AdaAnchor4D achieves higher rendering quality than representative dynamic Gaussian methods while maintaining real-time rendering performance. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaAnchor4D，一种用于单目无人机动态场景重建的自适应锚点变形框架。该方法针对城市场景中显著的空时异质性（spatiotemporal heterogeneity），通过锚点条件特征聚合、解耦局部几何变形与密度自适应坐标扭曲来改进动态高斯（dynamic Gaussian）方法的固定平面特征组合机制。在 UAV-Arc4D、VisDrone 和 UAVDT 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持实时渲染性能的同时达到更高的渲染质量。
Motivation: 单目无人机视频中的复杂城市场景呈现明显空时异质性，不同区域遵循不同的时间活动模式，且动态区域的运动状态会随时间演变。现有基于分解共享空时特征场的动态高斯方法采用固定平面式特征组合，难以适配无人机场景的局部动态，容易产生鬼影伪影和模糊的动态细节。
Method: 提出自适应锚点变形框架 AdaAnchor4D，核心包括三项技术：Anchor-Conditioned Feature Aggregation (ACFA) 使用锚点特定的聚合嵌入与时序信息自适应聚合共享空时特征；Decoupled Local Geometry Deformation (DLGD) 将锚点状态变形与局部高斯几何变形解耦；Density-Adaptive Coordinate Warping (DACW) 根据逐轴锚点分布对特征查询坐标进行重参数化，缓解非均匀几何采样与均匀网格参数化之间的失配。
Result: 在 UAV-Arc4D、VisDrone 和 UAVDT 数据集上，AdaAnchor4D 相比代表性动态高斯方法获得更高的渲染质量，同时保持实时渲染性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自适应锚点变形与锚点条件特征聚合能够更好地适配无人机场景中异质的局部动态，提升单目动态场景重建质量，并计划公开代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations
papers.abstract_en: This work presents Fairness Pruning, a lightweight structural intervention method designed for the management and future mitigation of demographic bias in large language models (LLMs). As a foundational empirical validation of this method, this work focuses on causal bias localization. Using minimally contrastive prompt pairs and inference-time activation capture, the method identifies neurons that react differentially when processing demographic attributes in GLU architectures, evaluating the signal at the down_proj input. Empirical evaluation was conducted on models of up to 3 billion parameters (Llama-3.2 family and Salamandra-2B), combining standardized benchmark evaluation with qualitative text generation experiments. Results demonstrate that zeroing the identified neurons alters how the model responds to associated demographic variables. However, rather than producing flat mitigation, the intervention causes bidirectional bias destabilization: because BiasScore is unsigned, candidate sets mix neurons that push toward and against the stereotype, and the net effect on aggregate bias depends on which sign dominates. The intervention is extremely surgical: zeroing at most 40 neurons in Llama-3.2-1B (less than 0.031% of total MLP width) achieves a mean retention of 99.49% in reasoning and general knowledge capabilities. These findings empirically confirm that demographic bias processing and model capabilities operate on dissociable circuits, establishing the methodological foundations for transitioning from blind zeroing toward directional behavior modulation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fairness Pruning，一种针对大语言模型（LLM）中人口统计偏置的轻量级结构干预方法，本文侧重其因果偏置定位验证。方法使用最小对比提示对（minimally contrastive prompt pairs）与推理时激活捕获，在 GLU 架构的 down_proj 输入处评估信号，识别对人口统计属性反应差异化的神经元。实验在最高 3B 参数的模型（Llama-3.2 家族与 Salamandra-2B）上进行；结果显示置零识别出的神经元会改变模型对相关人口统计变量的响应，但干预造成双向偏置失稳而非平坦缓解。在 Llama-3.2-1B 上最多置零 40 个神经元（不足总 MLP 宽度的 0.031%）即可保留 99.49% 的推理与通用知识能力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 偏置管理缺乏对偏置在模型中定位的结构性理解，且缺少轻量级、可解释的干预手段；本文目标是建立偏置因果定位的方法论基础，为后续定向偏置缓解做准备。
Method: 提出 Fairness Pruning：利用最小差异的对比提示对进行推理时激活捕获，在 GLU 架构的 down_proj 输入处评估信号，识别对人口统计属性差异响应的神经元，并以将神经元置零的方式实施结构干预。
Result: 摘要报告，置零识别出的神经元会改变模型对相关人口统计变量的响应，但净效果取决于 BiasScore 无符号性质下候选集中推动与对抗刻板印象神经元的符号主导，表现为双向偏置失稳而非平坦缓解；在 Llama-3.2-1B 中最多置零 40 个神经元（<0.031% 的 MLP 宽度）保持 99.49% 的推理与通用知识能力均值保留率。
Conclusion: 这些发现实证确认人口统计偏置处理与模型能力运行在可分离的电路上，为从盲目置零转向方向性行为调制奠定方法论基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PathView-Bench: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Achieve Fine-grained Multiscale Understanding of Pathology Images?
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to analyze pathology images. However, dominant multimodal benchmarks in pathology mainly score final diagnostic answers, captions, or reports. These evaluations provide limited insight into whether a model understands the multiscale visual content needed for pathology reasoning and decision-making. We introduce PathVU, a vision-anchored benchmark for fine-grained and multiscale visual understanding in computational pathology. Built from 23 public pathology imaging datasets with human-supervised labels and spatial annotations, PathVU evaluates MLLM understanding in two fields of view: Region FOV for high-resolution local regions and Slide FOV for macro whole-slide views. By converting raw annotations into deterministic task targets, PathVU enables programmatic scoring of region localization, visual recognition, quantity estimation, spatial reasoning, and insufficient-context judgment. The benchmark contains 14 VQA-style tasks, 61,673 images, and 308,070 samples across 28 organs and 7,253,526 annotations. Evaluating 18 representative general-purpose, medical-domain, and pathology-oriented MLLMs, we observe substantial limitations even in advanced models on fine-grained visual tasks across multiscale pathology images. PathVU provides a reproducible basis for developing and evaluating pathology MLLMs with explicit multiscale visual understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PathVU，一个面向计算病理学中细粒度多尺度视觉理解的视觉锚定基准。PathVU 由 23 个公共病理成像数据集构建，包含 14 个 VQA 风格任务、61,673 张图像和 308,070 个样本，覆盖 28 个器官和 7,253,526 个标注，并在 Region FOV 与 Slide FOV 两种视野下评估模型。对 18 个代表性通用、医学领域和病理导向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的评估显示，即使先进模型在多尺度病理图像的细粒度视觉任务上仍存在显著局限。
Motivation: 现有病理学多模态基准主要对最终诊断答案、字幕或报告进行评分，难以揭示模型是否真正理解病理推理与决策所需的多尺度视觉内容。
Method: PathVU 将原始标注转换为确定性任务目标，通过程序化评分评估区域定位、视觉识别、数量估计、空间推理和不足上下文判断，并分别在局部高分辨率的 Region FOV 与宏观全玻片的 Slide FOV 上测试。
Result: 在 18 个通用、医学领域和病理导向的 MLLM 上评估，观察到即使先进模型在多尺度病理图像的细粒度视觉任务上也有显著能力不足。
Conclusion: PathVU 为开发和评估具备明确多尺度视觉理解的病理 MLLM 提供了可复现的评测基础。

papers.title: One Human, $N$ Agents: Audit-Budget Allocation for LLM Agent Fleets under Miscalibrated, Correlated Confidence
papers.abstract_en: A single human must audit $N$ LLM agents under a budget of $B \ll N$ audits per round, guided by self-reported confidence that may be adversarially miscalibrated and by correlated errors. We model this as budgeted noisy inspection over a two-level Gaussian copula and locate the miscalibration threshold $δ^*$ past which confidence-ranked auditing is \emph{worse} than random. Two a-priori expectations reverse: $δ^*$ \emph{rises} as the budget shrinks, and cross-family correlation is not low---shared difficulty dominates lineage. Five open-weight LLMs show operationally useless (near-constant) confidence, point estimates at or beyond the flip though CIs straddle it; a proprietary model is informative and lands below it. We give a quantitative criterion for \emph{vacuous} oversight, and replaying policies on recorded traces confirms the ordering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单个审计员在预算 B ≪ N 的条件下审计 N 个 LLM 智能体的问题，智能体会给出可能被对抗性误校准 (miscalibrated) 的自报置信度，并且错误之间存在相关性。作者用两层高斯 copula 建模有预算的噪声检查，并定位了置信度排序审计比随机审计更差的误校准阈值 δ*。对五个开放权重 LLM 的实证显示其置信度近乎恒定且操作上无用，而一个专有模型信息量更大并落在阈值之下。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体审计大多依赖自报置信度进行排序，但置信度可能被对抗性误校准且不同智能体的错误相互关联，导致预算分配策略失效；本文要给出在何种误校准程度下置信度排序审计会劣于随机审计的定量判据。
Method: 将审计问题建模为两层高斯 copula 下的有预算噪声检查，推导误校准阈值 δ*，并用记录的轨迹回放策略来验证排序结论，同时用五个开放权重 LLM 与一个专有模型的置信度行为做实证。
Result: 两个先验预期被反转：δ* 随预算缩小而上升，跨家族相关性并不低，共享难度主导血缘关系。开放权重模型给出近乎常数的置信度，点估计位于或超过翻转阈值而置信区间跨越该阈值；专有模型信息充分且落在阈值之下，回放策略确认了排序。
Conclusion: 作者给出判定空洞监督 (vacuous oversight) 的定量标准，表明在误校准和相关性条件下，置信度排序审计可能不如随机审计，审计预算分配需要更稳健的策略。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体审计大多依赖自报置信度进行排序，但置信度可能被对抗性误校准且不同智能体的错误相互关联，导致预算分配策略失效；本文要给出在何种误校准程度下置信度排序审计会劣于随机审计的定量判据。
summary_sections.method: 将审计问题建模为两层高斯 copula 下的有预算噪声检查，推导误校准阈值 δ*，并用记录的轨迹回放策略来验证排序结论，同时用五个开放权重 LLM 与一个专有模型的置信度行为做实证。
summary_sections.result: 两个先验预期被反转：δ* 随预算缩小而上升，跨家族相关性并不低，共享难度主导血缘关系。开放权重模型给出近乎常数的置信度，点估计位于或超过翻转阈值而置信区间跨越该阈值；专有模型信息充分且落在阈值之下，回放策略确认了排序。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者给出判定空洞监督 (vacuous oversight) 的定量标准，表明在误校准和相关性条件下，置信度排序审计可能不如随机审计，审计预算分配需要更稳健的策略。

papers.title: ObjectStream: Latent Objects as Memory Anchors for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires models to continuously retain useful visual evidence before future questions are known. Existing approaches primarily manage the growing visual context according to token importance, temporal redundancy, or segment-level relevance, but rarely organize evidence around objects that persist and evolve over time. Thus, in this paper, we introduce ObjectStream, a training-free framework that treats latent objects as memory anchors for streaming video understanding. ObjectStream induces spatially coherent latent objects directly from frozen Video-LLM representations, links them across frames into persistent anchors, and maintains their histories under a bounded memory budget, without requiring external object detectors or segmentation models. Built on these anchors, ObjectStream preserves three complementary forms of evidence: persistent object histories, transient object changes, and recent visual context. This design enables existing Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over object identities, interactions, and state changes while leaving the underlying model unchanged. Extensive experiments on online streaming and offline long-video benchmarks demonstrate both effectiveness and efficiency. In online streaming evaluation, ObjectStream improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 10.0 points on OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception, while reducing peak GPU mem-ory and TTFT by approximately 50%. On offline long-video benchmarks, it surpasses the full-token baseline while discarding 82.5% of visual tokens. These results highlight latent objects as a practical and effective organizing principle for compact streaming video memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ObjectStream，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的流式视频理解框架，将潜在对象 (latent objects) 作为记忆锚点。它直接从冻结的 Video-LLM 表征中诱导出空间连贯的潜在对象，跨帧链接为持久锚点，并在有界记忆预算下维护其历史，无需外部目标检测器或分割模型。实验表明该方法在在线流式与离线长视频基准上均提升效果与效率。
Motivation: 现有流式视频理解方法主要按 token 重要性、时间冗余或片段相关性管理增长的视觉上下文，很少围绕随时间持续并演化的对象来组织证据，导致模型难以推理对象身份、交互和状态变化。
Method: ObjectStream 从冻结的 Video-LLM 表征中诱导空间连贯的潜在对象，将其跨帧链接为持久锚点，并在有界记忆预算下维护三类互补证据：持久对象历史、瞬时对象变化和近期视觉上下文；底层 Video-LLM 保持不变。
Result: 在在线流式评估中，ObjectStream 使 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception 上提升 10.0 点，同时峰值 GPU 内存和 TTFT 降低约 50%；在离线长视频基准上，它丢弃 82.5% 的视觉 token 仍超越全 token 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调潜在对象可作为紧凑流式视频记忆的一种实用且有效的组织原则，但其适用范围限于视频理解领域，未涉及天气相关任务。

papers.title: Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Query optimization of Basic Graph Patterns (BGP) SPARQL queries over Knowledge Graphs (KG) requires accurate cardinality estimation. Recently published learned estimators outperform statistics- and sampling-based approaches, but share a limitation preventing their adoption in real-world triplestores: they are transductive and require retraining when the underlying graph changes or when applied to new graphs. We present FICE (Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation), the first learned cardinality estimator for BGP queries over KGs that generalizes to entirely unseen graphs (including unseen relations), without any retraining. FICE is a graph neural network (GNN) with two coupled components. First, an encoder GNN over a factor-graph view of the KG produces entity and relation embeddings. We prove that BGP cardinality is a local function of the 2-hop neighborhood around bound terms in this view, motivating the local message-passing encoder. A decoder GNN then composes these embeddings along the join topology of the query to predict log-cardinality. The encoder and decoder are trained jointly, making the embeddings specialized for cardinality estimation. FICE is trained using neighborhood sampling to scale to KGs with millions of triples, and decouples embedding generation from cardinality decoding to enable estimation latency below a millisecond. Compared to learned and non-learned baselines over 10 KGs, FICE reduces the overall median q-error from 13.54 (for the best competitor) to 5.34 and dominates all approaches in tail behavior.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at ISWC 2026. 34 pages, 8 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FICE（Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation），据称是首个针对知识图谱上 BGP SPARQL 查询的完全归纳（fully inductive）学习式基数估计器，可在无需任何重训练的情况下泛化到完全未见过的图，包括未见关系。FICE 是包含编码器与解码器两个耦合组件的图神经网络（GNN）：编码器对知识图谱的因子图视图做局部消息传递，解码器沿查询连接拓扑组合嵌入以预测 log-cardinality。在 10 个知识图谱上，FICE 将整体中位 q-error 从最佳竞品的 13.54 降至 5.34，并在尾部行为上全面占优。
Motivation: 现有学习式基数估计器虽然在精度上优于基于统计和采样的方法，但都是直推式（transductive）的，在图结构变化或迁移到新图时都需要重训练，这一限制阻碍了其在真实 triplestore 中的采用。
Method: FICE 由两个耦合的 GNN 组件构成：编码器 GNN 在知识图谱的因子图视图上生成实体与关系嵌入，作者证明了 BGP 基数在该视图下是绑定项 2 跳邻域的局部函数，从而为局部消息传递提供理论依据；解码器 GNN 再沿查询的连接拓扑组合这些嵌入以预测对数基数。编码器与解码器联合训练，使嵌入专门服务于基数估计；训练采用邻域采样以扩展到数百万三元组的知识图谱，并通过将嵌入生成与基数解码解耦实现亚毫秒级估计延迟。
Result: 在 10 个知识图谱上与学习式及非学习式基线对比，FICE 将整体中位 q-error 从最佳竞品的 13.54 降至 5.34，并在所有方法中主导尾部行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FICE 的完全归纳性质使其无需重训练即可泛化到完全未见图（包括未见关系），同时具备亚毫秒级延迟和百万级三元组的可扩展性；该文是 ISWC 2026 录用论文的扩展版。

papers.title: Beyond Geometric Complementarity: Coherent Overlap in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing
papers.abstract_en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models route each token to multiple experts, suggesting a geometric account of their benefit: co-selected experts should contribute distinct representation directions. Existing evidence often conflates route coherence, candidate quality, and candidate-by-context interaction. We distinguish these quantities using an Expert Subspace Separation Index (ESSI), matched-route residuals, and a prefix-controlled $2\times2$ factorial; frozen-route interventions and a controlled Top-$k$ study assess functional value. Three paired contrasts organize the findings. First, across six MoE architectures, expert subspaces overlap substantially, yet actual routes explain token representations better than matched alternatives. Second, across the 39 factorial cells in OLMoE, Mixtral, and DeepSeek, the selected candidate explains more of the residual representation than the strongest unselected rival in every cell, yet the actual prefix narrows this advantage throughout: all interactions are negative, and every 95% confidence interval lies below zero. Third, this geometric narrowing does not imply functional redundancy: adding later experts improves next-token prediction in 24 of 39 frozen-route comparisons, while the other 15 estimates are inconclusive; a controlled training study also favors Top-2 over Top-1 in all three seeds. We call this joint pattern coherent overlap: routing selects token-relevant experts from a shared geometric neighborhood, while useful multi-expert computation persists without disjoint linear coverage. Separating these quantities clarifies why geometric similarity alone cannot determine redundancy or pruning value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的路由机制，指出现有证据常混淆路由一致性、候选质量和候选-上下文交互三个量，并提出 Expert Subspace Separation Index（ESSI）、匹配路由残差和前缀控制的 2×2 因子设计来区分它们。在六种 MoE 架构中，摘要发现专家子空间高度重叠，但实际路由仍比匹配的替代方案更能解释 token 表示；在 OLMoE、Mixtral、DeepSeek 的 39 个因子单元中，被选候选始终比最强未选对手解释更多残差，但实际前缀在每个单元都缩小了该优势，所有交互均为负且 95% 置信区间低于零。这种几何上的收窄并不等于功能冗余：24/39 的冻结路由比较中增加后置专家改善了下一 token 预测，其余 15 个估计不具结论性，受控训练研究在三个种子中均偏向 Top-2 而非 Top-1。作者将这一联合模式称为 coherent overlap。
Motivation: 现有关于稀疏 MoE 路由收益的解释常假设共选专家应贡献不同的表示方向（几何互补性），但证据中混淆了路由一致性、候选质量与候选-上下文交互，导致无法判断几何相似性是否真正决定冗余或剪枝价值。
Method: 提出三类度量工具：Expert Subspace Separation Index（ESSI）度量专家子空间重叠，匹配路由残差（matched-route residuals）评估路由对表示的贡献，前缀控制的 2×2 因子设计分离候选质量与上下文交互；辅以冻结路由干预（frozen-route interventions）和受控 Top-k 训练研究来评估功能价值。
Result: 摘要报告：六种 MoE 架构中专家子空间实质重叠但实际路由优于匹配替代；39 个因子单元中每个单元的被选候选残差解释力都强于最强未选候选，但真实前缀在所有单元中缩小该差异，所有交互项 95% 置信区间低于零；24/39 的冻结路由比较显示增加后置专家提升下一 token 预测，15 个不具结论性，受控训练在全部三个种子中 Top-2 优于 Top-1。
Conclusion: 作者将联合模式概括为 coherent overlap：路由从共享的几何邻域中选择与 token 相关的专家，同时有用的多专家计算依然存在，并不需要不相交的线性覆盖；因此几何相似性本身不能决定冗余度或剪枝价值，需分离这些量再做判断。

papers.title: From Textual Requirements to Microservice Architectures - A Comprehensive Evaluation of LLM-Based Design Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Microservice architectures have become dominant for modernizing monolithic systems, yet identifying appropriate services remains challenging and largely manual. Existing decomposition approaches are predominantly code-centric, limiting applicability in early design stages where only textual requirements are available. Despite advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), limited empirical evidence exists on their ability to synthesize complete microservice architectures from natural-language requirements, including service definitions and inter-service interactions. This study investigates whether an LLM can bridge requirements engineering and architectural design, generating architectures solely from textual requirements and evaluating structural agreement and perceived quality of results. We conduct a mixed-method study using OpenAI o3 under zero-shot (ZS) and few-shot (FS) prompting across two systems (Bookstore, PetClinic), one execution per system/condition. Architectures are evaluated through (i) comparison with reference architectures using precision, recall, and F1-score for service identification and communication recovery, and (ii) a blinded expert assessment of correctness, completeness, modularity, and plausibility, plus open feedback synthesis. OpenAI o3 identifies services with higher agreement under FS prompting (F1 = 0.79 for ZS versus = 0.97 for FS). Communication recovery is more challenging: ZS produces dense architectures with high recall but low precision (F1 = 0.61), while FS improves agreement, reaching F1 = 0.82 and reducing unsupported dependencies. Expert evaluation corroborates these results, with FS architectures perceived as more modular, coherent, and plausible than ZS outputs. OpenAI o3 shows potential for requirements-driven synthesis when guided by exemplar prompting. Results are model- and context-specific from two small systems, not model-independent proof.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型 (LLM) 能否仅从自然语言需求生成微服务架构，包括服务定义与服务间交互。作者使用 OpenAI o3 在零样本 (ZS) 和少样本 (FS) 提示下对 Bookstore 与 PetClinic 两个系统各执行一次，通过结构化指标（精确率、召回率、F1）和盲审专家评估对比参考架构。结果显示 FS 提示显著提升服务识别一致性 (F1 从 0.79 升至 0.97) 和通信恢复 (F1 从 0.61 升至 0.82)，专家也认为 FS 输出更模块化、更连贯、更合理。
Motivation: 微服务架构虽已成为系统现代化主流，但服务识别仍主要依赖代码，难以在只有文本需求的早期设计阶段使用；同时 LLM 从需求直接合成完整微服务架构的实证证据有限。
Method: 采用混合方法研究：用 OpenAI o3 在零样本和少样本两种提示条件下，对两个系统分别运行一次；将生成架构与参考架构比较（服务识别和通信恢复的精确率、召回率、F1），并邀请盲审专家对正确性、完整性、模块性和合理性进行评分及开放式反馈。
Result: 少样本提示下服务识别 F1 为 0.97（零样本为 0.79）；通信恢复从零样本的 F1 = 0.61（高召回低精确）提升到少样本的 F1 = 0.82，并减少不支持的依赖。专家评估同样认为 FS 架构更模块化、连贯且合理。

papers.title: A Distributed Acoustic Sensing Dataset for Vessel Detection and Localization in Submarine Cable Protection
papers.abstract_en: Recent incidents of accidental damage and suspected sabotage to submarine telecommunication and power cables, particularly in the Baltic Sea, have underscored their vulnerability and the need for continuous monitoring solutions. Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) applied to submarine optical-fiber cables enables wide-area monitoring of underwater acoustic activity. We present the Marlinks-NS DAS dataset, comprising processed submarine DAS measurements and AIS-derived vessel information curated for cable-protection research. The dataset defines two machine-learning tasks (vessel detection and vessel-to-cable distance estimation) allowing reproducible research under realistic marine conditions. The dataset contains 74,771 labeled data instances from ten days of continuous recording along a 2,554 m segment in a 28 km buried fiber-optic cable in the North Sea. Each instance includes spectral-energy features from 250 sensing channels, together with anonymized distance measurements and metadata from AIS information. The released HDF5 data, documentation, processing description, and example code support reproducible development and evaluation of DAS-based vessel-monitoring methods for submarine cable protection.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to be considered for publication as a Data Descriptor in the Scientific Data Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Marlinks-NS DAS 数据集，用于海底电缆保护场景下的船只检测与定位。数据集基于北海一条 28 km 埋地光缆中 2,554 m 段的十天连续记录，包含 74,771 个标注实例，每个实例由 250 个传感通道的谱能量特征以及来自 AIS 的匿名距离测量和元数据构成。文章定义了船只检测与船只到电缆距离估计两个机器学习任务，并随数据发布 HDF5 文件、文档、处理说明和示例代码。
Motivation: 近期波罗的海等海域的海底通信与电力电缆遭受意外损坏和疑似蓄意破坏，凸显了持续监测的需求。分布式声学传感 (DAS) 可用于海底光缆的大范围水下声学活动监测，但缺少为电缆保护研究整理的标准数据集。
Method: 作者构建了 Marlinks-NS DAS 数据集，将处理后的海底 DAS 测量数据与 AIS 船只信息相结合，定义了船只检测和船只到电缆距离估计两个机器学习任务，并提供了可复现开发与评估所需的数据格式、文档、处理流程描述和示例代码。
Result: 数据集包含来自 2,554 m 电缆段的十天连续记录，共 74,771 个带标签数据实例，每个实例包含 250 个传感通道的谱能量特征以及匿名的 AIS 距离测量和元数据。
Conclusion: 论文强调该数据集支持在真实海洋条件下对基于 DAS 的船只监测方法进行可复现的开发与评估，服务于海底电缆保护。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is transforming molecular sciences by accelerating property prediction, simulation, and the discovery of new molecules and materials. Acquiring labeled data in these domains is often costly and time-consuming, whereas large collections of unlabeled molecular data are readily available. Standard semi-supervised learning methods often rely on label-preserving augmentations, which are challenging to design in the molecular domain, where minor changes can drastically alter properties. In this work, we show that semi-supervised methods that rely on an ensemble consensus can boost predictive accuracy across a diverse range of molecular datasets, task types, and graph neural network architectures. We find that training with an ensemble consensus objective increases robustness in models and exhibits an effect similar to knowledge distillation; an individual member of an ensemble trained this way outperforms a full ensemble trained in a traditional supervised fashion in almost all cases. In addition, this type of semi-supervised training reduces calibration error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子图上的半监督学习，提出利用集成共识 (ensemble consensus) 目标而非依赖标签保持增强的方法。作者在多种分子数据集、任务类型和图神经网络架构上验证，发现该目标能提升预测精度、增强模型鲁棒性，并产生类似知识蒸馏的效果；几乎在所有情况下，集成中单个成员都优于传统全监督训练的完整集成，同时降低校准误差。
Motivation: 分子科学中标注数据获取成本高而大量未标注分子数据易得；标准半监督方法依赖标签保持增强 (label-preserving augmentations)，而分子域中微小改动可能显著改变性质，难以设计此类增强。
Method: 提出基于集成共识的半监督训练目标，在分子图上跨数据集、任务类型和图神经网络架构进行系统验证，并考察该目标对鲁棒性、蒸馏效应和校准误差的影响。
Result: 集成共识目标可提升多类分子数据集上的预测精度；相比传统全监督训练的完整集成，几乎在所有情形下单个集成成员能取得更好性能，即表现出类似知识蒸馏的效果，同时降低校准误差。
Conclusion: 作者认为不依赖增强的集成共识半监督方法是分子图标注稀缺场景下的有效途径，兼具精度、鲁棒性与校准收益。

papers.title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip large language models (LLMs) with domain knowledge for high-performance computing (HPC) tasks such as data race detection and benchmark question answering. However, knowledge alone does not guarantee task-appropriate behavior: the same SFT model that correctly classifies 88.65\% of C/C++ data race samples produces verbose, imprecise answers to factual queries, with 65.9\% of MLPerf responses exceeding 40 characters. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training addresses this gap by optimizing for task-specific rewards rather than token-level imitation. Yet HPC tasks exhibit extreme heterogeneity, with binary classification, factual QA, and semantic generation differing by 58x in answer length, spanning three distinct reward distributions, and showing widely varying SFT accuracy. This makes uniform-weight RL methods such as GRPO suboptimal. We propose HARGO, Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization, which introduces per-response importance weighting via confidence-modulated advantage: computing a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast and a confidence signal from reference model log-probabilities, then modulating the advantage before computing per-response weights, without requiring task-type labels. Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieves the best performance on all three primary metrics: WinRate 54.62\%, Data Race F1 91.30\%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558. Ablation confirms complementary contributions from both signals. HARGO establishes the best overall alignment quality among compared methods for heterogeneous HPC tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HARGO（Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization），一种面向 HPC 任务上 LLM RL 后训练的奖励引导优化方法。它针对 HPC 任务在答案长度、奖励分布和 SFT 精度上的高度异质性，通过置信度调制的 advantage 实现逐响应重要性加权，无需任务类型标签。在四个 HPC 任务上与九种方法对比，HARGO 在 WinRate、Data Race F1 和 PLP Similarity 三项主要指标上均取得最好结果。
Motivation: SFT 虽能为 LLM 注入 HPC 领域知识，但知识不足以保证任务适配行为，例如同一模型在数据竞争检测上准确率高却对事实性问答给出冗长不精确的回答。HPC 任务高度异质，答案长度相差 58 倍、跨越三种奖励分布且 SFT 精度差异大，导致 GRPO 等均匀权重 RL 方法次优。
Method: 提出 HARGO，通过置信度调制的 advantage 引入逐响应重要性加权：用组级奖励对比计算判别信号，用参考模型 log-probabilities 计算置信度信号，并在计算逐响应权重前对 advantage 进行调制，整个过程不需要任务类型标签。
Result: 在四个 HPC 任务和九种方法的对比中，HARGO 在全部三项主要指标上取得最佳：WinRate 54.62%、Data Race F1 91.30%、PLP Similarity 0.8558；消融实验确认两个信号具有互补贡献。
Conclusion: HARGO 在异构 HPC 任务上建立了相比所比较方法最好的整体对齐质量，摘要未提及对通用或非 HPC 领域的推广性。

papers.title: MonoVoc: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Lightweight Monocular Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Open vocabulary 3D scene understanding is essential for next-generation interactive systems, empowering users to intuitively query and navigate reconstructed environments using natural language. However, current 3D Gaussian frameworks are often bottlenecked by restrictive multiview capture requirements, costly scene-specific optimization, and the massive memory overhead of storing dense language features. We present a novel, training-free pipeline that fundamentally reimagines this paradigm by explicitly decoupling 3D geometric reconstruction from semantic integration. Given a standard monocular video sequence as input, our method efficiently outputs a compact, highly interpretable, and fully searchable object-level semantic Gaussian map. Rather than entangling heavy language embeddings within the mapping loop, we extract geometry independently and ground semantics through a lightweight, modular post-processing framework. Extensive evaluations on the Replica dataset demonstrate that this decoupled architecture preserves strong rendering fidelity and competitive segmentation accuracy. Crucially, by replacing dense per-Gaussian storage with modular, object-level semantic embeddings, our approach delivers an order-of-magnitude reduction in memory usage compared to SOTA baselines. This provides a highly efficient, scalable, and practical solution for open-vocabulary 3D retrieval and question answering directly from everyday monocular video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MonoVoc，一种无需训练的轻量级单目开放词汇 3D 场景理解管线，将几何重建与语义集成显式解耦。给定单目视频序列，方法输出紧凑、可解释且可搜索的对象级语义高斯图 (object-level semantic Gaussian map)，用模块化对象级语义嵌入替代稠密的逐高斯语言特征存储。在 Replica 数据集上的实验表明，该架构在保持渲染保真度和有竞争力的分割精度的同时，相比 SOTA 基线实现了数量级的内存降低。
Motivation: 现有 3D 高斯框架常受限于多视角采集要求、昂贵的场景专属优化以及稠密语言特征带来的巨大内存开销，难以直接用于日常单目视频的开放词汇 3D 理解。
Method: 将 3D 几何重建与语义集成解耦：独立提取几何，并通过轻量级模块化后处理框架完成语义接地 (semantic grounding)；以对象级语义嵌入替换密集的每高斯存储，形成训练无关 (training-free) 的端到端管线。
Result: 在 Replica 数据集上的评估显示，该方法能保持较强的渲染保真度和有竞争力的分割精度，同时相比 SOTA 基线在内存使用上实现数量级 (order-of-magnitude) 的降低。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种解耦架构为直接从普通单目视频进行开放词汇 3D 检索和问答提供了一种高效、可扩展且实用的解决方案。
