papers.title: Filling the Pareto-Optimal Front for Affordance Segmentation on Embedded Devices Using RGB-D Cameras
papers.abstract_en: While depth sensors have the potential to complement RGB data for affordance segmentation in wearable robots, their usage seems to remain underexplored. The paper proposes two approaches: a reformulated version of hardware-aware neural architecture search, endowed with a newly designed search space to integrate depth (D) information into small-sized deep networks, and a dedicated fine-tuning approach, including a preprocessing layer to merge depth information with RGB data and make it compatible with conventional architectures. In both cases, those methods aim to generate solutions that benefit from modern (portable) hardware accelerators and overcome existing tiny-like approaches, which often fail to tackle critical scenarios due to the severe constraints set by the supporting hardware. Extensive experiments on a pair of real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method as compared with existing solutions. The approach presented in the paper generates, in most cases, solutions that identify the Pareto optimal front to balance generalization performance and hardware requirements. The paper also describes the supporting prototype, including a Jetson Nano board and a RealSense RGB-D camera. When considering the energy profile of the device, the overall system can attain real-time performances within an energy budget that is compatible with standard batteries, such as those used in smartphones.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向可穿戴机器人中的 affordance segmentation（可供性分割）任务，提出两种利用深度信息的方法：一种重构的硬件感知神经架构搜索（hardware-aware NAS），配有专门设计的搜索空间以将深度（D）信息集成到小型深度网络中；另一种专用微调方法，通过预处理层将深度信息与 RGB 数据融合，使其兼容常规架构。在两个真实数据集上的实验表明该方法相比现有方案有效，并且多数情况下生成的解能识别出平衡泛化性能与硬件需求的 Pareto 最优前沿。论文还描述了基于 Jetson Nano 与 RealSense RGB-D 相机的原型系统，在能量受限时可达到实时性能。
Motivation: 深度传感器有潜力为可穿戴机器人中的 affordance segmentation 补充 RGB 数据，但这一方向仍未得到充分探索；现有类 tiny 方法因支撑硬件的严苛约束，常常无法应对关键场景。
Method: 提出两条技术路线：一是重构硬件感知神经架构搜索，并设计新搜索空间将深度信息引入小型深度网络；二是专用微调方法，包含一个预处理层将深度信息与 RGB 合并，使常规架构也能利用深度数据。二者都旨在受益于现代便携式硬件加速器。
Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的大量实验显示，所提方法优于现有解决方案；在多数情况下生成的解能识别 Pareto 最优前沿，以平衡泛化性能与硬件需求。采用 Jetson Nano 和 RealSense RGB-D 相机的原型系统在能量预算内可实现实时性能，能耗与智能手机常用电池兼容。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法生成的解在大多数情况下落在 Pareto 最优前沿上，兼顾泛化性能与硬件需求；整体系统能在与智能手机电池兼容的能耗预算内实现实时运行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in dynamic financial environments face a critical challenge: maintaining factual accuracy as market conditions, regulations, and corporate facts change continuously. While 4-bit quantization enables efficient deployment, it severely limits the viability of sequential memory editing: existing methods undergo catastrophic performance degradation under this "quantization stability crisis." We introduce CACHE-UK (Contextual Adaptive Continual Hybrid Editor for UK Finance), a stability-aware memory editing framework specifically designed for domain-specific, quantized LLMs. CACHE-UK integrates three components: a rank-1 LoRA perturbation mechanism that confines edits to the low-rank adapter subspace, a financial domain prioritization module for content-adaptive edit strength, and a closed-loop Stability Controller that tracks "degradation debt" to prevent catastrophic forgetting across sequential updates. Evaluated on a 4-bit quantized OpenLLaMA-3B model with a curated UK financial corpus of 88,021 documents, CACHE-UK reduces knowledge degradation by 11-17% relative to adapted baselines under identical 4-bit constraints -- its most robust effect -- while attaining the highest test success (generalization) rate observed in our setting (28%, a 6 percentage point improvement over the strongest adapted baseline). These results indicate that stability-aware editing can improve factual maintenance in resource-constrained financial LLM deployments, though absolute generalization rates remain low.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CACHE-UK，一个面向 4-bit 量化金融领域 LLM 的稳定性感知记忆编辑框架，以解决顺序编辑中出现的“量化稳定性危机”。框架结合 rank-1 LoRA 扰动、金融领域优先级模块和闭环稳定性控制器，在 4-bit 量化 OpenLLaMA-3B 和 88,021 篇英国金融语料上，将知识退化相对降低 11-17%，并将最高测试成功率提升至 28%。
Motivation: 动态金融环境中市场条件、法规和公司事实持续变化，LLM 需要不断更新事实知识；而 4-bit 量化虽利于部署，却使现有顺序记忆编辑方法发生严重性能退化，这一“量化稳定性危机”限制了量化模型在金融领域的可用性。
Method: CACHE-UK 包含三个组件：秩为 1 的 LoRA 扰动机制将编辑限制在低秩适配器子空间内；金融领域优先级模块根据内容自适应调整编辑强度；闭环稳定性控制器通过跟踪“退化债务”(degradation debt) 来防止顺序更新中的灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在 4-bit 量化 OpenLLaMA-3B 模型与 88,021 篇英国金融语料上，CACHE-UK 相对于受约束的基线将知识退化降低 11-17%，并取得最高的测试成功率 28%，比最强自适应基线高出 6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为稳定性感知编辑能改善资源受限金融 LLM 部署中的事实维护，但强调绝对泛化率仍偏低，表明该方向仍需进一步改进。

papers.title: Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3
papers.abstract_en: ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and game-over frames. From this structured history, an agent can model, test, plan with, repair, or bypass a free-form executable hypothesis. In one matched public-set run per policy, we compare four orchestration policies on all 25 public games using Claude Opus 4.8 under matched inference budgets. Actor-requested delegation to a model builder obtains the highest observed mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), 88.49. With this selected policy, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 both reach 100.00 RHAE and complete all 183 levels. Their game-balanced first-run human-replay midranks are 98.5 and 100.0. Opus 5 uses 61% fewer scored actions than the aggregate official human baselines. Automatic repair after verification failures produces models that reproduce observed transitions much more accurately, yet reaches only 83.07 RHAE. Transition match indicates whether a simulator reproduces observed dynamics, not whether it has identified the objective or improves the next action. Strong play also requires deciding when to construct, repair, use, or bypass a model. We call this joint problem active abstraction: generating a testable model from costly interaction and deciding when acquiring or using it is worth its cost.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 18 figures, 17 tables. Open-source implementation: https://github.com/NIMI-research/Tycho
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tycho，一个面向 ARC-AGI-3 交互式技能获取任务的编码智能体系统，将环境形式化为参数化的确定性 Moore 机，并从交互历史中区分可操作观察与动画、过关、游戏结束帧。系统在 25 个公开游戏上用 Claude Opus 4.8 在匹配推理预算下对比四种编排策略，发现由智能体请求委托给模型构建者的策略取得最高平均相对人类动作效率（RHAE）88.49；选定该策略后，GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Opus 5 均达到 100.00 RHAE 并完成全部 183 关。作者将生成可检验模型及其成本权衡这一联合问题称为主动抽象（active abstraction）。
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3 将抽象问题转化为交互式的技能获取问题，玩家需要在每一步动作都影响效率的条件下推断未知游戏的规则、隐藏状态与目标；现有方法缺少对何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型的系统决策。
Method: Tycho 把环境建模为参数化渲染的确定性 Moore 机，分离可操作观察与各类中间帧，并基于结构化历史对自由形式的可执行假设进行建模、测试、规划、修复或绕过；论文比较了四种编排策略，其中动作者请求委托给模型构建者是关键机制。
Result: 动作者请求委托策略取得最高观测平均 RHAE 88.49；采用该策略后 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Opus 5 均达到 100.00 RHAE 并通关全部 183 关，首次运行的人类回放中位排名分别为 98.5 与 100.0，其中 Opus 5 比官方人类基线合计少用 61% 的计分动作。自动修复虽然使模型对观测转移的重现更准确，但 RHAE 仅达 83.07。
Conclusion: 作者强调转移匹配只能说明模拟器复现了观测动态，并不代表识别出目标或提升下一步动作；强玩法还需要决定何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型，这个联合问题即主动抽象。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Visual Ambiguity: Guiding Robust Monocular Depth Estimation in Challenging Scenarios via Detailed Long Captions
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) faces challenges with non-Lambertian surfaces and adverse weather conditions due to the visual ambiguities inherent in single-image limited information. Existing works address them in isolation via image inpainting or augmentation, yielding limited robustness gains. Language, as a powerful complementary modality to vision, is demonstrated to enhance the visual perception capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) via detailed long captions. However, prior language-integrated MDE methods fail to fully harness this potential due to short text input with limited information, coarse global text feature learning, and limited language guidance during depth decoding. To address these limitations, we propose CapDepth, a novel framework for robust MDE that leverages guidance from detailed long captions to alleviate visual ambiguities in both challenging scenarios. First, we design a detailed long caption input template that explicitly conveys rich spatial relationships among multiple atom sentences. Second, a dynamic caption encoder is introduced to extract fine-grained depth-relevant text features via progressive masked attention. Finally, we propose a text-adaptive decoder that guides enhanced depth decoding with text features via stable adaptive layer normalization. Extensive experiments validate the efficacy of CapDepth, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving depth error reductions of 25.0% on non-Lambertian surfaces and 22.0% under adverse weather conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CapDepth，一种利用详细长描述 (detailed long captions) 引导单目深度估计 (MDE) 的框架，用于缓解非朗伯表面和恶劣天气等挑战性场景中的视觉歧义。方法包含长描述输入模板、动态字幕编码器和文本自适应解码器，实验表明其在非朗伯表面深度误差降低 25.0%、恶劣天气条件下降低 22.0%，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 单目深度估计在单图像信息有限时对非朗伯表面和恶劣天气存在视觉歧义，现有工作分别依赖图像修复或数据增强处理，鲁棒性收益有限；先前语言集成 MDE 方法受限于短文本输入、粗粒度全局文本特征学习以及深度解码阶段语言引导不足。
Method: CapDepth 框架包含三个部分：一是详细长描述输入模板，通过多个原子句子显式传达空间关系；二是动态字幕编码器 (dynamic caption encoder)，用渐进掩码注意力提取细粒度深度相关文本特征；三是文本自适应解码器，通过稳定自适应层归一化 (adaptive layer normalization) 利用文本特征引导深度解码。
Result: 摘要报告 CapDepth 在多个基准上超过现有最先进方法，实现非朗伯表面深度误差降低 25.0%，恶劣天气条件下深度误差降低 22.0%。
Conclusion: 作者认为详细长描述作为视觉的补充模态，能够有效缓解挑战性场景中的视觉歧义并提升单目深度估计的鲁棒性。

papers.title: (Towards) Scalable Reliable Automated Evaluation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the quality and relevance of textual outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging and resource-intensive. Existing automated metrics often fail to capture the complexity and variability inherent in LLM-generated outputs. Moreover, these metrics typically rely on explicit reference standards, limiting their use mostly to domains with objective benchmarks. This work introduces a novel evaluation framework designed to approximate expert-level assessments of LLM-generated content. The proposed method employs pairwise comparisons of outputs by multiple LLMs, reducing biases from individual models. An Elo rating system is used to generate stable and interpretable rankings. Adjustable agreement thresholds, from full unanimity to majority voting, allow flexible control over evaluation confidence and coverage. The method's effectiveness is demonstrated through evaluating competency profiles extracted from scientific abstracts. Preliminary results show that automatically derived rankings correlate well with expert judgments, significantly reducing the need for extensive human intervention. By offering a scalable, consistent, and domain-agnostic evaluation layer, the framework supports more efficient and reliable quality assessments of LLM outputs across diverse applications.
papers.comment: 17 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the Fourth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM2) at ACL 2025
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fourth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM2), pages 320-336, Association for Computational Linguistics, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向 LLM 文本输出的可扩展自动评估框架：由多个 LLM 对输出进行两两比较以降低单模型偏差，用 Elo 评分系统生成稳定且可解释的排名，并通过从全体一致到多数投票的可调一致性阈值来控制评估置信度与覆盖率。作者在从科学摘要中提取的能力画像 (competency profiles) 上验证该框架，初步结果显示自动排名与专家判断高度相关，同时显著减少人工介入。
Motivation: 现有自动评估指标难以捕捉 LLM 生成输出的复杂性与变异性，且通常依赖显式参考标准，仅限于存在客观基准的领域，缺乏可扩展且与领域无关的评估手段。
Method: 采用多个 LLM 对输出进行成对比较，借助 Elo 评分系统将比较结果转化为稳定的归一化排名；通过可调的一致性阈值（从完全一致到多数投票）灵活控制评估的置信度与覆盖率。
Result: 在科学摘要能力画像上的初步实验表明，自动生成的排名与专家判断相关性良好，并显著减少了对大量人工评估的依赖。

papers.title: MSCM-net: A hyperspectral image classiffcation method based on multi-scale convolution and Mamba
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral imaging is widely used in remote sensing and engineering. Therefore, research on its classification methods is crucial. While CNN and Transformer-based methods have advanced, they still face locality constraints and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose an innovative hyperspectral image classification model, MSCM-net. Specifically, first of all, a model architecture combining multi-scale CNN and Mamba is proposed. It consists of a multi-scale feature extraction module (MCSE) and multiple stacked Mamba blocks, which integrates the local feature extraction capability of multi-scale CNN and the long sequence modeling advantage of Mamba. Secondly, the proposed MCSE module consists of multi-scale convolution and SENet. Convolution kernels of different scales extract local information with different receptive fields, enhancing the fusion of spatial and spectral information. Meanwhile, the SENet enables the model to automatically learn the importance of each channel in the multi-scale features. Furthermore, we also propose a dual-branch feature aggregation module, which further effectively extracts and integrates the spectral information contained in the central pixel and the spatial information in the surrounding pixels. Our model has undergone numerous experiments on three widely used benchmark datasets. The experimental results show that MSCM-net can achieve advanced classification performance while reducing computational complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MSCM-net，一种结合多尺度卷积与 Mamba 的高光谱图像分类模型。模型由多尺度特征提取模块（MCSE）和多个堆叠的 Mamba 块组成，并配有双分支特征聚合模块；在三个常用基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法能在降低计算复杂度的同时取得先进的分类性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 CNN 和 Transformer 的高光谱图像分类方法分别存在局部感受野限制和高计算复杂度的问题，难以同时兼顾局部特征提取与长序列建模。
Method: 提出 MCSE 模块，利用不同尺度的卷积核提取不同感受野的局部信息，并结合 SENet 自动学习多尺度特征中各通道的重要性；多尺度 CNN 与 Mamba 结合以融合局部特征提取与长序列建模；另设计双分支特征聚合模块，分别提取中心像素的光谱信息与周围像素的空间信息。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的高光谱基准数据集上进行了大量实验，摘要报告 MSCM-net 能够实现先进的分类性能，同时降低计算复杂度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多尺度 CNN 与 Mamba 的混合架构以及双分支聚合机制可有效提升高光谱图像分类的精度与效率。

papers.title: MORFES: A Benchmark for Productive Inflectional Competence in Modern Greek
papers.abstract_en: Modern Greek is a richly inflected language, yet the language models built for it are evaluated mainly on factual knowledge, and no benchmark is dedicated to their inflectional competence. We introduce MORFES (Morphological Open-class Recognition-and-Formation Evaluation Suite), a benchmark of 500 expert-verified items that tests the recognition and production of Greek inflected forms, favoring lower-frequency lemmas so that a correct answer reflects the rule rather than a memorized form. We make it publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/KIEFERSA/MORFES. We evaluate a range of open language models on MORFES, situating them within the rapidly scaling open-weight ecosystem from LLaMA to Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Magistral, and Kimi K2, where multilingual coverage grows but grammatical competence in morphologically rich languages remains under-measured. Among them, Sophea-Genesis-1, a model we developed and release as open weights at https://huggingface.co/KIEFERSA/Sophea-Genesis-1, leads on inflectional morphology while matching similarly sized models in general capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MORFES（Morphological Open-class Recognition-and-Formation Evaluation Suite），一个用于评估现代希腊语屈折能力的基准，包含 500 个专家验证的题目，涵盖屈折形式的识别与产出，并偏向低频率词元以考察规则而非记忆。作者在多个开源语言模型上评测该基准，并发布了在此任务上领先的模型 Sophea-Genesis-1。
Motivation: 现代希腊语是屈折丰富的语言，但面向它的语言模型评测主要关注事实知识，缺少专门的屈折能力基准；同时多语言覆盖增长迅速，而形态丰富语言的语法能力仍未被充分测量。
Method: 构建包含 500 个专家验证题目的 MORFES 基准，测试希腊语屈折形式的识别与产出，并有意选择低频率词元。作者还开发并开源了在屈折形态学上表现领先的模型 Sophea-Genesis-1。
Result: 摘要报告在 LLaMA 到 Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1、Magistral、Kimi K2 等开源模型中，Sophea-Genesis-1 在屈折形态学任务上领先，同时在通用能力上匹配相近规模的模型。
Conclusion: 作者强调形态丰富语言中的语法能力仍缺乏评测，并公开了 MORFES 基准与 Sophea-Genesis-1 模型权重。

papers.title: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving past experiences has become a common strategy to enhance large language model agents. However, most existing memory-augmented agents treat retrieved experiences as static records to be replayed verbatim, injecting them into the context regardless of whether they align with the agent's current situation. This ``replay'' paradigm ignores the gap between the abstract, general nature of stored experience and the concrete, ever-changing states encountered at decision time, frequently causing negative transfer. In contrast, humans rarely recall past experiences verbatim; instead, they reorganize and adapt retrieved memories to fit the present context. Inspired by this, we propose MemHarness, a framework that equips LLM agents to actively harness and reconstruct past experiences based on the present context. At each decision step, a unified policy model critiques and reconstructs the retrieved experience conditioned on the current state, producing context-grounded guidance before acting. This reconstructive ability emerges naturally through end-to-end training with GRPO. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that MemHarness substantially outperforms pure RL and static memory-augmented baselines, demonstrating strong robustness in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Furthermore, our analyses reveal that this reconstruction objective not only prevents negative transfer but also serves as latent guidance during training, fundamentally improving the agent's intrinsic reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemHarness，一个让 LLM agent 根据当前情境主动重构检索到的经验而非逐字重放记忆的框架。在每个决策步骤，一个统一的策略模型（unified policy model）以当前状态为条件，对检索到的经验进行批判（critique）和重构（reconstruct），生成与上下文对齐的指导后再行动，并通过 GRPO 端到端训练获得该能力。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明，MemHarness 显著优于纯 RL 和静态记忆增强基线，并在分布外（OOD）场景中保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强 agent 将检索到的经验视为静态记录直接重放到上下文中，忽略了存储经验的抽象一般性与决策时具体、动态状态之间的差距，常导致负迁移。作者借鉴人类回忆时会重组和改编记忆而非逐字复述的机制，试图让记忆检索更好地适配当前决策情境。
Method: 提出 MemHarness 框架：在每个决策步骤，统一的策略模型基于当前状态批判并重构检索到的经验，产出情境化的指导后再行动；这种重构能力通过 GRPO 进行端到端训练自然涌现，而不是依靠显式人工规则。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，MemHarness 大幅优于纯 RL 和静态记忆增强基线，并在 OOD 场景中表现出强鲁棒性。分析还表明，重构目标不仅能防止负迁移，还能在训练过程中充当潜在指导（latent guidance），从根本上提升 agent 的内在推理能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调记忆应被重构而非重放，重构目标既缓解了负迁移，又作为训练时的潜在指导增强 agent 的推理能力。摘要未报告具体量化数值或局限性的讨论。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Agentic Method for Deterministic Validation of Legacy Code Migration
papers.abstract_en: Migration of legacy COBOL programs to Java requires extensive testing to ensure correct functionality. This effort is often complicated by the lack of test data and the difficulty of validating all corner cases. In this paper we propose a novel agentic test-synthesis method, the "Locksmith Loop," which is initiated by preparing two runtime environments: the COBOL source and the generated Java target are each instrumented with mocks and executed off-mainframe on commodity hardware, then an iterative agentic loop performs Witness Search over input mocks to penetrate program branches, followed by parity-preserving mutations. When routing boundaries are reached, an analyzer identifies a Locked Paragraph: a condition preventing deeper exploration. Across three COBOL-Java case studies, spanning two open-source programs and one internal production-like COBOL program and ranging from 430 to 4,114 source lines, Locksmith consistently improved coverage beyond input-search plateaus, reaching nearly complete coverage on the two open-source programs and 91.90% branch coverage on the internal production-like COBOL program. The generated Java matched the COBOL reference under deterministic parity checks in all accepted test cases. Through these findings we demonstrate, to the best of our knowledge, a novel approach for validating agentic coding output using a deterministic oracle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Locksmith Loop 的代理式测试合成方法，用于验证遗留 COBOL 程序到 Java 的迁移正确性。该方法先在非大型机环境对 COBOL 源程序与生成的 Java 目标程序分别进行 mock 插桩执行，再通过迭代代理循环对输入 mock 进行 Witness Search 以穿透程序分支，并执行保持奇偶性（parity-preserving）的变异；当遇到路由边界时，分析器识别出阻止深入探索的 Locked Paragraph。在三个 COBOL-Java 案例（两个开源程序和一个内部生产类程序，规模 430 至 4,114 行源码）中，Locksmith 持续超越输入搜索的平台期，在两个开源程序上接近完全覆盖，内部生产类程序达到 91.90% 分支覆盖，且所有被接受测试用例中生成的 Java 在确定性奇偶性检查下与 COBOL 参考一致。
Motivation: 遗留 COBOL 程序迁移到 Java 需要大量测试来确保功能正确，而测试数据缺乏以及所有边界情况难以验证使这一工作复杂化。
Method: 提出 Locksmith Loop 代理式测试合成方法：先准备两个运行时环境，分别在 off-mainframe 的商用硬件上对 COBOL 源和生成的 Java 目标进行 mock 插桩执行；然后通过迭代代理循环执行 Witness Search 穿透程序分支，并施加保持奇偶性的变异；遇到路由边界时，由分析器识别 Locked Paragraph 这一阻止更深探索的条件。
Result: 在三个案例研究（两个开源程序和一个内部生产类 COBOL 程序，430 至 4,114 行源码）中，Locksmith 持续提升覆盖率并突破输入搜索平台期，两个开源程序接近完全覆盖，内部生产类程序达到 91.90% 分支覆盖；所有被接受的测试用例中，生成的 Java 在确定性奇偶性检查下与 COBOL 参考匹配。
Conclusion: 作者认为这展示了一种利用确定性 oracle 验证代理式编码输出的新方法，但案例范围仅限于 COBOL 到 Java 迁移场景。

papers.title: Theia: Large-Scale Multimodal Captioning and Automated Validation of the Incidents1M Dataset for Data-Free Distillation
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in critical domains like disaster management requires high-quality multimodal datasets, especially for transferring knowledge via Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD). However, existing datasets in this domain either entirely lack descriptive text, such as Incidents1M, or suffer from severe text-image semantic misalignment, such as CrisisMMD. In this work, we present a novel methodology to construct and automatically validate a large-scale multimodal dataset for disaster response. Starting from the vision-only Incidents1M, we successfully recovered 100,000 images and generated high-fidelity textual descriptions using two distinct Qwen3.5 architectures: a 4B dense model and a 35B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model. To ensure the generated captions provide reliable semantic anchoring for DFKD, we introduce an image-blind LLM-as-a-Judge validation pipeline leveraging Qwen3.5-9B. By intentionally obscuring the original image from the judge, this evaluator accurately simulates the modality gap of the student model during data-free distillation. Our evaluation across 173,179 label pairs demonstrates a high semantic agreement (78.65/100) between the two architectures. Furthermore, the automated evaluation reveals a conservative captioning behaviour, characterized by a high Precision (77.6%) and low Recall (46.0%). This minimizes the false positive noise, while simultaneously exposing underlying human annotation inconsistencies in the original ground truth. papers.title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Constraint Model Reformulation to Improve Solver Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial problems appear in numerous industrial applications. A common approach is to formulate these problems as declarative constraint models that can subsequently be compiled to and solved by a range of back-end solvers. Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can produce correct models from natural language, but even a correct model can be expensive to solve because performance remains sensitive to modelling choices. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs can automate performance-oriented model reformulation. Inspired by Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD), we use an evolutionary framework in which an LLM proposes candidate reformulations that are verified and benchmarked against the user-defined baseline model. We compare AHD-adapted search strategies that control which prior attempts, instructions, and measured feedback enter each prompt. Existing retention strategies prioritize recency or performance, but do not explicitly diversify the context. To cover this gap, we introduce Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR), which applies Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to instance-level runtime vectors to retain behaviourally diverse attempts. We systematically evaluate the strategies on eight CSPLib problems using validation-based final model selection. The results show that: (i) iterative reformulation can produce substantial held-out speedups; (ii) strategies that keep the retained context diverse outperform those that retain only recent or the fastest attempts; and (iii) validation-based selection improves the held-out speedup of every strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否用 LLM 自动化面向求解效率的约束模型重写 (model reformulation)。作者采用受自动启发式设计 (AHD) 启发的进化框架，由 LLM 提出候选重写方案，并对照用户给定基线模型进行验证与基准测试。论文引入 Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR)，用最大边际相关 (MMR) 作用于实例级运行时间向量来保留行为多样的历史尝试，并在八个 CSPLib 问题上结合验证集进行最终模型选择；结果显示迭代重写带来可观的留出集加速。
Motivation: 即使 LLM 能从自然语言生成正确的约束模型，求解性能仍对建模选择高度敏感，正确模型也可能求解昂贵；现有 AHD 式搜索策略只按近期性或性能保留历史上下文，缺少显式的上下文多样化。
Method: 提出进化搜索框架，LLM 作为重写算子生成候选模型，系统对候选进行验证和基准测试；比较控制提示中历史尝试、指令与测量反馈的多种保留策略，并引入 Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR)，即对实例级运行时间向量应用最大边际相关 (MMR) 以保留行为多样化的尝试。
Result: 在八个 CSPLib 问题上的系统评估表明：迭代重写能产生显著的留出集加速；保留多样化上下文的策略优于只保留最近或最快尝试的策略；基于验证集的最终模型选择进一步提升所有策略的留出集加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 可以通过进化搜索自动化面向性能的约束模型重写，且多样化上下文保留与验证集选择是关键因素；实验范围限于 CSPLib 中的八个问题。

papers.title: TARS: Timestep-Aware Data Scaling for 3D-Free Video Re-Shooting
papers.abstract_en: Video re-shooting aims to regenerate videos with controllable camera motion and viewpoint. Existing methods rely on explicit 3D priors, which are limited by reconstruction quality and often perform poorly when synthesizing previously unseen regions, or on paired videos with different camera trajectories, whose scarcity hinders generalization. We revisit video re-shooting through text-driven semantic viewpoint specification, enabling control over shot scale, viewing angle, and first-/third-person perspective. To this end, we propose TARS, a 3D-free video re-shooting paradigm. Timestep-wise sensitivity analysis reveals that camera motion is primarily established during high-noise stages, where coarse spatiotemporal structures are formed. Based on this insight, we introduce self-supervised training to learn camera dynamics and fundamental visual representations without paired re-shooting data or 3D reconstruction. Through data scaling and joint textual-camera conditioning, TARS supports robust camera and viewpoint control, plausibly synthesizing regions beyond the source view under large camera motions while enabling reverse-angle re-shooting and perspective switching. Extensive experiments show that TARS provides more accurate and temporally consistent camera control than prior methods. Project Page: https://ymlinfeng.github.io/TARS.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TARS 提出一种无 3D 先验的视频重拍 (video re-shooting) 范式，通过文本驱动的语义视角指定来控制镜头尺度、视角和第一/第三人称。作者基于时间步敏感性分析发现相机运动主要在高噪声阶段建立，并引入自监督训练学习相机动力学，无需配对重拍数据或 3D 重建。配合数据扩展与文本-相机联合条件，该方法在大相机运动下能合成源视角之外的区域，并支持反向角度重拍与视角切换。
Motivation: 现有视频重拍方法要么依赖显式 3D 先验，受重建质量限制且难以合成未见区域；要么依赖不同相机轨迹的配对视频，而此类数据稀缺阻碍泛化。
Method: 通过时间步敏感性分析揭示相机运动在高噪声阶段被确立，基于此设计自监督训练来学习相机动力学与基础视觉表征；结合数据扩展 (data scaling) 和联合文本-相机条件 (textual-camera conditioning) 实现视角控制。
Result: 摘要报告广泛实验表明 TARS 相比先前方法提供更准确且时间上更一致的相机控制。
Conclusion: 作者认为文本驱动的语义视角规范可在无 3D 重建也不依赖配对重拍数据的条件下实现鲁棒的相机与视角控制。

papers.title: TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Topoformer, a lightweight and scalable framework for graph representation learning that encodes topological structure into attention-friendly sequences. At the core of our method is Topo-Scan, a novel module that decomposes a graph into a short, ordered sequence of topological tokens by slicing over node or edge filtrations. These sequences capture multi-scale structural patterns, from local motifs to global organization, and are processed by a Transformer to produce expressive graph-level embeddings. Unlike traditional persistent homology pipelines, Topo-Scan is parallelizable, avoids costly diagram computations, and integrates seamlessly with standard deep learning architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees on the stability of our topological encodings and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks. Our results show that Topoformer matches or exceeds strong GNN and topology-based baselines while offering predictable and efficient compute. This work opens a new path for parallelizable and unifying approaches to graph representation learning that integrate topological inductive biases into attention frameworks.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TopoFormer，一个轻量、可扩展的图表示学习框架，通过核心模块 Topo-Scan 将图沿节点或边过滤（filtration）切片为短的有序拓扑 token 序列，再由 Transformer 处理生成具有表达力的图级嵌入。摘要称该方法能捕捉从局部模体到全局组织的多尺度结构模式，避免传统持久同调（persistent homology）管线中昂贵的 diagram 计算且可并行化，并在图分类和分子性质预测基准上达到与强 GNN 和拓扑基线相当或更优的性能。
Motivation: 传统持久同调管线计算成本高、难以并行，且不易与标准深度学习架构整合；现有图表示学习方法也较少以注意力友好的方式融入拓扑归纳偏置。本文旨在提供一种可并行、统一的方案，将图的多尺度拓扑结构编码进注意力框架。
Method: 提出 TopoFormer 框架及其核心模块 Topo-Scan：将图沿节点或边过滤分解为短而有序的拓扑 token 序列，捕获从局部模体到全局组织的模式，并由 Transformer 处理生成图级嵌入。该方法避开显式持久图计算，可与标准深度学习架构无缝集成，并附有拓扑编码稳定性的理论保证。
Result: 摘要报告在图分类和分子性质预测基准上取得 state-of-the-art 或匹配/超过强 GNN 及基于拓扑的基线结果，同时计算开销可预测且高效。
Conclusion: 作者认为这项工作为将拓扑归纳偏置整合进注意力机制的图表示学习开辟了可并行、统一的新路径；理论部分提供了拓扑编码的稳定性保证。

papers.title: Operationally Guided Placement-Aware Learning for Industrial Online 3D Bin Packing
papers.abstract_en: The online three-dimensional bin packing problem (3D-BPP) is a longstanding challenge in logistics and industrial palletizing. Recent learning-based methods use a learned policy to select among feasible candidate placements. Performance depends on the candidate generator and representation, especially in industrial settings where packings must be space-efficient, stable, compact, and balanced. However, prior work has mainly optimized the policy, while candidate generation and representation remain largely geometry-driven. We address this gap with OPAL, an operationally guided placement-aware learning framework for industrial online 3D-BPP which combines an Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS), an operational representation for each candidate placement, and a masked ranking policy trained with proximal policy optimization. OG-EMS evaluates multiple anchors within each free-space region and prioritizes low, well-supported, compact, and spatially diverse placements. An xLSTM-based Placement Encoder models dependencies among geometric and operational candidate attributes, while a lightweight recurrent core combines the resulting embeddings with the current item and pallet state to rank feasible actions. On the BED-BPP benchmark, OPAL achieves a mean space utilization of 0.49, with improvements of 15.1% from operationally guided candidate generation and 6.3% from learned ranking, while maintaining robust inference-time performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPAL，一个面向工业在线三维装箱问题（online 3D-BPP）的操作引导且位置感知的学习框架。OPAL 结合操作引导的空余最大空间生成器（OG-EMS）、每个候选位置的操作化表示，以及用近端策略优化（PPO）训练的掩码排序策略。在 BED-BPP 基准上，OPAL 达到 0.49 的平均空间利用率，其中操作引导的候选生成带来 15.1% 的提升，学习到的排序带来 6.3% 的提升。
Motivation: 已有学习方法主要优化策略，而候选生成和表示仍主要由几何驱动；工业场景要求装箱同时满足空间高效、稳定、紧凑和均衡，因此需要改进候选生成与表示这一被忽视的环节。
Method: OPAL 包含三个部分：OG-EMS 在自由空间区域内评估多个锚点，优先选择低位置、支撑好、紧凑且空间多样的候选放置；xLSTM 位置编码器建模候选几何与操作属性的依赖关系；轻量循环核心将嵌入与当前物品及托盘状态结合来对可行动作排序，整个排序策略用 PPO 训练。
Result: 在 BED-BPP 基准上，OPAL 取得 0.49 的平均空间利用率，操作引导的候选生成贡献 15.1% 的提升，学习到的排序贡献 6.3% 的提升，并保持稳健的推理性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将操作引导引入候选生成并配合学习排序，可以有效提升工业在线 3D-BPP 的装箱效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: OPAL 包含三个部分：OG-EMS 在自由空间区域内评估多个锚点，优先选择低位置、支撑好、紧凑且空间多样的候选放置；xLSTM 位置编码器建模候选几何与操作属性的依赖关系；轻量循环核心将嵌入与当前物品及托盘状态结合来对可行动作排序，整个排序策略用 PPO 训练。
summary_sections.result: 在 BED-BPP 基准上，OPAL 取得 0.49 的平均空间利用率，操作引导的候选生成贡献 15.1% 的提升，学习到的排序贡献 6.3% 的提升，并保持稳健的推理性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，将操作引导引入候选生成并配合学习排序，可以有效提升工业在线 3D-BPP 的装箱效率。

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification for trustworthy deep learning: Methods and measures
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical domains demands reliable estimates of predictive confidence, yet conventional architectures lack principled uncertainty quantification. This survey provides a structured, critical review of methods for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) in deep learning, scoped to ensemble-based and approximate Bayesian approaches and the measures used to summarize their outputs. Relative to existing UQ surveys, our contribution is depth on efficient ensemble approximations and single-pass methods, and a unified treatment that separates the method producing a predictive distribution from the measure that summarizes its uncertainty. We organize methods into five families: Bayesian neural networks, Monte Carlo Dropout, deep ensembles, efficient ensemble approximations, and last-layer or single-pass approaches. We situate adjacent work on evidential and prior networks, conformal prediction, and post-hoc calibration, together with the decision-time tasks of out-of-distribution detection and selective prediction. For each, we examine theoretical motivation, implementation, empirical performance, and limitations. We then review ensemble diversity theory and uncertainty measures and their decompositions, contrasting the entropy decomposition with pairwise divergence measures, and consolidate evaluation methodology so that our qualitative comparisons share a common basis. We close with a brief treatment of uncertainty in large language models and open research directions, including efficient epistemic measures for classification, last-layer diversity, diversity and calibration under shift, and hybrid architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于深度学习不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification, UQ）的结构化综述，范围限定在基于集成（ensemble）和近似贝叶斯方法，以及用于概括其输出的度量。综述将“产生预测分布的方法”与“概括不确定性的度量”分离，把方法组织为五个家族：贝叶斯神经网络、Monte Carlo Dropout、深度集成、高效集成近似、末层或单次前向方法，并讨论了证据网络、保形预测、事后校准以及分布外检测和选择性预测等相邻工作。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在安全关键领域的部署要求可靠的预测置信度估计，但传统架构缺乏有原则的不确定性量化。现有 UQ 综述对高效集成近似和单次前向方法的覆盖不足，且常将方法与度量混为一谈，因此需要更统一的处理。
Method: 采用结构化批判性综述方法，按五个方法家族逐一考察理论动机、实现、实证表现与局限；随后综述集成多样性理论以及不确定性度量及其分解，对比熵分解与成对散度度量，并整合评估方法论，使定性比较具有共同基础。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，而是提供系统的定性比较和对各方法的理论、实现、实证表现及局限的审视；并总结了不确定性度量（如熵分解与成对散度）和评估方法的统一视角。
Conclusion: 作者以大语言模型中的不确定性处理作结，并列出开放研究方向，包括分类任务的高效认知不确定性度量、末层多样性、分布偏移下的多样性与校准，以及混合架构。

papers.title: Space2Ground 2.0: A Multi-Source Dataset and Framework for Agricultural Monitoring through Fusion of Street-Level and Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and scalable parcel-level agricultural monitoring remains challenging because satellite Earth Observation alone provides only an overhead perspective of agricultural parcels, while optical observations are further affected by cloud-induced temporal gaps. This paper presents Space2Ground 2.0, a multi-source framework integrating Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral time series with geo-tagged street-level imagery acquired using vehicle-mounted cameras and shared through the Mapillary platform. A largely automated processing pipeline performs semantic filtering, image quality assessment, viewpoint-based parcel association, and dataset refinement, transforming large volumes of crowdsourced imagery into parcel-linked, analysis-ready data. Applied over Cyprus during the 2022 growing season, the pipeline produced a curated dataset of 46,050 annotated street-level images, selected from an initial collection exceeding 900,000 images and linked with satellite information for 8,581 agricultural parcels. The practical value of the dataset was assessed through parcel-level crop classification experiments using both single- and multi-source observations. The results demonstrate that street-level imagery provides complementary fine-scale visual information that enhances classification when integrated with satellite time series. Overall, Space2Ground 2.0 provides an openly available benchmark dataset and a reproducible methodology for multimodal agricultural monitoring, with potential applications in visual verification, reduced reliance on costly field inspections, and data-driven agricultural policy implementation.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 45th EARSeL Symposium, Athens, Greece
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Space2Ground 2.0，一个多源农业监测框架，融合 Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 多光谱时间序列与 Mapillary 平台收集的带地理标签街景影像。作者构建了一条高度自动化的处理流水线，执行语义过滤、图像质量评估、基于视角的地块关联和数据集精化；在塞浦路斯 2022 生长季实验中，从超过 90 万张初始街景图像中筛选出 46,050 张标注图像，并与 8,581 个农业地块的卫星信息关联。地块级作物分类实验表明，街景影像提供的细粒度视觉信息与卫星时间序列集成时具有互补性并可提升分类效果。
Motivation: 仅依赖卫星对地观测只能提供农业地块的俯视视角，且光学观测容易受云层遮挡造成时间序列缺口，难以实现准确且可扩展的地块级农业监测。
Method: 提出一个多源框架，将 Sentinel-1 SAR 与 Sentinel-2 多光谱时间序列同车辆相机采集并经 Mapillary 分享的街景图像相融合；自动化流水线包含语义过滤、图像质量评估、基于视点的地块关联与数据集精化，将大规模众包图像转化为与地块链接、可供直接分析的标注数据。
Result: 在塞浦路斯 2022 生长季应用中，流水线从超过 90 万张初始街景图像中生成 46,050 张标注图像，并关联 8,581 个农业地块；地块级作物分类实验结果表明，结合卫星时间序列与街景影像时分类性能得到增强。
Conclusion: 作者提供了公开可用的基准数据集和可复现的多模态农业监测方法，潜在应用包括视觉验证、减少对昂贵田间巡检的依赖以及支撑数据驱动的农业政策。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video offers rich manipulation experience for embodied AI, yet collecting diverse egocentric data across scenes, objects, motions, and embodiments remains costly. We present \method, an egocentric world-action simulator that synthesizes controllable, high-quality manipulation videos to expand scarce real-world training data. \method{} builds on a pretrained video generation prior and introduces two geometry-aware conditioning mechanisms. Online Anchored Projective Memory (OAPM) preserves a first-frame 3D scene anchor while periodically refreshing a recent state during autoregressive generation. Action-3D Rotary Position Embedding (A3D-RoPE) encodes end-effector motion with camera-aware 3D rotary coordinates, injecting action geometry into skeleton-to-video cross-attention for precise control. Together, these components improve visual fidelity, geometric stability, and action alignment in long egocentric rollouts. Moreover, augmenting 400 real trajectories with 400 \method-generated trajectories improves out-of-distribution real-robot success from 77\% to 84\% on single-arm tasks and from 53\% to 70\% on dual-arm tasks, demonstrating that the synthesized data substantially improve downstream WAM generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoGenesis，一个自我中心的'世界-动作'仿真器（egocentric world-action simulator），基于预训练视频生成先验合成可控、高质量的操作视频，以扩充稀缺的真实世界训练数据。方法引入两个几何感知条件机制：在线锚定投影记忆（OAPM）在自回归生成中保留首帧 3D 场景锚点并周期性刷新近期状态，Action-3D 旋转位置编码（A3D-RoPE）将末端执行器运动编码为相机感知的 3D 旋转坐标并注入骨架到视频的交叉注意力。摘要报告该方法改善了长程自我中心视频 rollouts 的视觉保真度、几何稳定性和动作对齐，并用 400 条生成轨迹增强 400 条真实轨迹，将单臂任务的真实机器人成功率从 77% 提升到 84%，双臂任务从 53% 提升到 70%。
Motivation: 自我中心视频为具身 AI 提供丰富的操作经验，但跨场景、物体、运动和具身形态收集多样化自我中心数据的成本很高。该工作瞄准这一数据稀缺问题，试图通过合成可控的高质量操作视频来扩充训练数据。
Method: 方法建立在预训练视频生成先验之上，提出两个几何感知条件机制：OAPM 在自回归生成过程中保持第一帧 3D 场景锚点并周期性刷新近期状态；A3D-RoPE 将末端执行器运动编码为相机感知的 3D 旋转位置嵌入，并把动作几何注入骨架到视频（skeleton-to-video）的交叉注意力中，以实现精确动作控制。
Result: 摘要报告这些组件改善了长程自我中心 rollouts 的视觉保真度、几何稳定性与动作对齐。数据增强实验中，用 400 条 EgoGenesis 生成轨迹增强 400 条真实轨迹后，真实机器人 out-of-distribution 成功率在单臂任务上从 77% 提升到 84%，在双臂任务上从 53% 提升到 70%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调合成数据能显著改善下游 WAM（world-action modeling）泛化，表明该仿真器有望缓解真实自我中心操作数据收集成本高的问题。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Agentic Metaverse Services: A New As-a-Service Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is reconstructing the digital virtual world, upgrading agents through enhancing their abilities in autonomous learning, multi-modal interaction, content generation, and collaborative decision-making. In particular, the shift from conversational chatbots to agentic AI, the most recent significant technical breakthrough of GenAI, has brought a new form of services, agentic services and Agent-as-a-Service (AaaS), in which the agent's abilities are encapsulated, such as perception, decision-making, execution, collaboration, and content generation, to provide the customized agent services to users. The metaverse is a virtual ecosystem for human life, work, creation, and entertainment, supported by the new generation of digital technologies. Through combining agentic services and the metaverse, an Agentic Metaverse Service, denoted as AMServ, is produced for metaverse business processing, as a new form of metaverse service. The AaaS in the metaverse environment, denoted as Meta-AaaS, as an approach to realize AMServ, has become a new paradigm of agentic services and service computing. This paper overviews the evolution and new features of agents and services empowered by GenAI, reveals the roles and principles of agentic services in the metaverse environment, presents the forms, characteristics, and principles of the AMServ and the Meta-AaaS, discusses the typical application examples of the AMServ and the Meta-AaaS, and finally points out the new tendencies and research directions of the AMServ and the Meta-AaaS. The AMServ and the Meta-AaaS will bring great opportunities to human society and services in the AI era, and promote the rapid development of emerging service industries in the future.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures; Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Web Services (ICWS 2026); Corresponding author: Prof. Xiaofei Xu
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能体元宇宙服务 (Agentic Metaverse Service, AMServ) 及元宇宙中的智能体即服务 (Agent-as-a-Service, Meta-AaaS) 这一新服务范式，概述 GenAI 驱动的智能体与服务演化，分析智能体服务在元宇宙中的角色与原则，并讨论典型应用案例及未来研究方向。论文被 2026 IEEE ICWS 接收，属于服务计算与智能体方向的综述性概念论文。
Motivation: GenAI 正从对话式聊天机器人转向智能体式 AI (agentic AI)，催生了智能体服务与 AaaS 这一新服务形态；同时元宇宙作为虚拟生态需要新的服务支撑，但二者结合的服务范式尚缺乏系统化定义与梳理。
Method: 采用概念化与综述方法：首先总结 GenAI 赋予智能体的自主学习和多模态交互等新能力，继而定义 AMServ 与 Meta-AaaS 的形式、特征和原则，并给出典型应用示例与研究趋势。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果，主要内容为概念框架、角色与原则分析，以及应用示例和未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AMServ 与 Meta-AaaS 将给 AI 时代的服务与社会带来重大机会，并推动新兴服务业的快速发展；其价值主要体现在提出新范式与开放研究方向。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 AMServ 与 Meta-AaaS 将给 AI 时代的服务与社会带来重大机会，并推动新兴服务业的快速发展；其价值主要体现在提出新范式与开放研究方向。

papers.title: AI and Authenticity in Islamic Research: A Critical Evaluation of Generative AI Reliability, Hallucination, and Source Fidelity in Quranic, Hadith, and Fiqh Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly used by Muslims for religious guidance, Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith explanation, jurisprudential rulings, and Islamic education. Despite its growing adoption, there is limited empirical evidence on whether current AI systems provide authentic, verifiable, and trustworthy Islamic knowledge suitable for high-trust religious contexts. This study evaluates six leading generative AI systems using fifty realistic open-ended Islamic questions covering Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith, Fiqh, ethics, pastoral advice, and Madhhab-sensitive topics. Responses were collected under real-world conditions from participants in Australia and the United Kingdom and analysed using a mixed-method framework examining domain accuracy, citation verification, hallucinations, jurisprudential consistency, uncertainty handling, source provenance, and geographical variation. The study addresses four research questions: (1) How accurate and authentic are AI-generated responses across major Islamic knowledge domains? (2) To what extent do AI systems produce hallucinations, incomplete citations, or unverifiable religious references? (3) How consistently do models handle jurisprudential disagreement, Madhhab diversity, and uncertainty? (4) Are current AI systems sufficiently reliable for religious guidance, Islamic education, and scholarly research? Overall, current generative AI systems are valuable as assistive tools for introductory Islamic learning but should not be treated as authoritative sources for religious rulings or Islamic research without verification against authenticated primary sources and qualified scholarly expertise. This study provides one of the first comprehensive empirical evaluations of AI reliability within Islamic knowledge, offering practical guidance for researchers, educators, AI developers, and the wider Muslim community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式 AI 在伊斯兰宗教知识场景中的可信度问题，系统评估了六个主流生成式 AI 系统在古兰经解释、圣训 (Hadith)、教法学 (Fiqh)、伦理、牧灵建议及 Madhhab 敏感话题上的表现。研究使用五十个现实开放式问题，在澳大利亚和英国的真实条件下收集回复，并采用混合方法分析领域准确度、引文验证、幻觉 (hallucination)、教法一致性、不确定性处理、来源溯源与地域差异。摘要给出的总体结论是：当前生成式 AI 可作为入门性伊斯兰学习的辅助工具，但未经与权威原始文献和合格学者核实前，不应被视为宗教裁决或学术研究的权威来源。
Motivation: 尽管穆斯林群体越来越多地使用生成式 AI 获取宗教指导、古兰经解释、圣训讲解和教法裁决，但现有实证证据有限，无法判断这些系统在高信任宗教语境下能否提供真实、可验证且可信的伊斯兰知识。
Method: 研究选取六个领先的生成式 AI 系统，用覆盖古兰经解释、圣训、Fiqh、伦理、牧灵建议及 Madhhab 敏感话题的五十个开放式问题收集回复；回复在澳大利亚和英国参与者的真实条件下获取，并通过混合方法框架分析领域准确度、引文验证、幻觉、教法一致性、不确定性处理、来源溯源和地域差异，同时回答四个预设研究问题。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数字，但指出当前生成式 AI 系统整体上适合作为辅助工具用于入门性伊斯兰学习，同时存在幻觉、不完整引文或不可验证宗教引用等问题，不应被当作宗教裁决或伊斯兰研究的权威来源。
Conclusion: 作者强调，AI 生成的伊斯兰知识必须对照经过认证的原始文献并借助合格学者专长进行核实；该研究被认为是针对伊斯兰知识领域 AI 可靠性的首批全面实证评估之一，并为研究者、教育者、AI 开发者和穆斯林社群提供实用指导。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CDAE: Enhancing Perturbation Robustness in Pretrained Language Models with Contrastive Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained language models have significantly improved sentence representation learning, yet their embedding remain sensitive to semantic preserving textual perturbations such as synonym substitution, masking and word dropout. This work proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that refines pre-trained BERT embedding by jointly optimizing contrastive and reconstruction objective to learn perturbation-invariant representation. We evaluate the proposed framework using multiple perturbation strategies with varying strengths and compare it against the original BERT embeddings and SimCSE. Experimental results show that CDAE consistently preserves higher embedding similarity under perturbations, with the improvements becoming more pronounced as framework effectively enhances representation stability while preserving semantic information, highlighting perturbation-invariant learning as a promising direction for improving sentence embeddings. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/ComputationIASBS/CDAE
papers.comment: Submitted to 16th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轻量级对比去噪自编码器 (CDAE)，通过联合优化对比学习 (contrastive) 与重构 (reconstruction) 目标来微调预训练 BERT 嵌入，使其对同义替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持扰动更鲁棒。实验对比原始 BERT 嵌入和 SimCSE，显示 CDAE 在多种扰动策略下保持更高的嵌入相似度，且提升幅度明显，同时保留语义信息。代码已开源。
Motivation: 预训练语言模型的句子嵌入对同义替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持型文本扰动敏感，这种不稳定性会影响下游表示质量，现有方法尚未充分解决。
Method: 提出对比去噪自编码器 (CDAE)，在预训练 BERT 嵌入之上联合优化对比学习目标与重构目标，以学习扰动不变 (perturbation-invariant) 的句子表示。
Result: 在多种扰动策略和不同扰动强度下，CDAE 相比原始 BERT 嵌入和 SimCSE 始终保留更高的嵌入相似度，且扰动增强时改进更加明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调扰动不变学习是提升句子嵌入的有前景方向，CDAE 在增强表示稳定性的同时有效保留语义信息。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: The web is increasingly accessed by AI agents rather than humans. Every agent needs knowledge, especially in the life-sciences, where agentic pipelines are growing fast. Access to the literature is a crucial part of that need, and resources such as Europe PMC, with over 40M indexed records, are widely used to meet it. Yet these resources were not built for AI agents: they take keywords and complex syntax and return whole papers, so every agent must learn the syntax, issue several searches, and read full papers to find the evidence it needs. We introduce EMBL AI Librarian, a knowledge layer that upgrades the Europe PMC interface for AI agents: an agent asks in natural language and receives evidence that answers it. A single LLM orchestrates the whole knowledge retrieval process: it plans complementary subqueries executed by the live Europe PMC search engine, then reads the selected papers and locates the relevant evidence. We evaluate Librarian across four benchmarks: literature synthesis, claim verification, open-domain question answering, and downstream biology tasks such as protocol questions and sequence manipulation. On ScholarQABench, Librarian improves Citation F1 by more than $16$ points over strong recently published baselines. Used as the retrieval layer of an existing claim-verification pipeline, it increases agreement with expert consensus; and on the open-form LitQA2 benchmark, a GPT-5.4 agent scores about $8$ points higher when grounded in Librarian than with web search. Overall, our results show that equipping life-science agents with the Librarian knowledge layer improves performance across a range of tasks. We release our code publicly at https://github.com/petroni-lab/librarian
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EMBL AI Librarian，一个面向 AI 智能体的生命科学知识层，将 Europe PMC 接口升级为自然语言问答式证据检索：单个 LLM 规划互补子查询交给实时 Europe PMC 执行，再阅读选中论文并定位相关证据。论文在文献综述、主张验证 (claim verification)、开放问答和下游生物任务等四个基准上评估，其中 ScholarQABench 的 Citation F1 比近期强基线提升超过 16 点，LitQA2 上使用 Librarian 的 GPT-5.4 agent 比普通 web search 高约 8 分，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有文献资源如 Europe PMC（索引超过 4000 万条记录）是为人类设计的：接受关键字和复杂语法、返回整篇论文，而 AI agent 需要学习语法、多次搜索并通读全文才能找到所需证据；生命科学领域的 agentic 流程增长很快，需要更适配的知识访问接口。
Method: 提出 EMBL AI Librarian 知识层，作为 Europe PMC 与 AI agent 之间的统一接口；由单个 LLM 编排整个知识检索流程，先规划可由实时 Europe PMC 搜索引擎执行的互补子查询，再读取选中的论文并定位与问题相关的证据片段，最终以自然语言给出带证据的答案。
Result: 在 ScholarQABench 上，Librarian 将 Citation F1 较近期发布的强基线提高超过 16 点；将其作为现有 claim verification 管线的检索层时，与专家共识的一致性提升；在开放形式 LitQA2 基准上，基于 Librarian 检索的 GPT-5.4 agent 比使用 web search 的版本得分高约 8 点。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，给生命科学 agent 配备该知识层可在多种任务上带来一致的性能提升，并发布公开代码以支持复现与扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents have the potential to become a general purpose executor over existing digital devices. To advance them toward real-world use, we envision agents that operate reliably on real devices, execute workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, complete long-horizon tasks, proactively initiate useful services, and autonomously improve their capabilities with minimal human effort. Guided by this vision, we present Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent spanning mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments. Qwen-UI-Agent combines diverse sandbox environments with a large-scale real-device mobile runtime. Its unified action space interleaves GUI operations with CLI execution and generates batched actions in a single model turn. An AutoResearch-style data flywheel uses agents to construct tasks and environments, diagnose failures, and plan subsequent iterations. Online RL supports training on trajectories exceeding 100 turns, with over 10,000 concurrent environments accelerating rollout. A lightweight harness layer supports proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer. Across a broad suite of evaluations, Qwen-UI-Agent sets state-of-the-art performance on mobile-use benchmarks while delivering competitive performance on computer- and browser-use tasks against frontier models, including Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol. On mobile use, it achieves 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, and 97.5% on AndroidDaily. On computer use, it achieves 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified and a 40.0% partial-progress score on OSWorld-v2. On browser use and GUI grounding, it achieves 73.6% on WebArena and 81.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Qwen-UI-Agent，一个面向真实世界（real-world centric）的通用 GUI 智能体基础模型，覆盖移动端、电脑使用、网页和 DeepSearch 环境。它将多样沙箱环境与大规模真机移动运行时结合，统一动作空间内交错 GUI 操作与 CLI 执行，并支持单模型回合生成批量动作。摘要报告其在移动端基准上取得 SOTA，在电脑和浏览器任务上与前沿闭源模型具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体难以在真实设备上可靠运行、跨平台执行工作流并完成长时程任务；作者设想智能体应能可靠操作真机、结合 GUI 与 CLI、主动发起服务并以最少人力自主进化，这正是当前缺少的通用执行能力。
Method: 结合多样沙箱环境与大规模真实设备移动运行时；设计统一动作空间，将 GUI 操作与 CLI 执行交织，并在单次模型回合内生成批量动作。采用 AutoResearch 风格数据飞轮，由智能体构建任务与环境、诊断失败并规划后续迭代；在线 RL 支持超过 100 轮轨迹训练，并使用超过 10,000 个并发环境加速 rollout；轻量 harness 层支持主动服务发起和移动/电脑端的有状态工作流。
Result: 移动端基准上，MobileWorld 达 82.1%、MobileWorld-Real 达 92.2%、AndroidDaily 达 97.5%；电脑端 OSWorld-Verified 达 79.5%、OSWorld-v2 部分进展分数为 40.0%；浏览器使用 WebArena 达 73.6%，GUI grounding 的 ScreenSpot-Pro 达 81.5%。摘要称其在移动端基准上为 SOTA，并在电脑与浏览器任务上与 Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.6 Sol 等前沿模型竞争。
Conclusion: 摘要强调真实世界设备集成、跨平台执行与自动化数据飞轮的结合是下一代 GUI 智能体的关键路径；摘要未说明明确的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Security of World-Model-Based Embodied AI: A Lifecycle of Threats, Defenses, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: World models give embodied AI a predictive core: they compress observations into states, simulate action-conditioned futures, and enable planning beyond reactive control. This predictive layer, however, opens a new security boundary-compromise can propagate from data, sensors, prompts, or feedback into physical action. Rather than treating world models as an isolated component, this survey traces threats across their entire lifecycle-from data construction and representation learning, through state grounding and imagination, to trajectory evaluation, execution, and long-term adaptation via memory and tools. We show that familiar attack families: poisoning, backdoors, adversarial examples, sensor spoofing, prompt injection, trajectory manipulation, and supply-chain attacks take on distinct meanings when they corrupt world states, learned dynamics, affordance estimates, or safety costs. We also highlight a duality: world models can serve as runtime safety shields, yet when compromised or over-trusted they generate predictive safety illusions. The survey offers a lifecycle taxonomy, maps existing attacks to world-model security properties, outlines evaluation protocols for safety failures, and structures defenses across provenance, robust grounding, uncertainty-aware prediction, trajectory gating, feedback auditing, and deployment assurance.

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于基于世界模型 (world model) 的具身 AI 安全性的综述。作者将威胁按生命周期划分，从数据构建、表示学习、状态接地、想象/规划、轨迹评估与执行，到长期记忆与工具适配，追踪数据投毒、后门、对抗样本、传感器欺骗、提示注入、轨迹操纵和供应链攻击等攻击族。综述还指出世界模型既可充当运行时安全屏障，也会在被破坏或过度信任时产生预测性安全幻觉，并给出生命周期分类、攻击映射、评估协议与防御结构。
Motivation: 现有安全研究多将世界模型视为孤立组件，缺乏从数据、传感器、提示和反馈一路传导到物理动作的端到端威胁分析；预测层引入了新的安全边界，需要系统性梳理。
Method: 提出世界模型安全生命周期分类法，展示同一攻击族在不同生命周期阶段（如腐蚀世界状态、学习动力学、affordance 估计或安全代价）的不同含义，并将攻击映射到世界模型安全属性；同时给出安全失效的评估协议，以及来源追踪、鲁棒接地、不确定性感知预测、轨迹门控、反馈审计和部署保障等防御结构。
Result: 作为综述，本文没有报告实验数据；其主要结果是建立生命周期威胁分类，指出世界模型具有双重性：既能作为运行时安全屏障，也可能在被破坏或过度信任时产生预测性安全幻觉。
Conclusion: 论文强调需从生命周期视角统一建模世界模型的安全威胁与防御，并系统化评估协议与防御结构；这仍是开放研究领域。

papers.title: FaithEyes: Towards Faithful Tool Use via Multi-Agent Process-Image Verification
papers.abstract_en: Agentic vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave textual reasoning with explicit tool calls such as cropping and code-based image manipulation, have emerged as a compelling paradigm for reliable and interpretable multimodal reasoning. However, recent studies have revealed that such models often use tools unfaithfully. Many process images are irrelevant to the question (e.g., the tool crops the wrong region or misses the queried target), yet the call still receives full credit and the model still answers correctly. Such decorative or misaligned tool calls waste computation and reveal that the model leans on prior knowledge or the original image rather than the evidence it retrieves. This may stem from two limitations of prevailing methods: the tool reward fails to distinguish useful from useless calls, and tool feedback carries no signal of usefulness. To this end, we introduce FaithEyes, a multi-agent self-judging framework. Concretely, we use a VLM to judge whether each process image helps answer the question. The judgement is injected into the reasoning context as part of the tool observation to help subsequent reasoning, and meanwhile is used to scale the tool reward by the helpful-tool ratio to suppress reward hacking. To keep judgement available at evaluation and thus ensure train-test consistency, we further design a multi-agent framework where the model itself serves as a subagent to judge the tool calls from main agent, eliminating any dependence on an external model at inference. Training via a two-stage SFT + RL pipeline on adapted open-source data, FaithEyes attains competitive or superior accuracy across visual perception and reasoning benchmarks, while markedly improving tool faithfulness. The homepage is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/FaithEyes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FaithEyes，一个多 agent 自评判框架，用于提升 agentic vision-language models (VLMs) 中工具调用的忠实性。方法是用 VLM 判断每个过程图像（process image）是否有助于回答问题，将判断注入工具观察中，并按有用工具比例缩放工具奖励以抑制 reward hacking。在两层 SFT + RL 流程训练后，该方法在视觉感知与推理基准上达到有竞争力或更优的准确率，并显著改善工具忠实性。
Motivation: 现有 agentic VLM 常不忠实地使用工具，例如裁剪错误区域或漏掉查询目标，但调用仍获得完全奖励且最终答案正确。作者认为这源于两方面的局限：工具奖励无法区分有用与无用的调用，且工具反馈本身不携带有用性信号。
Method: 提出多 agent 自评判框架：用一个 VLM 判断每个过程图像是否有助于回答问题，判断结果作为工具观察的一部分注入推理上下文，同时用于按 helpful-tool ratio 缩放工具奖励以抑制 reward hacking。为保证评估时判断可用并保持训练-测试一致性，模型自身作为子 agent 评判主 agent 的工具调用，消除对外部模型的依赖；训练采用两阶段 SFT + RL，数据来自改编的开源数据。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在视觉感知与推理基准上取得有竞争力或更优的准确率，同时明显提高工具忠实性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过把有用性判断整合进工具观察与奖励，可以在不依赖外部评判模型的情况下实现更忠实的工具使用，并兼顾训练与评估的一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weather Emulators at the Frontier of Heat Extremes Predictability
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric predictability declines rapidly beyond the next ten days, such that forecasts at longer lead times primarily convey large-scale trends rather than specific states. Yet in a warming world, improving early warnings of extreme heat is an increasingly critical challenge. Here we evaluate six state-of-the-art deep learning weather emulators - Pangu-Weather, FuXi, ArchesWeather, AIFS, GraphCast and Aurora - alongside leading dynamical systems and statistical baselines in forecasting global near-surface temperature and extreme heat at lead times of 10-15 days. We find that several emulators rival or even surpass physics-based forecasts in deterministic temperature skill, but do so at the cost of reduced spectral fidelity, in a process widely known as blurring. While all models show some degree of predictive skill for extreme heat, most emulators under-represent peak intensities, and IFS recall is greater than that of any of the emulators. These results highlight both the emerging potential of AI to enhance extended range temperature prediction, and the remaining challenges in delivering reliable, actionable early warnings in a changing climate.
papers.comment: Main: 34 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary: 29 pages, 21 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估六种 SOTA 深度学习天气仿真器（Pangu-Weather、FuXi、ArchesWeather、AIFS、GraphCast、Aurora）在 10-15 天超前时间的全球近地面温度和极端高温预测表现，并与动力学系统及统计基线对比。摘要指出多个仿真器在确定性温度技巧上能与甚至超越基于物理的预报，但伴随光谱保真度下降（即模糊化 blurring）；对极端高温，所有模型都有一定技巧，但多数仿真器低估峰值强度，IFS 的召回率高于所有仿真器。
Motivation: 大气可预报性在十天以上快速衰减，长期预报主要传达大尺度趋势而非具体状态；在变暖背景下改进极端高温的提前预警日益关键。
Method: 对六个深度学习天气仿真器与领先的动力学系统和统计基线进行系统评估，聚焦 10-15 天超前时间的全球近地面温度与极端高温预报，并分析确定性技巧与光谱保真度（blurring）等属性。
Result: 多个仿真器在确定性温度技巧上与基于物理的预报相当或更优，但以光谱保真度下降为代价；所有模型对极端高温都有一定预测技巧，不过大多数仿真器低估峰值强度，且 IFS 的召回率超过任意一个仿真器。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果既凸显 AI 提升延伸期温度预报的潜力，也揭示了在气候变化背景下提供可靠、可操作的极端高温早期预警仍存在的挑战。

papers.title: Causal Discovery with Inverted Self-attention for Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery in multivariate time series data is challenging due to complex interactions, high dimensionality, and nonlinear dependencies among variables. Existing methods often struggle to capture these complexities, resulting in inaccurate causal structures. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that leverages self-attention mechanisms within the transformer architecture for causal discovery. Our approach introduces a novel inverted causal self-attention mechanism (CSAM) that emphasizes latent and indirect causal relationships by inverting tokens and inducing sparsity in attention scores, focusing on significant causal interactions and reducing spurious correlations. Additionally, we develop a global causal algorithm to identify global causal links, providing a holistic metric for causal influence, along with a causal verification module to ensure robustness in the identified causal relationships, enhancing the reliability of our framework. Experiments on both linear and nonlinear datasets, along with ablation studies and sensitivity analyses, show that our framework outperforms existing methods, demonstrating its potential for causal discovery in complex multivariate time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Transformer 自注意力机制的多元时间序列因果发现框架。核心是倒置因果自注意力机制 (inverted causal self-attention mechanism, CSAM)，通过倒置 tokens 并对注意力分数施加稀疏性来突出潜在和间接因果关系、抑制虚假相关；此外还包含全局因果算法与因果验证模块。在线性和非线性数据集上的实验以及消融和敏感性分析表明，该框架优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多元时间序列因果发现面临变量间复杂交互、高维性和非线性依赖等挑战，现有方法难以准确捕获这些复杂性，导致估计出的因果结构不够准确。
Method: 提出倒置因果自注意力机制 CSAM，通过倒置 tokens 和诱导注意力分数稀疏来聚焦显著因果交互、减少虚假相关；同时设计全局因果算法识别全局因果链路，并提供因果验证模块增强所识别因果关系的可靠性和鲁棒性。
Result: 在线性和非线性数据集上的实验、消融研究和敏感性分析显示，该框架在性能上优于现有方法；摘要未报告具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架在复杂多元时间序列的因果发现中展现出潜力；其定位是通用时间序列方法，实验细节和适用边界需进一步参考全文。

papers.title: Scaling Vision-Language Models Is Not Enough to Mitigate Bias
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are now foundational to multimodal systems, yet their robustness to spurious correlations remains poorly understood at scale. We present the first large-scale empirical study of 194 publicly available VLMs, including 16 model families, covering a wide range of model sizes, 24 training datasets, and three evaluation benchmarks, namely ImageNet (overall performance), CelebA (typical single-attribute bias), and UrbanCars (complex multi-attribute biases). Across these settings, the Spearman correlation between model scale and performance weakens as evaluation shifts from ImageNet ($ρ{=}0.68$) to single-attribute ($ρ{=}0.48$) and further to multi-attribute ($ρ{=}0.05$) bias benchmarks. In contrast, properties of the training data (size and quality) show more consistent relationships with worst-group accuracy across both bias benchmarks. Notably, curated datasets yield improvements of up to 25% over uncurated alternatives at a comparable scale. Finally, the effect of architectural choices (e.g., patch size, image resolution) is highly context-dependent, varying with the nature of the benchmark, including the type of bias and its spatial distribution within images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 194 个公开视觉语言模型（VLM）进行了大规模实证研究，覆盖 16 个模型族、24 个训练数据集，并使用 ImageNet、CelebA 和 UrbanCars 三个基准来考察模型规模与偏倚鲁棒性之间的关系。结果显示，模型规模与性能的 Spearman 相关从整体性能基准的 0.68 降至单属性偏倚基准的 0.48，再到多属性偏倚基准的 0.05；相反，训练数据的规模与质量与两个偏倚基准上的最差组准确率关系更一致。
Motivation: VLM（如 CLIP）已成为多模态系统的基础，但其对虚假相关性（spurious correlations）的鲁棒性在大规模范围内仍缺乏系统理解，现有研究没有清晰说明模型规模、训练数据和架构究竟如何影响偏倚。
Method: 对 194 个公开 VLM（含 16 个模型族）进行大规模实证分析，覆盖广泛模型尺寸、24 个训练数据集，并用整体性能（ImageNet）、单属性偏倚（CelebA）和复杂多属性偏倚（UrbanCars）三类基准，分别考察规模、数据属性与架构选择的影响。
Result: 模型规模与性能的相关性随评估从 ImageNet（ρ=0.68）到单属性偏倚（ρ=0.48）再到多属性偏倚（ρ=0.05）基准而显著减弱；训练数据规模与质量与最差组准确率的关系更加一致；在相当规模下，经策展的训练数据相比未策展数据可带来最高 25% 的提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅扩大 VLM 规模不足以缓解偏倚，训练数据的属性（规模与质量）更为关键；架构选择（如 patch size、图像分辨率）的效果高度依赖基准特性，包括偏倚类型及其在图像中的空间分布。

summary_sections.motivation: VLM（如 CLIP）已成为多模态系统的基础，但其对虚假相关性（spurious correlations）的鲁棒性在大规模范围内仍缺乏系统理解，现有研究没有清晰说明模型规模、训练数据和架构究竟如何影响偏倚。
summary_sections.method: 对 194 个公开 VLM（含 16 个模型族）进行大规模实证分析，覆盖广泛模型尺寸、24 个训练数据集，并用整体性能（ImageNet）、单属性偏倚（CelebA）和复杂多属性偏倚（UrbanCars）三类基准，分别考察规模、数据属性与架构选择的影响。
summary_sections.result: 模型规模与性能的相关性随评估从 ImageNet（ρ=0.68）到单属性偏倚（ρ=0.48）再到多属性偏倚（ρ=0.05）基准而显著减弱；训练数据规模与质量与最差组准确率的关系更加一致；在相当规模下，经策展的训练数据相比未策展数据可带来最高 25% 的提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为仅扩大 VLM 规模不足以缓解偏倚，训练数据的属性（规模与质量）更为关键；架构选择（如 patch size、图像分辨率）的效果高度依赖基准特性，包括偏倚类型及其在图像中的空间分布。

papers.title: Vibe-FDTR: An agent-oriented framework for reproducible frequency-domain thermoreflectance data analysis
papers.abstract_en: Frequency-domain thermoreflectance (FDTR) is a laser pump-probe technique widely used to measure thermal properties at the micro- and nanoscale; however, it relies on a complex data analysis procedure that demands substantial domain expertise and is susceptible to subtle human errors. Here, we present Vibe-FDTR, an agent-oriented framework that enables large language model (LLM) agents to perform reliable and reproducible FDTR analyses directly from natural language requests. This framework couples a configuration-driven FDTR code package, which enforces physical and parametric consistency, with procedural agent skills that translate user intentions into organized and verifiable analysis steps. We evaluate Vibe-FDTR using a controlled benchmark with two levels: synthetic single-step tasks and real-data multi-step tasks based on measurements of gold-coated graphite samples. Across the two levels, agents using Vibe-FDTR achieve success rates of 100% and 98.9%, respectively. In sharp contrast, ablating skills (Code-agent) reduces performance to 91.4% and 36.7%, which drops further to 38.6% and 0% when the domain package is also omitted (Agent-only). Beyond success rate, Vibe-FDTR also reduces computational cost by 87.7% relative to the Code-agent variant and cuts execution time by more than 60%. Finally, an optional expert mode supports experimental planning via autonomous sensitivity and uncertainty evaluations, and formulates physically grounded recommendations for underspecified tasks. These results demonstrate that encapsulating domain code and expert knowledge into agent skills offers a promising route toward low-barrier, autonomous, and trustworthy thermal metrology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vibe-FDTR，一个面向智能体 (agent) 的频域热反射 (FDTR) 数据分析框架，让大语言模型 agent 能从自然语言请求出发完成可靠且可复现的 FDTR 分析。框架由配置驱动的 FDTR 代码包和程序化 agent 技能组成，在合成单步任务与金/石墨样品实测多步任务基准上分别取得 100% 和 98.9% 的成功率；移除技能与领域包后性能大幅下降，并额外验证了计算成本与执行时间的降低。还提供专家模式用于实验规划与不确定度评估。
Motivation: FDTR 是微纳尺度热物性测量的激光泵浦-探测技术，但数据分析流程复杂、依赖大量领域专业知识且容易出现人为错误，限制了低门槛、可复现的自动化分析。
Method: 提出 agent-oriented 框架 Vibe-FDTR，将配置驱动的 FDTR 代码包（保证物理与参数一致性）与程序化 agent 技能结合，把用户意图转换为有序可验证的分析步骤；可选专家模式引入灵敏度与不确定度评估，为欠指定任务提供物理依据建议。
Result: 在两级受控基准（合成单步与真实数据多步）上，Vibe-FDTR 成功率为 100% 和 98.9%；去掉技能的 Code-agent 降至 91.4% 和 36.7%，再省略领域包后降至 38.6% 和 0%。相对 Code-agent，计算成本降低 87.7%，执行时间减少超过 60%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将领域代码和专家知识封装进 agent 技能，为实现低门槛、自主且可信的热计量分析提供了有前景的路径。摘要未报告方法在 FDTR 之外或更多样化数据上的泛化情况。

papers.title: UniCross: Unified Cross-Skill Dexterous Manipulation Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Many dexterous manipulation tasks require the object to remain securely held throughout the interaction. From the perspective of hand-object relational motion, such manipulation comprises four canonical skills: grasping, relocation, in-hand rotation, and in-hand translation. Human hands flexibly compose these skills to accomplish complex tasks. Existing approaches, however, model these skills separately with skill-specific action constraints, objectives, or even dedicated hand morphologies, which breaks the compatibility and continuity required for long-horizon composition. In this work, we present a unified framework that models all four skills in a single formulation that shares the same state and action spaces and a common objective structure. This formulation enables straightforward distillation of a single cross-skill policy that performs strongly on every skill, generalizes to unseen objects, stays robust to disturbances, and chains skills seamlessly into long-horizon manipulation. The framework also transfers effectively across different hand morphologies. Overall, our results suggest that different dexterous manipulation skills can be viewed as instantiations of a shared task formulation, revealing the intrinsic consistency across different behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCross，一个统一框架，将抓取、重定位、手内旋转和手内平移四种灵巧操作技能建模为单一公式，共享相同的状态空间、动作空间和共同目标结构。该框架可蒸馏出单一的跨技能策略，在每个技能上表现良好，并能泛化到未见物体、抵抗扰动、无缝串联成长期操作，且可迁移到不同手部形态。
Motivation: 现有方法将不同灵巧操作技能分别建模，使用技能特定的动作约束、目标甚至专门的手部形态，破坏了长期组合所需的兼容性和连续性。
Method: 提出统一公式，将四种核心灵巧操作技能纳入同一状态空间、动作空间和目标结构，从而直接蒸馏出单一跨技能策略。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在各项技能上表现强，能泛化到未见物体，对扰动保持鲁棒，并可将技能无缝串联为长期操作，同时在不同手部形态间有效迁移。
Conclusion: 结果表明不同灵巧操作技能可视为共享任务公式的实例，揭示了不同行为之间的内在一致性。

papers.title: Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables multiple institutions to train shared models without exchanging raw clinical EEG data, but it does not fully prevent privacy leakage from individual model updates. This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data using masking-based secure aggregation as the core protection mechanism. The framework combines graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout-resilient aggregation, local update clipping, an optional Bloom filter-based privacy-preserving record-linkage initialization module, and auxiliary-notary-based verifiability. It supports both semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and is implemented using the Flower federated learning framework. The secure-aggregation variants are evaluated in a simulated cross-silo healthcare setting using TUH EEG-derived data under different client configurations. Under the stated assumptions, the secure variants hide individual updates from the aggregation server. The results show that these variants remain compatible with federated model training, although malicious-setting safeguards and lightweight consistency-checking mechanisms introduce additional computation, communication, and round-duration overhead. The semi-honest variant provides the lowest overhead among the secure configurations, while malicious and auxiliary-notary variants offer stronger consistency, integrity, and lightweight verification support at higher cost.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. A version of this manuscript has been accepted for presentation at the International Workshop on Hot Topics at the Intersection of Distributed Machine Learning and Security (HotDiSec 2026), co-located with ESORICS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习在临床EEG数据场景下个体模型更新仍可能泄露隐私的问题，提出以掩码安全聚合 (masking-based secure aggregation) 为核心保护机制的隐私保护联邦学习框架。框架结合图通信、阈值秘密共享、dropout弹性聚合、局部更新裁剪、可选的基于Bloom filter的隐私保护记录链接初始化模块，以及基于辅助公证人的可验证性，支持半诚实与恶意两种聚合设置，并使用Flower联邦学习框架实现。作者在基于TUH EEG数据的模拟跨机构医疗场景中评估了安全聚合变体，结果显示这些变体在给定假设下能对聚合服务器隐藏个体更新，且与联邦模型训练兼容，但恶意设置和安全检查会引入额外开销。
Motivation: 联邦学习虽然允许机构在不交换原始EEG数据的情况下协作训练模型，但单次模型更新本身仍可造成隐私泄露，需要更强的保护机制。
Method: 提出一个完整框架：以掩码安全聚合为核心，集成图通信、阈值秘密共享、可抵抗客户端掉线的聚合过程、局部更新裁剪，以及可选的隐私保护记录链接模块和辅助公证人可验证性机制，覆盖半诚实和恶意两种威胁模型。
Result: 在模拟跨机构医疗环境、TUH EEG派生数据及不同客户端配置下的评估中，安全变体能够隐藏个体更新并保持与联邦训练的兼容性；其中半诚实变体开销最低，而恶意设置与辅助公证人变体提供更强的一致性、完整性和轻量验证支持，但代价是更高的计算、通信和轮次耗时。
Conclusion: 论文强调在所述假设下，基于掩码安全聚合的变体可以安全地用于临床EEG联邦学习，但更强安全属性（恶意保护、一致性检查和可验证性）会带来明显额外开销，需要在隐私/安全与效率之间权衡。

papers.title: The MADRS Pipeline: Supporting Depression Assessment in Clinical Trials
papers.abstract_en: Depression is a major mental disorder for which diagnosis relies primarily on clinical assessments. Automated methods to support its detection via the psychiatric MADRS scale are getting more and more attention. While existing solutions primarily focus on detecting the disorder from different text sources (e.g., online text, social media), there is still limited support for clinical trials, where clinical assessments are conducted through structured interviews based on standard guidelines such as SIGMA. In this work, we develop a LLM pipeline specifically designed to support clinicians in supporting the assessment of depression in patients enrolled in clinical trials. Our pipeline converts audio interviews into transcripts, maps them into the ten MADRS symptom items, estimates their severity, and identify problematic clinical ratings associated with them. Evaluation on real clinical interviews shows a strong overall correlation of 0.867 with expert ratings, providing interpretable support for future assessments in clinical trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向临床试验中的抑郁评估，提出一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的流水线：将音频访谈转换为转录文本，映射到 MADRS 量表的十个症状条目，估计严重程度，并识别有问题的临床评分。在真实临床访谈上的评估显示与专家评分的总体相关系数为 0.867，为临床试验中的未来评估提供可解释支持。
Motivation: 抑郁症诊断主要依赖临床评估，现有自动化方法多从在线文本或社交媒体检测抑郁，而针对临床试验场景、基于 SIGMA 等标准指南的结构化访谈评估支持仍然有限。
Method: 开发端到端的 LLM 流水线，依次完成音频访谈转写、将转录内容映射到 MADRS 十个症状条目、条目严重程度估计，以及识别与这些条目相关的可疑临床评分。
Result: 在真实临床访谈数据上的评估表明，流水线与专家评分的总体相关性达到 0.867。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该流水线能为临床试验中的抑郁评估提供可解释的辅助支持；其范围限定在临床试验访谈场景，而非泛化的抑郁检测。

papers.title: Old Tricks, New Models: How Simple Image Transformations Break Modern AI-based Content Moderation
papers.abstract_en: While automated content-moderation systems have become essential for screening harmful content at scale, conventional task-specific classifiers often provide limited policy cov- erage and contextual understanding. Recently, commercial multimodal moderation APIs built on large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of providing broader and more capable safety filters. In this work, we analyze whether this shift also yields more robust image moderation. We conduct a large-scale black-box evaluation on three established commercial image-moderation services and compare their robustness. By evaluating seven simple, model-agnostic image transformations across multiple providers, datasets, harm categories, perceptual-similarity constraints, and transformation intensities, we find that: (1) all three commercial services can be bypassed using inexpensive image transformations that require no gradients, surrogate models, or knowledge of the target system; (2) even fixed transformations such as color inversion and grayscale conversion induce unsafe-to-safe decision changes while preserving content that remains recognizable to humans; (3) their robustness varies substantially across datasets and harm categories, with multimodal content and self-harm exhibiting pronounced vulnerabilities. This yields the conclusion that replacing conventional moderation classifiers with foundation-model-based APIs does not, by itself, provide a reliable security boundary. Such systems must be evaluated under realistic transformations and deployed as one component of a layered moderation pipeline rather than as standalone safety filters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对三个商用多模态图像审核 API 进行大规模黑盒评测，测试七种简单、无需梯度的图像变换能否绕过其安全过滤。结果显示所有被测服务均可被低成本变换绕过，固定变换如颜色反转和灰度化就能引发不安全到安全的判定翻转，且不同数据集与危害类别下的鲁棒性差异显著，多模态内容与自伤类别尤为脆弱。作者据此认为仅用基础模型 API 替代传统审核分类器并不能提供可靠安全边界。
Motivation: 传统任务专用审核分类器在策略覆盖和上下文理解上有限，商业多模态审核 API 声称提供更广泛的安全过滤，但尚不清楚这种转变是否真的带来更强的图像审核鲁棒性。
Method: 对三个已商用的图像审核服务开展黑盒评估，使用七种简单、模型无关的图像变换，跨多个提供商、数据集、危害类别、感知相似性约束和变换强度系统比较其鲁棒性。
Result: 三个商用服务都能被无需梯度、代理模型或目标系统知识的廉价图像变换绕过；颜色反转和灰度化等固定变换足以造成 unsafe-to-safe 的判定变化，且内容仍对人工可辨识；鲁棒性在数据集与危害类别间差异大，多模态内容与自伤类别的脆弱性最突出。
Conclusion: 用基础模型 API 替代传统审核分类器本身并不构成可靠的安全边界，此类系统应在真实变换下评测，并作为分层审核管线的一个组件而非独立安全过滤器部署。

papers.title: Think with Extra-Image: A Farmland Segmentation Agent Driven by Spatio-Temporal Information Gain
papers.abstract_en: Existing farmland remote sensing image (FRSI) segmentation follows a "Think with Intra-Image" paradigm, assuming that the current image contains sufficient visual evidence for reliable segmentation. Yet farmland appearance varies with phenology and spatial context and is often confused with other land-cover, making instantaneous, local observations inadequate. Thus, segmentation ambiguity stems not only from limited model representation, but more fundamentally from the required spatio-temporal information lying beyond the current image. Based on this insight, we redefine FRSI segmentation from an information bottleneck perspective as a dynamic decision process driven by task-relevant extra spatio-temporal information gain. We further propose FarmSeeker, a dynamic FRSI segmentation agent that identifies ambiguous regions, reasons about their causes, and queries extra spatio-temporal information on demand for accurate segmentation. To evaluate FarmSeeker, we construct GSFS-Bench, the first global-scale, high-resolution FRSI segmentation benchmark that supports reasoning-querying. Experiments show that FarmSeeker achieves more stable segmentation performance than existing methods. The project is publicly available at: https://withoutocean.github.io/FarmSeeker/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有农田遥感图像分割遵循“图像内思考”范式，假设当前图像包含足够视觉证据，但农田外观随物候和空间背景变化，瞬时局部观测不足。作者从信息瓶颈视角将分割重定义为由任务相关的额外时空信息增益驱动的动态决策过程，并提出 FarmSeeker 智能体，识别模糊区域、推理原因并按需查询额外时空信息。此外构建了首个支持推理-查询的全球尺度高分辨率农田分割基准 GSFS-Bench，实验表明 FarmSeeker 比现有方法更稳定。
Motivation: 农田遥感图像分割的歧义不仅源于模型表示能力有限，更根本地源于所需时空信息位于当前图像之外；现有“图像内思考”范式假设当前图像证据充分，导致分割不可靠。
Method: 提出 FarmSeeker，一个动态分割智能体，从信息瓶颈角度将分割建模为动态决策过程，识别模糊区域、推理其成因，并按需查询额外的时空信息以完成精确分割；同时构建 GSFS-Bench 基准以支持推理-查询评估。
Result: 实验表明 FarmSeeker 相比现有方法取得更稳定的分割性能；GSFS-Bench 是首个全球尺度、高分辨率的支持推理-查询的农田分割基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要超越当前图像的额外时空信息才能解决农田分割歧义，动态按需查询是该方向的可行范式。

papers.title: Persistent Gaussian Perturbations Prevent Oversmoothing in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Oversmoothing is a fundamental limitation of deep graph neural networks (GNNs), where repeated message passing causes node representations to become increasingly similar, eventually collapsing toward a low-dimensional subspace. This phenomenon limits the effective depth of message-passing architectures and motivates the search for mechanisms that preserve representation diversity. In this paper, we study a recurrent graph neural network in which independent Gaussian noise is injected after every propagation step and analyze the resulting architecture as a stochastic dynamical system. Under a standard global contraction assumption on the deterministic update, we prove that the hidden representations form a geometrically ergodic Markov chain admitting a unique invariant probability measure. Our main theoretical result establishes an explicit positive lower bound on the expected stationary Dirichlet energy, proportional to both the noise variance and the spectral gap of the underlying graph. Consequently, the stationary representations cannot collapse onto the constant manifold, providing a rigorous guarantee that asymptotic oversmoothing is prevented in the sense of non-vanishing Dirichlet energy. Our analysis reveals persistent stochastic perturbations as a fundamentally different mechanism for combating oversmoothing, complementing existing deterministic approaches based on residual connections, normalization, and graph rewiring. Finally, numerical experiments on both linear and nonlinear recurrent graph neural networks closely match the theoretical predictions, illustrating the emergence of a stationary distribution and the predicted dependence of the limiting Dirichlet energy on the noise intensity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一种在每个传播步骤后注入独立高斯噪声的循环图神经网络，并将其作为随机动力系统分析。在确定性更新满足全局收缩假设下，作者证明隐表示构成几何遍历的马尔可夫链并存在唯一不变测度；主要理论结果给出平稳 Dirichlet 能量的显式正下界，与噪声方差和图的谱间隙 (spectral gap) 成正比，从而保证表示不会在渐近意义下坍缩到常数流形。数值实验在线性和非线性循环 GNN 上与理论预测一致。
Motivation: 过平滑 (oversmoothing) 是深度图神经网络 (GNN) 的根本限制，重复消息传递使节点表示趋于相似并坍缩到低维子空间，这限制了消息传递架构的有效深度。现有对策多为残差连接、归一化、图重连等确定性机制，作者希望探索持续随机扰动能否作为一种保持表示多样性的替代机制。
Method: 提出在每次传播步骤后注入独立高斯噪声的循环 GNN，并将整个架构建模为随机动力系统。在确定性更新满足全局收缩假设的前提下，证明隐表示构成几何遍历的马尔可夫链、存在唯一不变概率测度，并推导期望平稳 Dirichlet 能量的显式正下界。
Result: 理论结果表明平稳 Dirichlet 能量的下界正比于噪声方差与底图的谱间隙，因此平稳表示不能坍缩到常数流形，即渐近过平滑被严格防止。数值实验在带线性与非线性更新的循环 GNN 上均与理论预测吻合，展示了平稳分布的出现以及极限 Dirichlet 能量对噪声强度的依赖。
Conclusion: 持续随机扰动被论证为对抗过平滑的一种根本不同机制，补充了残差连接、归一化和图重连等确定性方法。摘要未提及具体数据集或应用场景，但强调其理论保证与实验结果的紧密对应。
