papers.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch current experience, exceed the policy's capability, or remain path-specific. We propose Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD), which derives capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative guidance from the policy's own verified rollouts. For each prompt, the policy reflects on each verified trajectory in an on-policy group, and a stop-gradient snapshot contrasts the resulting reflections from successful and failed rollouts to construct group-level privileged guidance. Conditioned on this guidance, a self-teacher refines turn-level credit assignment by modulating outcome-based advantages while preserving the verifier-determined learning direction. Experiments across multiple agentic environments and model scales demonstrate that GRSD consistently outperforms competitive baselines and generalizes more effectively to unseen tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD)，用于基于可验证奖励的智能体强化学习 (RLVR)。GRSD 从策略自身的已验证 rollout 中构造与当前能力对齐且能区分结果的引导：策略在 on-policy 组内对每条轨迹进行反思，stop-gradient 快照对比成功与失败轨迹的反思，形成组级特权引导；随后自教师 (self-teacher) 在保持验证器决定的学习方向的同时调制基于结果的优势，细化 turn 级信用分配。实验在多个智能体环境和模型规模上表明该方法一致优于竞争基线，并更有效地泛化到未见任务。
Motivation: RLVR 的终端奖励只提供粗粒度的轨迹级监督，将成功行为、重复错误和偶然选择混在同一结果信号中。现有智能体自蒸馏方法依赖外部检索或单条轨迹提取的自然语言技能，可能偏离当前经验、超出策略能力或过于路径特定。
Method: GRSD 从策略自身的已验证 rollout 推导能力对齐、结果可区分的引导。对每个 prompt，策略在 on-policy 组内反思每条已验证轨迹，stop-gradient 快照对比成功与失败 rollout 的反思以构建组级特权引导；基于该引导，自教师通过调制基于结果的优势来细化 turn 级信用分配，同时保留验证器确定的学习方向。
Result: 在多个智能体环境和模型规模下的实验表明，GRSD 持续优于竞争基线，并在未见任务上具有更强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用策略自身已验证 rollout 的组级对比反思，并结合保留验证器方向的优势调制，可以改善智能体强化学习的训练效率与泛化。论文未在摘要中说明具体局限性。

papers.title: Temporal Poisoning: Clean-Label Backdoors via Event Redistribution in SNNs
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks on Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have primarily assumed dirty-label poisoning, in which triggered training samples are relabeled to an attacker-selected class. We study clean-label temporal poisoning, where a fixed timestamp transformation is applied only to the target-class training streams, leaving their labels unchanged. The transformation preserves the per-pixel, per-polarity event count exactly, making clean and triggered samples identical after temporal aggregation while altering the sequence processed by the SNN. Across three neuromorphic datasets and both convolutional and transformer-based victims, the attack reaches an ASR of 1.00 in the strongest configurations. We analyze the attack through poison-budget and trigger-shape ablations and evaluate established backdoor defenses adapted to spiking models. Defenses that collapse the time axis before inspection are blind by construction, while feature-space methods detect the poison only in selected settings. Our model-free detector, based on per-step event mass, detects the evaluated temporal transformations, demonstrating both the limitation of rate-collapsed defenses and the boundary of the attack's stealth. To our knowledge, this is the first clean-label backdoor attack evaluated on SNNs and neuromorphic event data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一种针对脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的 clean-label 时间后门攻击：仅对目标类训练数据流施加固定的时间戳变换，标签不变，且变换保持每个像素、每个极性的脉冲计数完全一致，因此时间聚合后干净与触发样本不可区分，但 SNN 处理的序列被改变。在三个神经形态数据集及卷积和 Transformer 两种受害者模型上，最强配置下攻击成功率 (ASR) 达 1.00。作者还分析了毒化预算和触发形状，并评估了现有防御：塌缩时间轴的防御在构造上失效，基于特征空间的方法仅在特定设置下检测到毒化；其提出的基于逐时间步事件质量的模型无关检测器能够检测所评估的时间变换。
Motivation: 现有 SNN 后门攻击大多假设 dirty-label 毒化，即触发样本被重新标记到攻击者选择的类别；本文研究 clean-label 场景，以检验更隐蔽的时间型攻击在 SNN 上的可行性。
Method: 提出固定时间戳变换的 clean-label 时间毒化：对目标类训练流施加变换而不改标签，变换保持逐像素、逐极性事件计数不变，使得聚合后数据不可区分；并设计基于逐时间步事件质量 (per-step event mass) 的模型无关检测器。
Result: 在三个神经形态数据集上对卷积和 Transformer 受害者模型达到最高 1.00 的 ASR；防御方面，将时间轴塌缩后再检查的防御因构造原因无法检测，特征空间方法仅在特定设置下有效，而提出的检测器能检出所评估的时间变换。
Conclusion: 这是首次在 SNN 和神经形态事件数据上评估的 clean-label 后门攻击；摘要强调速率塌缩式防御的固有局限，并指出该攻击隐蔽性的边界。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents learn from what their actions change, so training one needs applications it can act on, break and reset. The applications that matter most are login-gated and stateful, so synthetic environments stand in for them. Recent pipelines generate such environments in bulk, which moves the bottleneck from how many exist to what is inside each one. The returns, we find, come from three properties: how much behavioural depth an environment carries, whether it targets the interaction an agent actually fails, and whether it improves alongside the model. We present Echoverse, which compiles specifications into stateful applications whose tasks are graded against the application's own database, and a co-evolution loop that reads every graded rollout twice: as repairs to the environment, its tasks and its verifier, and as training signal for the model. Trained on twelve such environments, a 9B model improves from $36.5\%$ to $67.1\%$ across fourteen evaluation splits, within fourteen points of the much larger frontier model that taught it. We examine each property in turn. On the same domains, shallow environments push live-site accuracy below the base model ($80.0 \to 75.0$) while deep ones raise it ($80.0 \to 85.0$ and $48.0 \to 65.0$); drilling one interface control across many renderings transfers to held-out widget families and to the open web; and repairing a single environment lifts the model trained on it from $16.2\%$ to $38.5\%$. The same worlds serve as reinforcement-learning environments, where a reward combining the grounded verifier with a dense per-step judge raises held-out score from $58.8\%$ to $68.0\%$. We release four environments as a benchmark, with their applications, seed data and grounded graders. Code: https://aka.ms/echoverse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Echoverse，一个面向计算机使用智能体（computer-use agents）的大规模训练环境生成与协同进化流程。它把规格说明编译为有状态（stateful）应用，任务由应用自身数据库进行评分；协同进化循环会把每次带评分的轨迹同时用于修复环境、任务和验证器，以及作为模型训练信号。摘要报告在 12 个环境中训练的 9B 模型在 14 个评估划分上从 36.5% 提升到 67.1%，距离训练它的更大前沿模型仅差 14 个百分点，并发布了包含 4 个环境的基准。
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体的训练需要可操作、可破坏并可重置的应用，而现实中最相关的应用通常需要登录且带有状态，因此需要合成环境来替代。作者发现瓶颈已从环境数量转向每个环境内部包含什么，收益来自行为深度（behavioral depth）、是否针对智能体实际失败的操作，以及环境能否随模型同步改进。
Method: Echoverse 将规格说明编译成有状态应用，任务通过应用自身数据库进行有依据的评分（grounded grading）；同时设计协同进化循环，对每个带评分的 rollout 进行两次使用：一次用于修复环境、任务和验证器，一次用于为模型提供训练信号。
Result: 摘要报告 9B 模型在 14 个评估划分上从 36.5% 提升到 67.1%，与教导它的更大前沿模型相差 14 个百分点；浅层环境使线上准确率从 80.0 降到 75.0，而深层环境分别从 80.0 提升到 85.0、从 48.0 提升到 65.0；针对单一界面控件的训练可迁移到未见的控件族和开放网络；修复单一环境使训练在其上的模型从 16.2% 提升到 38.5%；在强化学习设置中，将接地验证器与稠密逐步评判器结合的奖励把留出分数从 58.8% 提升到 68.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同一个环境世界也可作为强化学习环境使用，并发布四个环境作为基准，包含应用、种子数据和接地评分器。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Echoverse，一个面向计算机使用智能体（computer-use agents）的大规模训练环境生成与协同进化流程。它把规格说明编译为有状态（stateful）应用，任务由应用自身数据库进行评分；协同进化循环会把每次带评分的轨迹同时用于修复环境、任务和验证器，以及作为模型训练信号。摘要报告在 12 个环境中训练的 9B 模型在 14 个评估划分上从 36.5% 提升到 67.1%，距离训练它的更大前沿模型仅差 14 个百分点，并发布了包含 4 个环境的基准。
summary_sections.motivation: 计算机使用智能体的训练需要可操作、可破坏并可重置的应用，而现实中最相关的应用通常需要登录且带有状态，因此需要合成环境来替代。作者发现瓶颈已从环境数量转向每个环境内部包含什么，收益来自行为深度（behavioral depth）、是否针对智能体实际失败的操作，以及环境能否随模型同步改进。
summary_sections.method: Echoverse 将规格说明编译成有状态应用，任务通过应用自身数据库进行有依据的评分（grounded grading）；同时设计协同进化循环，对每个带评分的 rollout 进行两次使用：一次用于修复环境、任务和验证器，一次用于为模型提供训练信号。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 9B 模型在 14 个评估划分上从 36.5% 提升到 67.1%，与教导它的更大前沿模型相差 14 个百分点；浅层环境使线上准确率从 80.0 降到 75.0，而深层环境分别从 80.0 提升到 85.0、从 48.0 提升到 65.0；针对单一界面控件的训练可迁移到未见的控件族和开放网络；修复单一环境使训练在其上的模型从 16.2% 提升到 38.5%；在强化学习设置中，将接地验证器与稠密逐步评判器结合的奖励把留出分数从 58.8% 提升到 68.0%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调同一个环境世界也可作为强化学习环境使用，并发布四个环境作为基准，包含应用、种子数据和接地评分器。

papers.title: GVR-Coder: A Visual-Feedback Framework for Structured SVG Generation in Complex Document and Meeting Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: In demanding professional environments and meeting review scenarios, lengthy text often imposes a high cognitive load. To facilitate efficient information communication, transforming verbose text into logically clear diagrams is essential. Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) provide an effective representation for this purpose due to their editability and resolution independence. However, current research on Text-to-SVG generation remains hindered by three major challenges: (1) the scarcity of datasets for complex, logic-rich diagrams; (2) the absence of explicit layout priors, which leads to chaotic spatial arrangements; and (3) the lack of fine-grained visual feedback to validate rendered outputs and correct aesthetic defects. To address these challenges, at the data level, we introduce DocMeetSVG-100K, a large-scale SVG dataset tailored for document authoring and meeting review scenarios. At the model level, we propose GVR-Coder, a novel framework designed to generate high-quality logical diagrams from lengthy professional texts. Specifically, we adopt a curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning to progressively enhance the model's capability in modeling complex structures, while explicitly incorporating layout constraint knowledge during training. In addition, we introduce reinforcement learning from dual rendering feedback, a mechanism that provides implicit feedback through reward signals to jointly optimize structural complexity and visual aesthetics. Furthermore, we design a generate-verify-repair agent loop, which improves generation quality through explicit, fine-grained feedback and targeted refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GVR-Coder outperforms competitive baselines and reliably produces logically coherent and visually appealing diagrams. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CurryaNa/GVR-Coder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复杂文档编写与会议评审场景下的 Text-to-SVG 逻辑图生成问题，提出 GVR-Coder 框架，并配套构建大规模 SVG 数据集 DocMeetSVG-100K。框架结合课程式拒绝采样微调 (curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning)、显式布局约束知识、基于双重渲染反馈的强化学习 (reinforcement learning from dual rendering feedback) 以及生成-验证-修复 (generate-verify-repair) 智能体循环。实验表明该方法优于竞争基线，能生成逻辑连贯且视觉美观的图表。
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-SVG 生成研究面临三个主要挑战：面向复杂逻辑关系图的高质量数据集稀缺、缺少显式布局先验导致空间排列混乱、缺乏细粒度视觉反馈来验证渲染输出并修正美学缺陷。
Method: 数据层面构建 DocMeetSVG-100K 数据集；模型层面提出 GVR-Coder，采用课程式拒绝采样微调逐步增强复杂结构建模能力，并在训练中显式融入布局约束知识；引入基于双重渲染反馈的强化学习，通过奖励信号提供隐式反馈以联合优化结构复杂度与视觉美学；同时设计 generate-verify-repair agent loop，通过显式细粒度反馈进行定向精修。
Result: 大量实验表明 GVR-Coder 优于竞争基线，能够可靠地生成逻辑连贯且视觉吸引人的图表。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将专用数据集、带布局约束的训练策略以及隐式/显式反馈机制相结合，可有效解决 Text-to-SVG 生成中的结构复杂性与视觉质量问题；代码与数据已公开。

papers.title: SemPIC: Learning Semantic Position-Independent KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: Long-context retrieval and agentic workloads repeatedly reuse the same documents under changing instructions, histories, and document orders. Prefix caching cannot exploit this reuse, while position-independent caching (PIC) remains unreliable because independently compiled KV states lack the future context in which they will be consumed. Our diagnostics show that a learned boundary-conditioned baseline sharply reduces attention deviation near reusable-block boundaries but leaves interior and task-level residuals, motivating adaptation of the document representation itself. We present \emph{SemPIC}, which trains a LoRA-enabled Writer to compile native per-layer document KVs through behavioral distillation while retaining the pretrained decoder as an unchanged Reader. Adaptation is confined to offline cache construction, preserving the standard KV interface and cache-hit decoding path. We further introduce KV Gradient Checkpointing, which reduces peak training memory without severing gradients through cached KVs. Across three models and four tasks, SemPIC raises mean micro-F1 over KV Packet from 0.53 to 0.60, approaching Full Recompute at 0.62.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemPIC，一种学习语义位置无关 KV 缓存 (position-independent KV cache) 的方法，面向长上下文检索与 agentic 工作负载中同一文档在多变指令、历史和顺序下的复用问题。方法用带 LoRA 的 Writer 通过行为蒸馏 (behavioral distillation) 编译原生逐层文档 KV，同时保持预训练 decoder 作为不变的 Reader，适应仅发生在离线缓存构建阶段。摘要报告在三个模型和四个任务上，将平均 micro-F1 从 KV Packet 的 0.53 提升到 0.60，接近 Full Recompute 的 0.62。
Motivation: 长上下文检索和 agentic 工作负载会在指令、历史和文档顺序变化下反复复用同一文档；前缀缓存无法利用这种复用，而位置无关缓存 (PIC) 因独立编译的 KV 状态缺少其被消费时的未来上下文而仍然不可靠。
Method: 提出 SemPIC，训练一个启用 LoRA 的 Writer，通过行为蒸馏编译逐层文档 KV，预训练 decoder 作为不改变的 Reader；并引入 KV Gradient Checkpointing，在降低峰值训练内存的同时不断开经过缓存 KV 的梯度。
Result: 摘要报告在三个模型和四个任务上，SemPIC 将平均 micro-F1 从 KV Packet 的 0.53 提高到 0.60，接近 Full Recompute 的 0.62；诊断也显示有边界的 learned baseline 可降低可复用块边界附近的注意力偏移，但内部与任务级残差仍然存在。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过离线缓存构建阶段适配文档表示本身，同时保留标准 KV 接口与 cache-hit 解码路径，可以显著提升位置无关缓存的可靠性，并接近完全重计算的表现。

papers.title: Stimulus-Evoked Network Dynamics in Human Cortical Organoids: From a Graph-Computational Framework to Repeated-Stimulation Depression
papers.abstract_en: Human cortical organoids provide an experimentally accessible model of early neural circuit formation, yet whether their activity reflects structured information processing rather than spontaneous synchronization is unclear. We developed a graph-computational framework to quantify stimulus-evoked propagation. This includes stimulus-conditioned functional graphs, a graph-constrained dynamical (graph-neural-network) model used as a system-identification tool, a biological message-passing principle bounding integration depth by observable propagation depth, and a suite of graph-level metrics. We carried this program out in full on longitudinal HD-MEA recordings from three organoids. Once the true acquisition sampling rate and stimulus timing were recovered, the evoked response proved to be a fast, near-synchronous network burst with no measurable outward propagation (peak-latency vs. distance slope = 0). The propagation/integration-depth metrics (Deff ,reachability index, dmax) therefore do not apply, and per-day connectivity graphs were not reliably estimable at the available trial count, a negative result with methodological consequences for applying such metrics to organoid data. Reframing around synchrony, response-population size and shared variability revealed a control-validated phenomenon, i.e., repeated daily stimulation progressively depressed and spatially contracted the evoked response. That repeated stimulation reshapes organoid networks is established, but longitudinal designs in which every preparation is stimulated cannot separate this from developmental maturation. We break that confound with a developmentally-matched, stimulation-naive control, where at day 7, an organoid receiving its first-ever stimulation engaged 93% of the array, whereas organoids with five prior sessions engaged 10%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个图计算框架来量化人类皮层类器官中刺激诱发的信号传播，并在三个类器官的纵向 HD-MEA 记录上完整执行。结果发现，在恢复真实采样率和刺激时序后，诱发响应是快速、近乎同步的网络爆发，没有可测量的外向传播（峰值潜伏期与距离的斜率为 0），因此传播/整合深度指标不适用。进一步围绕同步性、响应群体规模和共享变异进行分析，揭示了对照验证的现象：重复每日刺激会渐进地抑制并空间收缩诱发响应；第 7 天首次受刺激的类器官激活了 93% 的阵列，而有五次先前刺激经历的类器官仅激活 10%。
Motivation: 人类皮层类器官为早期神经回路形成提供了可实验的模型，但其活动究竟反映结构化信息处理还是仅仅反映自发同步尚不清楚，因此需要量化刺激诱发传播的方法。
Method: 开发了图计算框架，包括刺激条件功能图、作为系统识别工具的图约束动力学（图神经网络）模型、用生物消息传递原则将整合深度限制在可观测传播深度，以及一组图级指标；并将该流程完整应用于三个类器官的纵向 HD-MEA 记录。
Result: 恢复真实采集采样率和刺激时序后，诱发响应表现为快速近同步的网络爆发，无外向传播；传播/整合深度指标（Deff、reachability index、dmax）因此不适用，且在可用试验次数下逐日连接图无法可靠估计。重复每日刺激会渐进抑制并空间收缩诱发响应：第 7 天首次受刺激的类器官激活 93% 阵列，而有五次先前会话的类器官仅激活 10%。
Conclusion: 该负面结果对将传播/整合类指标应用于类器官数据具有方法论后果；反复刺激会重塑类器官网络虽有共识，但所有制备均被刺激的纵向设计无法区分刺激效应与发育成熟，作者用发育匹配且未受刺激的对照打破了这一混淆。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BladeYOLO: Wind Turbine Blade Defect Detection with Limited Annotations and Weak-Saliency Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Wind turbine blade defect detection remains highly challenging in real-world inspection scenarios due to limited on-site data and the subtle visual characteristics of defects. In practice, blade defects are often small-scale, low-contrast, and difficult to distinguish from complex backgrounds, which significantly limits the robustness of existing detectors. To address these challenges, we propose BladeYOLO, a defect detection framework for wind turbine blades. Specifically, we integrate a Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone initialized with DINOv3 self-supervised pre-trained weights into YOLOv12-L, enabling the transfer of large-scale generic visual priors to blade defect detection and improving feature representation under limited training annotations. To enhance the perception of subtle defects, we further develop a Mamba-guided Weak-Defect Enhancement module, which consists of a Detail-Enhanced Multi-scale Branch for preserving high-frequency structural cues and a Cross-Mamba module for progressively propagating high-level semantic guidance to shallow features. In addition, we introduce a lightweight Style-Injector module that captures environment-related style information via Fourier decomposition and injects it into selected ViT self-attention layers, thereby improving robustness against environment-induced appearance variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BladeYOLO achieves superior performance on the WTBlade-Defect dataset, with additional annotation-budget experiments showing its favorable performance under reduced training annotations. Evaluation on the public Wind Surface Defect dataset further provides supportive evidence for the cross-dataset robustness of BladeYOLO. In particular, on this public dataset, BladeYOLO outperforms the best competing method by 3.5\% in mAP$_{50}$ and 2.5\% in mAP$_{50-95}$.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE TGRS, Code: https://github.com/zhangfangtao/BladeYOLO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BladeYOLO，一种用于风力发电机叶片缺陷检测的框架。它结合了以 DINOv3 自监督预训练权重初始化的 ViT 主干与 YOLOv12-L，并引入 Mamba 引导的弱缺陷增强模块和轻量级风格注入器，以应对标注有限、缺陷微小且低对比的问题。在 WTBlade-Defect 数据集上达到先进性能，并在公共 Wind Surface Defect 数据集上分别超过最佳对比方法 mAP50 3.5% 和 mAP50-95 2.5%。
Motivation: 实际场景中叶片缺陷通常小尺度、低对比、与复杂背景难以区分，且现场数据有限，限制了现有检测器的鲁棒性。
Method: 方法包括三部分：用 DINOv3 自监督预训练权重初始化 ViT 主干并整合进 YOLOv12-L；开发 Mamba 引导的弱缺陷增强模块，由 Detail-Enhanced Multi-scale Branch 保留高频结构线索、Cross-Mamba 逐步将高层语义指导传播到浅层特征；以及轻量级 Style-Injector，通过傅里叶分解捕获环境风格信息并注入特定的 ViT 自注意力层。
Result: 在 WTBlade-Defect 数据集上取得优越性能；标注预算实验显示在减少训练标注下仍有良好表现；在公共 Wind Surface Defect 数据集上，mAP50 超过最佳对比方法 3.5%，mAP50-95 超过 2.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在有限标注下增强了细微缺陷感知，并提升了跨数据集鲁棒性。

papers.title: Landmark shape spaces with induced metrics
papers.abstract_en: We present a unification of Kendall's landmark shape spaces, where rigid motions are factored out and scale fixed on landmark configurations equipped with Euclidean geometry, with landmark configuration spaces carrying Riemannian metrics descending from right-invariant Sobolev metrics on the diffeomorphism group. The resulting new landmark shape spaces achieve the defining properties of both approaches: The regularity of the descending metric prevents landmarks from colliding, the metric is defined in the ambient space independent of the number of landmarks, local rigid transformations are preserved, global rigid motions are removed, and scale fixed. To achieve this, we define a particular Sobolev-type operator, the screened elasticity operator, whose null-space consists exactly of the rigid motions, we show how this operator descends to achieve the desired geometry, and we present approaches to solving matching problems and computing geodesics numerically. The resulting construction allows the use of landmark configuration spaces with sufficiently regular metrics in applications while retaining the shape invariances that are a hallmark of Kendall's shape spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将 Kendall 的地标形状空间（Kendall's landmark shape spaces）与由微分同胚群上右不变 Sobolev 度量诱导的地标配置空间统一起来。作者定义了一种特别的 Sobolev 型算子——筛选弹性算子（screened elasticity operator），其零空间恰好由刚体运动构成，并证明该算子能够下降诱导出所需几何。构造出的新地标形状空间同时具备两套方法的性质：度量正则性阻止地标碰撞、度量定义在环境空间且与地标数量无关、局部刚体变换保持、全局刚体运动被去除且尺度固定。
Motivation: Kendall 形状空间与基于微分同胚群的度量形状空间各有优点，但缺乏统一框架。该工作目标是构造同时保留 Kendall 形状空间的不变性（去除刚体运动与固定尺度）以及微分同胚群度量的正则性（防止地标碰撞、度量与地标数无关）的形状空间。
Method: 定义筛选弹性算子（screened elasticity operator），其零空间恰为刚体运动；证明该算子可下降（descend）到地标形状空间并给出所需几何；并提出数值上求解匹配问题和计算测地线的方法。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验数值，主要贡献为理论构造：新的地标形状空间同时满足两套方法的定义性性质，包括度量正则性、环境空间定义、局部刚体变换保持、全局刚体移除与尺度固定。
Conclusion: 该构造允许在实际应用中使用具有足够正则度量的地标配置空间，同时保留 Kendall 形状空间标志性的形状不变性。

papers.title: Temporal Concentration from Rollout Errors: Implicit Preference Optimization for Text-to-Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in preference alignment for diffusion-based video generation, particularly via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), have significantly improved visual quality. However, temporally sparse artifacts such as motion collapse, object flickering, and color oversaturation remain a major barrier to perceptual realism. Existing methods struggle with these issues due to two key limitations: (1) the preference attribution bottleneck, where offline human annotations are costly and fail to accurately capture learning dynamics, while online reward signals are rollout-aware but often unstable and biased; and (2) temporal credit misallocation, where uniformly applied supervision cannot effectively target the brief segments in which artifacts occur. To address these challenges, we propose concentrated Implicit Preference Optimization (cIPO), a post-training framework for video diffusion models. cIPO derives implicit preference signals directly from the denoising process: given a real video, the model adds forward noise and reconstructs it via iterative denoising, treating the original as the preferred sample and the reconstruction as the dispreferred one. This formulation captures inference-time errors without requiring human annotations or external reward models. Moreover, frame-level discrepancies between original and reconstructed videos reveal when failures occur. cIPO leverages this by computing temporal reconstruction errors and concentrating optimization on high-error segments, enabling more precise correction of failure-prone regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that cIPO consistently enhances video authenticity and temporal coherence across multiple datasets, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of implicit preference with temporally concentrated optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 concentrated Implicit Preference Optimization (cIPO)，一种面向视频扩散模型的后训练 (post-training) 对齐框架，用于修正时间维度上的稀疏伪影（如运动坍缩、物体闪烁、颜色过饱和）。cIPO 利用去噪过程的隐式偏好信号：对真实视频加前向噪声后迭代重建，将原视频作为偏好样本、重建结果作为非偏好样本，无需人工标注或外部奖励模型。进一步地，cIPO 计算帧级时间重建误差，把优化集中在高误差片段上。实验显示该方法在多个数据集上提升视频真实性和时间一致性。
Motivation: 现有基于 DPO 的偏好对齐虽提升视觉质量，但难以解决时间稀疏伪影，原因在于偏好归因瓶颈（人工离线标注成本高且难以捕捉学习动态，在线奖励信号不稳定且有偏）和时间信用分配错位（统一监督无法针对伪影出现的短暂片段）。
Method: cIPO 从去噪过程直接推导隐式偏好信号：对真实视频添加前向噪声并迭代去噪重建，将原始视频视为偏好样本、重建视为非偏好样本；随后利用原始与重建视频的帧级差异计算时间重建误差，并将优化集中到高误差片段上，实现更精准的伪影区域修正。
Result: 摘要报告 cIPO 在多个数据集上的实验一致提升视频真实性和时间一致性，并强调其隐式偏好与时间集中优化的有效性和效率；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需人工标注或外部奖励模型的隐式偏好信号配合时间集中优化，能够更有效、更高效地校正视频生成中易出错的区域。摘要未明确说明方法边界或局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD
papers.abstract_en: Automating industrial CAD design and manufacturing places distinctive demands on multimodal foundation models: the model must see engineering drawings and 3D geometry screenshots, write correct parametric-modelling scripts and Windows COM API code, and cover the full range from single parts to assemblies. General-purpose multimodal models fall short on these tasks, while single-task fine-tuning is too narrow to support the diverse calls that upper-layer agents issue. We build IndustryForge-27B on top of Qwen3.5-VL-27B by curating and integrating six industrial-CAD sub-corpora totalling $\sim$52k multimodal samples---CAD Visual QA (CAD-VQA), parametric CAD code (text2cadquery), assembly-level CAD code (text2cadquery-assembly), and three COM sub-corpora for Inventor / SolidWorks (com_2d / com_3d / com_assembly)---and training with a unified multi-task SFT recipe. Across four CAD-domain benchmarks IndustryForge-27B lifts the base model by $+33.65$~pp on average and outperforms the strong closed-source model GPT-5.4 on all four; across eleven general-capability benchmarks it retains, and slightly improves upon, the base model ($+1.56$~pp mean, no catastrophic forgetting). IndustryForge-27B will serve as the common substrate for downstream industrial-agent projects, providing a unified starting point for a full-stack industrial agent that spans from CAD design to industrial-software operation, from parts to assemblies, and from single-shot generation to closed-loop self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 IndustryForge-27B，一个基于 Qwen3.5-VL-27B 构建的领域增强多模态基础模型，面向工业 CAD 设计与制造。作者整合六个工业 CAD 子语料库、总计约 52k 多模态样本，采用统一多任务 SFT 配方训练，使模型能够理解工程图纸与 3D 几何截图、编写参数化建模脚本和 Windows COM API 代码。在四个 CAD 域基准上平均提升 +33.65 个百分点，并在四个基准上均超过强闭源模型 GPT-5.4；在十一个通用能力基准上平均 +1.56 个百分点，未出现灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 通用多模态模型在工业 CAD 任务（工程图理解、参数化建模脚本、COM API 代码生成等）上表现不足，而单任务微调又过于狭窄，无法支撑上层代理（agents）发出的多样化调用需求。
Method: 在 Qwen3.5-VL-27B 基础上，整理并整合六个工业 CAD 子语料库（约 52k 多模态样本）：CAD Visual QA (CAD-VQA)、参数化 CAD 代码 (text2cadquery)、装配级 CAD 代码 (text2cadquery-assembly)，以及 Inventor/SolidWorks 的三个 COM 子语料库 (com_2d / com_3d / com_assembly)，并使用统一的多任务 SFT 配方进行训练。
Result: 摘要报告在四个 CAD 域基准上相对基础模型平均提升 +33.65 个百分点，且四个基准均超过 GPT-5.4；在十一个通用能力基准上平均提升 +1.56 个百分点，未出现灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: IndustryForge-27B 将作为下游工业代理项目的通用底座，为覆盖从 CAD 设计到工业软件操作、从零件到装配、从单次生成到闭环自改进的全栈工业代理提供统一起点。

papers.title: TSOG: A Format For Temporally And Spatially Ordered Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: We propose Temporally and Spatially Ordered Gaussians (TSOG), a format for efficient representation of 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) content. TSOG extends the Spatially Ordered Gaussians (SOG) framework to the temporal domain by introducing a timeline attribute and temporal parameterization of geometry and appearance attributes. Similar to SOG, TSOG is a lossy format that assigns each Gaussian a unique index and encodes attribute values as index-aligned image data. TSOG is model-agnostic, extensible, and compatible with both discrete and continuous 4DGS representations. Evaluation using a PLYs sequence and FreeTimeGS as baselines, serving as simplistic and state-of-the-art 4DGS representations respectively, shows file size reductions exceeding 90%, with PSNR differences ranging between -0.42 and +0.85 dB. These results demonstrate substantial file size savings with minimal quality degradation, enabling efficient representation, storage, and delivery of dynamic scenes for next-generation 4D content.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Temporally and Spatially Ordered Gaussians (TSOG)，一种面向 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) 内容的高效表示格式。TSOG 将 Spatially Ordered Gaussians (SOG) 框架扩展到时间域，通过引入时间轴属性以及几何和外观属性的时间参数化，为每个高斯分配唯一索引并将属性值编码为索引对齐的图像数据。摘要报告称，以 PLY 序列和 FreeTimeGS 作为基线时，文件大小减少超过 90%，PSNR 差异在 -0.42 到 +0.85 dB 之间。
Motivation: 4DGS 内容在表示、存储和传输动态场景时需要高效格式，现有表示如 PLY 序列体积庞大，缺乏紧凑的编码方案。
Method: TSOG 扩展 SOG 框架到时间域，引入时间轴属性和时间参数化的几何与外观属性，将属性编码为索引对齐的图像数据；格式为有损、模型无关且可扩展，兼容离散和连续 4DGS 表示。
Result: 以 PLYs 序列作为简单基线和 FreeTimeGS 作为先进基线进行评测，文件大小减少超过 90%，PSNR 差异介于 -0.42 到 +0.85 dB 之间，表明在极小质量损失下获得大幅文件体积节省。
Conclusion: TSOG 能够以显著降低的文件大小和轻微质量损失实现动态场景的高效表示、存储与传输，适用于下一代 4D 内容，但摘要未讨论其局限性。

papers.title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing skill acquisition methods often treat skills as experience summaries, memory entries, or direct summaries of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents: when a student fails because it lacks task knowledge or operational strategy, its failed trajectory may not contain enough evidence to infer the missing behavior, while the teacher trajectory may be too implicit to be internalized as reusable guidance. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates the patch by re-running the student, and iteratively refines the patch when the student still fails. To prevent repeated local updates from causing skill drift, SKILL-KD further maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation, deciding whether each patch should add a new rule, delete or modify an existing rule, or be skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.

papers.title: A Query-Efficient Stochastic Volume Rendering Framework for Time-Varying Implicit Neural Volumes
papers.abstract_en: Time-varying implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a compact representation of scientific volumes and, for modalities such as dynamic X-ray computed tomography (CT), are often the only practical way to represent the data. However, interactive volume rendering of INRs is challenging, as cheap memory lookups are replaced by expensive neural inferences, hindering the performance. Therefore, conventional volume rendering methods such as ray marching with dense sampling are often impractical. While resampling, caching, and retraining can mitigate this cost, they compromise convenience and accuracy and become impractical for time-varying data. We tackle these challenges using a query-efficient stochastic volume rendering framework based on delta tracking. Our system employs a four-stage pipeline that exploits heterogeneous parallelism, using ray tracing cores for traversal and tensor cores for batched neural evaluation. Furthermore, we present strategies to reduce INR queries via ray budgeting and query pruning, thereby increasing per-frame performance. Using our renderer, many time-varying INRs can be rendered directly from their original representation. The system achieves ~30-40 FPS at 1024x1024 resolution on an RTX 4090 GPU and converges to high-fidelity images. Moreover, the system enables interactive temporal exploration of the continuous domain, with timestep updates taking approximately 1-2 ms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 delta tracking 的查询高效随机体渲染框架，用于直接渲染时间变化的隐式神经体积 (INR)。系统采用四阶段流水线，结合光线追踪核心与 tensor core 的异构并行，并通过光线预算和查询剪枝减少 INR 推理查询。在 RTX 4090 上以 1024x1024 分辨率达到约 30-40 FPS，时间步更新约 1-2 ms，支持连续时间域的交互探索。
Motivation: 时间变化的隐式神经表示能紧凑表示科学体积数据，但交互式体渲染因昂贵神经推理而困难，传统稠密采样光线步进不实用；重采样、缓存和重训练虽能降低开销，却牺牲便利性与准确性，且对时变数据不实用。
Method: 提出基于 delta tracking 的随机体渲染框架，采用四阶段流水线，利用光线追踪核心进行遍历、tensor core 进行批量神经评估，并通过光线预算 (ray budgeting) 和查询剪枝 (query pruning) 降低 INR 查询次数。
Result: 在 RTX 4090 GPU 上以 1024x1024 分辨率达到约 30-40 FPS，并收敛到高保真图像；时间步更新约 1-2 ms，实现连续时域交互探索。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该渲染器可直接从原始表示渲染许多时间变化 INR，而无需重采样、缓存或重训练，为交互式时变隐式神经体积探索提供高效路径。

papers.title: TongueReenact: Geometry-Anchored Tongue Synthesis for Face Reenactment
papers.abstract_en: Modern face reenactment systems achieve impressive pose and expression transfer using geometry-driven representations. However, they largely ignore tongue dynamics, leading to anatomically inconsistent mouth interiors during speech and expressive motions. We introduce the first framework for cross-identity tongue dynamics transfer in face reenactment. We propose a foundation-model-assisted bootstrapping pipeline that produces a dedicated tongue segmentation model for in-the-wild reenactment without curated annotations. We further introduce a spatially constrained latent masked diffusion model for realistic tongue synthesis, with adaptive mask dilation for seamless mouth boundary transitions. Extensive experiments demonstrate improvements of more than two times over all baselines on every tongue-specific metric. We additionally propose a VLM-based evaluation protocol that replicates expert annotation at scale, confirming perceptual superiority across all ablation variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TongueReenact，据称是首个用于人脸重演 (face reenactment) 的跨身份舌头动态迁移框架。作者提出基于基础模型辅助的引导流程，无需人工标注即可训练面向真实场景的舌头分割模型；并引入空间约束的潜在掩码扩散模型用于舌头合成，配合自适应掩码膨胀实现嘴部边界的平滑过渡。实验称在所有舌头相关指标上超过所有基线两倍以上，并设计了一个基于 VLM 的评估协议以规模化复现专家标注。
Motivation: 现有人脸重演系统借助几何驱动表示实现了较好的姿态和表情迁移，但基本忽略舌头动态，导致说话和表达性动作时口腔内部在解剖学上不一致。
Method: 提出基础模型辅助的引导流程，生成专用的舌头分割模型用于真实场景重演；引入空间约束的潜在掩码扩散模型 (latent masked diffusion model) 进行舌头合成，并采用自适应掩码膨胀 (adaptive mask dilation) 以处理嘴部边界过渡。
Result: 摘要报告在每项舌头专用指标上较所有基线提升超过两倍；所提出的基于 VLM 的评估协议在全部消融变体上确认了感知质量的优越性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法填补了人脸重演中舌头动态建模的空白，并展示了无需人工精细标注即可实现解剖学上更一致的口腔内部合成。

papers.title: ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-based agents are deployed in complex, multi-step workflows, a critical evaluation gap has emerged: most existing benchmarks judge only final outcomes, unable to distinguish reliable reasoning from lucky success or attribute failures to specific process deficiencies, hindering attribution in long-horizon tasks. In this work, we present ClawTrack, a dual-assessment benchmark that simultaneously measures what an agent achieves (Task Score) and how it achieves it (Process Score). ClawTrack comprises 320 tasks across 8 domains with 25+ deterministic mock services. A Process Grader scores each reasoning turn along four dimensions (goal alignment, efficiency, information utilization, and result verification), anchored by 12,541 task-specific rubric items. Evaluating 21 models over 16,000+ trials, we find that: (1) process scores effectively attribute success and failure to specific reasoning dimensions, filtering lucky passes invisible to outcome-only evaluation; (2) the four dimensions are complementary, with result verification as the systematic bottleneck; (3) the framework is robust to evaluator choice across different judge LLMs; and (4) process-based trajectory filtering yields consistent post-training improvements across model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClawTrack，一个面向真实世界 LLM 智能体的双维度评估基准，同时衡量智能体达成目标的程度（Task Score）与达成过程的质量（Process Score）。基准包含 8 个领域的 320 个任务和 25+ 个确定性模拟服务，Process Grader 沿四个维度（目标对齐、效率、信息利用、结果验证）对每个推理轮次打分，并配有 12,541 条任务级评分细则。作者评估了 21 个模型、16,000+ 次试验，结果显示过程分数能有效归因成败并过滤侥幸成功，四个维度互补且结果验证是系统性瓶颈，框架对不同 judge LLM 稳健，且基于过程的轨迹过滤可在不同模型规模上带来一致的训练后提升。
Motivation: 现有大多数基准只评判最终结果，无法区分可靠推理与侥幸成功，也难以在长周期任务中把失败归因到具体过程缺陷，导致评估与改进缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出 ClawTrack 双评估框架：Task Score 衡量任务达成情况，Process Score 由 Process Grader 沿目标对齐、效率、信息利用和结果验证四个维度逐轮评分，并用 12,541 条任务特定评分细则锚定评判标准；此外引入基于过程分数的轨迹过滤用于后训练。
Result: 在 21 个模型、16,000+ 次试验上的关键发现包括：过程分数可将成功与失败归因到具体推理维度并过滤掉仅结果评估无法识别的侥幸通过；四个维度互补，其中结果验证是系统性瓶颈；框架对不同的 judge LLM 选择具有鲁棒性；过程驱动的轨迹过滤在不同模型规模上带来一致的后训练改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为对 LLM 智能体的评估不应只看最终结果，还需过程层面的归因与改进信号；ClawTrack 的规模与结论基于 8 个领域、320 个任务的设定。

papers.title: Learning features from Newton's algorithm: a way to accelerate nonlinear parametrized PDE solvers
papers.abstract_en: It is well known that Newton's method converges faster when the initial guess is closer to a root of a system of nonlinear equations. In this paper, a two-stage Newton initial guess strategy is proposed by learning features from a parameter-space sampling and a database of precomputed solutions. The method uses discrete Newton trajectories to construct two complementary reduced spaces: a solution feature space, built from converged states, and a corrective search direction feature space, built from intermediate Newton increments. For an unseen parameter, a regression model is used to predict a surrogate solution approximation. Then, in a second step, a residual-minimizing correction is computed using a dedicated GMRES-based approach. The resulting state is then used as an initial guess for the high-fidelity Newton method, which completes convergence. The corrective step is computationally inexpensive since it only requires residual evaluations and the solution of a small least-squares problem. The methodology is weakly intrusive once the high-fidelity residual fields and a script-based programming interface are available. This strategy reduces the number of Newton iterations and decreases the overall CPU time. Numerical experiments on representative PDE problems show quantifiable speedups compared with standalone surrogate initialization. Significant speedups are observed. This generic approach can be applied to a broad class of large-scale nonlinear problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段牛顿初值（initial guess）策略，通过从参数空间采样和预计算解数据库中学习特征，加速非线性参数化 PDE 求解。方法利用离散牛顿轨迹构造两个互补的降维空间：由收敛状态构建的解特征空间和由中间牛顿增量构建的修正搜索方向特征空间；对未见参数先用回归模型预测代理解，再用基于 GMRES 的残差最小化修正，最后交给高保真牛顿迭代完成收敛。数值实验表明该方法相比单独使用代理初始化能够减少牛顿迭代次数并显著降低 CPU 时间。
Motivation: 牛顿法的收敛速度依赖于初值离根的接近程度，而大规模非线性参数化 PDE 求解中初始猜测的质量往往限制了整体计算效率，本文旨在通过数据驱动的方式构造更好的初值以减少迭代次数和总 CPU 时间。
Method: 先利用离散牛顿轨迹构建解特征空间和修正方向特征空间这两个降维表示；对未见参数，用回归模型预测代理解，然后采用专用 GMRES 方法计算一个残差最小化修正，该修正只需残差求值和小规模最小二乘求解，计算代价低；最终状态作为高保真牛顿法的初值。该方法在具备高保真残差场和脚本化编程接口的前提下属于弱侵入式（weakly intrusive）方法。
Result: 在代表性 PDE 问题上的数值实验显示，与单独使用代理初始化相比，该方法可量化地减少牛顿迭代次数并降低整体 CPU 时间，摘要称观察到了显著加速（significant speedups）。
Conclusion: 该策略是一种通用的加速手段，可应用于一大类大规模非线性问题，但论文只在代表性 PDE 数值实验上验证，未在气象或降水相关问题上展示。

summary_sections.motivation: 牛顿法的收敛速度依赖于初值离根的接近程度，而大规模非线性参数化 PDE 求解中初始猜测的质量往往限制了整体计算效率，本文旨在通过数据驱动的方式构造更好的初值以减少迭代次数和总 CPU 时间。
summary_sections.method: 先利用离散牛顿轨迹构建解特征空间和修正方向特征空间这两个降维表示；对未见参数，用回归模型预测代理解，然后采用专用 GMRES 方法计算一个残差最小化修正，该修正只需残差求值和小规模最小二乘求解，计算代价低；最终状态作为高保真牛顿法的初值。该方法在具备高保真残差场和脚本化编程接口的前提下属于弱侵入式（weakly intrusive）方法。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该策略是一种通用的加速手段，可应用于一大类大规模非线性问题，但论文只在代表性 PDE 数值实验上验证，未在气象或降水相关问题上展示。

papers.title: Enhancing Irregular Time Series Forecasting with Continuous-Time Modeling Framework
papers.abstract_en: Irregular multivariate time series are widely encountered in applications such as healthcare monitoring, human activity recognition, and environmental sensing. Their core challenges stem from asynchronous observations, non-uniform sampling intervals, and the fact that temporal patterns themselves carry critical dynamic information. Existing approaches either rely on discretization-based preprocessing (e.g., interpolation, imputation, or aggregation), which disrupts the underlying continuous-time semantics, or adopt continuous-time modeling via ODE-based frameworks, which typically require specialized architectures and incur substantial computational overhead due to numerical solvers. To address these limitations, we propose WrapFlow, a continuous-time modeling framework for irregular time series forecasting. On the input side, WrapFlow introduces Continuous-Time Tokenization, which directly encodes raw observation events and explicitly models long unobserved intervals via gap-aware tokens. The resulting continuous-time tokens are then processed by a standard Transformer backbone to capture long-range temporal dependencies. On the output side, we develop a simulation-free training paradigm for Residual Flow Matching, which learns conditional residual vector fields around base predictions while avoiding numerical-solver simulation and backpropagation during training. This design enables high-quality continuous forecasting using only a small number of fixed rollout steps at inference. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that WrapFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WrapFlow，一个面向不规则多元时间序列预测的连续时间建模框架。输入端用 Continuous-Time Tokenization 直接编码原始观测事件，并借助 gap-aware token 显式建模长时间未观测区间，再由标准 Transformer 骨干捕捉长程依赖；输出端采用模拟自由的 Residual Flow Matching 训练范式，学习围绕基础预测的条件残差向量场，避免训练时的数值求解器模拟与反向传播。摘要报告在多个真实数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 不规则多元时间序列在医疗监测、人类活动识别和环境感知中广泛存在，难点源于异步观测、非均匀采样间隔以及时间模式本身携带动态信息。现有方法要么依赖插值、填补或聚合等离散化预处理，破坏底层连续时间语义；要么采用基于 ODE 的连续时间建模，但通常需要专门架构且数值求解器带来可观计算开销。
Method: WrapFlow 在输入侧提出 Continuous-Time Tokenization，直接编码原始观测事件并为长未观测区间生成 gap-aware token，随后由标准 Transformer 骨干处理连续时间 token。输出侧提出模拟自由的 Residual Flow Matching 训练范式，学习围绕基础预测的条件残差向量场，训练时无需数值求解器模拟和反向传播，推理时仅用少量固定 rollout 步骤即可得到高质量连续预测。
Result: 摘要在多个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明 WrapFlow 取得了 state-of-the-art 性能，但未给出具体数值、数据集名称或基线对比细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为该设计以较小推理成本实现高质量连续时间预测，并同时规避了离散化预处理和 ODE 数值求解两类既有路线的局限。摘要未明确讨论方法适用范围或局限性。

papers.title: DataClawEval: A Benchmark for Data Engineering Agents in Real Industrial Harness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed to automate complex workflows, promising to revolutionize data management and processing. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on simplified Text-to-SQL translation or data analysis, leaving the critical and complex domain of end-to-end data engineering largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce DataClawEval, the first comprehensive benchmark designed specifically to evaluate the end-to-end task completion capabilities of autonomous agents in real-world data engineering scenarios. Built upon production-grade code authored by professional enterprise data engineers, it comprises 100 rigorous, end-to-end tasks spanning five execution engines: PySpark, MySQL, HiveSQL, PrestoSQL/Trino, and FlinkSQL. Rather than non-deterministic LLM-as-a-judge scoring, each task is executed within a case-specific, isolated sandbox and graded by deterministic, rule-based scripts. Evaluating 16 frontier agents exposes critical limitations: The strongest model attains only 74.9 overall, and no single model dominates, as each excels on a different engine, revealing strict domain specialization rather than omnipotent proficiency. Thus, autonomous data engineering remains a formidable, unresolved challenge. We release our dataset, containerized environments, and deterministic evaluation scripts at https://github.com/Dicemy/DataClawEval/tree/master
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DataClawEval，据作者称是首个专门评估端到端数据工程场景中自主智能体任务完成能力的基准。它基于专业企业数据工程师编写的生产级代码，包含 100 个端到端任务，覆盖 PySpark、MySQL、HiveSQL、PrestoSQL/Trino 和 FlinkSQL 五种执行引擎；每个任务在按案例隔离的沙箱中执行，并用确定性规则脚本评分，而非 LLM-as-a-judge。作者评估了 16 个前沿智能体，最强模型总分为 74.9，且没有任何单一模型在所有引擎上占优。
Motivation: 现有基准主要关注简化的 Text-to-SQL 转换或数据分析，端到端数据工程这一关键且复杂领域在很大程度上未被探索，缺少对真实工业数据工程环境下自主智能体能力的评测。
Method: 构建了一个包含 100 个端到端任务的基准，任务来源于专业企业数据工程师编写的生产级代码，横跨五种执行引擎；每个任务在案例特定的隔离沙箱中运行，并由确定性的规则脚本自动评分，避免使用非确定的 LLM 评判。
Result: 对 16 个前沿智能体的评估显示，最强模型总分仅为 74.9；没有单一模型全面占优，不同模型分别在不同引擎上表现最好，体现出严格的领域专精而非全能能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为自主数据工程仍然是一个艰巨且未解决的挑战，并公开了数据集、容器化环境和确定性评估脚本。

papers.title: Split and Drive: Dual-Axis Disentanglement for Real-Time Gaussian Head Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Creating photorealistic animatable head avatars from a single image remains a fundamental challenge in digital human synthesis. While recent 3D Gaussian Splatting methods have achieved promising results, they rely on external tracking pipelines whose latency is excluded from inference measurements. Furthermore, they adopt unified representations that entangle geometrically distinct facial regions, limiting both expressiveness and rendering fidelity. We propose SpiD (Split and Drive), a single-image Gaussian head avatar framework built on two disentanglement axes. The compute axis internalizes per-frame driving, eliminating external tracking dependency at inference. The feature axis decomposes the avatar into three specialized Gaussian branches, each modeling a geometrically distinct facial domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistently strong performance against state-of-the-art methods while achieving the fastest inference speed among all compared methods on a single GPU with the complete driving pipeline included.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpiD (Split and Drive)，一个基于单张图像的高斯头部头像框架，通过计算轴与特征轴的双重解耦来消除推理时对外部追踪的依赖，并将头像分解为三个专门的高斯分支以分别建模几何上不同的面部区域。实验显示该方法在保持与最先进方法相当性能的同时，在单 GPU 上实现了最快的推理速度，且该速度包含完整驱动流程。
Motivation: 现有单图可动画头部头像方法依赖外部追踪管线，其延迟未被计入推理测量；同时统一表示会纠缠几何上不同的面部区域，限制表现力与渲染保真度。
Method: SpiD 构建在两条解耦轴上：计算轴将每帧驱动内化到模型中，从而在推理时去除外部追踪依赖；特征轴将头像分解为三个专用高斯分支，每个分支建模一个几何上不同的面部区域。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个最先进方法对比中表现稳定，并在包含完整驱动流程的单 GPU 推理设置下达到所有对比方法中最快的推理速度。
Conclusion: 作者强调双轴解耦可以同时改善表达力与推理效率，且完整推理流程的耗时领先是其主要优势。

papers.title: MUL-T: Decoding Spatial Cellular Architecture in Multiplexed Tissue Images
papers.abstract_en: Understanding tissue organisation in multiplexed imaging requires modelling both cellular phenotypes and their spatial context. Existing approaches typically rely on handcrafted features, such as marker intensity statistics or cell-type proportions, which often fail to scale or generalise across cohorts with heterogeneous marker panels. We introduce MUL-T, a lightweight transformer framework that reframes tissue architecture as a masked contextual prediction task over discrete cell tokens. By learning contextualised [CLS] embeddings without task-specific supervision, the model captures higher-order cellular interactions while remaining computationally efficient. We evaluate MUL-T on several clinically relevant downstream tasks, including core-level tumour pattern classification, patient-level grading, PD-L1 positivity prediction, and cross-dataset treatment response prediction. Across tasks, MUL-T consistently outperforms classical feature-based baselines and achieves performance comparable to a foundation ViT model, despite substantially fewer parameters and lower training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUL-T，一个轻量级 Transformer 框架，将多重组织成像中的组织结构建模为离散细胞 token 上的掩码上下文预测任务。模型仅用上下文化的 [CLS] 嵌入，不依赖任务特定监督即可捕获高阶细胞相互作用。在核心级肿瘤模式分类、患者级分级、PD-L1 阳性预测和跨数据集治疗反应预测等下游任务上，MUL-T 持续优于经典基于特征的基线，并达到与基础 ViT 模型相当的性能，同时参数量和训练成本显著更低。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖手工特征，如标记强度统计或细胞类型比例，在标记面板异质的队列中难以扩展或泛化；需要一种能联合建模细胞表型和空间情境、且计算高效的表征方式来支撑临床下游任务。
Method: MUL-T 将组织切片转化为离散细胞 token 序列，把组织结构学习定义为掩码上下文预测任务；通过上下文化的 [CLS] 嵌入获得全局组织表征，无需任务特定监督，整体设计轻量。
Result: 在核心级肿瘤模式分类、患者级分级、PD-L1 阳性预测和跨数据集治疗反应预测等任务上，MUL-T 持续超过经典基线，并取得与基础 ViT 模型相当的性能，但参数量和训练成本明显更低。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将组织空间结构作为离散细胞 token 上的掩码上下文预测任务来学习，是一种高效且可泛化的组织表征途径，适用于多种临床下游任务。

papers.title: VISA: A Structured Description Protocol for Agent-Based Simulation Models Towards Machine Reproducibility
papers.abstract_en: Agent-based models (ABMs) are difficult to reproduce: their behavior is spread across prose narratives, platform-specific code, and implicit assumptions, so that two readers routinely reconstruct different models from the same documentation. We present VISA, a structured, symbol-based description protocol that specifies a model in eight interconnected tables---four at the agent level (Agent, Variable, Sensing, Internal Function) and four at the model level (Associated Data, Input/Output, Schedule, Validation)---under the principle of minimality with completeness. VISA makes a model machine-parseable and unambiguous via two artifacts: nineteen executable consistency rules that turn model validity into a checkable property, and three reusable LLM-executable skills (authoring, checking, and code generation) that operationalize the full author--check--code--reproduce loop. We validate the protocol on three external, independently authored ABMs spanning three platforms: we reproduce two cross-language (NetLogo to Python) directly from their VISA specifications, and we capture a third, an industrial AnyLogic model, in eight tables (passing all nineteen rules) while honestly demarcating where reproduction is blocked by a proprietary movement library and unavailable data---itself a transparency contribution. VISA moves the reproduction barrier from the model, where it is invisible, to a named, localized dependency, where it is actionable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于智能体的模型 (agent-based models, ABMs) 难以复现的问题，提出 VISA——一种基于符号的结构化描述协议，用八张相互关联的表（四张智能体层、四张模型层）在最小且完备的原则下刻画模型。协议通过十九条可执行一致性规则将模型有效性变为可检查性质，并配套三个可由 LLM 执行的技能（编写、检查、代码生成），串起 author–check–code–reproduce 全流程。作者在三个外部独立撰写的 ABM 上验证：从 VISA 规格直接跨语言复现两个模型（NetLogo 到 Python），并用八张表刻画一个工业 AnyLogic 模型（通过全部十九条规则），同时如实标出因专有移动库和数据缺失而无法复现的部分。
Motivation: ABM 的行为散布在文字叙述、平台相关代码和隐含假设中，导致同一文档常被不同读者重构出不同模型，复现性差。
Method: 提出 VISA 描述协议，以八张互相关联的表（Agent、Variable、Sensing、Internal Function 以及 Associated Data、Input/Output、Schedule、Validation）在最小性与完备性并重的原则下规范模型；同时给出十九条可执行一致性规则，以及三个复用型 LLM 技能（authoring、checking、code generation）来落地整个复现闭环。
Result: 在三个外部独立撰写的 ABM 上验证：两个跨语言模型（NetLogo 到 Python）直接由 VISA 规格复现；第三个工业 AnyLogic 模型被完整收入八张表且通过全部十九条规则，但复现被专有移动库和不可得数据阻断，作者对此作了明确界定。
Conclusion: VISA 将复现障碍从不可见的模型内部转移为可定位、可处理的命名依赖，第三例中诚实的边界标记本身即是对透明度的贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) or On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). While OPSD provides dense, logit-level supervision, it inherently suffers from exposure bias due to the privileged information of the self-teacher. In multi-turn agentic settings, this leads to reasoning route convergence and the loss of clear optimization directions. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO), which reformulates agentic OPSD from a contrastive learning perspective. By leveraging predictive entropy to distinguish between positive positions (reflective exploration) and negative positions (exposure bias), CRPO conducts group-wise contrast to preserve reliable, fine-grained optimization signals. Extensive evaluations across 13 challenging reasoning and deep-search benchmarks demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines, significantly enhancing training stability and generalization in long-horizon interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO)，将智能体环境下的 On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 重新表述为对比学习问题，用预测熵区分正样本位置（反思性探索）与负样本位置（曝光偏差），通过组内对比保留可靠且细粒度的优化信号。作者在 13 个推理与深度搜索基准上报告 CRPO 优于现有 RL 和自蒸馏基线，并提升长程交互下的训练稳定性与泛化能力。
Motivation: OPSD 虽能提供稠密的 logit 级监督，但因自教师特权的信息存在固有曝光偏差 (exposure bias)。在多轮智能体 (agentic) 场景中，这会导致推理路径收敛并丧失清晰的优化方向，需要新的训练范式来缓解。
Method: CRPO 从对比学习视角重构智能体 OPSD，利用预测熵 (predictive entropy) 区分正位置（反思性探索）和负位置（曝光偏差），并执行组级对比 (group-wise contrast) 以保留可靠、细粒度的优化信号。
Result: 在 13 个具有挑战性的推理和深度搜索基准上，CRPO 一致优于现有强化学习与自蒸馏基线，显著提升长程交互中的训练稳定性和泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 OPSD 转化为对比学习形式可以有效缓解曝光偏差，并为长程智能体交互提供更稳定的优化信号。

papers.title: Scaling, Lock-In, and Proxy Compliance: A Political Economy of Responsible AI
papers.abstract_en: AI accountability at scale is an institutional problem: who can observe, verify, and change deployed systems. We develop a sequential political-economy model in which an AI vendor chooses auditability and substantive mitigation, a deployer monitors after adoption while facing switching costs, and enforcement depends on verifiable evidence. Anticipating the deployer's monitoring response, the vendor may stop at an observable procurement floor while mitigating below the social first best, producing a proxy-compliance equilibrium. We characterize the unique interior equilibrium and the corner in which harm is fully mitigated. Independent audit rights raise enforcement exposure directly; portability restores deployer leverage; incident reporting adds a regulator-visible evidence channel; and outcome-linked liability creates incentives that do not depend on vendor-controlled detection. The results explain why documentation and standardized evaluations can coexist with persistent post-deployment harms, and generate testable implications for monitoring, mitigation, and the gap between formal compliance and operational outcomes.
papers.comment: Accepted at AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建一个时序政治经济学模型，研究 AI 问责制：AI 供应商选择可审计性与实质性缓解措施，部署者在采用后受转换成本约束进行监控，执法依赖可验证证据。模型刻画了“代理合规”均衡：供应商只满足可观察的采购底线，缓解水平低于社会最优。作者还分析了独立审计权、可移植性、事件报告和结果挂钩责任等制度干预的效果。
Motivation: AI 大规模问责本质上是一个制度问题：谁能够观察、验证和改变已部署的系统。现有文档与标准化评估可能无法解释持续存在的部署后伤害，需要理论模型说明这种缺口为何出现。
Method: 建立序贯政治经济学模型，包含 AI 供应商、部署者和监管执法三方；刻画唯一的内部均衡与完全缓解的角点均衡，并用比较静态分析独立审计权、可移植性、事件报告和结果挂钩责任的作用。
Result: 摘要报告供应商可能停在可观察的采购底线而缓解不足；独立审计权直接提高执法风险暴露，可移植性恢复部署者杠杆，事件报告增加监管可见的证据渠道，结果挂钩责任创造不依赖供应商控制检测的激励。
Conclusion: 结果解释了为什么文档和标准化评估可以与持续部署后的伤害共存，并为监控、缓解以及正式合规与运营结果之间的差距提供可检验的预测。

papers.title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Large language model training in open-ended domains lacks verifiable rewards, making task preferences difficult to formalize as effective supervision. Contexts can convey such preferences, yet provide little additional supervision once distilled into the student, motivating contexts that evolve with student performance. However, directly using evolving contexts as in-training supervision results in an unstable distillation target and conflicting distributions, requiring mechanisms to stabilize target and downweight conflicts. In this paper, we analyze the effect of contexts through a decomposition of the reverse KL objective, revealing two findings: the student is distilled toward the geometric mean of context-conditioned teachers, and the objective contains a conflict term that measures conflicts among these teachers. Based on this decomposition, we propose Flux-OPD, an OPD paradigm that uses evolving contexts as in-training supervision to capture task preferences in open-ended domains. Flux-OPD treats the differences between context-conditioned and context-free teachers as contextual difference signals, injects them as contextual corrections into the context-free teacher anchor, and weights their correction strength using the conflict term as an indicator. Experiments on open-ended tasks show that Flux-OPD outperforms existing OPD paradigms, highlighting the potential to combine teacher supervision with evolving contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放域大语言模型训练中缺乏可验证奖励、任务偏好难以形式化为监督信号的问题，提出 Flux-OPD，一种使用随学生表现演化的上下文 (evolving contexts) 作为训练监督的在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation, OPD) 范式。作者通过对反向 KL 目标进行分解，发现学生被蒸馏向上下文条件教师的几何平均，且目标中存在一个衡量教师间冲突的冲突项。Flux-OPD 将上下文条件教师与无上下文教师之差视为上下文差异信号，将其作为上下文校正注入无上下文教师锚点，并以冲突项作为指标来加权校正强度。实验表明该方法在开放域任务上优于现有 OPD 范式。
Motivation: 开放域任务缺少可验证奖励，任务偏好难以形式化为有效监督；上下文可以传达这些偏好，但一旦被蒸馏进学生模型便几乎不再提供额外监督，因此需要随学生表现演化的上下文。直接使用演化上下文作为训练监督会导致蒸馏目标不稳定和分布冲突，需要稳定目标并降低冲突的机制。
Method: 通过对反向 KL 目标做分解，得到两个发现：学生被蒸馏向上下文条件教师的几何平均，且目标中包含一个衡量这些教师间冲突的冲突项。基于此提出 Flux-OPD，将上下文条件教师与无上下文教师之间的差异作为上下文差异信号，注入无上下文教师锚点作为上下文校正，并用冲突项作为指标来加权校正强度。
Result: 摘要报告在开放域任务上的实验显示 Flux-OPD 优于现有 OPD 范式，表明结合教师监督与演化上下文具有潜力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: Flux-OPD 通过稳定演化上下文监督并利用冲突项加权校正，展示了在开放域任务中结合教师监督与演化上下文的可行性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ENCORE: Event-Assisted Complementary Motion Refinement for Learned Video Compression
papers.abstract_en: Learned video compression relies on accurate temporal modeling to remove redundancy between adjacent frames. However, most existing codecs infer motion solely from discretely sampled RGB frames, making their estimates vulnerable to fast motion, blur, occlusion, weak texture, low illumination, and abrupt brightness changes. Event cameras asynchronously capture fine-grained intensity changes between RGB timestamps and therefore provide complementary evidence about inter-frame dynamics. We propose ENCORE, an Event-Assisted Complementary Motion Refinement framework for learned video compression. ENCORE first employs Complementary Motion Representation (CMR) to decompose aligned RGB-event features into common and modality-specific motion representations. Spatial Energy and Redundancy-Informed Calibration (SERIC) then identifies event-specific responses that are active and novel relative to RGB, suppresses weak or redundant evidence, and predicts a candidate flow correction. Finally, Energy-Aware Routing (EAR) determines where and how strongly the correction should refine the RGB flow. Events serve solely as an auxiliary modality for motion modeling, while RGB remains the only coding and reconstruction target. Experiments on BS-ERGB, HQ-EVFI, and CED demonstrate consistent gains across datasets and GOP lengths. On BS-ERGB, ENCORE achieves up to 20.80% PSNR-RGB and 22.14% MS-SSIM-RGB BD-rate savings, while retaining clear improvements on the other two datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ENCORE，一个事件辅助的互补运动细化框架，用于学习视频压缩。现有编解码器仅从离散采样 RGB 帧估计运动，在快速运动、模糊、遮挡、弱纹理、低光照和亮度突变下表现脆弱；事件相机异步捕获帧间强度变化，为运动建模提供互补证据。ENCORE 通过互补运动表示、空间能量与冗余校准以及能量感知路由来生成并施加光流修正，且事件仅作为辅助模态，RGB 仍是唯一编码与重建目标。实验在 BS-ERGB、HQ-EVFI 和 CED 上均有一致增益。
Motivation: 现有学习视频压缩主要依赖从 RGB 帧估计运动，难以处理快速运动、模糊、遮挡、弱纹理、低光照和亮度突变等时序退化场景，导致时间冗余去除不充分。
Method: ENCORE 包含三个组件：互补运动表示 (Complementary Motion Representation, CMR) 将对齐后的 RGB-事件特征分解为公共与模态特定表示；空间能量与冗余校准 (Spatial Energy and Redundancy-Informed Calibration, SERIC) 筛选活跃且新颖的事件特定响应、抑制弱或冗余证据，并预测候选光流修正；能量感知路由 (Energy-Aware Routing, EAR) 决定修正应在何处及以多强的方式细化 RGB 光流。
Result: 在 BS-ERGB 上，ENCORE 实现最高 20.80% PSNR-RGB 和 22.14% MS-SSIM-RGB 的 BD-rate 节省，并在 HQ-EVFI 和 CED 数据集上保持明显提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为事件相机提供的互补运动证据能够显著改善学习视频压缩的运动建模，且事件仅作为辅助模态即可带来跨数据集和不同 GOP 长度的一致增益。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有学习视频压缩主要依赖从 RGB 帧估计运动，难以处理快速运动、模糊、遮挡、弱纹理、低光照和亮度突变等时序退化场景，导致时间冗余去除不充分。
summary_sections.method: ENCORE 包含三个组件：互补运动表示 (Complementary Motion Representation, CMR) 将对齐后的 RGB-事件特征分解为公共与模态特定表示；空间能量与冗余校准 (Spatial Energy and Redundancy-Informed Calibration, SERIC) 筛选活跃且新颖的事件特定响应、抑制弱或冗余证据，并预测候选光流修正；能量感知路由 (Energy-Aware Routing, EAR) 决定修正应在何处及以多强的方式细化 RGB 光流。
summary_sections.result: 在 BS-ERGB 上，ENCORE 实现最高 20.80% PSNR-RGB 和 22.14% MS-SSIM-RGB 的 BD-rate 节省，并在 HQ-EVFI 和 CED 数据集上保持明显提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为事件相机提供的互补运动证据能够显著改善学习视频压缩的运动建模，且事件仅作为辅助模态即可带来跨数据集和不同 GOP 长度的一致增益。

papers.title: Building a User Foundation Model for the Open Web
papers.abstract_en: User foundation models have demonstrated strong results in e-commerce and social recommendation, but most industrial deployments assume environments where user identity is stable and persistent. Open-web real-time bidding (RTB) operates on a structurally different data distribution: user identity is fragmented and non-persistent across browsing sessions, and the availability of browsing history depends on user privacy choices. Consequently, a significant portion of traffic carries no historical data, and available records often consist of relatively short, disjointed sessions. As a result, historical signals in this domain are typically represented as aggregated counters and recency buckets, leaving the sequential structure unexploited. To address this limitation, we present a user foundation model that applies self-supervised learning on user browsing histories and show that the learned representation improves multiple downstream production tasks, demonstrating the viability of this approach on the open web. We pre-train a Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and a sequence-level contrastive objective, then fine-tune it on the click prediction task. We optimize the encoder's pre-training pipeline with an LLM-in-the-loop search over a curated catalog of reviewable, code-level edits (lifters), instantiating the LLM-as-optimizer paradigm in an industrial setting. The same encoder representation yields +1.197% RIG on the production bid win-rate model and +1.354% RIG on the production CTR ranker; a 7-day live A/B test confirms +2.13% CTR, -1.13% eCPC (80% CI excluding zero on both metrics).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放网页实时竞价（RTB）场景提出一个用户基础模型（user foundation model）。与电商或社交推荐不同，开放网页中用户身份碎片化且不持续，大量流量没有历史数据，可用记录多为短而不连贯的会话，传统做法只使用聚合计数和最近性分桶。作者用掩码语言建模和序列级对比目标预训练 Transformer 编码器，再在点击预测任务上微调，并借助 LLM-in-the-loop 搜索代码级编辑来优化预训练流程。该表示在生产出价胜率模型和 CTR 排序器上分别带来 RIG 提升，7 天线上 A/B 测试也显示 CTR 与 eCPC 改善。
Motivation: 现有用户基础模型大多假设稳定且持久的用户身份，而开放网页 RTB 的数据分布不同：身份碎片化、历史记录受隐私选择影响，且大量流量没有历史数据。这使得历史信号只能表示为聚合计数和最近性分桶，序列结构未被利用，需要一种能适应这种结构的用户表示方法。
Method: 提出对用户浏览历史施加自监督学习的用户基础模型：预训练一个 Transformer 编码器，使用掩码语言建模（masked language modeling）和序列级对比目标（sequence-level contrastive objective），然后在点击预测任务上微调。预训练流程通过 LLM-in-the-loop 对可审查的代码级编辑（lifters）进行搜索来优化，体现 LLM-as-optimizer 的工业应用范式。
Result: 同一编码器表示在生产的出价胜率模型上提升 +1.197% RIG，在生产的 CTR 排序器上提升 +1.354% RIG；7 天线上 A/B 测试确认 +2.13% CTR、-1.13% eCPC，两个指标的 80% 置信区间均排除零。
Conclusion: 摘要表明自监督的用户基础模型在开放网页广告场景中是可行的，学习到的表示能改善多个下游生产任务。

papers.title: RepBench: Compiling Benchmarks into Capability Representations for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Representation engineering reads and steers capability directions in large language models, yet methods are typically evaluated on paper-specific synthetic data. The resulting measurements are difficult to compare or reproduce and may reflect surface patterns rather than capabilities. We present RepBench, a benchmark-grounded data layer for capability-aligned representation probing. Crawling 13,427 benchmark papers yields a taxonomy of 182 capability clusters in 13 families; harvesting 353 public benchmark datasets yields 46,149 audited probe texts covering 94 capabilities, each supported by at least two independent benchmarks. This multi-benchmark design reduces dependence on any single source: raw per-text vectors exhibit no natural cluster granularity, whereas benchmark-pooled capability vectors show an interior clustering optimum at a small number of clusters on all 12 evaluated models, with low agreement to the human taxonomy. Under cross-benchmark transfer evaluation across twelve models completed by all four readouts, difference-in-means attains the highest model-level mean on ten models, while logistic regression wins the most capability-model cells. This disagreement shows that the readout method and aggregation criterion are meaningful evaluation dimensions. The pipeline, corpus, and evaluation code are released as a reusable closed-loop workflow.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, with appendices. Yanshi Li and Xueru Bai contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RepBench，一个基于真实基准测试构建的数据层，用于大语言模型的能力对齐表示探测 (capability-aligned representation probing)。作者从 13,427 篇基准论文中归纳出包含 182 个能力簇、13 个家族的分类体系，并从 353 个公共基准数据集中采集 46,149 条经审计的探测文本，覆盖 94 种至少由两个独立基准支持的能力。跨基准迁移评估显示，读出方法 (readout) 与聚合标准是有意义的评估维度，difference-in-means 与 logistic regression 各有优势。
Motivation: 表示工程 (representation engineering) 旨在读取并引导大语言模型中的能力方向，但现有评估多使用论文特定的合成数据，结果难以比较和复现，且可能反映表面模式而非真实能力。
Method: 提出 RepBench 流水线：爬取基准论文形成能力分类学，采集公共基准数据集构建多基准支持的探测文本，并以跨基准迁移评估来比较不同读出方法和聚合标准。
Result: 在全部 12 个评估模型上，原始逐文本向量没有自然簇粒度，而按基准池化的能力向量在少数簇上出现内部聚类最优，但与人工分类法的一致性较低。跨基准迁移评估中，difference-in-means 在 10 个模型上取得最高模型级均值，logistic regression 则赢得最多的能力-模型单元。
Conclusion: 作者将管线、语料库与评估代码作为可复用的闭环工作流发布，并强调读出方法与聚合标准是评估表示质量时不可忽略的维度。

papers.title: Beyond Classification: Pathology Foundation Models as Detection Encoders for Mitotic Figures
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (FMs) are models trained on vast amounts of typically unlabeled data and have been shown to yield regularized latent spaces that can be used effectively in downstream classification tasks. This is also true for the classification of mitotic figures vs. other cells. However, it is so far unclear if the latent space of current FMs provides features that are discriminant and spatially suitably resolved to also serve as a backbone for dense object detection paradigms. In this work, we investigate this question for common current pathology FMs (UNI, UNI2-h, Virchow, Virchow2, H-optimus-0, H-optimus-1) and compare their performance against a fully end-to-end trained baseline based on a ResNet50 architecture. We combine FM backbones with representatives of single stage, dual stage and self-attention-based detectors (RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, Deformable DETR respectively) on the multi-domain MIDOG++ dataset, and on the TUPAC16 dataset as an out-of-domain case. We show that the H-optimus-0 and Virchow models yielded competitive performance, indicating that the latent spaces of current FMs, all trained on image-level self-supervision, are suitable for direct mitotic figure detection and may be slightly more robust on our out-of-domain test case. All code is made available publicly at https://github.com/DeepMicroscopy/FM4MFdet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨病理学基础模型（pathology foundation models）的潜空间是否不仅适用于分类，也能作为密集目标检测（dense object detection）的骨干网络，具体用于有丝分裂图（mitotic figures）检测。作者将 UNI、UNI2-h、Virchow、Virchow2、H-optimus-0、H-optimus-1 等六个常见病理 FM 与单阶段、双阶段和自注意力检测器（RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN、Deformable DETR）组合，在 MIDOG++ 和 TUPAC16 数据集上与端到端训练的 ResNet50 基线比较。结果显示 H-optimus-0 和 Virchow 表现有竞争力，并表明当前 FM 的潜空间可以直接用于有丝分裂图检测，且在域外数据上略更稳健。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在图像级自监督训练后已被证明能提供适合下游分类任务的规则化潜空间，但有丝分裂图与其它细胞的分类并不等于检测；目前尚不清楚现有 FM 的潜空间是否具有足够判别性和空间分辨率，能否支撑密集目标检测范式。
Method: 将六种病理 FM 作为骨干网络，分别与单阶段检测器 RetinaNet、双阶段检测器 Faster R-CNN 以及基于自注意力的 Deformable DETR 组合，在多域数据集 MIDOG++ 和作为域外案例的 TUPAC16 上进行有丝分裂图检测实验，并与完全端到端训练的 ResNet50 基线对比。所有代码公开于 GitHub。
Result: 在多个 FM 中，H-optimus-0 和 Virchow 取得了与基线相比有竞争力的检测性能，表明这些 FM 的潜空间适合直接用于有丝分裂图检测；在域外测试集上，这些 FM 表现出略微更稳健的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，当前基于图像级自监督训练的病理 FM 的潜空间能够直接支持有丝分裂图检测，并可能在域外场景下具有一定优势，但实验仅覆盖所列举的 FM 和检测器组合，结论需在更广泛设置下进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal long documents are core carriers of professional knowledge, where critical evidence is sparsely distributed across paragraphs and modalities. This easily causes key information omission and cross-modal hallucinations in summarization by multimodal LLMs. These issues stem from attention drift in long-range dependency modeling and gaps in inter-modal alignment. To address this, we introduce MMLDSum-Bench, a high-quality benchmark for multimodal long-document summarization, covering multiple domains, context-length scales, and visual-textual modality distributions. We further propose MMLDSum-LLM, a reproducible two-stage training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with visual-alignment weighted loss and keyword-aware weighted loss, followed by GRPO with a multi-objective reward (keyword coverage, image-text alignment, ROUGE, and length control). Extensive experiments on MMLDSum-Bench, comparing against leading closed-source and open-source multimodal models under a unified evaluation protocol - including LLM-as-a-judge scoring, atomic-claim precision/recall, image-text alignment (ITA), and ROUGE - demonstrate that our approach significantly improves key-information coverage and cross-modal consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态长文档摘要中关键证据稀疏分布、长程依赖下的注意力漂移以及跨模态对齐不足导致的漏信息与幻觉问题，提出 MMLDSum-Bench 基准和 MMLDSum-LLM 两阶段训练框架。框架先用带视觉对齐加权损失与关键词感知加权损失的监督微调，再用带多目标奖励（关键词覆盖、图文对齐、ROUGE、长度控制）的 GRPO 强化学习。实验在统一评估协议下对比主流闭源与开源多模态模型，显示该方法显著提升关键信息覆盖与跨模态一致性。
Motivation: 多模态长文档摘要中关键证据稀疏分布于不同段落和模态，现有多模态大模型容易出现关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉；问题根源在于长程依赖建模中的注意力漂移以及模态间对齐的缺口。
Method: 提出 MMLDSum-Bench 高质量多模态长文档摘要基准，并构建可复现的两阶段训练框架：先进行带视觉对齐加权损失和关键词感知加权损失的监督微调，随后采用 GRPO 配合多目标奖励（关键词覆盖、图文对齐、ROUGE 与长度控制）进行强化学习。
Result: 在 MMLDSum-Bench 上与领先的开闭源多模态模型对比，采用 LLM-as-a-judge 评分、原子主张精确率/召回率、图文对齐 (ITA) 和 ROUGE 的统一评估协议，结果显示该方法显著提升关键信息覆盖率和跨模态一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过视觉对齐与关键词感知的加权训练目标配合多目标强化学习，可以缓解多模态长文档摘要中的注意力漂移与跨模态对齐问题。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出 MMLDSum-Bench 高质量多模态长文档摘要基准，并构建可复现的两阶段训练框架：先进行带视觉对齐加权损失和关键词感知加权损失的监督微调，随后采用 GRPO 配合多目标奖励（关键词覆盖、图文对齐、ROUGE 与长度控制）进行强化学习。

papers.title: Deep learning-based hierarchical insect classification using camera trap imagery
papers.abstract_en: Declining insect populations make reliable biodiversity monitoring increasingly urgent, yet monitoring of insect biodiversity is hampered by a lack of standardised data and by costly and time-consuming manual identification by expert entomologists. Deep learning-based image classifiers, processing data from automated non-lethal camera traps, have the potential to transform and scale insect biodiversity monitoring. However, challenges remain in acquiring expert-annotated datasets, developing model architectures that generalise well across diverse taxonomic levels and training models on highly imbalanced data. Hierarchical data also benefits from designing models that default to higher-confidence, coarser-level predictions, when uncertain about finer taxonomic levels. In this paper we address these challenges with a deep learning-based hierarchical classification model. First, we present a manually curated, long-tailed dataset of around one million images of insects, extracted from 1,801 camera-trap video recordings and annotated with a five-level, 34-class hierarchy. Further, we adapt a hierarchical classification model architecture to a five-level variable-depth hierarchy, with class-balanced weighting. Our model improves on non-hierarchical classifiers by leveraging biological taxonomy to extract granularity-specific visual features and makes hierarchy-consistent predictions to the deepest taxonomic level that meets a confidence threshold (T = 0.6). papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对昆虫种群下降背景下的生物多样性监测需求，提出基于深度学习的层级昆虫分类模型，使用相机陷阱影像作为数据来源。作者构建了约一百万张手工整理的长尾数据集，来自1,801个相机陷阱视频，并按五级34类的生物分类层级标注；模型采用类别平衡加权并将层级分类架构适配到可变深度，只有在置信度达到阈值（T=0.6）时才输出到最深的分类层级。模型在测试数据上跨越五个层级达到80-99%的逐层准确率。
Motivation: 昆虫种群下降使可靠的生物多样性监测愈发紧迫，但现有监测缺乏标准化数据，且依赖专家昆虫学家的手工识别，成本高且耗时；此外，获取专家标注数据、设计跨分类层级泛化的模型架构以及训练高度不平衡数据都构成挑战。
Method: 提出深度学习层级分类模型：先构建一个手工整理、长尾分布且约一百万张图像的数据集（来自1,801个相机陷阱视频，按五级34类层级标注）；再将层级分类模型架构适配到五级可变深度层级，并使用类别平衡加权（class-balanced weighting），通过置信度阈值（T=0.6）保证层级一致性预测。
Result: 摘要报告模型在测试数据上跨越五个层级获得80-99%的逐层准确率；相比非层级分类器，模型借助生物分类学提取粒度特定的视觉特征，并在对细粒度层级不确定时默认给出更可靠的粗粒度预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用生物分类学设计的层级分类模型能够做出层级一致的预测，并依据置信度在不确定时退回到粗粒度分类，这有助于规模化推进昆虫生物多样性监测。

papers.title: Generalization and Trade-off in Adversarial Training: An RKHS Perspective via Kernel Integral Operators
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training has emerged as a powerful approach for protecting models against adversarial attacks in a broad range of real-world applications. In this paper, we study adversarial training in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) framework through the associated kernel integral operator. We first derive source-uniform generalization error bounds for the RKHS adversarial training estimator in terms of the robustness level, sample size, source smoothness, and kernel spectrum. On a fixed polynomial-spectrum model, we further establish a matching lower bound showing that the optimally balanced generalization rate can be slower than the minimax prediction benchmark. This result reveals a loss of statistical accuracy in adversarial training. Our analysis shows that this loss arises from the interaction between adversarial robustness and observation noise: the noise contribution in the mixed robustness term slows the approximation rate, although the same term reduces the estimation complexity. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage noise-debiased procedure that estimates and removes the noise contribution from the mixed term. The resulting estimator improves the generalization rate and attains the minimax polynomial rate, up to a logarithmic factor, when the robustness level is selected at the stated sample-dependent order. Our results characterize the generalization behavior of adversarial training in a nonparametric framework and provide a new interpretation and a principled solution for the trade-off between adversarial robustness and generalization. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）框架下，借助核积分算子研究对抗训练估计量的泛化行为。作者推导了源均匀的泛化误差界，并在多项式谱模型上建立匹配下界，表明对抗训练的最优平衡泛化速率可能慢于minimax预测基准，即存在统计精度损失。为弥补该缺陷，提出两阶段噪声去偏程序，在适当选择鲁棒性水平时达到对数因子内的minimax多项式速率。数值实验支持理论结果。
Motivation: 对抗训练在实际应用中有效，但其在非参数框架下的泛化特性尚不清楚。本文旨在从RKHS视角揭示对抗鲁棒性与泛化之间的权衡，并解释对抗训练相比标准预测损失统计精度的原因。
Method: 利用核积分算子刻画RKHS中的对抗训练估计量，导出依赖鲁棒性水平、样本量、源光滑性和核谱的源均匀泛化误差界；在此基础上提出两阶段噪声去偏程序，估计并去除混合项中的噪声贡献。
Result: 在固定多项式谱模型上，推导了匹配下界，显示最优平衡泛化速率慢于minimax预测基准；去偏后的估计器在鲁棒性水平按样本相关阶数选取时，达到对数因子内的minimax多项式速率。数值实验验证了理论发现。
Conclusion: 本文为对抗训练在非参数框架下的泛化行为提供了刻画，并给出鲁棒性与泛化权衡的新解释与原则性解决方案。

papers.title: SKIMIX: Multi-Agent Harness-Time Scaling with Skill Mixture for Dynamic Harness Engineering
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly rely on large skill libraries, but selecting, combining, and maintaining skills remains difficult. We propose SKIMIX, a multi-agent framework in which agents with different skill portfolios collaborate through iterative refinement. SKIMIX combines embedding-based skill retrieval, submodular anti-dilution routing, and adaptive skill evolution. Across six reasoning benchmarks, multi-agent collaboration substantially improves open-ended mathematical reasoning but offers limited or negative gains on multiple-choice tasks. Agent-count scaling is non-monotonic, and most improvements arise during the first refinement round. These results show that task characteristics determine whether skill-level ensembles help and provide practical guidance for scalable agent design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKIMIX，一个多智能体 (multi-agent) 框架，让拥有不同技能组合的 agent 通过迭代精炼协作，结合基于嵌入的技能检索 (embedding-based skill retrieval)、子模防稀释路由 (submodular anti-dilution routing) 和自适应技能演化 (adaptive skill evolution)。在六个推理基准上，多智能体协作显著提升开放式数学推理，但在多项选择任务上提升有限甚至为负；agent 数量扩展呈非单调性，且大部分提升来自第一轮精炼。
Motivation: 大型技能库中技能的选择、组合与维护困难，现有方法难以高效利用异构 agent 的技能组合来完成复杂推理任务。
Method: 提出 SKIMIX 框架，包含三种机制：基于嵌入的技能检索用于挑选相关技能；子模 anti-dilution 路由用于分配任务并防止技能被稀释；自适应技能演化用于持续更新 agent 的技能组合，并通过迭代精炼实现多 agent 协作。
Result: 在六个推理基准上，多智能体协作大幅提升开放式数学推理，但在多项选择任务上提升有限或为负收益；agent 数量扩展呈非单调性，第一轮精炼贡献了大部分改进。
Conclusion: 任务特征决定技能级集成 (skill-level ensemble) 是否有效，研究为可扩展的 agent 设计提供了实践指导。

papers.title: Driving up Inference Energy on SNNs: Per-Sample and Universal Sponge Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spike events rather than dense activations, enabling energy-efficient inference on neuromorphic hardware and motivating their use in always-on, battery-powered edge systems. We show that this same efficiency advantage creates a distinct security risk: sponge attacks can increase inference-time spike activity and synaptic workload, inflating energy consumption while remaining difficult to detect through correctness-based monitoring alone. Prior input-space efficiency attacks on SNNs have focused on per-sample optimization, primarily in rate-coded settings. We extend this threat to native event-based binary inputs and study two attack models. First, we develop a per-sample sponge attack that crafts a custom adversarial spike train for each input via gradient-based optimization. This attack increases per-inference SynOps by 1.5-2.6x on three SNN models for the NMNIST, SHD, and IBM DVS Gesture datasets, while preserving the predicted class on at least 98% of evaluated samples. Second, to the best of our knowledge, we introduce the first universal sponge attack for native event-based SNN inputs: a fixed binary perturbation computed offline and applied via XOR to all subsequent inputs. Although weaker, it still inflates SynOps by 1.09-1.24x across all three datasets and represents a more realistic deployment threat because it requires no per-input optimization. Mapping SynOp inflation to estimated Loihi-1 energy yields per-inference overheads from 14 $μ$J to 13.24 mJ. These results show that native event-based SNNs are vulnerable to practical input-space efficiency attacks, and that reusable universal perturbations can accumulate into meaningful battery drain in continuously deployed edge systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的能效优势同时引入一种安全风险：sponge 攻击可增加推理时的脉冲活动与突触负载，从而抬高能耗，且难以被基于正确性的监控发现。作者针对原生事件驱动二进制输入提出两种攻击模型：为每个输入定制对抗脉冲序列的 per-sample 攻击，以及离线计算固定二进制扰动、经 XOR 应用于所有输入的 universal 攻击。实验在 NMNIST、SHD 和 IBM DVS Gesture 三个数据集上分别使 SynOps 提升 1.5-2.6 倍和 1.09-1.24 倍，映射到 Loihi-1 估算能耗为每次推理 14 μJ 至 13.24 mJ 的额外开销。
Motivation: 以往针对 SNN 的输入空间能效攻击主要集中于 per-sample 优化且多在 rate-coded 设定下，原生事件驱动二进制输入的效率攻击以及可复用的通用扰动尚未被系统研究；而 always-on、电池供电的边缘系统恰恰依赖 SNN 的低能耗特性，因此该威胁值得关注。
Method: 提出两种攻击模型：一是 per-sample sponge 攻击，通过基于梯度的优化为每个输入生成定制对抗脉冲序列；二是作者声称的首个面向原生事件驱动 SNN 输入的 universal sponge 攻击，即离线计算固定二进制扰动并经 XOR 叠加到所有后续输入上，无需逐输入优化。
Result: Per-sample 攻击在 NMNIST、SHD、IBM DVS Gesture 三个数据集上的三个 SNN 模型上使每次推理 SynOps 提升 1.5-2.6 倍，且至少 98% 的样本保持预测类别不变；universal 攻击使 SynOps 提升 1.09-1.24 倍。将 SynOps 增量映射到 Loihi-1 估算能耗，得到每次推理 14 μJ 至 13.24 mJ 的开销。
Conclusion: 摘要认为原生事件驱动 SNN 容易受到实用的输入空间效率攻击，且可复用的通用扰动会在持续部署的边缘系统中累积为可观的电池消耗；universal 攻击虽较弱，但因无需逐输入优化而更具现实部署威胁。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为原生事件驱动 SNN 容易受到实用的输入空间效率攻击，且可复用的通用扰动会在持续部署的边缘系统中累积为可观的电池消耗；universal 攻击虽较弱，但因无需逐输入优化而更具现实部署威胁。

papers.title: It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations
papers.abstract_en: Tensor operations represent a cornerstone of modern scientific computing. However, the Numpy-like notation adopted by predominant tensor frameworks is often difficult to read and write and prone to so-called shape errors, i.a., due to following inconsistent rules across a large, complex collection of operations. Alternatives like einsum and einops have gained popularity, but are inherently restricted to few operations and lack the generality required for a universal model of tensor programming. To derive a better paradigm, we revisit vectorization as a function for transforming tensor operations, and use it to both lift lower-order operations to higher-order operations, and conceptually decompose higher-order operations to lower-order operations and their vectorization. Building on the universal nature of vectorization, we introduce einx, a universal notation for tensor operations. It uses declarative, pointful expressions that are defined by analogy with loop notation and represent the vectorization of tensor operations. The notation reduces the large APIs of existing frameworks to a small set of elementary operations, applies consistent rules across all operations, and enables a clean, readable and writable representation in code. We provide an implementation of einx that is embedded in Python and integrates seamlessly with existing tensor frameworks: https://github.com/fferflo/einx
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 einx，一种面向张量运算的通用记号，将向量化 (vectorization) 作为变换张量运算的统一视角，用声明式的点式表达式 (pointful expressions) 表示运算，并把现有框架的大规模 API 归结为少量基本运算。摘要还提供了嵌入 Python、与现有张量框架集成的实现，并讨论了 Numpy 风格记号易出 shape errors 以及 einsum/einops 通用性不足的问题。
Motivation: 现有 Numpy 式张量记号难读难写且容易因跨运算规则不一致而产生 shape errors，einsum 与 einops 虽然流行但只覆盖少数运算，缺乏作为通用张量编程模型所需的通用性。
Method: 作者把向量化作为变换张量运算的函数，既用它把低阶运算提升为高阶运算，也从概念上将高阶运算分解为低阶运算及其向量化；在此基础上提出 einx 记号，使用与循环记号类比定义的声明式点式表达式，并在 Python 中实现、与现有张量框架集成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该记号能把现有框架的大量 API 归结为少量基本运算，对所有运算应用一致的规则，并在代码中提供清晰、可读且可写的表示。
Relevance: 5
