papers.title: Contrastive Concept Importance: Explaining Pairwise Class Decisions Through Automatically Extracted Concept Representations
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based explanations are a prevalent way to explain the decisions of complex black-box methods through semantically meaningful, human-interpretable concepts. To attribute the contribution of such concepts to a model's decisions, feature attribution methods are used to quantify how strongly each concept contributes to a model output. These attributions are typically computed for a single output class and therefore answer a non-contrastive "why P?" question. In many situations, however, such as cases of misclassification, class confusion, and low-margin predictions, the more natural question to ask is "why P rather than Q?". We introduce contrastive concept importance (CCI), which attributes the logit margin between a target class and a contrast, or foil, class to concepts in an automatically extracted visual concept basis. The resulting scores are signed, indicating whether a concept supports the target over the foil or the foil over the target, and can be decomposed into target-logit and foil-logit effects. This makes it possible to distinguish globally important concepts from concepts that specifically influence a class-pair distinction, including whether their effect is shared, one-sided, or directly contrastive. We evaluate the method on ImageNet class pairs using CRAFT-style concept bases, insertion and deletion curves, logit-wise decomposition analysis, and semantic class hierarchy. The results show that contrastive concept importance reveals class-pair-specific model behavior that is not captured by ordinary concept importance alone, and that highly contrastive concepts can be evaluated against semantic superclass structure to assess whether they affect fine-grained distinctions rather than broad category evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对比概念重要性 (contrastive concept importance, CCI)，将目标类别与对照类别之间的 logit 差值归因到自动提取的视觉概念基中的概念，从而回答“为什么是 P 而不是 Q？”这类对比性问题。CCI 输出带符号的归因分数，并分解为目标 logit 效应与对照 logit 效应，以区分全局重要概念和类别对特有的概念。方法在 ImageNet 类别对上结合 CRAFT 风格概念基、插入/删除曲线、logit 分解分析及语义类别层次进行评估。
Motivation: 传统概念归因通常针对单个输出类别回答非对比性的“为什么是 P？”问题，但在误分类、类别混淆和低置信预测等场景中，更自然的提问是“为什么是 P 而不是 Q？”，现有方法缺少这种对比性视角。
Method: 引入对比概念重要性 (CCI)，将目标类别与对照 (foil) 类别之间的 logit 差值归因到自动提取的视觉概念基中的概念；归因分数带符号，指示概念支持目标还是支持对照，并可分解为目标 logit 效应和对照 logit 效应。
Result: 在 ImageNet 类别对上使用 CRAFT 风格概念基、插入和删除曲线、logit 分解分析以及语义类别层次进行评估，结果显示 CCI 能揭示普通概念重要性无法捕捉的类别对特异模型行为；高度对比性的概念可对照语义超类结构来判断其影响的是细粒度区分还是宽泛类别证据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CCI 补充了非对比性概念归因的不足，能够区分共享、单侧或直接对比性的概念效应，从而解释类别对之间的决策差异。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出对比概念重要性 (contrastive concept importance, CCI)，将目标类别与对照类别之间的 logit 差值归因到自动提取的视觉概念基中的概念，从而回答“为什么是 P 而不是 Q？”这类对比性问题。CCI 输出带符号的归因分数，并分解为目标 logit 效应与对照 logit 效应，以区分全局重要概念和类别对特有的概念。方法在 ImageNet 类别对上结合 CRAFT 风格概念基、插入/删除曲线、logit 分解分析及语义类别层次进行评估。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统概念归因通常针对单个输出类别回答非对比性的“为什么是 P？”问题，但在误分类、类别混淆和低置信预测等场景中，更自然的提问是“为什么是 P 而不是 Q？”，现有方法缺少这种对比性视角。
summary_sections.method: 引入对比概念重要性 (CCI)，将目标类别与对照 (foil) 类别之间的 logit 差值归因到自动提取的视觉概念基中的概念；归因分数带符号，指示概念支持目标还是支持对照，并可分解为目标 logit 效应和对照 logit 效应。
summary_sections.result: 在 ImageNet 类别对上使用 CRAFT 风格概念基、插入和删除曲线、logit 分解分析以及语义类别层次进行评估，结果显示 CCI 能揭示普通概念重要性无法捕捉的类别对特异模型行为；高度对比性的概念可对照语义超类结构来判断其影响的是细粒度区分还是宽泛类别证据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 CCI 补充了非对比性概念归因的不足，能够区分共享、单侧或直接对比性的概念效应，从而解释类别对之间的决策差异。

papers.title: One Patch Is Enough: Reinforcement-Optimized Visual Token Grounding for MLLM-Based Scene Text Spotting
papers.abstract_en: Scene text spotting requires high-precision alignment between textual recognition and spatial localization. While visual-token grounding has emerged as a promising formulation for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the previous multi-patch paradigm often introduces redundant noise and localization ambiguity, particularly for dense or small text instances. To address this, we propose Single-Patch Text Spotting (SPaTS), a vision-centric framework that routes each text instance through a single anchor visual token and then recovers geometry via full-image refinement. To accurately identify this anchor without oracle labels, we introduce Single-Patch Selective Optimization (SPaSO), a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes discrete visual-token selection using patch-level rewards. To further improve representation robustness and localization precision, we introduce Directional Embedding Alignment (DEA) to suppress unstable norm bias by decoupling feature magnitude and direction, and Patch-Enhanced Decoding (PED) to fuse the routed anchor with language semantics and cross-attend over the full-image feature map for geometry-aware boundary regression beyond coordinate-space surrogates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPaTS consistently and significantly outperforms both frontier closed-source MLLMs and OCR MLLMs. Code will be released soon.

TL;DR: 本文提出 SPaTS，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 场景文本识别的视觉 token grounding 框架，将每个文本实例路由到单一 anchor 视觉 token，再通过全图精炼恢复几何信息。训练时使用 SPaSO 强化学习优化离散视觉 token 选择，并引入 DEA 解耦特征幅值与方向、PED 融合语言语义与全图特征做边界回归。摘要报告 SPaTS 在实验中一致且显著优于前沿闭源 MLLM 与 OCR MLLM，代码即将发布。

Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但称 SPaTS 在大量实验中一致且显著优于前沿闭源 MLLM 和 OCR MLLM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一 patch 的视觉 token grounding 配合全图精炼可以缓解多 patch 范式的噪声与定位模糊问题，并承诺公开代码。

papers.title: CoRE-UIR: Prior-guided common and residual experts for efficient all-in-one remote sensing image restoration
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing images acquired by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and satellites are often degraded by adverse weather, illumination variation, and imaging artifacts, which may co-occur and jointly induce global distribution shifts and local structural corruption. Although All-in-One image restoration offers an appealing unified alternative to task-specific pipelines, existing methods still suffer from weak or implicit degradation cues and parameter redundancy caused by full-rank multi-expert designs with overlapping restoration behaviors. We propose CoRE-UIR (Common and Residual Experts for Universal Image Restoration), a prior-guided global-local framework centered on the Common-and-Residual Expert Block (CoRE). CoRE explicitly decomposes restoration capacity into a common dense expert for degradation-invariant restoration and low-rank residual experts for degradation-specific compensation, enabling adaptive specialization without redundant expert replication. Built on this design, Degradation Prior Embedding (DPE) adapts frozen CLIP features into an explicit restoration-oriented prior, while Global Feature Modulation (GFM) aligns global feature statistics before local residual compensation. We also construct MDVD-108K (Multi-Degradation VisDrone), a large-scale UAV restoration dataset covering both single and compound degradations, together with a real-world test set. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets show that CoRE-UIR improves the overall average PSNR by 1.05 dB while running 11.83$\times$ faster and reducing peak memory by 85.3% relative to the strongest baseline, BaryIR, thereby maintaining a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. Evaluations on downstream tasks and unseen degradation also validate the generalizability of CoRE-UIR. The code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/zzaiyan/CoRE-UIR.
papers.comment: Accepted by ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoRE-UIR（Common and Residual Experts for Universal Image Restoration），一个面向无人机与卫星遥感图像的全能图像复原框架。核心是 Common-and-Residual Expert Block（CoRE），将复原能力显式分解为一个公共稠密专家（degradation-invariant restoration）和多个低秩残差专家（degradation-specific compensation），以避免全秩多专家设计中的参数冗余。作者还构建了大规模无人机退化数据集 MDVD-108K（Multi-Degradation VisDrone），覆盖单一与复合退化，并附带真实世界测试集。实验显示 CoRE-UIR 相对最强基线 BaryIR 平均 PSNR 提升 1.05 dB，同时速度快 11.83 倍、峰值内存降低 85.3%，且在下游任务与未见退化上表现良好。
Motivation: 遥感图像常受多种同时出现的退化影响（恶劣天气、光照变化、成像伪影），它们共同造成全局分布偏移和局部结构损坏。现有 All-in-One 复原方法存在退化线索弱或隐式，以及全秩多专家设计带来参数冗余和重叠行为的问题。
Method: 提出 CoRE-UIR，基于 Common-and-Residual Expert Block 将复原能力分解为公共稠密专家与低秩残差专家；Degradation Prior Embedding（DPE）将冻结的 CLIP 特征适配为显式复原先验；Global Feature Modulation（GFM）在局部残差补偿前对齐全局特征统计。同时构建 MDVD-108K 数据集以覆盖单一种类和复合退化。
Result: 在多个数据集上，CoRE-UIR 相对最强基线 BaryIR 平均 PSNR 提高 1.05 dB，推理速度快 11.83 倍，峰值内存减少 85.3%；下游任务评估和未见退化实验验证了其泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式分解公共与残差专家并结合先验引导的全局-局部框架，能够在保持图像复原质量的同時显著提升效率与泛化性；代码和数据集将公开。

papers.title: Unifying Adversarially Robust Model Experts in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, posing a serious problem for real-life applications and deployment. Adversarial fine-tuning emerges as a prominent defense method; however, different fine-tuning strategies often produce specialized models with distinct robustness characteristics. Each fine-tuned model in turn thrives in some evaluation settings but falters on others, limiting their defensive capabilities. We refer to these specialized fine-tuned models as robust model experts and propose a collaborative adversarial fine-tuning framework: CARE - Collaborative Adversarial Robustness fine-tuning using Embedding alignment. CARE maintains multiple experts during training, enables knowledge exchange through embedding-space harmonization, and consolidates the learned knowledge into a single unified robust model. Experts benefit from one another while preserving their individual specializations, enabling the final model to inherit complementary robustness properties. In this paper, we demonstrate CARE on two different adversarial fine-tuning strategies with complementary robustness behaviors. Extensive experiments on classic image classification and downstream vision-language tasks display the effectiveness of our approach, with CARE being able to outperform individually learned model experts. The results suggest that collaborative learning across model experts is a promising direction for improving adversarial robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARE（Collaborative Adversarial Robustness fine-tuning using Embedding alignment），一个面向视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的协作对抗微调框架。作者将不同微调策略得到的专精模型视为鲁棒模型专家 (robust model experts)，在训练中维护多个专家，通过嵌入空间对齐 (embedding-space harmonization) 促进知识交换，并最终合并为单一统一鲁棒模型。在经典图像分类和下游视觉语言任务上的实验显示，CARE 能优于单独学习的模型专家。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型如 CLIP 易受对抗攻击，对抗微调是主要防御手段，但不同微调策略产生的模型各有专长，只在部分评测设置下表现好，限制了整体防御能力。
Method: 提出 CARE 框架：训练时维护多个专家，通过嵌入空间对齐实现专家间的知识交换，同时保留各自的专长，最后将所学知识整合为单一统一鲁棒模型；论文在两种具有互补鲁棒行为的对抗微调策略上验证该方法。
Result: 在经典图像分类和下游视觉语言任务上的大量实验表明，CARE 能超越单独训练的模型专家。
Conclusion: 摘要认为跨模型专家的协作学习是提升对抗鲁棒性的有前途方向。

papers.title: MMHBench: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Mental Health Understanding in Long-Form Videos
papers.abstract_en: Mental health understanding in long-form videos requires nuanced reasoning over observable behavior, interpersonal context, and latent psychological states. Existing benchmarks largely reduce this task to coarse-grained classification, providing limited insight into whether models truly understand psychological phenomena or rely on superficial correlations. To address this limitation, we introduce MMHBench, a comprehensive multimodal benchmark for multi-perspective mental health understanding, comprising 268 long-form videos and 2,184 carefully curated questions. MMHBench organizes the evaluation into two complementary settings: (1) third-person assessment, consisting of 605 questions that focus on the interpretation of observable behaviors and multimodal evidence, and (2) first-person perspective-taking, comprising 1,579 questions that require perspective-conditioned reasoning to identify the interpretation of the mental state supported by the available multimodal evidence. We propose a Multi-Agent Question Generation (MAQG) framework that simulates diverse social roles to synthesize questions from multiple perspectives. The generated questions are refined through multi-role feedback and iterative optimization, followed by expert-guided verification to ensure quality and validity. Extensive evaluation of 22 representative multimodal large language models (MLLMs), spanning both open-source and leading closed-source models, demonstrates that long-form video mental health understanding remains highly challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMHBench，一个面向长视频心理健康理解的多视角多模态基准，包含 268 个长视频和 2,184 个精心设计的问题。基准分为第三人称评估（605 问）和第一人称视角推理（1,579 问）两个互补设置，并通过多智能体问题生成（MAQG）框架从多种社会角色视角合成问题、经多轮反馈与专家验证。作者对 22 个代表性多模态大模型（MLLM）的评估表明，长视频心理健康理解仍是一个高度困难的挑战。
Motivation: 现有心理健康理解基准大多将任务简化为粗粒度分类，只能判断模型是否利用表面关联，难以验证模型是否真正理解心理现象及其多模态证据。
Method: 提出 Multi-Agent Question Generation (MAQG) 框架，模拟多种社会角色合成多视角问题，并通过多角色反馈和迭代优化精炼问题，最后经专家引导验证保证质量与有效性。
Result: 对 22 个覆盖开源与领先闭源模型的多模态大语言模型进行广泛评估，结果显示长视频心理健康理解仍然高度挑战性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前 MLLM 在该任务上表现有限，MMHBench 可作为更细粒度评估模型心理理解能力的基准资源。

papers.title: Dynamic Spectral Filtering for Temporal Graph Learning: Learning Evolving Propagation Operators
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph learning is commonly organized around the evolution of node states or the encoding of interaction histories. We study an underexplored, operator-centric question: should the graph propagation mechanism itself evolve over time? We introduce Dynamic Spectral Filtering (DSF), which represents propagation at snapshot t by a Chebyshev polynomial filter with vector-valued, time-dependent coefficients. DSF explicitly treats these compact multi-order coefficients as recurrent temporal states. A recurrent branch proposes updates, while multiplicative global and order-specific gates regulate their magnitude. The temporal state is independent of the number of nodes. On MOOC, Wikipedia, and Reddit temporal link-prediction benchmarks, converged DSF runs attain AP scores of 0.7851, 0.9088, and 0.9860, respectively, with 93K to 133K trainable parameters, 68 to 182 MB peak GPU memory, and 1.6 to 2.1 seconds of training per epoch. Against the closely related DEFT baseline, DSF is better on MOOC, within 0.001 AP on Reddit, and modestly lower on Wikipedia, while using 8.3 to 8.6 times fewer parameters, 25 to 33 times less GPU memory, and 5 to 19 times less time per epoch. Relative to all measured alternatives, it uses 3.3 to 38.6 times less GPU memory. These results support direct spectral-response evolution as a useful temporal inductive bias when computational efficiency is a first-class requirement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间图学习中的一个算子中心问题：图传播机制本身是否应随时间演化。作者提出动态谱滤波 (Dynamic Spectral Filtering, DSF)，用系数为时间相关向量的 Chebyshev 多项式滤波器表示每个快照的传播算子，并将这些多阶系数作为循环时序状态。在 MOOC、Wikipedia 和 Reddit 时间链路预测基准上，收敛的 DSF 分别取得 AP 0.7851、0.9088 和 0.9860，参数量 93K 至 133K，峰值 GPU 内存 68 至 182 MB，每 epoch 训练 1.6 至 2.1 秒。
Motivation: 现有时间图学习方法主要围绕节点状态演化或交互历史编码，尚不清楚传播机制本身是否应当随时间演化；作者针对这一未充分探索的算子中心问题展开研究。
Method: DSF 将时间快照 t 的传播表示为具有向量值、时间相关系数的 Chebyshev 多项式滤波器，显式把这些紧凑的多阶系数当作循环时序状态；一个循环分支提出更新，乘法全局门与阶别门 (order-specific gates) 调节更新幅度，且时序状态与节点数量无关。
Result: 与密切相关的 DEFT 基线相比，DSF 在 MOOC 上更优，在 Reddit 上 AP 差距在 0.001 以内，在 Wikipedia 上略低，同时参数少 8.3 至 8.6 倍，GPU 内存少 25 至 33 倍，每 epoch 时间少 5 至 19 倍；相对所有被测替代方案，GPU 内存少 3.3 至 38.6 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，当计算效率是一等需求时，直接学习谱响应的演化可以作为一种有效的时间归纳偏置 (temporal inductive bias)。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Not All Tokens Deserve Equal Credit: Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation for Long-CoT Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is central to improving long-CoT reasoning in large language models. Critic-free methods such as GRPO convert response-level rewards into advantages and uniformly broadcast them across tokens, overlooking their unequal contributions to the final outcome. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) instead provides dense distributional supervision by minimizing the forward KL divergence between an unprivileged policy and a privileged self-teacher, implicitly assuming that the resulting likelihood shifts encode reliable answer-aligned information. We test this premise by fixing each sampled trajectory and re-scoring it under two opposing outcome conditions, one asserting correctness and the other incorrectness. Most affected tokens shift in the same direction under both conditions, with few sign reversals and substantial overlap in the induced optimization signals. Large shifts also concentrate on highly substitutable surface-form tokens, whereas tokens carrying problem-specific reasoning content are less sensitive. These findings show that privileged shifts fail to provide reliable answer-aligned directions, while their magnitudes primarily reflect counterfactual sensitivity rather than token-level learning value. Based on these observations, we propose Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation (CSCR), a simple extension of GRPO that reduces credit for highly sensitive tokens and renormalizes token-level advantages to preserve both the original credit budget and verifier-determined direction. On long-CoT mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CSCR consistently outperforms GRPO baseline with the same number of policy updates. Targeted ablations further corroborate our diagnosis: privilege-induced directions are unreliable, moderate downweighting is most effective, and stronger modulation destabilizes optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 RLVR（verifiable rewards 强化学习）下长 CoT 推理的 token 级信用分配问题。作者通过将同一轨迹在“正确”与“错误”两种相反结果条件下重打分，发现 privileged self-teacher 产生的似然位移方向并不可靠，且大幅位移集中在高度可替换的表层 token。基于此提出 CSCR，即对高反事实敏感度 token 降权并重新归一化 GRPO 的 token 级优势，在长 CoT 数学推理基准上稳定优于 GRPO 基线。
Motivation: 现有 critic-free 方法如 GRPO 将 response-level 奖励均匀广播到所有 token，忽略 token 对最终结果的不等贡献；而 OPSD 类方法通过前向 KL 蒸馏提供密集分布监督，隐含假设似然位移编码了可靠的答案对齐信息，但该前提未被验证。
Method: 先做诊断实验：固定采样轨迹，在断言正确与断言错误两种相反结果条件下重新打分，分析 token 位移方向与幅度。随后提出 Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation (CSCR)，作为 GRPO 的简单扩展：降低高敏感 token 的信用，并重新归一化 token 级优势，以保持原始信用预算和 verifier 决定的优化方向。
Result: 在长 CoT 数学推理基准上，CSCR 在相同策略更新次数下一致优于 GRPO 基线。针对性消融显示 privilege 诱导的方向不可靠、适度降权最有效，而过强调制会破坏优化稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 token 级学习价值应依据反事实敏感度而非 privileged 似然位移来判断；CSCR 通过轻量修改在保持信用预算与方向的同时改善了长 CoT RLVR 训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DECODE: Tackling Representation and Decision Degradation in Continual AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: As generative models continue to evolve, AI-generated image detectors must incrementally adapt to emerging generative domains while preserving knowledge acquired from previous ones. This continual learning setting is particularly challenging because forensic traces are often subtle and generator-specific, making detectors highly vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods primarily address this problem by stabilizing feature representations, implicitly treating forgetting as a representation-level issue. In this paper, we show that this perspective is incomplete. We demonstrate that even when feature representations remain discriminative, the decision boundary can progressively drift as the classification head is continually optimized on new domains. These two effects jointly give rise to a compound failure mode, termed Dual Degradation. To overcome this challenge, we propose DECODE, a decoupled continual detection framework that jointly mitigates representation- and decision-level forgetting. Specifically, we introduce Subspace Diversity Regularization (SDR) to preserve diverse forensic representations and Closed-Form Decision Alignment (CDA) to recalibrate the shared classification head after each adapter merge without manual hyperparameter tuning. Extensive experiments on 19 generative domains show that DECODE achieves an average accuracy of 99.36% with only 0.39% forgetting, while further generalizing to 11 unseen generators with 95.36% accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习场景下的 AI 生成图像检测问题，指出仅稳定特征表示不足以避免遗忘，分类头在新域上持续优化会导致决策边界漂移，二者共同构成 Dual Degradation。作者提出解耦的持续检测框架 DECODE，包含子空间多样性正则化 (SDR) 和闭式决策对齐 (CDA)，在 19 个生成域上达到平均准确率 99.36%、遗忘率仅 0.39%，并能泛化到 11 个未见生成器。
Motivation: 现有持续 AI 生成图像检测方法主要聚焦于稳定特征表示，将灾难性遗忘视为表示层面的问题；但作者指出即使表示保持判别性，分类头的持续优化仍会使决策边界漂移，导致表示与决策两个层面的退化同时发生。
Method: 提出 DECODE 解耦持续检测框架：用子空间多样性正则化 (Subspace Diversity Regularization, SDR) 保留多样的取证表示；用闭式决策对齐 (Closed-Form Decision Alignment, CDA) 在每次适配器合并后重新校准共享分类头，且无需手动调超参数。
Result: 在 19 个生成域上，DECODE 达到平均准确率 99.36%，仅遗忘 0.39%；在 11 个未见生成器上进一步泛化，准确率为 95.36%。
Conclusion: 作者强调持续检测中的遗忘同时涉及表示与决策两个层面，解耦地缓解这两类退化可以显著降低灾难性遗忘并提升对新生成域的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoboBRIDGE: A Modular Framework for Bridging Policies to Robust Real-World Robotic Agents
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have attracted growing interest as a scalable approach to robotic manipulation. While these models are effective action predictors, deploying them as robotic agents exposes critical gaps: no mechanism for failure recovery, inconsistent execution over long horizons, and limited robustness to shifts in observations, tasks, or embodiments. Existing solutions address these limitations individually through model retraining or environment-specific modules, yet what is needed is a general framework that systematically transforms a pretrained VLA into a robotic agent. We present RoboBRIDGE, a modular framework that provides an orchestration layer over five coordinated modules, namely Monitor, Perceptor, Planner, Controller, and Robot Interface, to compose robust robotic agents from off-the-shelf components, including pretrained VLAs. The Monitor pairs rapid failure detection with hierarchical recovery to correct errors before they cascade. When the environment diverges from the current plan, the Planner triggers replanning while the Perceptor updates scene understanding asynchronously, avoiding execution stalls. Within the Controller, primitive skill fine-tuning factors manipulation into domain-invariant primitives with dedicated LoRA adapters, reducing sensitivity to domain shifts when a VLA is used. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world case studies spanning multiple robot platforms and VLA backbones, RoboBRIDGE consistently outperforms both standalone policies and prior augmented VLA deployments. These results suggest that reliable robotic agency does not arise from scaling action predictors alone, but from structured orchestration around them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboBRIDGE，一个模块化框架，通过五个协调模块（Monitor、Perceptor、Planner、Controller、Robot Interface）将预训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）组织为鲁棒的机器人操作智能体。该框架提供快速失败检测与分层恢复、重规划触发、异步场景理解，以及基于 LoRA 适配器的原始技能微调，以解决 VLA 部署中常见的失败恢复缺失、长时程执行不一致和域偏移敏感性问题。在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 及覆盖多机器人平台和多种 VLA 骨干的真实世界案例研究中，RoboBRIDGE 一致优于独立策略和先前的增强型 VLA 部署。
Motivation: 预训练 VLA 模型作为动作预测器表现有效，但直接部署为机器人智能体时缺乏失败恢复机制、长时程执行不一致，且对观察、任务或本体（embodiment）变化鲁棒性有限。现有方案往往通过模型重训练或环境特定模块逐点修补，缺少一个通用框架来系统性地把预训练 VLA 转化为完整的机器人智能体。
Method: 提出 RoboBRIDGE，一个在预训练 VLA 之上提供编排层（orchestration layer）的模块化框架：Monitor 将快速失败检测与分层恢复结合以在错误级联前纠正；Planner 在环境偏离当前计划时触发重规划，Perceptor 异步更新场景理解以避免执行停滞；Controller 中的原始技能微调（primitive skill fine-tuning）将操作分解为域不变原语（domain-invariant primitives）并使用专用 LoRA 适配器，降低 VLA 对域偏移的敏感性。
Result: 摘要报告在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 以及覆盖多个机器人平台和 VLA 骨干的真实世界案例研究中，RoboBRIDGE 一致优于独立策略和先前的增强型 VLA 部署，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，可靠的机器人智能体（robotic agency）不仅来自扩大动作预测器的规模，更来自围绕这些预测器的结构化编排。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARES: Adaptive Reasoning-Effort Steering for PPA- and Cost-Aware RTL Optimization with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents optimize the power, performance, and area (PPA) of register-transfer-level (RTL) designs by iterating over edits, synthesis, and PPA analysis, paying a dollar cost for every LLM call. Prior agents report the quality reached without its normalized cost, attribute that quality to an engineered cross-design memory, and hold the reasoning effort of every call fixed. We propose Ares with three corresponding innovations. (1) We introduce a normalized dollar cost per LLM call reported alongside the figure of merit (FoM), enabling fair comparison across effort levels and optimizers. (2) Using this accounting, we find the construction of the long-term memory matters little. An engineered memory brings no dependable gain over a plain concatenation of the same experience. (3) We instead adapt the per-call reasoning effort by escalating to deeper reasoning only once progress at a lower effort stalls, via a patience counter fit on 21 training designs, allocating reasoning where it pays rather than uniformly across all iterations. On three test designs unseen during training, the effort policy lowers the FoM by 23-27% where the best fixed effort reaches 16-23%, at equal normalized cost. Ares closes up to 83% of the gap from an LLM-drafted multiply-accumulate unit to its highly hand-optimized counterpart, and reaches a 25% deeper FoM than state-of-the-art Dr. RTL at 12% of its tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARES，一个面向寄存器传输级（RTL）设计功耗/性能/面积（PPA）优化的 LLM agent 框架。它引入每次 LLM 调用的归一化美元成本作为公平比较指标，发现工程化长期记忆相比简单拼接经验没有可靠增益，并提出基于耐心计数器的自适应推理努力（reasoning effort）策略：仅在低努力进度停滞时升级到更深推理。在三个未见测试设计上，等成本下 FoM 降低 23-27%，而最佳固定努力只降低 16-23%。
Motivation: 既有 LLM agent 在优化 RTL PPA 时只报告达到的质量而不报告归一化成本，把质量归因于工程化的跨设计记忆，并且每次 LLM 调用都保持固定推理努力；这使得不同优化器和努力水平难以公平比较，也在不需要深推理的迭代上浪费成本。
Method: 提出三项创新：1) 在品质因数（FoM）旁同时报告每次 LLM 调用的归一化美元成本；2) 用该核算发现长期记忆的构建方式影响甚微，工程化记忆相对简单拼接同样经验没有可靠增益；3) 通过拟合 21 个训练设计的耐心计数器，自适应调整每次调用的推理努力，只在低努力进展停滞时升级到更深推理。
Result: 在三个训练中未见过的测试设计上，该努力策略在相同归一化成本下将 FoM 降低 23-27%，而最佳固定努力仅达到 16-23%；ARES 最多闭合 LLM 起草的乘累加单元与其高度手工优化版本之间 83% 的差距，并以 state-of-the-art Dr. RTL 的 12% token 数量达到比其深 25% 的 FoM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调按调用归一化成本报告、避免依赖过度工程化的跨设计记忆、按需分配推理努力，可以在 RTL PPA 优化中以更低 token/美元成本达到更优品质。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Coordination Mode as the First-Class Citizen in From-Scratch Multi-Agent Coding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent vibe coding promises to accelerate software development, yet existing benchmarks rely on synthetic environments that ignore practical time and monetary costs, conflate reasoning with communication, and reward only superficial completion. We introduce multi-agent from-scratch evaluation benchmark, MSEval, evaluating multi-agent coding on real-world tasks. Grounded in 10 authentic, full-stack projects across 10 domains, MSEval scores performance using hierarchical requirements and deterministic rubrics. Its execution engine, LegoGent, tests 10 collaboration topologies where agents coordinate via periodic sync intervals and deploy through native CI/CD pipelines. Concurrently, the automated grader TAgent dynamically probes implementations to jointly measure functional success, latency, and prefix-cached token cost. Across 100 runs, MSEval reveals that organizational topology rivals model capability in shaping the speed--cost--quality trade-off. For identical tasks and models, varying the topology shifts scores by over 30 points and doubles wall-clock time. Structured pipelines converge fastest with the highest quality, whereas heavy managerial oversight degrades performance. Ultimately, MSEval establishes a rigorous, reproducible standard for measuring how multi-agent teams actually build software. The benchmark is released at https://github.com/robinren03/MSEval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MSEval，一个面向从零开始多智能体编码的真实任务评估基准，基于 10 个跨域全栈项目，用分层需求与确定性评分规则衡量性能；配套执行引擎 LegoGent 测试 10 种协作拓扑（通过周期同步协调并走原生 CI/CD 部署），自动评分器 TAgent 联合测量功能成功度、延迟与前缀缓存 token 成本。100 次运行表明组织拓扑对速度-成本-质量权衡的影响可与模型能力相当，论文并强调协作模式（coordination mode）应作为一等公民被评估。
Motivation: 现有多智能体编码基准依赖合成环境，忽略实际时间与金钱成本、混淆推理与通信、只奖励表面完成度，因而难以回答多智能体团队在真实软件开发中如何权衡速度、成本与质量。
Method: 构建 MSEval 基准，基于 10 个领域中的 10 个真实全栈项目，采用分层需求与确定性评分规则；其执行引擎 LegoGent 支持 10 种协作拓扑，智能体通过周期同步间隔协调并经由原生 CI/CD 流水线部署；自动评分器 TAgent 动态探测实现，以联合度量功能成功、延迟和前缀缓存 token 成本。
Result: 在 100 次运行中，对相同的任务和模型，仅改变协作拓扑即可使分数变化超过 30 分并将墙钟时间翻倍；结构化流水线（structured pipelines）收敛最快且质量最高，而繁重的管理监督反而降低性能。
Conclusion: MSEval 为衡量多智能体团队实际构建软件的能力建立了更严格、可复现的标准，核心结论是组织拓扑（organizational topology）与模型能力同等重要地塑造速度-成本-质量权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Search as Computation Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Many algorithms spend an internal resource before returning a decision and are evaluated only by the quality of that terminal output. We formalize such procedures as terminal computation-allocation problems: costly computations produce observations, update beliefs about a latent environment, and matter only through terminal decision loss. Bellman equations characterize optimal allocation under fixed budgets, priced computation, and exact certification. We then relate value of computation (VOC) to information. Mutual information equals myopic VOC under log loss, whereas under simple regret VOC is a knowledge-gradient quantity; moreover, information gain can rank computations arbitrarily poorly, although it gives a one-sided upper bound on VOC. Bandit pulls, tree simulations, and node expansions illustrate the same model under different computation topologies. Finally, under an explicit frontier-resolution and heuristic-error model, maximizing approximate VOC recovers weighted A*, with A* and greedy best-first search as limiting cases. The theory identifies a shared decision problem without asserting that one acquisition rule is universally optimal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化一类“终局计算分配”问题：算法在返回决策前消耗内部计算资源，评估只看最终输出质量。作者用 Bellman 方程刻画固定预算、计价计算与精确认证下的最优分配，并把计算价值 (value of computation, VOC) 与互信息、知识梯度联系起来；在显式前沿消解和启发式误差模型下，最大化近似 VOC 可导出加权 A*，A* 与贪心最佳优先搜索为其极限情况。摘要强调该理论识别出一个共享决策问题，但不断言某一种采集规则普遍最优。
Motivation: 许多算法在返回决策前都要消耗内部资源，但现有评估通常只关注最终输出质量，缺少对这些程序统一的最优资源分配刻画。作者希望建立共同决策框架，并厘清信息增益与计算价值之间的真实关系。
Method: 将此类程序形式化为 terminal computation-allocation problems，用 Bellman 方程处理固定预算、计价计算和精确认证三种情形；通过将 VOC 与互信息、知识梯度建立联系，并在一个显式的前沿消解与启发式误差模型下考虑近似 VOC 最大化。
Result: 摘要报告：互信息在对数损失下等于近视 VOC，而在简单遗憾 (simple regret) 下 VOC 是知识梯度量；信息增益虽然给出 VOC 的单侧上界，但对计算项的排序可能任意差。在提出的模型下，最大化近似 VOC 可以恢复加权 A*，A* 和贪心最佳优先搜索作为极限情况；bandit 拉臂、树模拟和节点扩展被作为不同计算拓扑的示例。
Conclusion: 论文的要点是不同计算拓扑共享同一个决策问题，但作者明确不声称某一获取规则普遍最优，因此该理论更多用于统一理解而非推荐单一算法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Orca: Neural Operators for Causal Reasoning in Continuous Time
papers.abstract_en: Structural causal models are the standard language for reasoning about interventions and counterfactuals, but they describe static variables, typically measured once, and usually forbid cyclic dependencies. Many systems we care about, such as patients, climates, and economies, instead evolve continuously in time, are observed at irregular time points, and contain feedback loops. We argue that neural operator learning provides a natural foundation for causal reasoning in this setting, and propose Orca, a framework in which each node of the causal graph is a function of time and each mechanism is a learned map between function spaces. We extend existing neural operator architectures to express causal mechanisms: a mechanism computes the function value of a node from its parent nodes by taking several parent functions as input, respects the arrow of time, and treats latent exogenous noise as a function that can be inferred and reused for counterfactuals. We formalize the model class and demonstrate counterfactual reasoning on synthetic continuous-time examples. Code is available at https://github.com/gerritgr/orca
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Orca，一个基于神经算子 (neural operator) 的连续时间因果推理框架。与描述静态变量的结构因果模型不同，Orca 将因果图中每个节点视为时间的函数，每个机制视为函数空间之间的可学习映射，支持不规则观测和反馈环。作者形式化了该模型类别，并在合成连续时间示例上演示了反事实推理，代码已开源。
Motivation: 经典结构因果模型 (SCM) 面向静态、单次测量且通常禁止循环依赖的变量，难以刻画随时间连续演化并含反馈的系统（如患者、气候、经济），因此需要一种能处理连续时间、不规则采样和环状因果的建模框架。
Method: 提出 Orca 框架：因果图中每个节点是时间的函数，每个机制是函数空间之间的映射；机制以多个父函数为输入来计算节点函数，遵守时间箭头，并把潜在外生噪声 (exogenous noise) 当作可推断并可复用于反事实推理的函数。
Result: 摘要报告在合成连续时间示例上实现了反事实推理，并形式化了模型类别；未报告具体数值结果或基准。
Conclusion: 作者论证神经算子学习为连续时间因果推理提供了自然基础；Orca 目前仅在合成示例上验证，代码公开，但摘要未提及真实世界应用或定量评估。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: Learning to Understand Body Language from Flight through Robust 3D Avatar Placing
papers.abstract_en: Perceiving human motion and intent at long range is a prerequisite for socially intelligent aerial robots, yet the data to learn it barely exists. We introduce Drones2BodyLanguage, a dataset grounding human motion in real UAV footage: avatars manifesting ten communicative intents are placed into unmodified 4K drone scenes with metrically correct position, scale and orientation, maintained over hundreds of frames of camera motion. Enabling it is a lightweight geometric world model of the local scene - semantically selected anchors lifted to 3D through streaming monocular depth - in which a placement point is predicted as an affine anchor combination with provably rigid-invariant weights, and re-rendered under an SVD-fitted ground rotation. Across twelve architectures on scene- and motion-disjoint splits, training on placed data lifts mean intent accuracy by a wide margin for real, retargeted and generated motion alike, with gains confirmed on two in-the-wild scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Drones2BodyLanguage 数据集，用于从无人机航拍视频中学习远距离人体动作与交流意图理解。方法将带有十种交流意图的虚拟化身以度量正确的位置、尺度和朝向放入未修改的 4K 无人机场景，并跨数百帧相机运动保持一致性；其核心是一个轻量级局部场景几何世界模型，通过流式单目深度把语义选定的锚点提升到 3D，用仿射锚点组合预测放置点并保证刚性不变权重，再在 SVD 拟合的地面旋转下重渲染。在 12 种架构的场景隔离与运动隔离划分上，用放置数据训练显著提升真实、重定向与生成动作的平均意图准确率，并在两个野外场景上得到验证。
Motivation: 远距离感知人体运动与意图是具备社交智能的空中机器人的前提条件，但用于学习该能力的数据几乎不存在。
Method: 构建 Drones2BodyLanguage 数据集：将体现十种交流意图的化身放入原始 4K 无人机视频；采用轻量级几何世界模型，用语义选定的锚点结合流式单目深度完成 3D 提升；放置点被预测为仿射锚点组合（具有可证明的刚性不变权重），并通过 SVD 拟合地面旋转进行重渲染。
Result: 在 12 种架构上、场景隔离和运动隔离两种划分下，使用放置数据训练使平均意图准确率大幅提升，对真实、重定向和生成的运动均有效，且在两个野外场景中获得增益确认。
Conclusion: 作者表明将合成化身可靠地放置在真实航拍场景中，可有效支撑空中机器人学习身体语言理解，并支持对未见场景与运动的泛化。

summary_sections.method: 构建 Drones2BodyLanguage 数据集：将体现十种交流意图的化身放入原始 4K 无人机视频；采用轻量级几何世界模型，用语义选定的锚点结合流式单目深度完成 3D 提升；放置点被预测为仿射锚点组合（具有可证明的刚性不变权重），并通过 SVD 拟合地面旋转进行重渲染。
summary_sections.result: 在 12 种架构上、场景隔离和运动隔离两种划分下，使用放置数据训练使平均意图准确率大幅提升，对真实、重定向和生成的运动均有效，且在两个野外场景中获得增益确认。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者表明将合成化身可靠地放置在真实航拍场景中，可有效支撑空中机器人学习身体语言理解，并支持对未见场景与运动的泛化。

papers.title: Back to All-Entity Ranking: Sampler-Dependent Evaluation in Continuous-Time Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Next-destination prediction in continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) commonly ranks an observed interaction against sampled negative destinations. The resulting score is conditional on both the negative distribution and the number of candidates chosen by the researcher. We show that a non-uniform negative distribution changes the Bayes-optimal ranking, while even a finite candidate set drawn uniformly can destabilize model rankings and measured module effects. Time-varying source-destination history membership and model operations that use this information directly transmit the sampler's influence to the evaluation score. We examine this mechanism using a factorial evaluation of repeated and new positives against seen and unseen negatives, a minimal scorer based solely on pair-history membership, and controlled representation interventions. Across six models on LastFM, MOOC, Reddit, and Wikipedia, at least one model pair changes relative order between the expected Uniform-20 metric and the full catalog on three of the four datasets. The measured effect of the same module also changes in magnitude and direction with the candidate-set size and training objective. These results establish that model-superiority and ablation conclusions from sampled-negative benchmarks are conditional on the stated candidate configuration. All-entity ranking evaluates every destination in a fixed catalog, eliminating negative-selection freedom and sampling variation while retaining the original CTDG scorer. We therefore recommend all-entity ranking as the primary evidence for architecture comparisons on CTDG benchmarks with an enumerable, fixed destination catalog.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间动态图 (CTDG) 中下一目的地预测评估对负采样配置的依赖。作者证明非均匀负分布会改变贝叶斯最优排序，均匀小规模候选集也会破坏模型排名和模块效应测量的稳定性；在六个模型、四个数据集上，Uniform-20 与全目录评估在四个数据集中的三个上出现至少一对模型相对顺序变化。作者因此建议在目标目录固定且可枚举的 CTDG 基准上采用 all-entity ranking 作为架构比较的主要证据。
Motivation: CTDG 下一目的地预测通常对采样负例计算排名，评估得分同时取决于负分布和研究者选择的候选数量，这一自由度可能使模型优越性和消融结论不稳定。
Method: 作者用因子化评估（重复/新正例 × 见过/未见负例）、仅基于 pair-history membership 的最简评分器，以及受控表示干预来剖析采样器影响机制，并在六个模型上比较 LastFM、MOOC、Reddit 和 Wikipedia 上的 Uniform-20 指标与全目录评估。
Result: 在四个数据集中的三个上，至少一对模型在 Uniform-20 与全目录评估之间的相对顺序发生改变；同一模块的测量效应在幅度和方向上随候选集大小与训练目标变化。
Conclusion: 基于采样负例的模型优越性和消融结论是有条件于候选配置的；对目录固定且可枚举的 CTDG 基准，推荐以 all-entity ranking 作为架构比较的主要证据，因为它消除负选择自由度与采样波动，同时保留原始 CTDG 评分器。

papers.title: ZAPs: A Reward Attribution Framework for DeFi Ecosystems with Adversarial-Robust Scoring via Parallel Anomaly Ensemble Detection
papers.abstract_en: Incentive programs are central to user acquisition in decentralized finance, but many reward systems rely on raw volume, transaction count, and wallet count, making them vulnerable to bots and sybil operations. We present ZAPs, a reward attribution framework that combines economic contribution scoring with adversarial robustness. A composite activity score uses protocol-specific percentile normalization to limit whale dominance while preserving differentiation among users. A two-layer weighting mechanism combines protocol share within sector and sector share within the ecosystem, which reduces the profitability of farming small protocols. We show that the maximum reward obtainable from any protocol is bounded by that protocol's global volume share. ZAPs also introduces a four-layer defense stack consisting of transaction-level integrity checks, a parallel anomaly ensemble, post-distribution behavioral memory, and graph-based sybil clustering. The anomaly ensemble combines a one-class reconstruction model with an isolation forest and applies graduated rather than binary penalties. On 1,073 labeled malicious wallets covering 124,638 transactions, the ensemble achieves 0.923 +/- 0.013 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.891 +/- 0.016 for the reconstruction model alone, when the isolation forest is trained on benign wallets. Training it on the pooled population reverses its polarity and removes the ensemble gain. Controlled simulations reduce adversarial reward capture by 30-90 percent while legitimate-user scenarios change by 1-8 percent. Live campaigns recorded a 56 percent reduction in sybil allocation, a 49 percent increase in quality-wallet participation, and a 50 percent reduction in sell pressure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZAPs，一个面向 DeFi 生态系统的奖励归属框架，将经济贡献评分与对抗鲁棒性结合。框架包含基于协议特定百分位归一化的复合活动评分、两层加权机制，以及由交易完整性检查、并行异常集成、分布后行为记忆和图基女巫聚类组成的四层防御栈。在 1,073 个标记恶意钱包和 124,638 笔交易上，并行异常集成达到 0.923 ± 0.013 的 ROC-AUC；真实活动数据显示女巫分配减少 56%、优质钱包参与增加 49%。
Motivation: 现有 DeFi 激励计划多依赖原始交易量、交易数和钱包数，容易被机器人和女巫操作利用；需要一个能抵抗此类攻击的奖励归属机制。
Method: 提出 ZAPs 框架：复合活动评分使用协议特定百分位归一化以限制巨鲸主导；两层加权机制结合协议在行业内的份额与行业在生态系统内的份额，从而降低刷小协议收益；防御层采用单类重建模型与孤立森林的并行异常集成，并施加渐进式而非二值化惩罚；同时证明任何协议可获得的最大奖励受该协议全局成交量份额的上界约束。
Result: 在标记恶意钱包数据集上，并行异常集成的 ROC-AUC 为 0.923 ± 0.013，优于单独重建模型的 0.891 ± 0.016；孤立森林仅在良性钱包上训练时有效，在全量人群上训练会反转极性并消除集成增益。受控模拟显示对抗性奖励捕获降低 30-90%，合法用户场景变化仅 1-8%；真实活动中sybil分配减少 56%、优质钱包参与增加 49%、抛售压力减少 50%。
Conclusion: 论文强调协议全局成交量份额对奖励上界的约束作用，并指出孤立森林训练数据的选择（良性钱包 vs 全量人群）会显著影响其有效性与集成收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EEG-EditBench: Probing Visual Information in EEG-Image Retrieval Models with Controlled Image Edits
papers.abstract_en: Recent EEG-to-image retrieval models have achieved strong performance in identifying viewed images from semantically diverse candidates. Yet such success does not reveal what visual information supports the match. A model may readily identify a cheetah among tools, plants, and vehicles, but can it still distinguish the viewed cheetah from the same scene with the cheetah replaced by a dog? Motivated by this question, we introduce EEG-EditBench, a diagnostic benchmark that examines this question through controlled edits of object identity, attributes, background, and object presence. Built from the 200 THINGS-EEG2 test images, EEG-EditBench contains 2,137 quality-controlled edits and evaluates eight representative EEG visual decoding models. Our results show that strong standard retrieval does not consistently transfer to edit-based evaluation, with fine-grained attribute changes presenting the greatest challenge. EEG-EditBench reveals model behavior hidden by aggregate retrieval accuracy and provides a controlled basis for studying what visual information EEG-image models preserve. The code and complete dataset are publicly available.
papers.comment: Main paper with supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XiaoZhangYES/EEG-EditBench. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xiaozgg/EEG-EditBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EEG-EditBench，一个用于 EEG 图像检索模型的诊断基准，通过对物体身份、属性、背景和物体存在性进行受控编辑，考察模型在匹配时依赖哪些视觉信息。基准基于 200 张 THINGS-EEG2 测试图像构建，包含 2,137 个质量受控的编辑样本，并评估了八个代表性 EEG 视觉解码模型。结果显示，较强的标准检索性能并不能一致迁移到基于编辑的评估，细粒度属性变化最具挑战性，并揭示了被聚合检索准确率掩盖的模型行为。
Motivation: 现有 EEG-to-image 检索模型在语义多样的候选中表现优异，但这种成功并不能说明匹配究竟依赖什么视觉信息；例如模型能在一堆工具、植物和车辆中认出猎豹，却未必能把猎豹从被替换成狗的同场景中区分出来。
Method: 引入 EEG-EditBench 诊断基准，从 200 张 THINGS-EEG2 测试图像生成 2,137 个受控编辑，覆盖物体身份、属性、背景和物体存在性四类变化，并用该基准评估八个代表性 EEG 视觉解码模型。
Result: 摘要报告强标准检索性能不能一致迁移到基于编辑的评估，其中细粒度属性变化构成最大挑战；EEG-EditBench 揭示了聚合检索准确率下隐藏的模型行为差异。
Conclusion: EEG-EditBench 为研究 EEG 图像模型保留哪些视觉信息提供了受控评测基础，代码与完整数据集均已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Benchmarking Foundation and Large Language Models for Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot medical image segmentation (FS-MIS) aims to segment novel regions of interest (ROIs) from a few annotated support examples. Despite rapid progress, existing FS-MIS solutions span diverse paradigms but are evaluated under inconsistent settings, leaving their relative effectiveness unclear. We introduce FAME, a unified benchmark for evaluating FS-MIS solutions, covering specialists, SAM-based methods, CLIP-based methods, and MLLM-based methods. FAME contains 14,958 test samples across 7 anatomical sites, 9 imaging modalities, and 14 ROI categories, and evaluates models under zero-shot and ten-shot settings with additional assessment of target-absence recognition and generalization under covariate and semantic shifts. Our evaluation reveals several findings. First, effective few-shot segmentation depends on how models exploit support examples: direct visual adaptation generally outperforms prompt-based strategies. Second, increasing support examples improves performance only when models can effectively utilize them. Third, semantic transfer remains substantially more challenging than imaging-domain adaptation, and strong localization ability does not necessarily imply reliable target-absence recognition. We hope FAME provides a comprehensive understanding of current FS-MIS solutions and facilitates the development of more effective and reliable few-shot medical segmentation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAME，一个用于统一评估少样本医学图像分割 (FS-MIS) 方法的基准，涵盖专家模型、SAM-based、CLIP-based 与 MLLM-based 方法。基准包含 7 个解剖部位、9 种成像模态、14 个 ROI 类别、14958 个测试样本，并在零样本与十样本设置下评估，同时考察目标缺失识别以及协变量与语义迁移下的泛化。评估发现直接视觉适配优于基于提示的策略，增加支持样本仅在模型能有效利用时才有帮助，语义迁移比成像域适配更具挑战性，强定位能力不等同于可靠的目标缺失识别。
Motivation: 现有 FS-MIS 解决方案跨越多种范式，但在不一致的设置下被评估，导致它们的相对有效性不明确，缺乏统一的比较基准。
Method: 构建 FAME 基准，统一评估四类 FS-MIS 方法（专家模型、SAM-based、CLIP-based、MLLM-based），在 14958 个测试样本上进行零样本与十样本分割评估，并额外测试目标缺失识别及协变量/语义迁移下的泛化。
Result: 评估发现：直接视觉适配通常优于基于提示的策略；增加支持样本仅当模型能有效利用时才提升性能；语义迁移比成像域适配更难；强定位能力并不必然意味着可靠的目标缺失识别。
Conclusion: 作者希望 FAME 能提供对当前 FS-MIS 解决方案的全面理解，并促进更有效、更可靠的少样本医学分割方法的发展。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Simplifying Neural Networks During Training
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and exploiting the training dynamics of overparameterized deep neural networks remains a central challenge in modern machine learning. Recent evidence on Neural Collapse (NC) shows that class representations and classifiers exhibit highly structured geometry, while the Tunnel Effect suggests that only a subset of layers is essential for feature extraction. We combine these two perspectives and propose an NC-inspired training framework for simplifying deep networks during training. Our method monitors representation dynamics through the Inverse Fisher Criterion, a stable and efficient proxy for the variability collapse behavior, to identify both the split point between feature extraction and classification and the training stage at which simplification becomes viable. We then replace the trailing layers with a lightweight classification head and continue training the reduced model. Experiments on image-classification benchmarks across MLP, VGG, and ResNet architectures show that the proposed method achieves substantial parameter reductions while maintaining accuracy comparable to that of the full model. Code to reproduce the experiments can be found at: https://github.com/LorenzoSciandra/NNS.

Motivation: 过参数化深度网络的训练动态难以理解，而 Neural Collapse 与 Tunnel Effect 分别表明类表示几何高度结构化且仅少数层对特征提取关键，作者希望利用这两种视角在训练中就简化模型。

Result: 在 MLP、VGG 和 ResNet 的图像分类基准上，方法在保持与完整模型相当精度的同时实现了可观的参数缩减。

papers.title: FinanceHarness: Autonomous Financial Deep Research Framework
papers.abstract_en: Powered by advances in LLMs and autonomous agents, deep research has become one of the most widely adopted agentic products. However, most deep research systems write general-purpose reports, which are inadequate for financial deep research. Financial research demands specialized knowledge to analyze historical patterns and forecast upcoming events. Automating financial deep research therefore requires both a layered harness to drive the research agent and a verifiable, point-in-time benchmark that prevents leakage of future information. We present FinanceHarness, a harness that runs finance-oriented tools and practitioner-guided workflows, automating financial deep research end to end: environment and data construction, the agent execution loop, and reward modeling. We further propose FinanceGym, comprising thesis-driven research questions and rubrics that combine pre-cutoff and post-cutoff criteria. Professional expert validation yields an 82% pass rate. Even leading LLMs and agents score below 40% on the rubrics, showing that FinanceGym is challenging and leaves substantial headroom. With the same open-weight backbone, FinanceHarness improves the overall rubric score from 25.3% to 32.4%. FinanceHarness is available at https://github.com/Yijia-Xiao/FinanceHarness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinanceHarness，一个面向金融深度研究的自动化智能体框架，将环境与数据构建、智能体执行循环和奖励建模端到端串联，并配套提出 FinanceGym 基准，包含以论点驱动的研究问题以及结合截止日期前后标准的评分细则。摘要报告称专家验证通过率为 82%，而领先 LLM 与智能体在评分细则上得分低于 40%；使用相同开源权重底座时，FinanceHarness 将总体评分从 25.3% 提升至 32.4%。
Motivation: 现有深度研究系统通常生成通用报告，无法满足金融研究对历史模式分析与事件预测的专业需求；同时，自动化的金融深度研究需要可验证、时点化（point-in-time）的基准来防止未来信息泄露。
Method: 提出一个分层式 harness，运行金融导向的工具和从业者引导的工作流，覆盖环境与数据构建、智能体执行循环与奖励建模；并提出 FinanceGym，由论点驱动的研究问题与结合 pre-cutoff/post-cutoff 标准的评分细则构成。
Result: 专业专家验证显示 FinanceGym 的通过率为 82%；即使领先 LLM 与智能体在评分细则上得分也低于 40%。在相同开源权重底座下，FinanceHarness 将总体评分从 25.3% 提高到 32.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为自动化金融深度研究既需要分层 harness 驱动研究智能体，也需要可验证且避免未来信息泄露的基准；FinanceHarness 与 FinanceGym 可共同支撑端到端的金融研究自动化。

papers.title: Safety-Gated Agentic Supervisory Control on a Coupled Distillation Benchmark: Regime Map, Auditable Gate, and Co-Design Findings
papers.abstract_en: An open-weight LLM can write composition setpoints every five minutes. What a plant still needs is a hard check: named constraints, logged margins, and an admit/block decision before the regulatory layer moves. This paper puts that check in a rule-based forked-twin counterfactual gate (nine pinned constraints) and leaves the regulatory layer unchanged. On Skogestad's Column A the ladder is PID-only (C0), linear MPC (C1), ungated agent (C2), and gated agent (C3) under one contract: identical level closure (M_D, M_B), scenarios, and seeds; C2/C3 share the linear-MPC backend. The split is not subtle. Off-nominal target acquisition: the agent beats Pareto-tuned linear MPC in the strong band (C2/C1 IAE ratio 0.361 at the upper CI). Disturbance rejection on the same 16-point grid inverts by 16.03 at the upper CI (10.18 at the point estimate), where an ungated LLM supervisor does not belong. The gate compresses a specification-abandonment attractor into a bounded offset (d approx. -1.4; P95 cell IAE 11.5 to 0.77). A one-line prompt fix removes the attractor at source (6/10 to 0/10; sensitivity only, not a new headline). In a 250-cell statistical pass, 534 of 590 gate interventions are spec-on-bound geometry: the operating specification sits on a safety limit, so a well-behaved OP becomes inoperable while misbehaving ones are only contained; 318 blocks still correct actively harmful proposals. Headlines are single-column and model-conditional on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. A second-family sweep (NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super) keeps the disturbance-rejection fails band and plant-side failure geography; magnitudes and protocol operability stay model-conditional, and Super target-acquisition strong cells are survivors only (not confirmation). Transfer means twin, constraint envelope, and setpoint interface, not a second plant class measured here.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 8 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/cgncro-cyber/IndustrialAI. Sole author; independent research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在 Skogestad 的 Column A 蒸馏塔基准上，用规则化的 forked-twin counterfactual gate（九个固定约束）对开放权重 LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）每五分钟生成的合成设定点做 admit/block 硬检查，底层调节层保持 PID (C0)、线性 MPC (C1) 不变。摘要报告：目标获取中带门控 agent (C3) 显著优于 Pareto 调优的线性 MPC（C2/C1 IAE 比 0.361，上置信区间），但在扰动抑制上该优势翻转（上 CI 为 16.03），说明无门控 LLM 监督在该任务中不可用；门控能把规格放弃吸引子压制成有界偏移（P95 单元 IAE 从 11.5 降至 0.77）。头条结果均为单列且模型条件性（model-conditional）。
Motivation: 开放权重 LLM 可以写合成设定点，但工厂仍然需要调节层动作之前的硬检查：命名约束、记录余量 (logged margins) 以及 admit/block 判定。作者针对的是 LLM 监督控制缺少这种可审计硬门控的问题。
Method: 提出规则化 forked-twin counterfactual gate，将门控置于监管层与调节层之间，底层调节层保持不变；在同一契约（相同的液位闭环 M_D、M_B、场景与种子）下比较 C0 到 C3 四条阶梯，且 C2/C3 共享线性 MPC 后端。另尝试一行 prompt 修复在源头移除吸引子，并做 250 单元的统计扫描（590 次门干预）。
Result: 在 16 点网格上，目标获取的 C2/C1 IAE 比为 0.361（上 CI），而扰动抑制在同一网格上翻转 16.03（上 CI；点估计 10.18）；门控将规格放弃吸引子压缩为有界偏移（d≈-1.4，P95 单元 IAE 11.5→0.77）。250 单元扫描中 534/590 次门干预属于 spec-on-bound 几何，318 次 block 正确阻止了有害提议。第二族模型（NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super）复现了扰动抑制失败带与故障地理，但目标获取强单元只是幸存而非确认。
Conclusion: 摘要强调头条数字均为单列且对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 具有模型条件性；迁移被定义为 twin、约束包络与设定点接口，而非本文测量的第二种工厂类别。整体结论是：在扰动抑制失败带上，无门控 LLM 监督不适用，而所提出的门控能把失控行为限制在有界偏移内，但幅度与协议可操作性仍依赖具体模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AutoSupervision: Closing the Feedback Loop in Scientific Workflows with Grounded Revision Verification
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled AI systems to assist scientific research and peer review. However, an essential capability for reliable AI-assisted scientific workflows remains underexplored: verifying whether reviewer feedback leads to meaningful and evidence-supported manuscript improvements. We introduce AutoSupervision, which evaluates whether scientific manuscript revisions genuinely address reviewer concerns through grounded evidence. AutoSupervision leverages transparent peer-review records as a natural source of supervision, where reviewer comments specify scientific concerns, author responses describe claimed resolutions, and revised manuscripts provide evidence of changes. Given reviewer comments, author responses, and revised manuscripts, models must characterize reviewer concerns, determine whether concerns have been addressed, and identify supporting manuscript evidence. We construct AutoSupervision from 56,000 Nature Communications articles and corresponding review records. Then we conducted experiments on LLMs, the ablation study, and the case study. Our results show that while LLMs perform well in characterizing reviewer concerns, with GPT-5.5 achieving a score of 0.754, evidence-based verification remains the primary bottleneck, with the best-performing model reaching only 0.501.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoSupervision，利用公开的同行评审记录作为天然监督信号，评估科学稿件修改是否真正基于证据解决了审稿人提出的关注点。作者从 56,000 篇 Nature Communications 文章中构建数据集，任务要求模型刻画审稿人关注点、判断关注点是否被解决并找出支撑修改的稿件证据。实验显示 LLM 在刻画关注点上表现较好（GPT-5.5 得分 0.754），但基于证据的验证是主要瓶颈，最佳模型仅达到 0.501。
Motivation: LLM 已开始辅助科学研究和同行评审，但可靠验证审稿人反馈是否带来有意义且证据支持的稿件改进，这一关键能力仍未被充分探索。
Method: AutoSupervision 将透明的同行评审记录作为监督来源：审稿人评论说明科学关注点，作者回复描述声称的解决方案，修订稿件提供修改证据。模型需要刻画关注点、判断其是否被解决并识别支撑证据；作者据此构建数据集并进行 LLM 实验、消融研究和案例研究。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 在刻画审稿人关注点方面表现良好，GPT-5.5 得分 0.754；但基于证据的验证仍是主要瓶颈，最佳模型仅达到 0.501。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于证据的修改验证是当前 AI 辅助科学工作流的主要短板，AutoSupervision 提供了相应数据集与基准，但并未声称已解决该瓶颈。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Nanoparticle Networks for Neuromorphic Computing
papers.abstract_en: Physical computing leverages complex dynamical systems for energy-efficient data processing. In this work, we present a neuromorphic architecture based on metallic nanoparticles interconnected by molecular junctions on a $\text{SiO}_2$/Si substrate. We demonstrate that surrounding static control electrodes transform this nanoparticle network from a passive reservoir into a tunable nonlinear dynamical system. By analyzing how these electrodes route simple one-dimensional voltage inputs into multidimensional signal responses, we establish three core design rules to maximize computational performance. First, operating near the system's cutoff frequency achieves an optimal balance between nonlinear charge tunneling and linear capacitive memory. Second, tuning the underlying $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness sets the electrostatic screening length and dictates the memory type. Thick oxide layers reduce the screening length, causing networks larger than this length to transition into a persistent, non-volatile-like regime. Conversely, networks smaller than the screening length exhibit only fading memory. Third, introducing structural disorder via heterogeneous molecular junctions overcomes inherent limits on expressivity. While a network's computational expressivity scales with its physical size, it is ultimately capped by the screening length. Breaking internal spatial symmetries with localized disorder bypasses this saturation, allowing control voltages to independently manipulate specific signal amplitudes and phases, universally maximizing performance for dynamic neuromorphic applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 SiO2/Si 衬底上金属纳米粒子经分子结互连的神经形态计算架构，利用周围静态控制电极将网络从被动储层转变为可调非线性动力系统。通过分析电极如何将一维电压输入路由为多维信号响应，作者建立了三条核心设计规则：在截止频率附近工作以平衡非线性电荷隧穿与线性电容记忆、通过 SiO2 厚度调节静电屏蔽长度以决定记忆类型、用异构分子结引入结构无序以突破表达性饱和。摘要称这些规则可普遍最大化动态神经形态应用的性能。
Motivation: 物理计算希望通过复杂动力系统实现高能效数据处理，但无序纳米粒子网络如何被有效调控并最大化计算性能尚缺乏明确设计准则。本文目标是针对这类储层计算（reservoir computing）式网络给出可操作的设计规则。
Method: 提出基于金属纳米粒子与分子结互连的神经形态架构，并用静态控制电极对输入进行多维信号路由；随后推导出三条设计规则：将工作点设在系统截止频率附近取得非线性与记忆的平衡，调节 SiO2 厚度以控制静电屏蔽长度进而决定记忆类型，以及利用异构分子结引入结构无序来突破表达性上限。
Result: 摘要指出网络的计算表达性随物理尺寸扩展，但最终受静电屏蔽长度限制；厚度大的 SiO2 层使大于屏蔽长度的网络进入持久、非易失-like 状态，而小于屏蔽长度的网络仅具有易失记忆。通过局域无序打破内部空间对称性可绕过表达性饱和，使控制电压能独立操纵特定信号的幅度与相位，从而普遍提升动态神经形态应用性能。摘要未报告数值实验指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调围绕截止频率、SiO2 厚度和结构无序的三条规则为无序纳米粒子神经形态网络提供了通用设计框架，其适用范围是动态神经形态计算场景，具体定量性能仍需依赖后续实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VCP-DCN: Beyond Visual Concealed Property via Depth Collaborative Network for Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) aims to identify and segment camouflaged objects in complex environments, which are often concealed because their color and texture are similar to the background. Several existing COD methods introduce depth maps to boost detection performance via learning complementary RGB-D features, ignoring modality-specific characteristics of concealed objects in the depth domain. To address this issue, we propose a depth collaborative network, called VCP-DCN, to mine distinguishable multi-modality features beyond visual concealed prototype in depth domain. Specifically, VCP-DCN progressively performs multi-modality alignment, interaction, and fusion for the COD task. In the \textbf{alignment} stage, we propose a Separable Prototype Embedding (SPE) module to learn modality-consistency and modality-specific RGB/depth prototype tokens through prototype contrastive learning. Furthermore, we develop a Multi-modality Dual Attention (MDA) module to enhance the cross-modal feature representation through local response maps between modality-consistency RGB/depth prototype tokens and visual tokens on the \textbf{interaction} stage. Finally, we design a Depth Adaptive Injection (DAI) module to adaptively measure contribution of RGB/depth features with a decision-making mechanism, which calculates similarity distance between RGB/depth modality-specific prototype tokens and modality-consistency ones on the \textbf{fusion} stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our VCP-DCN on three authoritative datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种深度协作网络 VCP-DCN，用于伪装目标检测 (Camouflaged Object Detection, COD)，通过显式挖掘深度域中与视觉隐藏原型不同的多模态特征来提升检测性能。网络在三个阶段依次进行多模态对齐、交互与融合，并在三个权威数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有 COD 方法引入深度图来融合 RGB-D 特征，但忽视了深度域中隐蔽物体自身的模态特定特性，导致特征融合不够充分。
Method: 在对齐阶段提出 Separable Prototype Embedding (SPE) 模块，通过原型对比学习 (prototype contrastive learning) 学习模态一致与模态特定的 RGB/深度原型 token；在交互阶段设计 Multi-modality Dual Attention (MDA) 模块，利用模态一致原型与视觉 token 的局部响应图增强跨模态特征；在融合阶段提出 Depth Adaptive Injection (DAI) 模块，通过计算 RGB/深度模态特定原型与模态一致原型之间的相似度距离，自适应衡量二者贡献。
Result: 摘要在三个权威 COD 数据集上报告了实验，表明 VCP-DCN 的有效性，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模深度域中隐蔽物体特有的模态特征、并通过分阶段对齐交互融合，是提升 COD 性能的有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FeatFix: Reuse What You Verify through Local Exact-Feature Correction for Faster Cached Diffusion Inference
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are widely used to generate high-quality images and videos, but their iterative denoising process remains computationally intensive. A growing class of training-free accelerators reduces this cost by reusing cached intermediate features or forecasting future ones. To control draft drift, these methods sometimes compute an exact block feature for verification. Yet the resulting exact feature is typically used only to measure discrepancy or guide a later decision and is then discarded. We find that this previously computed feature can instead be reused for correction. Forwarding it at the verification site resets the local draft residual and reduces downstream feature error. Based on this observation, we introduce FeatFix, a local exact-feature correction method for cached diffusion inference. FeatFix operates at a fixed sparse set of layer--timestep sites. At each selected site, it replaces the complete draft block output with the exact output computed from the same incoming state, avoiding token- or channel-level partial replacement and full-timestep recomputation. Experiments across four image and video backbones show that FeatFix consistently accelerates generation, achieving a speedup of up to $6.70\times$ over Vanilla while maintaining competitive output quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FeatFix，一种面向缓存扩散推理 (cached diffusion inference) 的免训练加速方法。作者发现现有加速器为验证而计算出的精确块特征 (exact block feature) 通常只用于衡量偏差或指导后续决策，随即被丢弃；FeatFix 将其复用于局部修正，在固定且稀疏的 layer-timestep 站点用同一输入状态算出的精确输出替换完整 draft 块输出。实验在四个图像与视频骨干上达到最高 6.70 倍于 Vanilla 的加速，并保持有竞争力的输出质量。
Motivation: 扩散模型迭代去噪的计算开销大，现有免训练加速器通过复用缓存中间特征或预测未来特征来提速，但为控制 draft 漂移而计算的精确特征往往仅被用来验证，随后丢弃，浪费了修正局部 draft 残差、减少下游特征误差的机会。
Method: FeatFix 在固定且稀疏的一组 layer-timestep 站点上做局部精确特征修正：每个选定站点用同一 incoming state 计算出的精确输出整体替换 draft 块输出，既不做 token 级或 channel 级部分替换，也不做全时间步重算。
Result: 在四个图像与视频骨干上的实验显示，FeatFix 能一致地加速生成，相对 Vanilla 取得最高 6.70 倍加速，同时保持有竞争力的输出质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将验证阶段已经算出的精确特征复用于局部修正，可以在避免完整重算的前提下降低下游特征误差，从而加速缓存扩散推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Virtual Process Dossier: A Process-Aware Data Catalogue
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Virtual Process Dossier (VPD), a Knowledge Graph-based data catalogue that also captures workflow provenance. We developed VPD for multi-stage manufacturing use-cases where downstream AI-based optimization tasks require to distinct between datasets generated during individual workflow steps. VPD provides these datasets in a FAIR manner and makes both prospective and retrospective workflow provenance explicit. Our contributions are: (1) the VPD ontology that serves as the catalogue's semantic core; (2) the VPD provenance framework that integrates ontology instantiation into the production environment; and (3) the VPD user interface that provides human-centered interaction with the VPD Knowledge Graph. The ontology and code are available at https://github.com/kubeluk/VirtualProcessDossier .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Virtual Process Dossier (VPD)，一种基于知识图谱 (Knowledge Graph) 的数据目录，用于多阶段制造场景，同时捕获工作流溯源 (workflow provenance)。VPD 以 FAIR 方式提供各工作流步骤产生的数据集，并使前瞻性和回溯性溯源显式化。作者还发布了本体和代码。
Motivation: 多阶段制造中下游 AI 优化任务需要区分各工作流步骤生成的数据集，而现有数据目录缺乏对工作流溯源的显式建模，难以满足这一需求。
Method: 包含三个贡献：VPD 本体作为目录的语义核心；VPD 溯源框架将本体实例化集成到生产环境；VPD 用户界面提供以人为中心的知识图谱交互。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；方法以 FAIR 方式提供数据集，并显式表达前瞻与回溯工作流溯源。
Conclusion: 作者强调 VPD 将知识图谱与工作流溯源结合，适用于多阶段制造中的 AI 优化数据管理；本体和代码已开源供社区使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Crossing the Margin Cliff: Toward Relearn-Robust LLM Unlearning via Margin Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Large language model unlearning is consistently fragile under relearn attacks. On TOFU, fine-tuning on twenty forget examples substantially recovers held-out forget-set ROUGE for every method we evaluate, and we trace this fragility to optimization geometry. The per-token answer margin of fourteen post-hoc methods spanning gradient, preference, and distillation families converges into a narrow band above the retain reference in 41 of 42 method--size cells, a regularity we call the margin cliff. We prove that this cliff follows whenever the retain coupling holds the diagnostic log-odds of forget content above a floor, a condition that token-saturating losses induce at stationarity and that we verify directly on 34 of 42 cells. Margin Calibration (\textsc{MC}) is a plug-in polish adding a non-saturating margin hinge anchored at the reference's per-token margin plus a KL probe on a disjoint instruction corpus, restoring forget-side pressure where the native loss saturates. Under a stated gradient-dominance condition, whose on-trajectory gradient signature we measure by instrumenting the polish, its stationary set lies on the cliff-crossing side, yielding an attack-budget upper bound on the relearn margin lift. Across TOFU (three Llama-3 sizes, three forget tiers), MUSE-News on Llama-2-7B-hf, and a Phi-3.5 panel, a single frozen configuration wins all 14 head-to-head forget aggregates and all populated relearn cells (panel-mean post-attack ROUGE-L $0.41$ to $0.18$) and lowers raw membership AUC on 13/14, with reduced retain-side utility as the main cost. A deployment variant matches these gains without a retain-trained reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型遗忘（LLM unlearning）在重新学习攻击下的脆弱性，提出基于边际校准（Margin Calibration, MC）的插件式方法。作者发现多种后验方法在TOFU等基准上都会落入所谓的边际悬崖（margin cliff），即遗忘样本的逐token答案边际收敛到保留参考之上的狭窄区间；MC通过非饱和边际铰链和KL探针恢复遗忘侧压力，并在多个模型与数据集上降低重新学习后的ROUGE得分与成员推理攻击AUC。
Motivation: 大语言模型遗忘方法在重新学习攻击下始终脆弱，少量遗忘样本的微调就能大幅恢复遗忘集的ROUGE；作者将这一脆弱性归因于优化几何中的边际悬崖，需要一种能绕过该悬崖的校准方法。
Method: 提出Margin Calibration（MC），一种插件式（plug-in）精修方法：在保留参考的逐token边际上添加非饱和边际铰链（margin hinge），并在不相交的指令语料上加入KL探针，从而在原生损失饱和处重新施加遗忘侧压力；同时给出梯度支配条件下的驻点位于悬崖穿越侧的证明，并用攻击预算上界刻画重新学习边际提升。
Result: 在TOFU（三种Llama-3规模、三档遗忘设置）、MUSE-News (Llama-2-7B-hf) 和Phi-3.5面板上，单一的冻结配置赢得全部14组遗忘聚合对比和所有有数据的重新学习单元（面板平均攻击后ROUGE-L从0.41降至0.18），并在13/14组中降低原始成员推理AUC；主要代价是保留侧效用下降。
Conclusion: 作者指出MC在无需保留训练参考的部署变体下也能达到相近效果，但其主要代价是保留侧效用降低；论文强调边际悬崖这一规律性现象，并认为MC是缓解重新学习脆弱性的有效插件方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型遗忘（LLM unlearning）在重新学习攻击下的脆弱性，提出基于边际校准（Margin Calibration, MC）的插件式方法。作者发现多种后验方法在TOFU等基准上都会落入所谓的边际悬崖（margin cliff），即遗忘样本的逐token答案边际收敛到保留参考之上的狭窄区间；MC通过非饱和边际铰链和KL探针恢复遗忘侧压力，并在多个模型与数据集上降低重新学习后的ROUGE得分与成员推理攻击AUC。

summary_sections.method: 提出Margin Calibration（MC），一种插件式（plug-in）精修方法：在保留参考的逐token边际上添加非饱和边际铰链（margin hinge），并在不相交的指令语料上加入KL探针，从而在原生损失饱和处重新施加遗忘侧压力；同时给出梯度支配条件下的驻点位于悬崖穿越侧的证明，并用攻击预算上界刻画重新学习边际提升。
summary_sections.result: 在TOFU（三种Llama-3规模、三档遗忘设置）、MUSE-News (Llama-2-7B-hf) 和Phi-3.5面板上，单一的冻结配置赢得全部14组遗忘聚合对比和所有有数据的重新学习单元（面板平均攻击后ROUGE-L从0.41降至0.18），并在13/14组中降低原始成员推理AUC；主要代价是保留侧效用下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者指出MC在无需保留训练参考的部署变体下也能达到相近效果，但其主要代价是保留侧效用降低；论文强调边际悬崖这一规律性现象，并认为MC是缓解重新学习脆弱性的有效插件方案。

papers.title: SAFViT: Spatial Attention Fusion Gating for Vision Transformer-Based Nucleus Segmentation and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Accurate cell segmentation and classification are foundational to digital pathology, enabling quantitative tissue analysis for diagnosis and treatment planning. Encoder-decoder architectures that fuse multi-scale features through skip connections have become the dominant paradigm for this task, yet standard direct skip connections treat every spatial location equally, which leads to redundant and potentially conflicting information reaching the decoder. To overcome this problem, various gating mechanisms have been introduced, but most of them operate solely on filtering encoder information, neglecting the benefit of global contextual information from the decoder. This study proposes replacing conventional skip connections in a CellViT-based model with a novel Spatial Attention Fusion (SAF) Gating module. Each SAF gate concatenates the encoder skip and upsampled decoder features, compresses them through two pointwise convolutions with an intermediate ReLU, and applies a channel-wise softmax to produce a per-pixel "heatmap of trust" that sums to unity at every spatial location, allowing the network to learn where each source is most trustworthy. The resulting fused features improve the model's ability to detect the minority "Dead" class, which in turn enhances the multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ) on the PanNuke dataset. SAF Gating is compared against six gating alternatives including no gating, attention gates, squeeze-and-excitation, CBAM, cross-attention, and attentional feature fusion on PanNuke and MoNuSeg datasets. SAF Gating achieves the highest mPQ (0.471), a gain driven primarily by a 14.5-point improvement in Dead-class F1 score compared to ungated CellViT baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数字病理学中细胞核分割与分类任务，提出在基于 CellViT 的编码器-解码器模型中用空间注意力融合 (Spatial Attention Fusion, SAF) 门控模块替代传统跳跃连接。每个 SAF 门拼接编码器跳跃特征与上采样后的解码器特征，经两个带中间 ReLU 的逐点卷积压缩，再通过通道级 softmax 生成每个空间位置求和为 1 的逐像素"可信度热图"。在 PanNuke 数据集上该方法取得最高 mPQ 0.471，主要收益来自相较未加门控的 CellViT 基线，"Dead" 类 F1 分数提升 14.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 编码器-解码器架构中标准的直接跳跃连接对所有空间位置同等对待，会使到达解码器的信息冗余甚至相互冲突；已有门控机制大多只过滤编码器信息，忽略了来自解码器的全局上下文信息。
Method: 提出 SAF Gating 模块：将编码器跳跃特征与上采样解码器特征拼接，通过两个逐点卷积（中间含 ReLU）压缩，再进行通道级 softmax，生成每个空间位置数值之和为 1 的逐像素可信度热图，让网络学会判断每个来源在何处最可信，并据此融合特征。
Result: 在 PanNuke 和 MoNuSeg 数据集上，SAF Gating 与无门控、注意力门控 (attention gates)、SENet、CBAM、交叉注意力 (cross-attention) 和注意力特征融合 (attentional feature fusion) 六种门控方案对比，取得最高 mPQ 0.471；该收益主要由 Dead 类 F1 分数相比未加门控的 CellViT 基线提升 14.5 个百分点驱动。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用 SAF Gating 替代常规跳跃连接能提升多类全景质量 (mPQ)，特别是改善少数类 "Dead" 的检测能力；实验范围限于 PanNuke 与 MoNuSeg 两个数据集及列出的六种门控基线。

papers.title: MemTxn: A Transaction Boundary for Source-Supported Updates and Complete-State Recovery in Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory lets long-running large language model agents reuse information across sessions and tasks. Yet errors in writable memory can persist and corrupt future behavior. Existing systems improve storage and retrieval, but they do not provide a transaction boundary for reliable updates and recovery. We therefore propose MemTxn, a governance layer outside the answer model. MemTxn verifies whether an update is supported by its source. It also selects the visible version when facts conflict and restores the application-visible state after a fault. The system uses Ordered PatchTest to validate writes, a Temporal Resolver to select versions, and a durable snapshot journal to recover state. On an item-disjoint audit, MemTxn accepts all 60 supported originals and rejects all 179 hard negatives. Under persistent multi-key faults on LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo states, it restores the complete declared active map without knowing the actual physical write set. On MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation, MemTxn achieves the highest average F1 across all twelve answer-model configurations. It outperforms Dense by 17.06--24.07 points in five representative settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemTxn，一个位于答案模型之外的记忆治理层 (governance layer)，为长期运行的 LLM agent 的可写记忆提供事务边界 (transaction boundary)。MemTxn 验证更新是否受源支持，在事实冲突时选择可见版本，并在故障后恢复应用可见状态，核心组件包括 Ordered PatchTest、Temporal Resolver 和持久化快照日志 (durable snapshot journal)。在项不相交审计中接受全部 60 个受支持的原型并拒绝全部 179 个硬负例；在 LongMemEval-S 与 LoCoMo 的持久多键故障下能恢复完整的声明活动映射；在 MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation 上取得十二种 answer-model 配置的最高平均 F1。
Motivation: 长运行 LLM agent 依赖持久记忆跨会话与任务复用信息，但可写记忆中的错误会持续存在并污染未来行为；现有系统侧重存储与检索，未提供可靠更新与恢复所需的事务边界。
Method: MemTxn 作为回答模型之外的治理层运行：通过 Ordered PatchTest 校验写入是否受源支持，使用 Temporal Resolver 在事实冲突时选择可见版本，并利用持久化快照日志在故障后恢复应用可见状态，无需知晓实际物理写入集合。
Result: 在项不相交审计中，MemTxn 接受全部 60 个受支持的原始项并拒绝全部 179 个硬负例；在持久多键故障下能恢复 LongMemEval-S 与 LoCoMo 状态的完整声明活动映射；在 MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation 的十二种 answer-model 配置上取得最高平均 F1，并在五个代表性设置中超出 Dense 17.06–24.07 点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可靠记忆需要事务边界，MemTxn 以源支持更新 (source-supported updates) 与完整状态恢复 (complete-state recovery) 提供了该边界，但其结论仅限于实验所述数据集与审计设置。

papers.title: Thinking Once Is Enough: Intermediate-Layer Evidence Routing for High-Resolution VQA
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution visual question answering (HR-VQA) is often treated as a problem of insufficient evidence acquisition, where failing multimodal large language models must inspect images again through cropping, re-encoding, or multi-round search. We show that this view is incomplete: in many cases, fine-grained evidence has already survived visual encoding and become identifiable and influential within an intermediate-layer routing window, but is later diluted before answer generation. We propose Thinking-Once, a \textbf{training-free, single-visual-pass} evidence-routing method that reconstructs question-conditioned attention at this window, preserves core entity tokens and compact background context, and routes this evidence to later layers without extra visual encoding. Across five base models, Thinking-Once consistently improves or matches the corresponding base setting, increasing the average scores on V$^*$Bench, HRBench-4K, and HRBench-8K by \textit{+3.1}, \textit{+3.0}, and \textit{+2.7} points while reducing the average peak memory by about 4,GB. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, it improves the three benchmarks by \textit{+9.9}, \textit{+4.6}, and \textit{+5.5} points, raising the cross-benchmark mean from 72.5 to 79.1. With the ZwZ-8B base model, Thinking-Once reaches a mean score of 82.7. Against 11 open-source HR-VQA baselines, it obtains the best or tied-best score on all three benchmark averages and the best overall mean; for example, compared with DeepScan, it reduces V$^*$Bench inference time by \textbf{97.2\%} while improving the cross-benchmark mean from 77.8 to 79.1. These results show that HR-VQA can be improved by routing already encoded evidence rather than repeatedly acquiring new visual inputs. Code is available in the appendix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高分辨率视觉问答（HR-VQA）提出一个不同于主流思路的观点：许多失败案例并非因为证据获取不足，而是细粒度证据在中间层路由窗口（intermediate-layer routing window）中已经可识别、有影响，却在生成答案前被稀释。作者提出 Thinking-Once，一种免训练、单次视觉编码（training-free, single-visual-pass）的证据路由方法，在该窗口重构问题条件化注意力，保留核心实体 token 与紧凑背景上下文，并将证据路由到后续层而无需额外视觉编码。在五个基础模型上，该方法一致提升或持平对应基线，并在 V*Bench、HRBench-4K、HRBench-8K 上分别平均提升 +3.1、+3.0、+2.7 分，同时平均峰值显存降低约 4GB。
Motivation: HR-VQA 常被视为证据获取不足的问题，失败的多模态大模型需要反复裁剪、重新编码或多轮搜索图像；作者认为这一视角不完整，因为部分细粒度证据其实已经通过视觉编码保留下来，只是在中间层之后被稀释，因此问题在于证据路由而非证据获取。
Method: 提出 Thinking-Once，一种免训练、单次视觉编码的证据路由技术：在中间层路由窗口内重构问题条件化注意力，保留核心实体 token 与紧凑背景上下文，并把该证据路由到后续层，避免额外的视觉编码与多次图像访问。
Result: 在五个基础模型上，方法一致提升或持平基线，V*Bench、HRBench-4K、HRBench-8K 平均分分别提升 +3.1、+3.0、+2.7，平均峰值显存降低约 4GB；在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上三个基准分别提升 +9.9、+4.6、+5.5，跨基准均值从 72.5 升至 79.1；在 ZwZ-8B 上达到 82.7 的均值。与 11 个开源 HR-VQA 基线相比，在三个基准平均分上取得最佳或并列最佳，且相比 DeepScan 将 V*Bench 推理时间降低 97.2%，同时跨基准均值从 77.8 升至 79.1。
Conclusion: 作者认为 HR-VQA 可以通过路由已编码的证据而非反复获取新视觉输入来改进；代码在附录中提供。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sign Language Question Answering: A New Task, Benchmark, and Baseline for Sign Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in sign language (SL) understanding (SLU) have led to remarkable progress in tasks such as continuous SL recognition and SL translation. However, these tasks are designed with predefined objectives, requiring models to learn a fixed mapping from sign videos to glosses or spoken-language sentences. As a result, they provide only a limited assessment of whether a model truly understands the semantic content of SL videos. To address this limitation, \textbf{we first propose a new task, Sign Language Question Answering (SLQA)}, which evaluates SL understanding by requiring models to answer arbitrary natural language questions about SL videos. Unlike previous SLU tasks, SLQA provides a more flexible and comprehensive evaluation framework that assesses multiple reasoning capabilities beyond recognition and translation. To facilitate this task, \textbf{we further construct two SignQA benchmarks} based on PHOENIX14T and CSL-Daily by automatically generating question-answer pairs from existing gloss and sentence annotations using carefully designed templates. The resulting datasets cover five complementary question categories, including position reasoning, structural reasoning, visual search, gloss recognition, and translation understanding. \textbf{Finally, we propose a simple yet effective baseline model} equipped with a Question-Conditioned Modulated Temporal Downsampling module and an in-domain knowledge transfer strategy, enabling effective knowledge transfer from existing SLU tasks while enhancing question-aware temporal feature modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our baseline consistently outperforms representative vision-language models across all question categories, establishing a strong benchmark for future research on SLQA. Datasets are available at:{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hulala/SignQA-2026}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出手语问答（Sign Language Question Answering, SLQA）这一新任务，要求模型回答关于手语视频的任意自然语言问题，以更全面地评估手语理解能力。作者基于PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily构建了两个SignQA基准，通过模板自动生成五类问题（位置推理、结构推理、视觉搜索、手语识别和翻译理解），并提出一个带Question-Conditioned Modulated Temporal Downsampling模块和域内知识迁移策略的基线模型。实验表明该基线在各问题类别上均优于代表性视觉-语言模型。
Motivation: 现有手语理解任务（连续手语识别、手语翻译）依赖预定义目标，只学习从视频到注释或句子的固定映射，无法充分评估模型是否真正理解手语视频的语义内容。
Method: 先定义SLQA任务并从PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily自动生成问答对构建基准；再提出基线模型，包含Question-Conditioned Modulated Temporal Downsampling模块和域内知识迁移策略，以利用现有SLU任务的知识并增强问题感知的时间特征建模。
Result: 摘要报告该基线在所有问题类别上一致优于代表性视觉-语言模型，建立了SLQA的强基准。
Conclusion: SLQA为手语理解提供了更灵活全面的评估框架，基准与代码已公开（HuggingFace）。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出手语问答（Sign Language Question Answering, SLQA）这一新任务，要求模型回答关于手语视频的任意自然语言问题，以更全面地评估手语理解能力。作者基于PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily构建了两个SignQA基准，通过模板自动生成五类问题（位置推理、结构推理、视觉搜索、手语识别和翻译理解），并提出一个带Question-Conditioned Modulated Temporal Downsampling模块和域内知识迁移策略的基线模型。实验表明该基线在各问题类别上均优于代表性视觉-语言模型。

papers.title: Endo-NeRF++: Uncertainty-Aware Neural Rendering with Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding for Dynamic Surgical Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic surgical scenes is crucial for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery; however, it continues to be difficult because of tissue deformation, occlusions, specular reflections, and restricted viewpoints. In this study, we introduce Endo-NeRF++, a neural rendering framework that accounts for uncertainty in the reconstruction of dynamic surgical scenes. Expanding on EndoNeRF, the suggested approach incorporates multi-resolution hash-grid encoding, temporal feature merging, and uncertainty-informed adaptive sampling to enhance reconstruction accuracy and temporal coherence in deformable endoscopic scenes.The multi-resolution hash-grid representation within the framework effectively captures both coarse and fine anatomical details, while temporal feature blending ensures stable reconstruction during tissue deformation and surgical tool occlusions. Additionally, uncertainty-driven adaptive sampling assigns more samples to uncertain areas to enhance rendering quality and geometric coherence. Experiments on robotic surgical video sequences demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided adaptive sampling improves PSNR by up to 1.22\,dB (4.3\%), increases SSIM by up to 5.3\%, and reduces LPIPS by up to 55.1\% compared with the EndoNeRF baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Endo-NeRF++，一个面向动态手术场景重建的不确定性感知神经渲染框架。在 EndoNeRF 基础上，框架引入多分辨率哈希网格编码 (multi-resolution hash-grid encoding)、时间特征融合 (temporal feature merging) 和基于不确定性的自适应采样 (uncertainty-informed adaptive sampling)，以提升可变形内窥镜场景的重建精度与时间一致性。在机器人手术视频序列上的实验表明，相比 EndoNeRF 基线，PSNR 最高提升 1.22 dB（4.3%），SSIM 最高提升 5.3%，LPIPS 最高降低 55.1%。
Motivation: 动态手术场景重建对于机器人辅助微创手术至关重要，但组织变形、遮挡、镜面反射和受限视角使其一直具有挑战性；现有方法（如 EndoNeRF）在重建质量和时间一致性上仍有不足。
Method: 框架在 EndoNeRF 基础上扩展，结合多分辨率哈希网格编码以同时捕获粗细解剖细节，通过时间特征混合 (temporal feature blending) 保证组织变形和手术器械遮挡下的稳定重建，并用不确定性驱动的自适应采样将更多采样点分配到不确定区域以增强渲染质量与几何一致性。
Result: 在机器人手术视频序列上的实验显示，所提出的不确定性引导自适应采样相比 EndoNeRF 基线，PSNR 最高提升 1.22 dB（4.3%），SSIM 最高提升 5.3%，LPIPS 最高降低 55.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，不确定性感知的自适应采样与多分辨率哈希编码结合能够提升可变形内窥镜场景的重建精度和时间连贯性；其评估范围限于机器人手术视频序列。

papers.title: STEREODISCO: Discovering Stereotypicality in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLMs encode, convey, and perpetuate stereotypes. Prior computational research focuses on a small set of semantic axes investigated in social psychology, and operates on word embeddings produced by language models, leaving open which other semantic axes carry stereotypical associations in LLMs and how LLMs internally represent such axes. We introduce STEREODISCO, a framework that adapts the semantic differential method (Osgood et al., 1957) to the systematic study of stereotypes in LLM internal representations. STEREODISCO constructs approx. 2,000 candidate semantic axes from WordNet antonym synsets, recovers each as a geometric axis in the LLM's activation space via probing, and identifies stereotypical axes via a statistical test over concept projections. As a case study, we apply STEREODISCO to social group stereotypes with LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT and MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT. We find that the two LLMs agree with each other on social group ratings more than with humans, suggesting that LLM-encoded stereotype content diverges from that documented in social psychology. We also discover stereotypical axes not investigated in prior work -- including humble vs. proud, narrow-minded vs. broad-minded, and cowardly vs. brave, which human annotators independently confirm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEREODISCO 框架，将 Osgood 等人的语义微分法 (semantic differential) 引入 LLM 内部表征的刻板印象研究：从 WordNet 反义词 synset 构造约 2000 个候选语义轴，通过 probing 在激活空间中恢复几何轴，并用统计检验识别刻板印象轴。案例研究使用 LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT 和 MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT 分析社会群体刻板印象，发现两个 LLM 彼此评分的一致性高于与人类的一致性，并发现若干未被前人研究的刻板印象轴（如 humble vs. proud 等），这些轴得到人类标注者独立确认。
Motivation: 现有计算研究只考察社会心理学中已研究的一小组语义轴，并且是在语言模型产生的词嵌入 (word embeddings) 上操作，未回答 LLM 中还有哪些语义轴携带刻板印象关联，以及 LLM 内部如何表征这些轴。
Method: 提出 STEREODISCO 框架：从 WordNet 反义词 synset 构造约 2000 个候选语义轴；通过 probing 将每个轴恢复为 LLM 激活空间中的几何轴；对概念投影施加统计检验，识别出具有刻板印象的语义轴。
Result: 在 LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT 和 MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT 上的案例研究中，两个 LLM 对社会群体评分彼此的一致性高于与人类的一致性，表明 LLM 编码的刻板印象内容与社会心理学记录存在分歧；同时发现先前未研究的刻板印象轴，包括 humble vs. proud、narrow-minded vs. broad-minded、cowardly vs. brave，得到人类标注者独立确认。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 STEREODISCO 将语义微分法适配到 LLM 内部表征，能够系统地发现 LLM 中的刻板印象语义轴；案例结果表明 LLM 携带的刻板印象内容与人类心理学维度的记录存在显著差异。
Relevance: 0
