papers.title: Hallucinations Leave a Grounding Signature:Verifier-Guided Decoding for Selective Object Correction
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate objects that are absent from an image. Despite recent progress, existing mitigation methods still lack reliable object-level grounding diagnostics and therefore tend to apply coarse-grained interventions, which can impair visual understanding, shorten responses, and reduce coverage of genuinely grounded objects. The key challenge is thus to detect, during generation, whether each emerging object mention is supported by reliable visual evidence, so that hallucination can be mitigated selectively. Yet output confidence reflects next-token plausibility rather than visual support, allowing language priors to make absent objects appear certain. We show that the missing diagnostic evidence is encoded in an Intrinsic Grounding Signature (IGS), a distributed signed attention pattern that remains informative for such confident hallucinations. Based on IGS, we propose Verifier-Guided Decoding (VGD), a decoding framework in which a lightweight verifier examines each emerging object mention, rolls back the KV cache when the mention is identified as high risk, suppresses the object and its synonyms, and regenerates the affected continuation. Because VGD intervenes only on object mentions identified as high risk, it reduces object hallucination while preserving the model's original visual understanding and grounded object coverage. Experiments on CHAIR and AMBER-G show that VGD achieves state-of-the-art object hallucination reduction: at @rec90, it cuts AMBER-G CHAIR by 43.6\% while retaining 99.6\% of grounded-object coverage, and reduces CHAIR-MSCOCO CHAIR$_i$/CHAIR$_s$ by 37.0\%/30.4\% without shortening captions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 在生成时对图像中不存在对象的幻觉问题，提出内在接地签名 (Intrinsic Grounding Signature, IGS) 作为可诊断的对象级视觉证据信号，并在此基础上构建验证器引导解码 (Verifier-Guided Decoding, VGD)。VGD 仅在对象提及被识别为高风险时回滚 KV cache、抑制该对象及其同义词并重新生成，从而在减少幻觉的同时保留 grounded object coverage。实验在 CHAIR 和 AMBER-G 上取得对象幻觉降低的 state-of-the-art 结果，且不缩短描述。
Motivation: 现有缓解方法缺乏可靠的对象级接地诊断 (object-level grounding diagnostics)，倾向于施加粗粒度干预，可能损害视觉理解、缩短回答并减少对真正接地对象的覆盖；而输出置信度反映的是 next-token 合理性而非视觉支持，语言先验会让不存在的对象显得确定。
Method: 作者证明缺失的诊断证据编码在 IGS 中，即一种分布式的带符号注意力模式，对高置信幻觉仍然有效。基于 IGS 提出 VGD 解码框架：轻量验证器检查每个新出现的对象提及，若识别为高风险则回滚 KV cache、抑制该对象及其同义词，并重新生成受影响的后续文本；干预只作用于高风险对象提及。
Result: 在 CHAIR 和 AMBER-G 上，VGD 达到对象幻觉降低的 state-of-the-art 性能：在 @rec90 下将 AMBER-G CHAIR 降低 43.6%，同时保留 99.6% 的 grounded-object coverage；并将 CHAIR-MSCOCO 的 CHAIR_i/CHAIR_s 降低 37.0%/30.4%，且不缩短描述。
Conclusion: 作者认为 IGS 提供了缺失的视觉支持诊断信息，VGD 通过只干预高风险对象提及，可以在减少对象幻觉的同时保持模型原有的视觉理解与接地对象覆盖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Deep Learning for Accelerated Long-Horizon Forecasting of Multicomponent Multiphase Microstructure Evolution in High-Entropy Alloys
papers.abstract_en: Phase-field modeling provides a powerful approach for predicting microstructure evolution but becomes computationally prohibitive for multicomponent and multiphase systems over large spatial and temporal scales. This work presents an AE-GCN-LSTM surrogate framework for long-horizon forecasting of microstructure evolution in the multicomponent AlCrFeNi high-entropy alloy system containing coexisting BCC and FCC phases. A multi-head autoencoder compresses the four elemental concentration fields and phase-field order parameter into latent representations, which are formulated as graphs for learning their spatial and temporal evolution. The framework accurately forecasts microstructure evolution over horizons extending to 3,000,000 simulation timesteps. Its robustness is systematically evaluated under previously unseen conditions without retraining, fine-tuning, or parameter adaptation. These evaluations include variations in FCC precipitate size and initial position, microstructures containing one, two, and five FCC precipitates, and complex phase interactions involving precipitate merging and splitting. Although trained only on 100 x 100 computational domains containing a single nominal alloy composition, the framework is successfully transferred to larger 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 systems and to previously unseen AlCrFeNi compositions. Across the evaluated configurations, the model preserves the dominant phase morphology and compositional evolution while providing computational speedups ranging from approximately 7200 to 62300 relative to conventional phase-field simulations. These results demonstrate that latent graph-based AE-GCN-LSTM forecasting provides a scalable and computationally efficient surrogate for long-horizon simulation of multicomponent, multiphase microstructures and offers a promising foundation for high-throughput alloy design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多组分多相高熵合金微结构演化的长时程预测问题，提出 AE-GCN-LSTM 代理框架。该方法用多头自编码器将 AlCrFeNi 合金的四个元素浓度场和相场序参数压缩为潜表示，并以图结构学习其时空演化，可预测长达 3,000,000 个模拟时间步的微结构演化。框架在未见条件、更大计算域和未见合金成分下保持稳健，相对传统相场模拟获得约 7200 至 62300 倍的加速。
Motivation: 相场建模是预测微结构演化的有力手段，但对多组分多相系统在大空间和时间尺度上的计算成本过高，难以支撑高通量合金设计。
Method: 提出 AE-GCN-LSTM 代理框架：多head自编码器将多个浓度场与相场序参数编码为潜表示，将这些潜表示构建成图，再利用图卷积网络（GCN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）联合学习并预测其时空演化。
Result: 摘要报告该框架能精确预测长达 3,000,000 时间步的微结构演化；在未经过重训练、微调或参数适配的情况下，对 FCC 析出物尺寸与初始位置的变化、1/2/5 个析出物构型及析出物合并分裂等复杂相相互作用保持鲁棒；从 100×100 训练域成功迁移到 256×256 和 512×512 系统及未见 AlCrFeNi 成分，并在所有评估配置中保持主导相形貌与成分演化，计算加速比约为 7200 至 62300 倍。
Conclusion: 本文表明基于潜图的 AE-GCN-LSTM 预测可作为多组分多相微结构长时程模拟的可扩展且高效的代理方法，为高通量合金设计提供基础。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该框架能精确预测长达 3,000,000 时间步的微结构演化；在未经过重训练、微调或参数适配的情况下，对 FCC 析出物尺寸与初始位置的变化、1/2/5 个析出物构型及析出物合并分裂等复杂相相互作用保持鲁棒；从 100×100 训练域成功迁移到 256×256 和 512×512 系统及未见 AlCrFeNi 成分，并在所有评估配置中保持主导相形貌与成分演化，计算加速比约为 7200 至 62300 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文表明基于潜图的 AE-GCN-LSTM 预测可作为多组分多相微结构长时程模拟的可扩展且高效的代理方法，为高通量合金设计提供基础。

papers.title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
authors: Hongtao Xie (1) ((1) University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract_en: Role-playing agents (RPAs) have become one of the most important consumer applications of large language models. Users engage in multi-turn conversations with RPAs for experiences such as emotional comfort, making reliable evaluation essential for measuring capability, comparing systems, and guiding further improvement. Existing benchmarks, however, typically require an RPA to continue a fixed dialogue history and then evaluate the continuation using a fixed rubric detached from the user. We identify and empirically demonstrate two limitations of this design. First, an RPA's output is shaped by the preceding dialogue history, preventing a scientifically grounded assessment of its role-playing ability in real multi-turn settings. Second, user experience varies substantially across individuals, and conventional fixed rubrics need not align with user satisfaction. We therefore introduce PALATE (Person-Aligned LLM-Simulated-User Assessment with Tailored Evaluation), a scalable RPA benchmark built on user simulators. PALATE is accompanied by a pool of 300 character profiles. Its main evaluation trains five per-user simulators and lets them engage candidate RPAs in free-form, multi-turn conversations over a pre-frozen panel of character profiles. Alongside a general quality rubric, we construct personalized rubrics to measure user satisfaction; on held-out annotated data, the personalized rubrics show higher agreement with human judgments than the general rubric. In the main evaluation of 16 candidates, PALATE separately characterizes generic turn quality, long-horizon session capability, and per-user experience on multi-turn trajectories co-constructed by each candidate. It thereby produces interpretable evaluations of specific user-RPA pairs rather than compressing systems into a single user-independent ranking.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary material. Resources: https://github.com/Zhuyh1139/PALATE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PALATE，一个基于用户模拟器 (user simulators) 的可扩展角色扮演智能体 (RPA) 评测基准，配套 300 个角色档案。评测训练五个逐用户模拟器，让它们与候选 RPA 在预冻结的角色档案上进行自由多轮对话，并同时使用通用质量 rubric 和个性化 rubric 度量用户满意度。摘要在保留标注数据上显示个性化 rubric 与人类判断的一致性高于通用 rubric，并在 16 个候选模型的评测中区分通用回合质量、长程会话能力和逐用户体验。
Motivation: 现有 RPA 基准通常要求模型继续一段固定对话历史，再用与用户脱节的固定 rubric 评估，导致两个问题：输出受前置历史影响而无法科学评估真实多轮场景下的角色扮演能力；用户个体体验差异大，固定 rubric 未必符合用户满意度。
Method: 构建包含 300 个角色档案的 PALATE 基准；训练五个逐用户模拟器与候选 RPA 进行自由多轮对话，并在通用质量 rubric 之外构建个性化 rubric 来衡量用户满意度。
Result: 在保留的标注数据上，个性化 rubric 与人类判断的一致性高于通用 rubric；对 16 个候选模型的评测分别刻画了通用回合质量、长程会话能力和多轮轨迹上的逐用户体验。
Conclusion: PALATE 提供对具体用户-RPA 配对的可解释评测，而非将系统压缩为单一的用户无关排名。

papers.title: Robust Estimation of Sparse Numerical Vectors under Local Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Local differential privacy (LDP) protocols are vulnerable to poisoning attacks. Existing research have proposed efficient defense strategies for single-item users. However, in practice, a user may possess multiple items. The defense against poisoning attacks for multi-item users is challenging, because due to larger output spaces, the adversary can conduct more powerful attacks without being detected. In this paper, we address the robust sparse vector mean estimation problem, in which each user has a vector with $m$ nonzero coordinates. We propose Randomized Projection with Clipping (RPC). Firstly, the server sends a random binary vector to each user. The user then projects its local data on the vector, and clip the value to restrict the attacker's capability. To handle clipping bias, we propose a correction method based on a careful analysis that gives an exact expression of the bias. As a result, bias-variance tradeoff is no longer needed, thus the clipping threshold can be further reduced to shrink the output space and enhance robustness. We provide a rigorous theoretical guarantee of the estimation error under all possible attacks. Numerical experiments show that under trusted environments, our new method achieves comparable or better performance than existing methods, indicating that our method is already an efficient estimator in its own right. Under untrusted environments, our method is also significantly more robust to poisoning attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究本地差分隐私 (local differential privacy, LDP) 下稀疏数值向量的鲁棒均值估计，每个用户持有含 m 个非零坐标的向量。作者提出 Randomized Projection with Clipping (RPC)：服务器发送随机二值向量，用户投影并裁剪本地数据以限制攻击者能力；通过精确刻画裁剪偏差的表达式进行校正，从而无需再权衡偏差与方差，可进一步降低裁剪阈值以缩小输出空间并增强鲁棒性。论文给出所有可能攻击下的估计误差理论保证，数值实验表明在可信环境下性能与现有方法相当或更优，在不可信环境下对投毒攻击明显更鲁棒。
Motivation: LDP 协议易受投毒攻击，现有防御策略主要针对单条目用户，而实际用户可能拥有多个条目。由于输出空间更大，攻击者可以对多条目用户发起更强大且更难被检测的攻击，因此多条目场景下的抗投毒防御更具挑战性。
Method: 提出 Randomized Projection with Clipping (RPC)：服务端向每个用户发送随机二值向量，用户将本地数据投影到该向量并对结果进行裁剪以限制攻击者能力。针对裁剪引入的偏差，作者通过精确表达式给出校正方法，使裁剪阈值可以进一步降低，从而缩小输出空间并提升鲁棒性。
Result: 论文提供在所有可能攻击下估计误差的严格理论保证。数值实验显示，在可信环境中新方法达到与现有方法相当或更优的性能；在不可信环境中，该方法对投毒攻击显著更加鲁棒。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法本身已是高效的估计器，同时具备对投毒攻击的较强鲁棒性，适用于多条目用户的稀疏向量均值估计场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPFM-Net: Semantic-Prior-Guided Frequency-Constrained Mamba for Invisible Watermark Attack
papers.abstract_en: Existing watermark attacks typically rely on predefined signal-processing operations or locally constrained restoration networks, making it difficult to capture the long-range dependencies of globally distributed watermark signals and resulting in an unfavorable trade-off between removal effectiveness and visual fidelity. In this paper, we propose SPFM-Net, a semantic-prior-guided and frequency-constrained Mamba framework for invisible watermark attack. SPFM-Net first employs high-ratio masking to disrupt the spatial coherence of invisible watermark signals, and then utilizes a partially fine-tuned pretrained Masked Autoencoder to reconstruct semantically consistent image from sparse observations while suppressing watermark-related information. A Multi-scale Residual Frequency Feature Interaction module subsequently aggregates watermark-related residual features across multiple receptive fields, while adaptively suppressing responses from watermark-irrelevant regions. To further capture the long-range dependencies of globally distributed watermark signals, a lightweight Mamba-based Global State-space Feature Modeling (GSFM) unit is introduced to separate watermark-related features from natural image content and suppress the remaining watermark traces. In addition, SPFM-Net is optimized using a multi-level objective that jointly imposes spatial-, frequency-, and edge-domain constraints, enabling effective watermark suppression while preserving perceptual quality. Extensive experiments on representative spatial-domain, transform-domain, orthogonal moment-based, and deep learning-based watermarking schemes demonstrate that SPFM-Net achieves a favorable trade-off between watermark attack effectiveness and perceptual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPFM-Net，一种面向不可见水印攻击的语义先验引导、频率约束的 Mamba 框架。它先用高比例掩码打散水印信号的空间连贯性，再通过部分微调的预训练 Masked Autoencoder 从稀疏观测重建语义一致的图像并抑制水印，随后用多尺度残差频率特征交互和轻量 Mamba 全局状态空间建模捕获全局分布水印的长程依赖。多级损失在空间、频率、边缘域联合约束，实验覆盖空间域、变换域、正交矩和深度学习水印方案，声称取得了攻击有效性与感知保真度之间的有利权衡。
Motivation: 现有水印攻击多依赖预定义信号处理操作或局部受限修复网络，难以捕获全局分布水印信号的长程依赖，导致去除效果与视觉保真度之间难以平衡。
Method: 提出 SPFM-Net，包含高比例掩码破坏水印空间连贯性、部分微调预训练 MAE 重建语义一致图像、多尺度残差频率特征交互模块聚合跨感受野水印残差并抑制无关区域响应，以及轻量 Mamba 全局状态空间特征建模单元分离水印特征与自然内容；使用空间、频率、边缘域联合的多级目标优化。
Result: 在空间域、变换域、正交矩和深度学习水印方案等代表性水印方法的实验中，SPFM-Net 实现了水印攻击有效性与感知保真度之间的有利权衡。摘要未给出具体数字。
Conclusion: 摘要强调语义先验与频率约束相结合、并利用 Mamba 建模长程依赖，可以更好地兼顾水印去除效果与视觉质量。未提及其局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning-Augmented and Randomized Algorithms for Line Aggregation with Delays
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies learning-augmented and randomized online aggregation with delays on a line metric. We consider advice given as online suggested service lengths, and evaluate the algorithms in terms of robustness and consistency. For each $λ\in (0,1]$, we first propose a deterministic learning-augmented \textsc{Balance} algorithm that is $(4/λ+1/λ^2)$-robust and $(4+λ)$-consistent. We also propose a randomized algorithm for the problem in the classical adversarial model, which is $(e+1)$-competitive against an oblivious adversary, improving over the deterministic $5$-competitive \textsc{Balance} benchmark~\cite{bienkowski2013chain}. Notably, this competitive ratio is even lower than the lower bound of $4$ for deterministic online algorithms. Moreover, we establish a lower bound of $e$ on the competitive ratio of randomized online algorithms, improving the previous lower bound of $e/(e-1)$. Besides, we combine the two ideas and obtain a randomized learning-augmented algorithm that is $(e/λ+1/λ^2)$-robust and $(e+λ)$-consistent. Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to complement our theoretical analysis and evaluate the empirical performance of our algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线度量上带延迟的在线聚合问题，提出学习增强（learning-augmented）与随机化算法。作者给出了一个确定性学习增强 Balance 算法，其鲁棒性为 $(4/\lambda+1/\lambda^2)$，一致性为 $(4+\lambda)$；并在经典对抗模型中提出 $(e+1)$-竞争的随机化算法，优于确定性 $5$-竞争的 Balance 基准。文中还建立了随机化在线算法竞争比下界 $e$，并将两种思想结合得到随机化学习增强算法，最后用数值实验补充理论分析。
Motivation: 现有确定性在线聚合算法存在竞争比限制，且学习增强算法在带延迟的线度量聚合问题上缺乏系统研究。目标是在 advice 模型下同时保证鲁棒性和一致性，并探索随机化能否突破确定性算法的下界。
Method: 先提出确定性学习增强 \textsc{Balance} 算法，以在线建议的服务长度作为 advice；再设计经典对抗模型下的随机化算法，并给出竞争比分析。然后将学习增强与随机化结合，得到 $(e/\lambda+1/\lambda^2)$-鲁棒、$(e+\lambda)$-一致的随机化学习增强算法。
Result: 确定性学习增强算法达到 $(4/\lambda+1/\lambda^2)$-鲁棒和 $(4+\lambda)$-一致；随机化算法对 oblivious adversary 达到 $(e+1)$-竞争，低于确定性 $4$ 的下界；随机化算法的下界被改进为 $e$。数值实验补充了经验性能评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调随机化能够以超越确定性下界的竞争比求解该问题，且学习增强与随机化可以结合以同时获得鲁棒性和一致性保证。

papers.title: LoMeVQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Longitudinal Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: In clinical practice, patients often undergo multiple imaging examinations over successive visits, yielding longitudinal data. Modeling such temporal information is crucial for reliable assessment of disease progression and treatment response. However, despite the rapid advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), longitudinal medical visual reasoning remains largely underexplored. To fill this gap, we propose LoMeVQA, a comprehensive benchmark consisting of 206K longitudinal visual question answering (VQA) pairs for temporal medical image analysis. LoMeVQA covers five tasks: progress classification, progress description, progress report generation, differential region grounding, and differential region description. To construct the dataset, we develop an automated pipeline that (1) organizes patient records chronologically, (2) extracts clinically meaningful entities via a medical knowledge graph, and (3) models their temporal evolution to guide large language models in generating high-quality longitudinal VQA pairs. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that both general-purpose and medical-domain MLLMs perform poorly on LoMeVQA, revealing substantial limitations in temporal reasoning. To address these limitations, we introduce MedLong-8B, which achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks. papers.title: FDDWAN: A Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Network for Watermarking Attack
papers.abstract_en: Existing invisible watermark removal methods often struggle to accurately capture the watermark-bearing features, leading to an unfavorable trade-off between watermark suppression and perceptual fidelity. In this paper, we propose the Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Watermark Attack Network (FDDWAN), a coarse-to-fine framework that performs watermark removal through wavelet-domain decomposition and residual diffusion refinement. In the initial stage, the Wavelet-based Frequency-domain Preliminary Attack Module (WFPAM) decomposes the watermarked image into low- and high-frequency subbands and applies frequency-specific attack strategies tailored to their respective contributions to watermark robustness and perceptual quality. In the next stage, the Frequency-domain Residual Diffusion Attack Module (FRDAM) separately models the residual distributions between the preliminarily attacked outputs and the corresponding watermark-free references during training. Rather than reconstructing the entire image, FRDAM selectively refines frequency-domain residuals, directing the diffusion process toward the remaining watermark related discrepancies while minimizing modifications to image content. Extensive experiments on CelebA and ImageNet across four representative watermarking schemes demonstrate that FDDWAN achieves a more favorable trade-off between watermark removal effectiveness and visual fidelity than conventional and learning-based attack methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FDDWAN，一种面向不可见水印去除的粗到细扩散攻击网络，通过小波域分解与残差扩散细化来改善水印抑制与感知保真度之间的权衡。方法包含小波频域初步攻击模块 (WFPAM) 和频域残差扩散攻击模块 (FRDAM)，后者在训练时建模初步攻击输出与无水印参考之间的残差分布，仅选择性细化频域残差。在 CelebA 和 ImageNet 上针对四种水印方案的实验表明，FDDWAN 比传统和基于学习的攻击方法取得了更有利的权衡。
Motivation: 现有不可见水印去除方法往往难以准确捕获含水印特征，导致水印抑制与感知保真度之间存在不利权衡。
Method: 提出粗到细框架 FDDWAN：第一阶段 WFPAM 将含水印图像分解为低频和高频子带，并针对各频带对水印鲁棒性和感知质量的贡献采用特定攻击策略；第二阶段 FRDAM 分别建模初步攻击输出与对应无水印参考之间的残差分布，通过细化频域残差将扩散过程导向剩余水印相关差异，同时最小化对图像内容的改动。
Result: 在 CelebA 和 ImageNet 上对四种代表性水印方案的广泛实验表明，FDDWAN 在水印去除效果与视觉保真度之间实现了比传统和基于学习方法更有利的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过小波域分解和残差扩散细化，可以在水印去除任务中更好地平衡水印抑制与图像内容保持。

papers.title: MemeBench: What LVLMs Miss When Interpreting Culture-Dependent Memes
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models have improved at describing visual content, but accurate descriptions do not ensure interpretation when meaning depends on knowledge beyond the pixels. Memes expose this gap because they rely on cultural entities, background knowledge, and community conventions. Most meme benchmarks reduce interpretation to labels or holistic scores, obscuring where an explanation breaks down. We introduce MemeBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,253 Chinese and English memes with human-written references and quality-controlled VIKR annotations, centered on anime, comics, games, and adjacent online subcultures. Its VIKR schema decomposes explanations into Visual clues, Identity links, Knowledge units, and Reasoning mechanisms. Across 26 LVLMs, every model covers visible content more reliably than the knowledge needed to interpret it, and even the strongest retains a 22.6% Visual-Knowledge gap. To test whether this diagnosis can guide improvement, we introduce KAR, an entity-guided retrieval baseline built on CultureBase. Across four controlled models, KAR raises VIKR Success by 3.6-7.4% and, compared with generic retrieval, repairs more answers and breaks fewer. Yet both retrieval conditions improve Identity and Knowledge while reducing Visual coverage in every comparison. MemeBench reveals whether an interpretation succeeds, what is missing, and whether targeted evidence fills the diagnosed gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemeBench，一个用于诊断 LVLM 文化相关梗图解释能力的基准，包含 1,253 个中英文梗图及人工参考标注，并采用 VIKR 模式将解释分解为视觉线索、身份链接、知识单元和推理机制。在 26 个 LVLM 上的评估显示，所有模型对可见内容的覆盖都优于对解释所需知识的覆盖，最强模型仍存在 22.6% 的视觉-知识差距。作者还提出基于 CultureBase 的实体引导检索基线 KAR，在四个受控模型上将 VIKR Success 提升 3.6-7.4%，且比通用检索修复更多答案、破坏更少。
Motivation: 梗图的含义依赖像素之外的文化实体、背景知识和社区惯例，而现有 meme 基准大多把解释简化为标签或整体分数，无法定位解释在何处失败。
Method: 构建 MemeBench 诊断基准，包含质量控制的 VIKR 注解与人工参考解释；VIKR 模式将解释分解为 Visual clues、Identity links、Knowledge units 和 Reasoning mechanisms。另提出 KAR（entity-guided retrieval baseline）并构建 CultureBase，用于测试诊断结果能否指导改进。
Result: 在 26 个 LVLM 上，所有模型对可见内容的覆盖均比知识覆盖更可靠，最强模型保留 22.6% 的视觉-知识差距。KAR 在四个受控模型上使 VIKR Success 提升 3.6-7.4%，相比通用检索修复更多答案且破坏更少；但两种检索条件均在每次对比中提升 Identity 和 Knowledge，同时降低 Visual 覆盖。
Conclusion: MemeBench 能够揭示解释是否成功、缺失什么，以及定向证据（如 KAR 检索）能否填补已诊断的差距；摘要同时指出检索虽改善知识相关环节，但会削弱视觉覆盖。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Revisiting Predictive Process Monitoring in the Age of Foundation Models: A Comparative Study of Sequence, Tabular, and LLM Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) leverages event logs to forecast the future of running process instances, for instance, predicting the next activity, the remaining time until case completion, or the time to the next event. While PPM research in recent years has been dominated by deep sequence models trained from scratch, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, foundation-model approaches---particularly large language models (LLMs)---are increasingly explored for PPM. At the same time, tabular foundation models with in-context learning capabilities offer a promising alternative but have not yet been systematically benchmarked for PPM. Thus, it remains unclear whether classical sequence-based models remain competitive in this evolving landscape. This paper compares the three modeling paradigms both conceptually and empirically through a controlled benchmark across multiple datasets and prediction tasks. The results show that sequence models consistently perform best for next activity prediction, whereas tabular foundation models are competitive on temporal tasks, with LLMs usually lagging behind despite higher cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对预测性流程监控（Predictive Process Monitoring, PPM）中的三类建模范式——从零训练的深度序列模型、具备上下文学习能力的表格基础模型（tabular foundation models）以及大语言模型（LLM）——进行了概念与实证比较。通过在多个数据集和预测任务上的受控基准测试，摘要报告序列模型在下一活动预测上持续最优，表格基础模型在时序预测任务上具有竞争力，而 LLM 通常表现落后且成本更高。
Motivation: PPM 研究近年来以从零训练的深度序列模型（如 LSTM）为主，LLM 等基础模型方法正被越来越多地探索，但表格基础模型尚未在 PPM 上被系统化基准测试；因此，经典序列模型在新兴基础模型环境下是否仍具竞争力尚不明确。
Method: 论文从概念和实证两个层面比较三种建模范式，通过受控基准（controlled benchmark）在多个数据集和预测任务上统一评估序列模型、表格基础模型与 LLM。
Result: 结果表明，序列模型在下一活动预测任务上始终表现最好；表格基础模型在时序任务（如剩余时间等）上与序列模型相当；LLM 尽管成本更高，通常仍落后于其他两类方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在 PPM 中经典的序列模型仍然具有竞争力，LLM 在当前评估中性价比不高，而表格基础模型是时序预测任务的有力替代方案。

papers.title: Can AI Follow In Einstein's Footsteps?
papers.abstract_en: AI is accelerating physics discovery, but perhaps away from Einstein-level theory building. To understand this gap, we must recognize a striking trend: while being very successful, the most visible AI contributions to physics discovery appear to mirror the historical development of physics, but in reverse. Human discovery in physics progressed, in broad strokes, from ancient pattern prediction, through phenomenological laws such as Kepler's, to principle-based universal theories such as relativity and the Standard Model. On the AI side, prominent contributions to physics discovery point in the opposite direction: early milestones emphasized explicit equation-discovery methods, such as symbolic regression, whereas more recent frontier contributions are powerful predictors such as AlphaFold and GraphCast, which can be remarkably accurate yet do not provide clear theoretical understanding. If this trend continues, AI would become extraordinarily good at prediction but may struggle to ever propose its first serious contender to quantum gravity or other paradigm-level theories. We review the current landscape of AI for physics discovery and highlight a critical missing skill: the ability to pose the right questions or invent the right principles to guide the development of new theories and the tests to falsify them. This mode of discovery has driven many of the deepest advances since the 17th century, where symmetry, simplicity, and new mathematical frameworks guided theory construction before experimental tests. Equipping AI systems with such skills could move them from predicting within known frameworks to proposing the next paradigm-level discovery in physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审视AI在物理学发现中的作用，指出一个耐人寻味的趋势：AI的突出贡献似乎在反向重演物理学史——从早期的显式方程发现（如符号回归）转向如今的强预测器（如AlphaFold、GraphCast），后者精度高但缺乏理论理解。作者认为若此趋势延续，AI将擅长预测却难以提出量子引力级别的范式理论，并呼吁发展AI提出正确问题、发明原理并设计可证伪检验的能力。
Motivation: AI正在加速物理发现，但可能偏离爱因斯坦式的理论构建；现有最显眼的AI物理贡献多为高精度预测工具，缺少理论洞察，作者希望弥合这一能力缺口。
Method: 论文是一篇综述与观点性文章：梳理AI for physics discovery的当前格局，对比人类物理学从模式预测到现象学定律再到原理性理论的发展脉络，提出AI缺失的关键技能是提出正确问题、发明指导性原则并构造可证伪的实验检验。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要贡献是识别“AI物理发现反向重演物理史”这一趋势，并指出前沿模型（如AlphaFold、GraphCast）虽有预测力但缺乏清晰理论理解。
Conclusion: 作者强调，若赋予AI以原理驱动、问题提出与证伪检验的能力，有望让AI从在已知框架内预测转向提出下一项范式级物理发现；关注点集中在理论物理发现而非具体应用领域。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，若赋予AI以原理驱动、问题提出与证伪检验的能力，有望让AI从在已知框架内预测转向提出下一项范式级物理发现；关注点集中在理论物理发现而非具体应用领域。

papers.title: Annotating Topical Legal Insights from Case Proceedings
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we mainly concentrate on finding concepts or topics from the legal case proceedings, since adopting a structured representation for legal documents, as opposed to a mere bag-of-words flat text representation, can significantly enhance processing capabilities. To achieve this objective, we put forward a set of diverse concepts for legal case proceedings. With this motivation, we propose LeDA, a system for Legal Data Annotation. The system offers the generic functionality of annotating and adjudicating entities or concepts within documents via a web-based interface. A novel feature of our system is that it allows to dynamic create new tags for annotation, which is a particularly useful provision for situations where there exists no pre-defined ontology for the entities (concepts) that need to be annotated - these being rather discovered by annotators as they continue examining more documents. The system that we demonstrate is currently in use to annotate a set of concepts from legal documents to construct semantic representations of documents as bags of concepts that can then be used for several downstream tasks, such as prior case retrieval, judgment prediction, and so on. Along with the system features in general, we also describe how LeDA was used by 3 assessors to annotate and adjudicate legal concept names from Indian Supreme Court case proceedings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LeDA（Legal Data Annotation）系统，用于从法律案件审理记录（case proceedings）中标注概念或主题，以构造结构化的“概念袋”（bag of concepts）表示，替代扁平词袋表示。系统提供基于 Web 的标注与裁决界面，并支持动态创建新标签，适用于尚无预定义本体、需人工边标注边发现概念的场景。文中还描述了该系统在印度最高法院案件记录上由 3 名评估者标注与裁决法律概念名的使用情况。
Motivation: 法律文档采用结构化表示比扁平词袋表示更能提升后续处理能力；但案件审理记录中的概念往往缺乏预定义本体，需要支持标注者在审阅过程中动态发现并创建新概念标签。
Method: 提出 LeDA 系统，提供基于 Web 的通用文档标注与仲裁（annotating and adjudicating）功能；其新颖之处在于允许动态创建新标签，以适应无预定义实体本体（ontology）的标注场景。
Result: 摘要报告该系统正被用于标注法律文档中的一组概念，并由 3 名评估者用于标注和仲裁印度最高法院案件记录中的法律概念名称；未提供量化实验结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过将法律文档表示为概念袋，可支持先例检索（prior case retrieval）、判决预测（judgment prediction）等下游任务；系统本身面向无预定义本体时的动态标注需求。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to interpret complex human emotions by integrating natural language with non-verbal modalities. Non-verbal modalities share a structural isomorphism with natural language, as both can be viewed as feature sequences evolving over time. This isomorphism enables the transformation of non-verbal modalities into text-like tokens for unified semantic reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs), designed to understand and generate sequential data, can thus be utilized to interpret complex affective sequences. However, existing LLM-based methods primarily capture low-level superficial features, failing to model affective semantics arising from structural variations and contextual interactions. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SentiLLM}, a unified framework that leverages \textit{Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction} to distill continuous raw signals into compact, semantically meaningful tokens. Specifically, we introduce a \textit{Dual-Stream Salience-Context Calibration Mechanism}, which disentangles non-verbal feature sequences into a focus stream and an ambient stream. The focus stream captures salient sentiment shifts (e.g., facial expressions) guided by textual priors, while the ambient stream characterizes stable background states. Through calibrating these dynamic sentiment shifts against background states, SentiLLM effectively projects non-verbal modalities into a unified semantic space, making them naturally understandable for LLMs. Serving as a plug-and-play module, SentiLLM significantly improves discriminative performance with only a small number of trainable parameters. Our method achieves superior performance on four datasets, MOSI, MOSEI, CH-SIMS, and CH-SIMS v2, demonstrating the effectiveness of the structural abstraction paradigm in MSA. Our code is available at: \href{https://github.com/especiallyW/SentiLLM}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SentiLLM，一个利用语义对齐结构抽象（Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction）的多模态情感分析统一框架，将连续的非语言信号蒸馏为紧凑且有语义的 token，使其可被大语言模型（LLM）理解。框架引入双流显著性-背景校准机制（Dual-Stream Salience-Context Calibration Mechanism），在 MOSI、MOSEI、CH-SIMS 和 CH-SIMS v2 四个数据集上取得更优的判别性能，且仅需少量可训练参数。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多模态情感分析方法主要捕捉低层表面特征，未能建模由结构变化和上下文交互产生的情感语义，导致情感理解不充分。
Method: 利用非语言模态与自然语言在时间序列上的结构同构性，将非语言模态转化为类文本 token。提出双流显著性-背景校准机制，把非语言特征序列拆分为焦点流（focus stream）和背景流（ambient stream），前者在文本先验引导下捕捉表情等显著情感变化，后者刻画稳定背景状态，通过校准动态情感变化与背景状态，将非语言模态投影到统一语义空间。
Result: 在 MOSI、MOSEI、CH-SIMS 和 CH-SIMS v2 四个数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能，作为即插即用模块仅引入少量可训练参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构抽象范式在多模态情感分析中的有效性，并指出 SentiLLM 可作为即插即用模块提升 LLM 对多模态情感序列的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpecCal: Ambiguity-Aware Candidate Calibration for Infrared Spectrum-Based Molecular Structure Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Inferring molecular structures from infrared (IR) spectra is a fundamental yet challenging problem. A key difficulty is that an IR spectrum provides limited structural information: different molecules may share similar functional groups and local vibrational patterns, leading to highly similar spectral responses. Thus, even when an observed spectrum has a unique underlying structure, reconstructing it from the spectrum remains ambiguous. Existing IR-to-molecule models usually generate a ranked set of candidate molecules, but this set is largely determined by the model's learned generation preference and may not fully capture the structures that best satisfy the observed spectral constraints. To address this limitation, we propose SpecCal, a training-free candidate calibration framework for IR-to-molecule prediction. SpecCal operates on the candidate outputs of existing base models and improves the prediction set by re-ranking current candidates while introducing additional structurally plausible alternatives guided by spectral consistency. The framework is plug-and-play and model-agnostic, requiring no parameter updates for integration with diverse base models. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SpecCal consistently improves top-k reconstruction at both SMILES and scaffold levels across different base models. Further analyses demonstrate that calibrating candidate sets under spectral ambiguity provides a practical way to improve molecular reconstruction from IR spectra. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecCal-B18A.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecCal 提出一种免训练 (training-free) 的候选校准框架，用于红外 (IR) 光谱到分子结构重建。该框架作用于现有基础模型的候选输出，通过重排当前候选并结合光谱一致性 (spectral consistency) 引入额外的结构合理备选，以缓解光谱歧义。多个基准上的实验显示，SpecCal 在不同基础模型上都能一致提升 top-k 重建效果。
Motivation: 红外光谱能提供的结构信息有限，不同分子可能因共享官能团和局部振动模式而具有相似光谱响应，即使观测光谱对应唯一结构，重建仍然存在歧义。现有 IR-to-molecule 模型的候选集合主要由生成偏好决定，可能无法覆盖最能满足光谱约束的结构。
Method: SpecCal 是一个即插即用、模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的校准框架，直接作用于现有基础模型的候选输出，无需参数更新；它通过重排现有候选，并依据光谱一致性补充额外的结构合理备选来改进预测集合。
Result: 在多个基准上，SpecCal 在不同基础模型上均一致提升 top-k 重建，且同时体现在 SMILES 和 scaffold 两个层级。
Conclusion: 摘要认为在光谱歧义条件下校准候选集合是提升红外光谱分子重建的实用途径，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO): A Sampling-Time Low-Rank Scaffold for Recovering Reinforcement-Learning Gradient on Zero-Reward Cliff Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) for mathematical reasoning suffers from a structural blind spot: on "cliff" prompts-those on which every sampled rollout in a group fails-the group-normalized advantage is identically zero, so GRPO produces no gradient on precisely the prompts at the frontier of the model's capability. We introduce LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO), a sampling-time mechanism that recovers this lost gradient. Each RL step, LSPO detects cliff prompts, fits a small low-rank (LoRA) adapter by a brief supervised step on their ground-truth solutions, re-rolls the cliffs with the base-plus-adapter model, splices the now-successful completions back into the RL batch with an importance-sampling correction, and takes a GRPO step on the base alone; the adapter receives only the supervised gradient and is discarded at checkpoint, yielding a base-only model. On DeepMath-103K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, evaluated over n=5 paired seeds per arm at a matched 1000-step reporting horizon, LSPO's 5-seed mean matches or beats a DAPO baseline on all 16 (benchmark, pass@k) cells (15 strict wins and one exact tie), with gains of up to +10.7 points on AIME24/pass@4, +6.7 points on AIME24 and AIME26 at pass@16, and +2.4 points on MATH500/pass@1; averaged over the 16 cells the improvement is +3.8 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO)，针对 RLVR 数学推理中‘悬崖提示’（cliff prompts，即一组采样全部失败的提示）上 group-normalized advantage 恒为零、GRPO 不产生梯度的问题，在采样时用 LoRA 适配器恢复丢失的梯度。LSPO 在每步 RL 中检测悬崖提示，对其真实解做短暂监督拟合一个小型 LoRA 适配器，用 base+adapter 重采样悬崖，将成功完成以重要性采样校正拼回 RL batch，再仅对 base 做 GRPO 更新，适配器在 checkpoint 时丢弃。在 DeepMath-103K 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 上，5 种子均值在 16 个 (benchmark, pass@k) 单元中全部持平或超过 DAPO 基线（15 胜 1 平），平均提升 +3.8 点。
Motivation: RLVR 在数学推理中有一个结构性盲点：当某个提示的所有采样 rollout 都失败时，group-normalized advantage 恒为零，GRPO 恰好在该模型能力前沿的提示上不产生任何梯度，导致学习停滞。
Method: LSPO 是采样时机制：每步 RL 检测悬崖提示，用其 ground-truth 解做短暂监督步骤拟合小规模 LoRA 适配器，以 base-plus-adapter 模型重新采样悬崖提示，将成功完成通过重要性采样校正拼接回 RL batch，然后仅对 base 模型执行 GRPO 步骤；适配器只接收监督梯度并在 checkpoint 时被丢弃，最终只保留 base-only 模型。
Result: 在 DeepMath-103K 上以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 为基座，n=5 配对种子、匹配 1000 步报告窗口下，LSPO 的 5 种子均值在全部 16 个 (benchmark, pass@k) 单元中匹配或超过 DAPO 基线（15 个严格胜出、1 个平局），其中 AIME24/pass@4 提升高达 +10.7 点，AIME24 与 AIME26 在 pass@16 上各 +6.7 点，MATH500/pass@1 上 +2.4 点，16 个单元平均 +3.8 点。
Conclusion: LSPO 通过在采样时引入低秩 LoRA 脚手架并在 checkpoint 丢弃适配器，能恢复悬崖提示上丢失的 RL 梯度，显著改善数学推理 RLVR 训练，且最终模型仍为 base-only 结构。

papers.title: Reasoning Consensus: Structural Ensembling of LLM Reasoning via Weighted DAG Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) explore problems through chain-of-thought, but this exploration is buried in unstructured prose. On high-stakes tasks, users cannot tell which steps are well-supported, which alternatives were seriously considered, or how the final conclusion compares to those the model discarded. We propose a framework that ensembles the reasoning structure, not just the answers, of multiple LLMs by weighted merging of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) extracted from reasoning chains. We weight each step by how many traces independently attest to it, to return "Consensus Reasoning". Across six benchmarks spanning statutory interpretation, graduate-level science, narrative multi-hop reasoning, and first-order logic, our ensemble outperforms a matched-budget majority-vote baseline, with a maximum accuracy gain of 3.1% on MuSR-MM (narrative multi-hop reasoning). On a single model, the framework matches or exceeds self-consistency at the same trace budget while additionally exposing an inspectable consensus reasoning graph. Ensemble weights correlate with LLM-judge rankings of reasoning quality at Spearman $ρ= 0.30$-$0.51$, and consensus subgraphs are preferred over alternatives leading to the majority-vote answer in 54.4-65.4% of head-to-head comparisons across five of six datasets. We observe that our framework can also be used to analyze diverse reasoning perspectives for a problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种对多个 LLM 的推理结构（而非仅答案）进行集成的框架：先从推理链中提取有向无环图（DAG），再按每个步骤被多少条独立轨迹支持来加权合并，得到“Consensus Reasoning”共识推理图。在六个基准（涵盖法规解释、研究生级科学、叙事多跳推理和一阶逻辑）上，该集成超越了同等预算的多数投票基线，在 MuSR-MM 上最大准确率提升 3.1%；在单模型设置下，相同轨迹预算内达到或超过 self-consistency，同时提供可检查的共识推理图。
Motivation: LLM 通过 chain-of-thought 探索问题，但这种探索被埋没在非结构化的自然语言文本中；在高风险任务上，用户无法判断哪些步骤有充分支持、哪些备选方案被认真考虑过，以及最终结论与模型放弃的结论相比如何。
Method: 从多个 LLM 的推理链中提取 DAG，依据每条步骤被多少独立推理轨迹共同证实的程度赋予权重，并通过加权合并这些 DAG 来集成推理结构，输出“Consensus Reasoning”图；该框架也可用于分析同一问题的多样化推理视角。
Result: 在六个基准上，该方法优于匹配预算的多数投票基线，最大准确率提升为 MuSR-MM 上的 3.1%；在单模型上，相同轨迹预算下达到或超过 self-consistency。集成权重与 LLM 裁判对推理质量的排序相关（Spearman ρ = 0.30–0.51），且在六个数据集中的五个上，共识子图在 54.4%–65.4% 的成对比较中被偏好于通向多数投票答案的替代路径。
Conclusion: 框架通过可检查的共识推理图暴露推理过程，同时保持或提升准确率，并可用于分析问题的多样化推理视角。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RedFlow: Redirect Failure into Action-Level Corrections for Flow-matching VLA Policy
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation but often suffer from compounding errors caused by distribution shifts during deployment. While offline reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical way to improve deployed policies using rollout data, existing methods either ignore failure data or exploit it only at the trajectory level, resulting in low learning efficiency and persistent errors. We propose **RedFlow**, a fine-grained offline RL framework that redirects failure experiences into action-level corrective supervision for flow-matching VLA policies. RedFlow consists of two key components: (1) a **Context-Aware Corrective Matching** mechanism that identifies failure-inducing actions and retrieves successful alternatives from similar contexts as corrective targets, and (2) an **Adaptive Redirection Objective** that jointly reinforces successful actions, suppresses undesirable ones, and redirects recoverable failures toward corrective targets. By converting both successful and failed experiences into dense supervision, RedFlow enables robust recovery learning from mixed-quality data. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and three real-world manipulation tasks show that RedFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art offline RL baselines, improving the real-world success rate from 56.7% to 74.7%. It also matches strong on-policy methods (PPO, GRPO, and DDPO) while requiring roughly an order of magnitude fewer training samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RedFlow，一个针对 flow-matching 视觉-语言-动作策略的细粒度离线强化学习框架，通过将失败经验转化为动作级别的纠正监督来缓解部署时的分布漂移与复合误差。RedFlow 包含情境感知纠正匹配机制和自适应重定向目标，在 LIBERO 基准和三个真实机器人操作任务上优于 SOTA 离线 RL 基线，并将真实世界成功率从 56.7% 提升到 74.7%，同时以约一个数量级更少的训练样本匹敌强在线方法。
Motivation: Flow-matching VLA 策略在真实部署中常因分布漂移产生复合错误；现有离线 RL 方法要么忽略失败数据，要么仅在轨迹层面利用失败，导致学习效率低且错误持续存在。
Method: RedFlow 提出两个关键组件：(1) Context-Aware Corrective Matching 识别导致失败的动作，并从相似上下文中检索成功动作作为纠正目标；(2) Adaptive Redirection Objective 联合强化成功动作、抑制不良动作并将可恢复失败重定向到纠正目标，从而将成功与失败经验都转化为密集监督信号。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准和三个真实世界操作任务上，RedFlow 一致优于现有离线 RL 基线，将真实世界成功率从 56.7% 提高到 74.7%；同时以约一个数量级更少的训练样本达到与强在线方法（PPO、GRPO、DDPO）相当的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将失败经验转化为动作级纠正监督，可以使 flow-matching VLA 策略在混合质量数据下实现稳健的恢复学习。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Neural Network Approximation of Solutions to Fractional Parabolic Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We establish a dimension-efficient neural network approximation theory for solutions to fractional parabolic equations with lower-order drift and potential terms. By introducing anisotropic spectral Barron spaces, which measure temporal and spatial regularity separately in frequency space, we first develop a dimension-independent maximal regularity theory for these equations, using dimension-independent multiplication estimates and the method of continuity to incorporate the lower-order terms. A key technical novelty is the application of the Vandermonde matrix to the global-in-time extension of the finite-time fractional heat semigroup with sufficient regularity at the initial time, thereby enabling analysis of the forward-in-time evolution via the global space-time Fourier structure of anisotropic Barron norms. We also show that a corresponding uniform-in-time estimate of the spectral Barron regularity generally fails. Finally, we derive $n^{-1/2}$ two-layer approximation bounds in mixed Sobolev norms for non-constant periodic activations and, under additional anisotropic Barron regularity, for non-periodic activations satisfying a polynomial-decay condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为带低阶漂移项和势项的分数阶抛物方程建立维数高效的神经网络逼近理论。作者引入各向异性谱 Barron 空间 (anisotropic spectral Barron spaces)，分别在频域度量时间和空间正则性，并借助维数无关的乘法估计与连续性方法发展维数无关的最大正则性理论。技术新颖点是使用 Vandermonde 矩阵对具有足够初始正则性的有限时间分数阶热半群做全局时间延拓，从而利用各向异性 Barron 范数的全局时空 Fourier 结构分析前向演化。
Motivation: 分数阶抛物方程解的高效神经网络表示缺乏系统性理论，尤其是存在低阶漂移项和势项时，如何在谱 Barron 框架下获得维数无关的正则性与逼近误差估计尚未解决。
Method: 提出各向异性谱 Barron 空间，将时间和空间正则性分开度量；利用维数无关乘法估计和连续性方法处理低阶项；并将 Vandermonde 矩阵应用于分数阶热半群的全局时间延拓，以分析前向时间演化。随后据此推导两层神经网络的逼近界。
Result: 得到混合 Sobolev 范数下 $n^{-1/2}$ 的两层逼近界：对非恒定周期激活函数成立，并在额外各向异性 Barron 正则性假设下对满足多项式衰减条件的非周期激活函数也成立；同时证明谱 Barron 正则性的均匀时间估计一般会失败。
Conclusion: 摘要表明维数高效的逼近理论在分数阶抛物方程上可行，但谱 Barron 正则性无法获得均匀时间控制，这一失败构成方法的适用范围限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CXR-Retrieve: Compositional Text-to-Image Retrieval in Chest Radiography
papers.abstract_en: Large chest radiography archives are difficult to search because most studies are paired only with free-text reports rather than structured clinical annotations. Vision-language models offer a natural interface for text-to-image retrieval, but current biomedical models are primarily optimized for report-to-image matching rather than for satisfying short clinical search queries. This creates an objective mismatch: a model may retrieve images related to words in the query while failing to satisfy the full clinical constraint, especially for conjunctions and negations such as ``atelectasis and no pneumonia.'' We introduce CXR-Retrieve, a structured benchmark for compositional chest X-ray text-to-image retrieval. The benchmark contains 5,159 test images from the official test-split of MIMIC-CXR-JPG and 145 textual queries spanning single and conjunction findings, both positive and negative. Relevance is defined by whether a retrieved image satisfies all asserted pathology constraints, rather than by whether it matches a paired report. We further propose a label-aware contrastive fine-tuning objective for clinical retrieval. Our method attracts image-text pairs with compatible asserted pathology constraints, including shared confirmed absences, while explicitly repelling contradictory pairs. Starting from the in-domain CXR-CLIP checkpoint, our method improves Precision@5 over CXR-CLIP by 8.5 percentage points on two-pathology conjunctions and by 22.0 percentage points on negation queries. These results show that reliable chest X-ray retrieval requires training objectives that model not only which findings are mentioned, but also how they are clinically asserted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CXR-Retrieve，一个面向胸部 X 光影像的组合式文本-图像检索基准，并配套提出一种标签感知的对比微调目标。基准基于 MIMIC-CXR-JPG 官方测试集，包含 5,159 张图像和 145 条文本查询，覆盖单征象与双征象、阳性与阴性表述；相关性定义为图像是否满足所有断言的病理约束，而非是否匹配配对报告。从领域内 CXR-CLIP 检查点出发，该方法在双病理合取查询上提升 Precision@5 达 8.5 个百分点，在否定查询上提升 22.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 大型胸部 X 光档案难以检索，因为多数检查只有自由文本报告而非结构化标注；现有生物医学视觉语言模型主要针对报告-图像匹配优化，难以满足短小临床查询，尤其在合取与否定（如“肺不张且无肺炎”）条件下存在目标失配。
Method: 构建 CXR-Retrieve 基准，并设计标签感知对比学习 (label-aware contrastive learning) 微调目标：吸引病理约束相容的图像-文本对（包括共同确认的缺席），同时显式排斥矛盾对。
Result: 从 CXR-CLIP 检查点出发，该方法在双病理合取查询上比 CXR-CLIP 提升 Precision@5 达 8.5 个百分点，在否定查询上提升 22.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 可靠的胸部 X 光检索需要训练目标不仅能建模提到了哪些发现，还要能建模这些发现是如何被临床断言（肯定或否定）的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RIPPLE: Generating Multi-Channel Phase, Not Recovering It
papers.abstract_en: Generative models synthesize magnitude spectra with high fidelity, while phase is delegated to a recovery module---Griffin--Lim, a vocoder, or a latent decoder---applied independently to each channel. For multi-channel waveforms this delegation is costly: the physical content of spatial audio and three-component seismograms lives in the phase relationships between channels, precisely what channel-independent recovery cannot produce. The cost is also invisible, since the magnitude-based metrics common to both fields barely move when inter-channel phase coherence collapses---so a pipeline can discard the physical information in its output while still scoring well. We argue that phase should be generated, not recovered, and present RIPPLE (Rectified Inter-channel Phase with Prior-based LEarning), which reinterprets Griffin--Lim as a phase **prior** rather than a final estimator: initialized from the source phase, this prior carries the inter-channel structure to be preserved, and a rectified flow refines it toward the target under an explicit inter-channel phase loss. Tested on first-order ambisonics environment transfer and seismic cross-station translation---two physically unrelated domains---RIPPLE outperforms recovery-based pipelines on the coherence metrics that downstream analyses consume. The seismic case is decisive: across architecturally distinct generators, per-channel recovery leaves S-wave polarization error near the $57.3^\circ$ random expectation, whereas learned phase reduces it to $33.8^\circ$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成模型把相位交给逐通道独立恢复模块（如 Griffin–Lim、声码器或潜解码器）的问题，提出 RIPPLE（Rectified Inter-channel Phase with Prior-based LEarning），将 Griffin–Lim 重新解释为携带通道间结构的相位先验，并用整流流（rectified flow）在显式通道间相位损失下细化生成相位。在一阶环境声（first-order ambisonics）环境传输与地震跨台站翻译两个物理无关领域上，RIPPLE 在相干性指标上优于基于恢复的流水线；地震案例中，学习的相位将 S 波偏振误差从接近 57.3° 随机期望降至 33.8°。
Motivation: 多通道波形（空间音频、三分量地震图）的物理内容在于通道间相位关系，而逐通道独立的相位恢复无法产生这种关系；同时，两领域常用的幅度指标对通道间相位相干性几乎不敏感，导致流水线即使丢弃物理信息仍能获得高分。
Method: 提出 RIPPLE，将 Griffin–Lim 从最终相位估计器重新解释为相位先验：以源相位初始化以保留待传递的通道间结构，再通过整流流在显式设计的通道间相位损失下将先验细化到目标。
Result: 在一阶环境声环境传输和地震跨台站翻译两个领域上，RIPPLE 在下游分析所消费的相干性指标上优于基于恢复的流水线。地震实验中，跨不同架构生成器，逐通道恢复使 S 波偏振误差接近 57.3° 的随机期望，而学习的相位将其降至 33.8°。
Conclusion: 作者主张相位应当被生成而非恢复，并通过两个物理无关领域的验证说明通道间相位建模可以显著改善下游物理相干性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the Best Teacher: Expanding and Compressing the Reasoning Solution Manifold
papers.abstract_en: A single reinforcement-learning run can produce a strong reasoner yet an incomplete teacher: it often amplifies only a subset of the valid solution modes. We argue that reinforcement learning (RL)-trained policies should therefore be viewed as local probes of a multi-basin reasoning solution manifold, rather than as globally reliable supervisors. Based on this view, we propose an expand-then-compress framework that couples teacher construction with multi-teacher policy distillation. In the expansion stage, Residual Group Relative Policy Optimization (RGRPO) trains a sequence of teachers from a common initialization and redirects each later round toward examples not yet covered by the accumulated teacher union. In the compression stage, reliability-gated Teacher-Union On-policy Distillation (TU-OPD) lets the student learn from its own response prefixes. For each example, only reliable teachers contribute, and their sampled-token OPD losses are weighted by their per-example quality. We further introduce Consensus-Residual Decomposition, which preserves a winner teacher's excess token preferences over its reliable peers, preventing specialist behavior from being suppressed during teacher aggregation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following show that the resulting Qwen3-1.7B student consistently outperforms the strongest individual teacher across all three domains, yielding relative improvements of 2.0%, 8.3%, and 6.9%, respectively, while retaining single-model inference. These results establish a simple but powerful principle: stronger students can be obtained not by selecting a single better teacher, but by deliberately constructing and compressing a complementary teacher union.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将强化学习训练的推理策略视为多盆地推理解流形（reasoning solution manifold）的局部探针，而非全局可靠的监督者，并据此提出 expand-then-compress 框架：先用 Residual Group Relative Policy Optimization (RGRPO) 从同一初始化训练一组教师并将后续轮次导向未覆盖样本，再用 reliability-gated Teacher-Union On-policy Distillation (TU-OPD) 让学生从自身响应前缀学习，仅让可靠教师按每示例质量加权贡献采样 token 的 OPD 损失。实验表明 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随上分别相对提升 2.0%、8.3%、6.9%，同时保持单模型推理。
Motivation: 单一强化学习运行可能产生强推理器但作为教师不完整，往往只放大有效解模式中的一部分；因此需要把 RL 策略看作对多盆地解流形的局部探测，而不是可全局依赖的监督来源。
Method: 提出 expand-then-compress 框架，把教师构建与多教师策略蒸馏耦合起来。扩展阶段用 RGRPO 从共同初始化训练教师序列，并让每一轮转向教师并集尚未覆盖的示例；压缩阶段用 reliability-gated TU-OPD，学生从自身响应前缀学习，每个示例仅由可靠教师贡献，其采样 token OPD 损失按每示例质量加权。还引入 Consensus-Residual Decomposition，保留赢家教师相对其可靠同行的超额 token 偏好，避免教师聚合时抑制专家化行为。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随三个领域中，Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型始终优于最强的单个教师，相对提升分别为 2.0%、8.3%、6.9%，并且保持单模型推理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，要获得更强的学生，不应依赖挑选单个更好的教师，而应刻意构造并压缩互补的教师并集（complementary teacher union）。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: VocalRender: Score-Native Singing Voice Synthesis for Real-World Composition
papers.abstract_en: Existing singing voice synthesis systems often require predefined durations, explicit duration prediction, or time-aligned acoustic guidance, which limits their compatibility with practical composition workflows. We propose VocalRender, a score-native system that directly synthesizes singing from lyrics, pitches, symbolic note values, and tempo. It uses an interleaved lyric--note representation and an autoregressive diffusion model to generate continuous acoustic latents while predicting the output length, eliminating the need for explicit duration prediction. Trained on a 2,300-hour singing dataset, VocalRender achieves strong intelligibility, strong melody control, and high speaker similarity across both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks. Notably, it outperforms the strongest baseline by $0.42$ points in naturalness CMOS, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed score-native architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VocalRender，一个面向真实作曲流程的 score-native 歌唱语音合成系统，直接从歌词、音高、符号音符值与 tempo 合成歌声，无需预定义时长或显式时长预测。系统采用交错歌词-音符表示和自回归扩散模型，在生成连续声学隐变量的同时预测输出长度。在 2,300 小时歌唱数据集上训练后，VocalRender 在域内与域外基准上均表现出强可懂度、强旋律控制和高说话人相似度，并在自然度 CMOS 上超过最强基线 0.42 分。
Motivation: 现有歌唱语音合成系统通常需要预定义时长、显式时长预测或时间对齐的声学引导，这与实际作曲工作流的兼容性受限。
Method: 提出 score-native 架构，使用交错的歌词-音符表示并由自回归扩散模型直接生成连续声学隐变量，同时预测输出长度，从而消除对显式时长预测模块的依赖。
Result: 在 2,300 小时歌唱数据集上训练，VocalRender 在域内和域外基准上实现强可懂度、旋律控制与说话人相似度，并在自然度 CMOS 上比最强基线高 0.42 分。
Conclusion: 作者强调 score-native 架构的有效性，证明无需显式时长预测即可从乐谱信息直接合成高质量歌声。

papers.title: Train Small, Deploy Large: Zero-Shot GNN Transfer Through Geometric Renormalization
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can operate on large graphs but become infrastructure-sensitive at the scale of millions of nodes and typically require scalable training techniques for even larger graphs. This raises a central question: when can a model trained on a smaller, scaled-down replica of a graph be deployed on the full-resolution graph without retraining? We introduce a zero-shot transfer protocol in which a GNN is trained on a graph coarse-grained by geometric renormalization (GR), and the resulting weights are transferred directly to the original network. Across synthetic and real-world networks, training on GR scaled-down replicas preserves much of the original-scale predictive performance while significantly reducing training cost. We further find that learned representations and predictive trajectories remain aligned across scales. These findings suggest that structural similarity may be more important than network size in determining GNN transferability, opening a path toward scale-equivariant graph architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本迁移协议：先在经几何重整化 (geometric renormalization, GR) 粗粒化的小规模图副本上训练 GNN，再将权重直接迁移到原始全分辨率图上，无需重新训练。在合成网络和真实网络上，这种训练方式在显著降低训练成本的同时保留了大部分原始尺度下的预测性能，且学习到的表征和预测轨迹在不同尺度间保持对齐。作者认为结构相似性可能比网络规模更能决定 GNN 的可迁移性。
Motivation: GNN 虽能处理大规模图，但在百万节点尺度下对基础设施敏感，通常需要可扩展的训练技术。论文关注的核心问题是：何时可以将在小规模缩放副本上训练的模型直接部署到全分辨率图上而无需重训。
Method: 引入零样本迁移协议，即用几何重整化对图进行粗粒化得到缩小副本，在该副本上训练 GNN，然后将训练得到的权重直接迁移到原始网络上进行部署。
Result: 在合成网络和真实网络上的实验显示，基于 GR 缩小副本的训练能保留大部分原始尺度的预测性能，同时显著降低训练成本；此外，不同尺度间学习到的表征与预测轨迹保持对齐。
Conclusion: 这些发现表明在决定 GNN 可迁移性时，结构相似性可能比网络规模更重要，为构建尺度等变 (scale-equivariant) 的图架构开辟了路径。

papers.title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects complementary encoder layers, constructs an output-derived conditioning space from candidate memory, and aligns candidate input representations to this space through closed-form ridge regression. Low-rank factorization then produces a compact retrieval basis where candidate outputs are used only during offline index construction, whereas query-time retrieval requires only the query input and precomputed index. We show that CoRA's rank-constrained basis is the optimal low-rank compression of the output-conditioned fitted representation, and derive an exact two-pass streaming construction that avoids materializing the full fitted matrix. We further extend the framework to multimodal exemplar retrieval by incorporating visual representations into the conditioning and retrieval spaces. Experiments across ten textual datasets and four multimodal benchmarks with Llama-3.2-1B, MobileLLM-Pro, OpenFlamingo-3B, and Qwen3.5-2B, as well as end-to-end Raspberry Pi~5 deployment demonstrate that CoRA supports effective task-conditioned retrieval without retriever fine-tuning, backpropagation, or target-model calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoRA (Conditional Retrieval Alignment)，一个无需梯度的框架，将冻结编码器转换为任务条件化的检索器，用于设备端 (on-device) 上下文学习 (in-context learning, ICL)。CoRA 通过闭式岭回归 (ridge regression) 将候选输入表示对齐到由候选输出推导出的条件空间，并用低秩分解得到紧凑检索基；候选输出只在离线构建索引时使用，查询时只需输入和预计算索引。实验覆盖十个文本数据集和四个多模态基准，并部署到 Raspberry Pi 5，表明无需微调检索器、反向传播或目标模型调用即可实现有效的任务条件化检索。
Motivation: 设备端 ICL 需要在下游模型推理前从本地记忆中检索演示样本 (demonstrations)，但检索必须利用任务特定信息，同时受限于有限的计算、内存和数据暴露预算。现有方法难以在如此受限条件下实现任务条件化的检索。
Method: 提出 CoRA：从冻结编码器中选取互补层，用候选输出构建输出导出的条件空间，通过闭式岭回归将候选输入表示对齐到该空间；再通过低秩分解生成紧凑检索基。作者还推导了精确的两遍流式 (two-pass streaming) 构建过程以避免显式构造完整拟合矩阵，并将框架扩展到多模态示例检索，把视觉表示纳入条件与检索空间。
Result: 在 Llama-3.2-1B、MobileLLM-Pro、OpenFlamingo-3B 和 Qwen3.5-2B 上，跨越十个文本数据集与四个多模态基准的实验，以及 Raspberry Pi 5 的端到端部署，表明 CoRA 能支持有效的任务条件化检索，且无需检索器微调、反向传播或目标模型调用。
Conclusion: CoRA 表明通过闭式对齐与低秩压缩，可以在不更新检索器参数的情况下获得任务条件化的检索能力；作者强调其秩约束基是输出条件化拟合表示的最优低秩压缩，并可用流式方式高效构建。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Private Face Recognition Training Dataset Publication via Identity-Decoupled and Geometry-Preserving Face Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Publishing private face recognition~(FR) training datasets is privacy-sensitive because faces expose identity information. Private FR training dataset publication mitigates this risk by releasing protected proxies as substitutes for private training faces. However, training FR models with such data introduces an identity paradox: \emph{the identity cues that make released faces useful for recognition supervision are also the cues that make them linkable to real individuals.} A protected face should be decoupled from the original identity, yet still behave as a reliable identity sample for training. Removing these cues too aggressively may destroy the class structure needed for recognition learning, whereas preserving them too faithfully may increase source-identity linkability. We argue that this paradox stems from conflating source-aligned identity semantics with recognition-useful proxy identity geometry. The former should be suppressed to reduce linkage to private individuals, while the latter should be preserved for FR learning. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{Private Face Distillation}, an identity-decoupling and geometry-preserving framework. It uses Orthogonal Geometry Preservation to construct decoupled proxy identities from private identity representations while maintaining hyperspherical geometry, and Relational Topology Alignment to preserve identity relations for recognition learning. Experiments across multiple domain-shifted FR scenarios show that Private Face Distillation achieves stronger utility than the evaluated publication baselines. On IJB-C surveillance, it improves $\mathrm{TAR}@\mathrm{FAR}{=}1\text{e-}{3}$ by 3.94\% over the baseline while reducing source-identity linkability. These results suggest that private FR training dataset publication should decouple source-identity correspondence while preserving proxy identity geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对私有人脸识别（FR）训练数据集发布中的隐私问题，提出受保护代理（protected proxy）数据，并指出其中的身份悖论：用于识别监督的身份线索同时也是将人脸关联回真实个体的线索。作者提出 Private Face Distillation 框架，通过正交几何保持（Orthogonal Geometry Preservation）构造解耦的代理身份并维持超球面几何，用关系拓扑对齐（Relational Topology Alignment）保留识别学习所需的身份关系。跨多个域偏移 FR 场景的实验表明该方法优于所评估的发布基线，在 IJB-C surveillance 上使 TAR@FAR=1e-3 相对基线提升 3.94%，同时降低源身份可链接性。
Motivation: 发布私有 FR 训练数据会暴露身份信息，现有受保护代理方法面临身份悖论：过度去除身份线索会破坏识别学习所需的类结构，过度保留则会增加与真实个体的可链接性。作者认为该悖论源于混淆了源对齐身份语义与对识别有用的代理身份几何。
Method: 提出 Private Face Distillation 框架，包含两个组件：Orthogonal Geometry Preservation 从私有身份表示中构造解耦的代理身份并保持超球面几何；Relational Topology Alignment 用于保留身份之间的拓扑关系以支持识别学习。
Result: 在多个域偏移 FR 场景下，该方法相较所评估的发布基线取得更强效用；在 IJB-C surveillance 上 TAR@FAR=1e-3 提升 3.94%，同时降低源身份可链接性。
Conclusion: 作者认为私有 FR 训练数据集发布应当解耦源身份对应关系，同时保留代理身份几何结构，以实现隐私与识别效用的权衡。

papers.title: DS@GT ARC at ImageCLEFmedical 2026: Architectural Diversity for Concept Detection and Foundation-Model Scaling for Caption Prediction in Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We describe the DS@GT submissions to the ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 challenge, which continues a long-running benchmark on the ROCOv2 dataset with two tracks: Concept Detection (Task 1), assigning UMLS Concept Unique Identifiers (CUIs) to radiology images, and Caption Prediction (Task 2), generating natural-language captions. For Task 1, our primary submission was a three-way late-fusion ensemble of ConvNeXt-V2, BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16, and DenseNet-169 with a regularized ''Honest Threshold Tuning'' procedure designed to avoid validation overfitting on rare concepts; this submission ranked first on the official submission with a primary $F_1$ of $0.5790$ and a secondary $F_1$ of $0.9657$. In parallel, we submitted a training-free KNN retrieval pipeline over frozen BiomedCLIP embeddings, which reached a primary $F_1$ of $0.5780$ and a secondary $F_1$ of $0.9599$-essentially matching the fine-tuned ensemble on the primary track at a fraction of the cost. For Task 2, our submissions included a fine-tuned Gemma-3 27B model (overall $0.3571$, ranking third in the official submission), a fully fine-tuned BLIP pipeline with custom Vizwins merging ($0.3564$), and a zero-shot MedGemma-4B run with a PubMed-style prompt ($0.3186$), spanning a wide range of model scales and training costs. Code: https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-caption-2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 DS@GT 团队在 ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 挑战赛（基于 ROCOv2 数据集）中的提交方案，涵盖概念检测（Task 1，为放射影像分配 UMLS 概念唯一标识符）和描述生成（Task 2，生成自然语言影像描述）两个任务。Task 1 的主提交是 ConvNeXt-V2、BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16 与 DenseNet-169 的三路晚期融合集成，配合带正则化的 Honest Threshold Tuning 流程，在官方提交中以主 F1 0.5790、次 F1 0.9657 排名第一；并行的免训练 KNN 检索流程在冻结 BiomedCLIP 嵌入上取得主 F1 0.5780、次 F1 0.9599，几乎以极低成本追平微调集成。Task 2 提交包括微调的 Gemma-3 27B（总体 0.3571，官方排名第三）、带定制 Vizwins 合并的全微调 BLIP 流程（0.3564）以及使用 PubMed 风格提示的零样本 MedGemma-4B（0.3186）。
Motivation: 该工作针对 ImageCLEFmedical 2026 挑战赛的两个任务：放射影像的概念检测与描述生成，目标是设计在罕见概念上避免验证集过拟合、同时兼顾性能与计算成本的解决方案。
Method: Task 1 采用三种不同架构（ConvNeXt-V2、BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16、DenseNet-169）的三路晚期融合集成，并提出正则化的 Honest Threshold Tuning 流程；同时设计了基于冻结 BiomedCLIP 嵌入的免训练 KNN 检索管道。Task 2 覆盖不同规模与成本：微调 Gemma-3 27B、带自定义 Vizwins 合并的全微调 BLIP 流程，以及带 PubMed 风格提示的零样本 MedGemma-4B。
Result: Task 1 官方提交排名第一，主 F1 为 0.5790、次 F1 为 0.9657；免训练 KNN 检索取得主 F1 0.5780、次 F1 0.9599，在主导指标上几乎与微调集成持平。Task 2 中 Gemma-3 27B 以 0.3571 排名第三，BLIP 流程为 0.3564，零样本 MedGemma-4B 为 0.3186。
Conclusion: 作者强调架构多样性与基础模型扩展相结合的有效性，并指出免训练的嵌入检索在远低于微调成本下可接近集成性能；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DAS-PMVC: A Framework for Partial Multi-View Clustering via Dual Alignment and Structure Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, multi-view clustering has attracted widespread research interest. However, due to limitations in data collection devices, data across different views often suffer from misalignment, leading to the partial view alignment problem (PVAP). To mitigate the impact of view asymmetry and irrelevant samples, this paper proposes a framework for partial multi-view clustering via dual alignment and structure enhancement (DAS-PMVC), which leverages view structure consistency and semantic relevance. Specifically, DAS-PMVC includes three parts: \textbf{anchor graph structure alignment}, where sample joint embedding representations with consistent latent space are derived from anchor point relationships for initial view alignment; \textbf{structure-enhanced feature learning}, where the model learns view structure information through pretraining and combines multi-view graph convolutional networks to further extract deep latent features from the aligned graph structure to improve the discriminative power of representations; and \textbf{a dual alignment strategy}, where initial alignment is performed through the anchor graph in the pretraining phase, and contrastive learning loss and the Hungarian algorithm are introduced in the training phase to further optimize the alignment of latent features. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that the DAS-PMVC framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in clustering performance, showcasing its effectiveness and superiority.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAS-PMVC，一个面向部分多视图聚类 (partial multi-view clustering) 的框架，用于缓解跨视图样本不对齐造成的 partial view alignment problem (PVAP)。框架由锚点图结构对齐、结构增强的特征学习以及双对齐策略三部分组成，在预训练阶段用锚点图做初步对齐，在训练阶段引入对比学习损失和匈牙利算法进一步优化潜在特征对齐。摘要称在多个数据集上的聚类性能优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 多视图聚类中，数据采集设备限制常导致不同视图间样本不对齐，产生 partial view alignment problem；视图不对称和无关样本会损害聚类性能，现有方法对这一问题处理不足。
Method: 提出 DAS-PMVC，包含三个部分：锚点图结构对齐 (anchor graph structure alignment)，从锚点关系得到一致潜在空间下的样本联合嵌入用于初始视图对齐；结构增强特征学习，通过预训练学习视图结构信息并结合多视图图卷积网络从对齐图结构中提取深层潜在特征以增强判别力；双对齐策略，预训练阶段用锚点图做初步对齐，训练阶段引入对比学习损失和匈牙利算法进一步优化潜在特征对齐。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上的实验表明，DAS-PMVC 在聚类性能上优于现有最先进方法，说明其有效性和优越性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用视图结构一致性和语义相关性可以缓解视图不对称与无关样本的影响，从而提升部分多视图聚类性能；但未给出具体数据集的量化结果或局限性讨论。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Hierarchical Latent Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for recommendation by leveraging their semantic understanding and contextual modeling capabilities. Recent studies further introduce reasoning mechanisms to improve user preference modeling. However, explicit natural-language reasoning incurs substantial inference overhead, whereas existing latent reasoning methods mainly focus on generating or verifying intermediate states, leaving their layer-wise preference roles and contributions insufficiently characterized. We propose HiLaR, a Hierarchical Latent Reasoning framework with layer-aware reinforcement optimization for LLM-based recommendation. HiLaR constructs temporal-guided hierarchical user preference representations, aligns them with multiple LLM latent reasoning states, and organizes the reasoning process from broad preferences to fine-grained current intents. To further optimize the reasoning trajectory, HiLaR combines final recommendation feedback with layer-aware process rewards derived from the marginal target-likelihood gain of each state. Experiments on four Amazon benchmark datasets show that HiLaR generally outperforms strong sequential, generative, and LLM-based recommendation baselines. Ablation and sensitivity analyses further verify the contribution of hierarchical representation learning, latent alignment, and process-level optimization. Our code is available in https://github.com/hupeiyu21/HiLaR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiLaR，一个用于基于 LLM 的推荐的层次化潜在推理框架（Hierarchical Latent Reasoning framework）。HiLaR 构建时间引导的层次用户偏好表示，将其与多个 LLM 潜在推理状态对齐，并把推理过程组织为从广泛偏好到细粒度当前意图；同时结合最终推荐反馈和基于每层边际目标似然增益的逐层过程奖励进行强化优化。在四个 Amazon 基准数据集上，HiLaR 通常优于强顺序、生成式及基于 LLM 的推荐基线。
Motivation: 显式自然语言推理会带来大量推理开销，而现有潜在推理方法主要聚焦于生成或验证中间状态，对逐层偏好所扮演的角色及其贡献刻画不足。
Method: HiLaR 设计时间引导的层次用户偏好表示，并与多个 LLM 潜在推理状态对齐；推理轨迹从广泛偏好推进到细粒度当前意图。为了优化轨迹，HiLaR 将最终推荐反馈与由每个状态边际目标似然增益导出的逐层过程奖励相结合。
Result: 在四个 Amazon 基准数据集上的实验表明，HiLaR 通常优于强顺序、生成式和基于 LLM 的推荐基线；消融与敏感性分析进一步验证了层次表示学习、潜在对齐和过程级优化的贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调层次化潜在推理与过程级奖励可改善 LLM 推荐的用户偏好建模，并指出代码已开源。该工作属于推荐系统领域，与天气预报类关键词没有直接关联。

papers.title: EgoGVAE: Ego-body Mesh Reconstruction via Guided Variational Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of recovering the full-body mesh from only the head pose. This task has become essential for various applications based on head-mounted devices or smart glasses. The challenge of this task lies in estimating the pose information of unobserved body parts based solely on a single joint (i.e., head) trajectory. Several studies have begun to adopt head-conditioned generative models, however, such previous methods are costly and time-consuming due to the diffusion-based iterative process. As an alternative, we propose a simple yet novel method that leverages the latent space of the guidance network, which is designed as a variational autoencoder taking full-body poses as inputs. By enforcing latent distributions of this guidance network and our head-to-motion network to be similar, latent features sampled from the 'guided' distribution, i.e., distribution learned in our head-to-motion network, can be reliably decoded for natural representations of full-body poses even only with the head pose. One important advantage of the proposed method is that one-step sampling scheme achieves remarkably fast inference (more than 50 times faster) compared to diffusion-based approaches. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that the proposed method efficiently improves the performance of ego-body mesh reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoGVAE，一种仅利用头部姿态恢复全身网格 (ego-body mesh) 的方法。作者用变分自编码器作为引导网络，通过约束引导网络与头部到运动网络 (head-to-motion network) 的潜变量分布一致，实现仅凭单关节轨迹的全身姿态解码，并采用单步采样以替代扩散模型的迭代过程。实验表明该方法在基准数据集上改善了 ego-body 网格重建性能，且推理速度比扩散方法快 50 倍以上。
Motivation: 从头部姿态恢复全身网格是头戴设备或智能眼镜应用的关键任务，难点在于仅凭单一关节轨迹估计未观测身体部位的姿态。现有基于扩散模型的方法虽已尝试，但迭代推理过程成本高、耗时长。
Method: 设计一个以全身姿态为输入的变分自编码器作为引导网络 (guidance network)，并让头部到运动网络学习与其相似的潜变量分布；推理时从该'引导'分布采样潜变量并解码出自然的全身姿态，采用单步采样方案。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在基准数据集上有效提升 ego-body 网格重建性能，同时单步采样使推理速度比扩散式方法快 50 倍以上。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用引导网络潜空间并约束分布相似性，可以在保持高质量全身姿态重建的同时显著加速推理，是一种比扩散方法更高效的单步生成方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
papers.abstract_en: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. Yet existing methods for articulated object reconstruction require explicitly observable motion from multiple articulation states. We introduce a rest-state formulation that reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration, an inherently ill-posed setting where geometry, semantics, and motion priors compensate for the absence of motion cues. Our framework adopts an explicit mesh as an intermediate representation for cross-model verification and fusion, reconciling noisy outputs from vision-language and segmentation models into spatially consistent part structures. To estimate joint parameters without observed motion, we use a video diffusion model to synthesize articulation hypotheses and validate them through geometric consistency. Our approach achieves accurate part decomposition and physically plausible articulation, performing competitively with motion-observing reconstruction-based, generation-based, and modular pretrained-model baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从静止状态 (rest state) 重建可活动物体 (articulated object) 的框架，仅用单个闭合配置的观测即可恢复 3D 几何与运动学结构。该方法以显式网格作为中间表示，融合视觉-语言模型与分割模型的噪杂输出，并通过视频扩散模型合成运动假设、以几何一致性验证关节参数。摘要报告其在部件分解与物理解释性上表现准确，并与需要多状态运动观测的重建式、生成式及模块化预训练基线具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有可活动物体重建方法依赖从多个运动状态中显式观测运动信息，这限制了数字孪生等应用中交互式模型构建的适用场景。
Method: 提出 rest-state 公式化，在无运动线索的欠定条件下同时利用几何、语义与运动先验；采用显式网格作为中间表示进行跨模型验证与融合，以得到空间一致的部件结构；并借助视频扩散模型合成关节运动假设，再通过几何一致性进行校验。
Result: 摘要表明该方法能实现准确的部件分解和物理上合理的关节运动，性能与基于运动观测的重建基线、生成式基线和模块化预训练模型基线相当。
Conclusion: 该工作的核心结论是：即使没有显式可观测的多状态运动，利用先验与扩散模型合成假设也能可靠估计关节参数并重建可活动物体。

papers.title: A Structured Knowledge Infrastructure for Domain-Specific Data Asset Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise data analytics agents face two structural failures: generic RAG retrieves the wrong asset (Hit@10=19.1%) and delivers no usage knowledge to prevent metric misinterpretation---stemming from four root causes (C1--C4) ranging from semantic gap and entity ambiguity to schema drift and asset-usage gap. We present a two-layer solution deployed in the commercial advertising data warehouse at Xiaohongshu (5,300+ Hive tables, 14 domains). A three-tier dual-purpose knowledge base (179 documents, eight-section annotation template) serves both retrieval and generation, with a closed-loop refresh pipeline maintaining day-level freshness (one yes/no approval, 30s hot-reload). The Graph-Guided Retriever (GGR) uses a 2,859-node knowledge graph as a candidate gate with intent routing to deliver 71.6x token reduction. The Scene-Aware Ranker (SAR) applies 19-class entity recognition and explicit scenario annotations; negative knowledge alone contributes 25 percentage points of Hit@10 gain. On two 100-question benchmarks, Hit@10 rises from 19.1% to 96.6% (+77.5pp) and knowledge coverage from 56% to 77%, at 4.84--5.33s end-to-end latency.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to DAI 2026 Industry Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向企业数据资产发现场景，提出一套两层知识基础设施，并部署在小红书商业广告数据仓库（5,300+ Hive 表、14 个域）。方案由一个三层的双用途知识库（179 篇文档、八段标注模板）与 Graph-Guided Retriever (GGR)、Scene-Aware Ranker (SAR) 组成，将两个 100 题基准上的 Hit@10 从 19.1% 提升到 96.6%，知识覆盖率从 56% 提升到 77%，端到端延迟 4.84–5.33 秒。
Motivation: 企业数据分析代理存在两类结构性失败：通用 RAG 检索到错误资产，且缺乏使用知识，导致指标被误读；作者将其归纳为语义鸿沟、实体歧义、schema 漂移与资产使用鸿沟四类根因（C1–C4）。
Method: 提出双用途三层知识库同时服务检索与生成，并配以闭环刷新管线（日级新鲜度、一次 yes/no 审批、30 秒热加载）；GGR 用 2,859 节点知识图作为候选门控并做意图路由，SAR 采用 19 类实体识别和显式场景标注，其中负向知识单独贡献了 25 个百分点的 Hit@10 提升。
Result: 在两个 100 问题基准上，Hit@10 从 19.1% 升至 96.6%（+77.5pp），知识覆盖率从 56% 升至 77%，同时实现 71.6 倍的 token 压缩和 4.84–5.33 秒的端到端延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在真实商业数仓中，结合知识图引导与会话场景感知的受控知识基础设施能同时改善检索准确率与知识覆盖，缓解通用 RAG 的资产误取和使用知识缺失问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Visual illusions are phenomena in which the human visual system misinterprets objective signals, resulting in an understanding that deviates from reality. We constructed IllusionReasoning, a benchmark of illusion images collected from the real world, incorporating diverse annotated question-answer pairs. Based on IllusionReasoning, we show that the reasoning capabilities of a wide range of LVLMs are not as advanced as claimed. Our work provides new insights into LVLMs and offers future direction for optimisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用视觉错觉（visual illusions）作为诊断工具，联合评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的感知与推理能力，并构建了来自真实世界的错觉图像基准 IllusionReasoning。基于该基准的实验表明，多种 LVLMs 的推理能力并未达到其宣称的水平。
Motivation: 现有 LVLM 评测要么仅关注感知，要么依赖数学或编程等特定领域，缺乏与开放世界环境一致并同时考虑感知与推理的评测。
Method: 构建 IllusionReasoning 基准，收集真实世界中的错觉图像，并配以多样化的标注问答对（question-answer pairs），利用视觉错觉来诊断模型的感知与推理能力。
Result: 基于 IllusionReasoning 的评估显示，一系列 LVLMs 的推理能力并不如宣称的那样先进。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解 LVLMs 提供新见解，并为后续优化方向提供参考。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ROCS: Request-Oriented Compute Sharing for Efficient Large-Scale Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommendation models gain prediction quality by scaling feature-interaction and sequence modules, but production cost constraints cap how far systems can scale. In this work, we propose Request-Oriented Compute Sharing (ROCS), a modeling and inference paradigm that exploits a unique property of recommendation inference: each user request is evaluated against many candidates, while request-side features are shared across candidates. ROCS defers request-candidate interactions as late as possible, isolates candidate-dependent representations, and evaluates substantial portions of the model once per request rather than once per candidate, significantly improving inference efficiency while maintaining or improving prediction quality. To realize this paradigm, we develop Generalized Layer Masking (GLM) to enforce candidate isolation in feature-interaction architectures, and Deep Cross Attention (DCA) to extend request-oriented sharing to sequence architectures. To support efficient GPU deployment, we co-design In-Kernel Broadcast Optimization (IKBO) that significantly accelerates ROCS model execution. Experiments on public benchmarks show that ROCS consistently improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff across recommendation backbones. On production-scale workloads, ROCS achieves up to a 3x QPS improvement on retrieval models without quality degradation and a 0.5% relative LogLoss improvement with a 50% QPS gain on a short-form video ranking model. ROCS has been deployed across large-scale recommendation systems spanning ads and organic surfaces, retrieval and ranking stages, and more than two orders of magnitude in inference complexity, delivering significant online gains at reduced infrastructure cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向请求的计算共享范式 ROCS (Request-Oriented Compute Sharing)，利用推荐推理中一个用户请求对应多个候选、且请求侧特征在候选间共享的特性，尽量延迟请求-候选交互并隔离候选相关表示，使模型大部分计算按请求执行一次而非按候选重复执行，以提升推理效率并保持或改善预测质量。为实现该范式，作者提出 Generalized Layer Masking (GLM) 用于特征交互架构中的候选隔离，以及 Deep Cross Attention (DCA) 将请求侧共享扩展到序列架构，并设计了 In-Kernel Broadcast Optimization (IKBO) 以加速 GPU 部署。实验显示 ROCS 在公开基准上改进多种推荐骨干的质量-效率权衡，并在生产规模工作负载上取得显著 QPS 与质量收益。
Motivation: 现代推荐模型通过扩展特征交互和序列模块提升预测质量，但生产成本约束限制了可扩展程度；而推荐推理中请求侧特征天然在多个候选间共享，现有按候选逐一计算的范式浪费了这一共享机会。
Method: 提出 ROCS 范式，将请求-候选交互尽可能推迟，隔离候选相关表示，使模型大部分计算按请求执行一次；并配套三种技术：GLM 在特征交互架构中强制候选隔离、DCA 将请求侧共享扩展到序列架构、IKBO 通过 GPU 内核协同设计加速执行。
Result: 在公开基准上，ROCS 一致改善各推荐骨干的质量-效率权衡；生产规模下，检索模型获得最高 3 倍 QPS 提升且无质量下降，短视频排序模型以 50% QPS 提升换来 0.5% 相对 LogLoss 改善。
Conclusion: 作者报告 ROCS 已部署于覆盖广告与自然内容、检索与排序阶段、推理复杂度横跨两个数量级以上的大规模推荐系统，在降低基础设施成本的同时带来显著在线收益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Three-Photon Bayesian Imaging of Ortho-Positronium
papers.abstract_en: PET provides functional images relying on two-photon coincidences from positron-electron annihilation. In human tissue, about 40\% of annihilations are preceded by Ps formation, of which o-Ps component partially decays into three photons, with the remainder annihilating via pick-off or spin-exchange into two photons. This three-photon channel carries additional information about the surrounding micro-environment, including the three-to-two-photon yield ratio as a potential diagnostic marker. We propose the TRIO algorithm, a novel three-photon event-by-event image reconstruction algorithm formulated as a Bayesian maximum a posteriori inference problem. TRIO unifies time-based trilateration, energy-based reconstruction and, for the first time, a physics-informed prior derived from the QED description of Ps decay within a single probabilistic framework. In contrast to positronium lifetime imaging, which requires a prompt photon and is therefore restricted to specific radionuclides, TRIO relies solely on the three photons and is fully compatible with standard radionuclides such as 18F. Monte Carlo simulation modelled after the Siemens Biograph Quadra scanner demonstrates a mean position error of 1.62~cm, improving by approximately a factor of two over the time-based trilateration (3.05 cm) and by about an order of magnitude over energy-based reconstruction alone (18 cm). More importantly, the proposed Bayesian approach is compatible with existing TOF-PET scanners that can register three-photon annihilation coincidences.

TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIO 算法，一种针对正电子湮灭中三光子事例的逐事件图像重建方法，将基于时间的三边测量 (time-based trilateration)、基于能量的重建，以及首次引入的由 Ps 衰变 QED 描述导出的物理先验，统一到贝叶斯最大后验 (MAP) 推理框架中。基于 Siemens Biograph Quadra 扫描仪的蒙特卡罗模拟显示，其平均位置误差为 1.62 cm，比纯时间三边测量 (3.05 cm) 提升约两倍，比纯能量重建 (18 cm) 提升约一个数量级。该方法仅依赖三个光子，与 18F 等标准放射性核素以及能够记录三光子湮灭符合的现有 TOF-PET 扫描仪兼容。
Motivation: 人体组织中约 40% 的湮灭事件前会形成正电子素 (Ps)，其中 o-Ps 分量部分衰变为三光子，这一通道携带周围微环境信息，三光子与双光子产额比可能成为诊断标志物。然而现有的正电子素寿命成像需要瞬发光子，仅限于特定放射性核素，因此需要一种仅依赖三个光子、兼容标准核素的图像重建方法。

Result: 以 Siemens Biograph Quadra 为模型的蒙特卡罗模拟表明，TRIO 的平均位置误差为 1.62 cm，相比纯时间三边测量的 3.05 cm 改善约两倍，相比纯能量重建的 18 cm 改善约一个数量级。
