papers.title: Improving the Robustness/Accuracy Tradeoff Against Adversarial Attacks Using Information Bottleneck Distillation Through Dual Teachers
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in classical machine learning problems. However, they are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Countermeasures proposed in the literature, notably Information Bottleneck Distillation (IBD) introduced by Kuang et al., degrade the classification accuracy on clean inputs while improving the robustness to adversarial inputs. In this work, we extend the IBD framework by introducing an extra teacher model (clean teacher) trained with only clean inputs, into the distillation process from a robust teacher model trained by adversarial training. The features of both clean and robust teachers are transferred to the student through a cross-layer attention matrix. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets show that the proposed method improves classification accuracy on clean samples compared to the original IBD, while maintaining similar accuracy on adversarial samples. Furthermore, our methods are competitive with state-of-the-art approaches, including the recent dual-teacher distillation framework B-MTARD, particularly in terms of the harmonic mean between clean and robust accuracy. We also analyze the impact of different training settings that have different influences on the attention module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对信息瓶颈蒸馏（Information Bottleneck Distillation, IBD）在提升对抗鲁棒性时牺牲干净样本精度的问题，提出在鲁棒教师之外引入一个仅用干净样本训练的干净教师，构成双教师蒸馏框架。两个教师的特征通过跨层注意力矩阵（cross-layer attention matrix）传递给学生模型。在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上的实验表明，相比原始 IBD，该方法提高了干净样本上的分类精度，同时保持相似的对抗样本精度，并与包括近期双教师蒸馏框架 B-MTARD 在内的最先进方法相当。
Motivation: 现有对抗防御方法如 IBD 虽然能改善对对抗样本的鲁棒性，但会显著降低干净输入上的分类精度，鲁棒性与精度之间存在权衡问题。
Method: 在原始 IBD 的蒸馏过程中引入一个额外教师（干净教师），该教师仅在干净输入上训练；学生模型通过跨层注意力矩阵同时从干净教师和鲁棒教师获取特征。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 数据集上，该方法相比原始 IBD 提升了干净样本的分类精度，同时对抗样本上的精度基本不变；在干净精度与鲁棒精度的调和平均（harmonic mean）方面与最先进方法包括 B-MTARD 具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双教师蒸馏可以改善鲁棒性-精度权衡，并指出不同训练设置对注意力模块有不同影响，作者对此进行了分析。

papers.title: VeriSkill: A Self-Evolution Framework for Program Verification Skills
papers.abstract_en: Automating program verification with LLM agents requires generating specifications, annotations, auxiliary lemmas, and tool invocations, all of which depend on reusable skills. A natural remedy is skill self-evolution: distilling skills from trajectories and refining them through feedback. However, existing evolution methods struggle with program verification tasks because they cannot reliably identify skill-specific failures or extract actionable signals from opaque verifier feedback. In this paper, we propose VeriSkill, a self-evolution framework built for program verification. It attributes verification failures to skill deficiencies, distills diagnostic signatures into reusable lessons, and iteratively refines candidate skills, admitting only revisions that improve verification performance while preserving program semantics. Experiments show that VeriSkill consistently outperforms all baselines across multiple verification tools, agent frameworks, and LLM backends.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VeriSkill，一个面向程序验证的自进化框架，用于让 LLM agent 自动生成规范、注解、辅助引理并调用验证工具。该框架把验证失败归因到技能缺陷，将诊断信号蒸馏为可复用经验，并迭代精炼候选技能，只接受能提升验证性能且保持程序语义的修订。实验表明它在多种验证工具、agent 框架和 LLM 后端上均优于所有基线。
Motivation: 现有技能自进化方法难以应用于程序验证，因为它们无法可靠地识别由特定技能缺陷导致的失败，也难以从模糊的验证器反馈中提取可操作的改进信号。
Method: VeriSkill 通过归因机制将验证失败联系到具体技能缺陷，把诊断性签名蒸馏为可复用的技能经验，并在迭代中只采纳那些既提高验证性能又保持程序语义不变的技能修订。
Result: 摘要报告 VeriSkill 在多个验证工具、agent 框架和 LLM 后端的组合下一致优于所有基线，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该框架表明，针对验证器反馈不透明的问题，通过技能缺陷归因和语义保持的迭代精炼可以显著提升程序验证自动化水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards joint scaling laws with optimal batch size schedules
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning typically keeps the batch size static throughout training, thus overlooking the joint effect of learning rate and batch size on the training dynamics. In this paper, we study the deep learning dynamics through the lens of convex optimization and derive a joint characterization of loss in terms of both schedules, applicable to general optimizers and model architectures. This characterization yields a closed-form optimal batch size schedule for any prescribed learning rate schedule, and further leads to joint scaling laws that consistently outperform static batch size baselines, highlighting the significance of dynamic batch size schedule in large language model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从凸优化的视角研究深度学习训练动态，将损失表征为学习率调度与批大小调度的联合函数，并据此推导出任意学习率调度下的闭式最优批大小调度。摘要称该联合缩放律 (joint scaling laws) 一致优于静态批大小的基线，强调了动态批大小调度在大语言模型训练中的重要性。
Motivation: 现代深度学习通常在整个训练过程中保持批大小不变，忽略了学习率与批大小对训练动态的联合影响。
Method: 通过凸优化框架对训练动态建模，推导出损失关于学习率调度和批大小调度的联合刻画，该刻画适用于一般优化器和模型架构，并由此得到闭式的最优批大小调度。
Result: 摘要报告所提出的联合缩放律在训练中一致优于静态批大小基线，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调动态批大小调度在大语言模型训练中具有重要意义，联合考虑学习率与批大小的调度可提升训练效率。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PrintAnything: Learning an Intermediate Representation for 3D printing G-code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Point clouds are one of the most fundamental and widely used 3D representations, serving as the most basic geometric representation of 3D shapes. Nevertheless, most existing 3D printing pipelines require a watertight mesh as input, preventing the direct use of point clouds for fabrication. A common workaround is to reconstruct meshes from point clouds; however, the resulting meshes often contain geometric artifacts, such as incorrect faces or topological inconsistencies, that are difficult to repair and may lead to printing failures. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrintAnything, a novel framework that learns to produce executable 3D printing G-code directly from 3D point clouds without requiring mesh reconstruction. To enable point clouds to serve as direct input for slice-wise toolpath generation, we introduce a slice-wise point projection strategy that transforms unstructured 3D point clouds into slice-aligned 2D representations consistent with layer-by-layer nature of fused deposition modeling in 3D printing. To eliminate mesh dependency and provide a unified representation that bridges point clouds and G-code, we propose Geometric plan (G-plan) map, a compact 2D representation composed of occupancy, region, and flow maps that encode the geometric and extrusion properties required for toolpath synthesis in 3D printing. As a result, our proposed method accurately generates printable G-code directly from point clouds, enabling a practical and fully mesh-free pipeline for 3D printing. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything}{https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrintAnything 提出一种直接从 3D 点云生成可执行 3D 打印 G-code 的框架，绕过了传统管线中必需的 watertight mesh 重建步骤。作者引入 slice-wise 点投影策略，将无序点云转换为与逐层打印过程对齐的 2D 表示，并提出 Geometric plan (G-plan) map 作为连接点云与 G-code 的紧凑中间表示。摘要报告该方法能够直接从点云生成可打印的 G-code，实现完全无网格 (mesh-free) 的打印流程。
Motivation: 点云是最基础的 3D 几何表示，但现有 3D 打印流程通常要求输入 watertight mesh，无法直接使用点云制造。常见的从点云重建网格的方法会产生面片错误或拓扑不一致等几何伪影，难以修复并可能导致打印失败。
Method: 提出 PrintAnything 框架，学习直接从点云预测 G-code；通过 slice-wise 点投影策略将点云变换为切片对齐的 2D 表示，并设计由 occupancy、region 和 flow 图组成的 G-plan map，统一编码打印所需的几何与挤出属性，从而替代网格作为中间表示。
Result: 摘要未提供量化实验数据，仅说明该方法能准确直接从点云生成可打印的 G-code，并实现实用的全 mesh-free 3D 打印管线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架消除了对网格重建的依赖，为点云到 G-code 提供了统一表示，代码已公开。

papers.title: Baikal: Structured Search for Deep Research over Data Lakes
papers.abstract_en: Deep research over data lakes requires an LLM agent to investigate evidence across thousands of heterogeneous tables and passages to synthesize a report. Existing methods perform iterative retrieval and generation, letting accumulated context determine what to investigate next, which can overexploit locally promising evidence and fail to cover distinct semantic regions under a fixed budget. To address this, we cast deep research over data lakes as a budgeted search problem and present Baikal - a framework that clusters heterogeneous evidence into semantic regions, then searches over them adaptively to balance exploration and exploitation. Within each selected region, Baikal generates and investigates region-grounded subquestions, using finding quality as rewards to update region-level value estimates and guide search under policies ranging from random and LLM-guided selection to Bayesian $ε$-greedy and UCB. We evaluate Baikal on 15 queries each over HybridQA and TAT-QA data lakes containing 10,993 and 2,757 tables, respectively, together with 227K Wikipedia passages and 13K financial report passages. We assess research quality with a new rubric covering groundedness, relevance, diversity, and utility, and use GPT-5-mini to score Baikal and strong baselines, including DeepSearcher and an OpenCode research agent with retrieval and clustering variants. Across both data lakes, Baikal performs strongly under several region-selection policies; its best configuration improves report scores over the strongest baselines by 28% on HybridQA and 36% on TAT-QA. Our analyses attribute these gains to organizing and exploring semantic evidence regions, which improves groundedness and diversity and yields more useful findings under the same subquestion budget. These results demonstrate the value of structured semantic exploration for systematic research and discovery over heterogeneous data lakes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Baikal，一个将数据湖上的深度研究 (deep research) 建模为预算受限搜索问题的框架。Baikal 先把异构证据聚类成语义区域，再对这些区域进行自适应搜索以平衡探索与利用，并在选中的区域内生成基于区域 (region-grounded) 的子问题来逐步收集发现。在 HybridQA 和 TAT-QA 两个数据湖上的实验表明，其最佳配置相比最强基线将报告得分分别提升 28% 和 36%。
Motivation: 现有方法采用迭代检索与生成，让累积上下文决定下一步调查内容，容易过度利用局部有希望的证据，并在固定预算下无法覆盖不同的语义区域。作者希望解决这种覆盖不足的问题，使 LLM agent 能在包含数千张异构表格和大量段落的数据湖中更系统地进行研究。
Method: 将深度研究形式化为预算受限搜索，先对异构证据进行聚类以形成语义区域，然后自适应选择区域并搜索。在选中区域内生成并调查基于区域的子问题，用发现质量作为奖励来更新区域层面的价值估计，搜索策略涵盖随机选择、LLM 引导选择、贝叶斯 ε-greedy 和 UCB。
Result: 在 15 个查询上评估，数据湖包含 HybridQA 的 10,993 张表、TAT-QA 的 2,757 张表，以及 227K 条 Wikipedia 段落和 13K 条财务报告段落；使用覆盖 groundedness、relevance、diversity 和 utility 的新评分标准，由 GPT-5-mini 对 Baikal 与 DeepSearcher 等基线打分。最佳配置在 HybridQA 上比最强基线提升 28%，在 TAT-QA 上提升 36%。
Conclusion: 作者将收益归因于对语义证据区域的组织与探索，这提升了 groundedness 和 diversity，并在相同子问题预算下产生更有用的发现，展示了结构化语义探索在异构数据湖系统研究中的价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Error Analysis of Neural-Network-Based Engression
papers.abstract_en: Engression (Shen and Meinshausen, 2024) learns a conditional distribution by fitting a generative model $Y = f(X,\varepsilon)$ under the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule. We provide a theoretical error analysis of engression implemented with deep neural networks. We decompose the excess risk into three components: the approximation error, the stochastic error, and the Monte Carlo error. Based on this decomposition, we establish convergence rates under the assumption that the target conditional generator admits a compositional smoothness structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基于深度神经网络的 engression 方法（Shen and Meinshausen, 2024）给出理论误差分析。作者将超额风险分解为逼近误差、随机误差和 Monte Carlo 误差三部分，并在目标条件生成器具有组合光滑性结构的假设下建立收敛速率。内容为纯理论分析，未涉及具体实验数值。
Motivation: Engression 通过能量分数 (energy score) 拟合条件生成模型，但其基于深度神经网络的实现缺乏系统性的误差理论刻画。
Method: 将 engression 的超额风险分解为逼近误差 (approximation error)、随机误差 (stochastic error) 和 Monte Carlo 误差三部分，并基于组合光滑性 (compositional smoothness) 结构假设推导收敛速率。
Result: 在目标条件生成器满足组合光滑性结构的条件下，建立了相应的收敛速率。
Conclusion: 该分解框架为神经网络的 engression 提供了理论支撑，但其结论依赖于组合光滑性等假设。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: New Synchronous Computation Dynamics for Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract_en: The dynamics of the original Hopfield network is asynchronous (sequential) (updates the state of only one neuron per time step). In this paper, we propose a new tool and a new dynamics to reduce the processing time by updating one or more neurons simultaneously per instant while ensuring process convergence and aiming for the maximum energy decrease at each step, thus guaranteeing the shortest total processing time. From the point of view of synchronous dynamics, calculating the next network state at which energy decreases the most from the current state while ensuring convergence is itself a combinatorial optimization problem. We develop and use a new tool to solve it. We call this new tool Discrete Differential Filter (DDF) and, based upon it, we develop a new synchronous dynamics which we call SD-DDF (Synchronous Dynamics based upon Discrete Differential Filter). In this paper, we review the original asynchronous dynamics for Hopfield networks and present a new tool and a new synchronous dynamics with its theoretical justification and four computational experiments to assess the speed up in processing time empirically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对原始 Hopfield 网络逐时间步只更新一个神经元的异步（sequential）动力学处理时间较慢的问题，提出一种新的同步动力学 SD-DDF（Synchronous Dynamics based upon Discrete Differential Filter）。作者开发了称为离散差分滤波器（Discrete Differential Filter, DDF）的新工具，用于在保证收敛的前提下计算每一步使能量下降最大的下一网络状态，从而缩短总处理时间。文中给出了理论依据，并通过四项计算实验经验地评估了处理时间的加速效果。
Motivation: 原始 Hopfield 网络的异步更新每次只改变一个神经元的状态，导致处理时间较长；作者希望在不牺牲收敛保证的前提下，通过一次更新一个或多个神经元来降低总处理时间。
Method: 将每一步中从当前状态出发、在保证收敛的同时使能量下降最大的下一状态计算视为一个组合优化问题，并据此提出新工具 Discrete Differential Filter (DDF) 来求解；基于该工具设计了同步动力学 SD-DDF，每次可同时更新一个或多个神经元。
Result: 摘要报告开展了四项计算实验来经验评估处理时间加速，但未在摘要中给出具体加速数值或对比基准。
Conclusion: 作者回顾了 Hopfield 网络的原始异步动力学，提出 DDF 工具与 SD-DDF 同步动力学，并给出理论正当性；实验显示该方法在处理时间上有加速，但摘要未说明其适用范围或局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VESTIGE: A Knowledge-Guided Masking Strategy for Corruption-Aware Fine-Tuning of Genomic Transformers, Validated on Ancient DNA Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Standard masked-language-model fine-tuning applies a uniform masking probability across every token position, assuming reconstruction difficulty is position-agnostic. When the degradation process is characterised and concentrated at predictable positions, this assumption fails: at peak damage sites the model can underperform a frequency-matched random predictor. We introduce VESTIGE, a parameter-free, drop-in replacement for the standard MLM collator that aligns the masking distribution with an empirically measured per-position corruption profile. We apply it to ancient DNA (aDNA) reconstruction, where cytosine deamination produces a position-dependent C-to-T / G-to-A gradient quantified per-position by mapDamage2. Rescaling so the mean C/G masking rate equals 15% - identical to standard MLM - isolates spatial redistribution as the sole variable, with model, data, seed, and hyperparameters held fixed across both DNABERT-2 runs on a mammoth CDS corpus (two specimens, seven genes). Across six terminal-zone widths and 626 paired windows, VESTIGE leads standard MLM at every width (Delta = +4.18 to +10.35 pp, all p < 10^-8), cuts validation cross-entropy by 13% (3.274 vs. 3.757), and yields ESMFold reconstructions with TM-score > 0.95 across all six reconstructions (three genes) even under damage amplified 10-30x beyond authentic PMD rates. A 1D CNN biosecurity classifier returns AUC = 0.935 and clears 98.2% of reconstructed windows, the 1.76% remainder attributable to reference-genome features, not reconstruction artefacts. The principle is domain-agnostic: any measurable position- or context-specific corruption profile - FFPE, bisulfite, metagenomic, or nanopore - substitutes directly for the PMD array, making VESTIGE a knowledge-guided training routine for intelligent systems operating on degraded or noisy sequence inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VESTIGE，一种无需参数、可直接替换标准 MLM collator 的掩码策略，将掩码分布与按位置经验测得的损伤分布对齐，并应用于古 DNA (aDNA) 重建。作者用 DNABERT-2 在猛犸象 CDS 语料（两个标本、七个基因）上对比 VESTIGE 与标准 MLM，在全部六种末端区域宽度、626 对窗口上 VESTIGE 均更优（Delta = +4.18 到 +10.35 pp，p < 10^-8），验证集交叉熵下降 13%，且在损伤放大 10-30 倍时仍得到 TM-score > 0.95 的 ESMFold 重建结构。摘要强调该原则与领域无关，任何可测量的位置或上下文相关损伤分布都可替换 PMD 数组。
Motivation: 标准掩码语言模型微调对所有 token 位置使用均匀掩码概率，假设重建难度与位置无关；当降解过程集中且可预测时，该假设失效，峰值损伤位点的模型表现甚至不如与频率匹配的随机预测器。
Method: VESTIGE 是一种参数无关的即插即用掩码策略，它根据 mapDamage2 经验测量的每位置脱氨基损伤剖面（PMD）调整掩码分布；通过将平均 C/G 掩码率重标定到与标准 MLM 相同的 15%，使空间重分布成为唯一变量，模型、数据、随机种子与超参数在两组 DNABERT-2 运行中保持固定。
Result: 在 626 对窗口上，VESTIGE 在所有六种末端区域宽度下均优于标准 MLM（增益 +4.18 到 +10.35 个百分点，p < 10^-8）；验证集交叉熵从 3.757 降至 3.274（降低约 13%）；在损伤被放大到真实 PMD 率 10-30 倍时，三个基因的六种重建均取得 ESMFold TM-score > 0.95；1D CNN 生物安全分类器 AUC = 0.935，放行 98.2% 的重建窗口，其余 1.76% 归因于参考基因组特征而非重建伪影。
Conclusion: 作者认为该原理可推广到任何可测量的位置或上下文特定损伤剖面，例如 FFPE、亚硫酸氢盐、宏基因组或纳米孔数据，从而成为面向退化或噪声序列输入的智能系统的知识引导训练方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NMINE: Normalized Mutual Information Neural Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Mutual information is a general measure of statistical dependence that captures both linear and nonlinear relationships between random variables. For continuous and multidimensional variables For continuous multidimensional variables, mutual information must be estimated from samples. Because mutual information is unbounded, its values are not directly comparable across datasets, dimensions, or applications. Normalized mutual information addresses this limitation by converting mutual information into a normalized dependency score. Recent work has demonstrated the practical value of normalized mutual information in applications such as molecular dynamics {arXiv:2405.04980} and interpretable machine learning {arXiv:2409.16768}, but existing estimators remain sensitive to dimensionality and numerical stability {arXiv:2410.07642}. In this paper, we propose a fully neural normalized mutual information estimator for continuous variables. The proposed approach combines a MINE-based neural mutual information estimator {arXiv:1801.04062} with MI-NEE-inspired neural marginal entropy estimators {arXiv:1905.12957}. Mutual information is estimated using the Donsker--Varadhan representation, while marginal entropies are estimated by learning the divergence between each marginal distribution and a uniform reference distribution, from which entropy is recovered. The resulting estimator provides a neural alternative to k-nearest-neighbor-based normalized mutual information estimation {arXiv:2405.04980}. Experiments on Gaussian data from one to eight dimensions show that the proposed estimator improves accuracy over a KSG-based normalized mutual information baseline. These results indicate that neural estimation is a promising direction for normalized dependency measurement in continuous multidimensional settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向连续变量的全神经网络归一化互信息估计器 (normalized mutual information, NMI)。该方法结合基于 MINE 的神经互信息估计与受 MI-NEE 启发的神经边际熵估计：互信息通过 Donsker–Varadhan 表示估计，边际熵通过学习各边际分布与均匀参考分布之间的散度再恢复。在 1 到 8 维高斯数据上的实验显示，其估计精度优于基于 KSG 的归一化互信息基线。
Motivation: 互信息无上界，数值难以跨数据集、维度或应用直接比较；归一化互信息虽解决这一问题，但现有估计器对维度和数值稳定性敏感，缺少适合连续多维变量的稳定神经估计方案。
Method: 结合两条神经估计路线：用基于 MINE 的神经估计器配合 Donsker–Varadhan 表示估计互信息，另用受 MI-NEE 启发的神经估计器学习每个边际分布与均匀参考分布之间的散度，从而恢复边际熵并完成归一化。
Result: 在 1 维到 8 维高斯数据上的实验表明，所提估计器相比基于 KSG 的归一化互信息基线获得更优的估计精度。
Conclusion: 摘要将神经估计视为连续多维场景下归一化依赖度量的有前景方向，并以高斯数据实验作为初步验证。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.result: 在 1 维到 8 维高斯数据上的实验表明，所提估计器相比基于 KSG 的归一化互信息基线获得更优的估计精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要将神经估计视为连续多维场景下归一化依赖度量的有前景方向，并以高斯数据实验作为初步验证。

papers.title: MECA: A Mechanism-Centered Agent for Constructing Well-Specified and Valuable Mathematical Conjectures
papers.abstract_en: Automatically constructing well-specified and valuable mathematical conjectures remains a central challenge in AI-assisted mathematical discovery. Many existing open problems and conjectures are often too broad, underspecified, or difficult to connect to plausible proof or refutation strategies. We view a mathematical mechanism as a structure or reasoning principle that connects the assumptions of a candidate problem to its target conclusion, such as an inequality, invariant, decomposition, or reduction to an intermediate claim. We present MECA (MEchanism-centered Conjecture Agent), a multi-agent framework that constructs conjectures by jointly developing candidate statements and their supporting mechanisms. Explorer agents propose mechanisms, test how they apply, and revise the candidate conjecture accordingly, while critic agents assess their mathematical validity and research value. Their feedback guides changes to the assumptions, scope, and conclusion. Through this process, MECA transforms broad research directions into precise conjectures with substantive mathematical support while retaining a clearly identified unresolved core. We evaluate MECA in two complementary settings. First, we compare it with a generate-and-revise baseline on reconstructing preselected target-paper conclusions from target-conditioned but article-blind source materials. Second, we construct 100 semi-open problems from literature-derived seeds and existing open problems and evaluate them through independent proof and refutation attempts by automated provers. Our results indicate that mechanism-centered refinement produces well-specified and research-worthy conjectures that remain challenging for current automated provers.
papers.comment: 78 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and the full collection of 100 generated conjectures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MECA（MEchanism-centered Conjecture Agent），一个以数学机制为中心的多智能体框架，用于自动构造有明确定义且有研究价值的数学猜想。Explorer 智能体提出并测试支撑机制，critic 智能体评估其数学有效性与研究价值，两者协同迭代修改猜想的假设、范围与结论。摘要报告 MECA 在两类评估中优于 generate-and-revise 基线，并生成了 100 个对现有自动证明器仍具挑战性的半开放问题。
Motivation: 自动构造有明确定义且有价值的数学猜想仍是 AI 辅助数学发现的核心难题；现有开放问题与猜想往往过于宽泛、欠精确，或难以连接到可行的证明/反驳策略。
Method: 提出多智能体框架 MECA，将数学机制视为连接假设与结论的结构或推理原则（如不等式、不变量、分解或归约为中间命题）；Explorer 智能体提出机制、检验其适用性并据此修订候选猜想，critic 智能体评估其数学有效性与研究价值，反馈驱动对假设、范围与结论的调整。
Result: 在两项互补评估中：一是从目标条件化但文章盲化的源材料重建预设目标论文结论，与 generate-and-revise 基线比较；二是从文献种子和现有开放问题构造 100 个半开放问题，并通过自动证明器进行独立证明与反驳尝试。结果显示机制中心化精炼能产生定义良好且具研究价值的猜想，且对当前自动证明器仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 摘要强调机制中心化的精炼过程可将宽泛研究方向转化为具有实质数学支撑、同时保留明确未解决核心的精确猜想；该工作的范围限定在数学猜想构造与自动证明器评估，未涉及对证明策略本身的改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Albilich: Steerable Proof-State Orchestration for LLM-Based Mathematical Research with CAS Integration
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can contribute useful ideas to mathematical research, yet long-horizon proof attempts remain difficult to coordinate, evaluate, and reproduce. We present Albilich, an open-source agentic harness for autoresearch in mathematics that combines long-horizon reasoning, computer algebra systems (CAS), literature retrieval, and persistent SQLite-based context management. We evaluate Albilich on the RealMath benchmark (Zhang et al. 2025) and on open problems in group theory from the Kourovka Notebook (Khukhro and Mazurov 2026). It solved 10/10 problems on RealMath with CAS and 9/10 with no CAS. On the Kourovka problems, Albilich produced a counterexample to Problem 21.142 and a proof of a strengthening of Problem20.2. Anablation on Problem 17.91 demonstrates 32.0% token reduction when CAS is enabled. An ablation on Problem 21.142 demonstrates higher verifier-rejection rate and failure to synthesize proof routes in the absence of the advisor agent. These results support Albilich as a human-steerable, CAS-boosted environment for scalable AI-assisted mathematical research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Albilich，一个面向数学自动研究 (autoresearch) 的开源智能体框架，将长程推理、计算机代数系统 (CAS)、文献检索与基于 SQLite 的持久化上下文管理相结合。在 RealMath benchmark 上，CAS 模式下解决 10/10 问题、无 CAS 时解决 9/10；在 Kourovka Notebook 的群论开放问题上，它为 Problem 21.142 构造出反例，并为 Problem 20.2 的加强命题给出证明。消融实验显示 CAS 可降低 token 消耗，且缺少 advisor agent 时证明路线合成失败。
Motivation: LLM 能为数学研究提供有用想法，但长程证明尝试难以协调、评估和复现，缺少一个可引导且稳定的自动化研究环境。
Method: 提出 Albilich 智能体框架，统一整合长程推理、CAS、文献检索和 SQLite 持久化上下文管理，并采用 advisor agent 等组件来支持人工引导 (human-steerable) 的证明状态编排。
Result: RealMath 基准上 CAS 模式解决 10/10、无 CAS 解决 9/10；Kourovka Notebook 中生成 Problem 21.142 的反例和 Problem 20.2 加强形式的证明。消融显示 Problem 17.91 开启 CAS 后 token 减少 32.0%，Problem 21.142 在缺少 advisor agent 时验证器拒绝率更高且无法合成证明路线。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Albilich 提供了一种可人工引导、CAS 增强的数学自动研究环境，可用于可扩展的 AI 辅助数学研究。

papers.title: LightRot: A Light-Weighted Rotation Scheme and Architecture for Accurate Low-Bit Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various domains, the challenge of achieving energy-efficient and accurate inference becomes increasingly critical. This work presents LightRot, a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated hardware accelerator designed for low-bit LLM inference. The proposed architecture integrates Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) algorithms with a hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-based rotation unit to address key challenges in low-bit quantization, including the energy overhead of rotation operations. The proposed accelerator, implemented in a 28nm CMOS process, achieves a peak energy efficiency of 27.4 TOPS/W for 4-bit inference, surpassing prior state-of-the-art designs. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on higher-precision inference or evaluate on basic language modeling tasks like GPT-2, LightRot is optimized for advanced models such as LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B. Its performance is further validated on MT-Bench, demonstrating robust applicability to real-world conversational scenarios and redefining benchmarks for chat-based AI systems. By synergizing algorithmic innovations and hardware efficiency, this work sets a new paradigm for scalable, low-bit LLM inference, paving the way for sustainable AI advancements.
papers.comment: 13 pages, journal version. Published in IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems (JETCAS), vol. 15, no. 2, pp. 231-243, 2025, DOI: 10.1109/JETCAS.2025.3558300
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems, vol. 15, no. 2, pp. 231-243, June 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightRot，一种面向低比特大语言模型 (LLM) 推理的轻量级旋转方案与专用硬件加速器。核心是 Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) 和 Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) 算法，配合基于层次化 Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT) 的旋转单元，以降低低比特量化中旋转操作带来的能量开销。28nm CMOS 实现达到 4-bit 推理 27.4 TOPS/W 峰值能效，并在 LLaMA2-13B、LLaMA3-8B 及 MT-Bench 对话基准上验证。
Motivation: 低比特 LLM 推理需要在能效和精度之间取得平衡，现有旋转方案虽能缓解量化中的离群点问题，但旋转操作本身带来显著能量开销；同时，以往评估多基于 GPT-2 等基础语言建模任务，缺乏对先进模型和真实对话场景的验证。
Method: 提出 LightRot 框架，集成 Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) 与 Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) 两种轻量化旋转算法，并设计层级化 Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT) 旋转单元，将旋转计算高效映射到专用硬件，减少能量消耗。整体加速器在 28nm CMOS 工艺上实现，面向 4-bit 低比特推理。
Result: 所实现的加速器在 4-bit 推理下取得 27.4 TOPS/W 的峰值能效，超过先前最先进设计；在 LLaMA2-13B 和 LLaMA3-8B 上完成验证，并在 MT-Bench 上表现出对真实对话场景的适用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调算法创新与硬件效率的协同设计为可扩展、低比特 LLM 推理确立了新范式，为可持续 AI 发展提供路径；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. We further introduce SpatialCLI-Bench, a 516-example benchmark for compositional perception across localization, segmentation, depth, and pose. On MindCube, SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol with tools (72.1%), while retaining 73.8% without tools after internalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialCLI，一个让视觉语言模型 (VLM) 先借助外部空间工具进行推理、再逐步内化这些专业感知能力的框架。流程分为三个阶段：Call（暴露专用视觉模型作为空间工具）、Learn（用 Cold-Start SFT 和 agentic RL 改进工具使用）、Internalize（将成功的工具使用轨迹言语化以内化感知能力）。作者还引入 516 个样本的基准 SpatialCLI-Bench，覆盖定位、分割、深度和位姿的组合感知任务。在 MindCube 上，SpatialCLI 将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 从 29.3% 提升到 84.6%（带工具），超过带工具的 GPT-5.6 Sol（72.1%），内化后无工具时仍保持 73.8%。
Motivation: 通用 VLM 能理解整体任务但常遗漏决定成败的视觉细节，而专用视觉模型能捕获细节却无法转化为任务级决策；这种能力错配限制了具身智能体的空间推理表现。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：Call 将专用视觉模型暴露为空间工具以增强 VLM 感知；Learn 采用 Cold-Start SFT 和 agentic RL 改进工具使用；Internalize 将成功的工具使用轨迹言语化，使模型逐步内化专业感知能力。同时构建组合感知基准 SpatialCLI-Bench（516 例，含定位、分割、深度、位姿）。
Result: 在 MindCube 上，带工具的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 从 29.3% 提升至 84.6%，超过带工具的 GPT-5.6 Sol（72.1%）；经过内化后，不带工具的同一模型仍保持 73.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明通过工具使用与内化阶段，VLM 可以渐次获得专用视觉模型的感知能力，并在去除工具后保留大部分性能；相关基准与能力也由 SpatialCLI-Bench 刻画。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Calibrate Before Reason: Robust Visual Token Reduction against Semantic Drift in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from prohibitive inference overhead due to long sequences of visual tokens. However, existing visual token reduction methods mainly improve efficiency by pruning or compressing redundant tokens without examining whether the resulting representation remains semantically consistent with the original representation. Mapping the original N-token visual sequence to K tokens may discard, dilute, or misassign critical visual cues, triggering severe semantic drift that deviates the VLM's understanding. In this paper, we first introduce the principle of 'Calibrate Before Reason' to visual token reduction and propose CaRe, a training-free robust framework that calibrates compact visual representations before reasoning to preserve semantic fidelity in VLMs. CaRe consists of two mutually complementary modules: 1) Perturbation-Robust Calibration Anchoring, which identifies calibration anchors with stable model-side influence under multi-directional perturbations; 2) Confidence-Gated Token Calibration, which extracts reliable calibration signals from unselected tokens and injects them into anchors. Extensive evaluations across diverse VLM architectures and benchmarks verify that CaRe outperforms state-of-the-art token reduction baselines. While pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, our method retains 96.4% of the original full-token performance, delivering up to 2.30 times faster end-to-end inference speed relative to unpruned vanilla models.

Result: 在多种 VLM 架构和基准上的大量评估表明 CaRe 优于最先进的 token 缩减基线；剪除 94.4% 视觉 token 时保留 96.4% 的原始全 token 性能，端到端推理速度相对未剪枝模型最多提升 2.30 倍。
Conclusion: 作者将 'Calibrate Before Reason' 原则引入视觉 token 缩减，强调在推理之前校准紧凑视觉表示对保持 VLM 语义保真度是有效的。

papers.title: RefineSVG: Visual Feedback-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Image-to-SVG Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose RefineSVG, a single-step closed-loop visual feedback framework that enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform high-fidelity image-to-SVG generation through self-correction. Existing MLLM-based approaches rely on single-pass open-loop inference, where the model receives visual input only once and must generate thousands of SVG code tokens without intermediate verification. This paradigm inevitably leads to geometric drift, error accumulation, and visual hallucination on complex images. RefineSVG overcomes this limitation by invoking an external rendering engine after an initial SVG generation pass to compare the rendered output against the target image. The comparison yields a multi-dimensional visual residual map (Diff-Map) that is fed back to the model as a ReAct-style correction signal, driving a targeted correction step. To support this render-observe-correct interaction, we further introduce an SVG-oriented semantic vocabulary that compresses token sequences by over 52%. A progressive training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampling cold-start data construction, and end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning aligns the model with closed-loop visual correction. Extensive experiments show that RefineSVG consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity, structural accuracy, and code efficiency.Code is available at https://github.com/liuxiaobo66/RefineSVG.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 main-paper figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). Includes the complete supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RefineSVG，一种单步闭环视觉反馈框架，让多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过自我纠错实现高保真图像到 SVG 生成。初始生成后调用外部渲染引擎，将渲染输出与目标图像比较得到多维视觉残差图（Diff-Map），作为 ReAct 式纠正信号反馈给模型进行定向修正。配套引入的 SVG 语义词汇表将 token 序列压缩超过 52%，并通过监督微调、拒绝采样冷启动数据构建和端到端智能体强化学习的渐进训练管线对齐模型。实验表明其在重建保真度、结构准确性和代码效率上持续优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的图像到 SVG 方法依赖单遍开环推理，模型只接收一次视觉输入就必须生成数千个 SVG 代码 token，缺少中间验证，导致复杂图像上出现几何偏移、误差累积和视觉幻觉。
Method: 提出 RefineSVG 闭环渲染-观察-纠正框架：初始 SVG 生成后调用外部渲染引擎，比较渲染输出与目标图像生成多维视觉残差图 Diff-Map，作为 ReAct 式信号驱动下一步定向纠正。引入压缩 token 序列超过 52% 的 SVG 语义词汇表，并设计包含监督微调、拒绝采样冷启动数据构建和端到端 agentic 强化学习的渐进训练流程。
Result: 大量实验表明 RefineSVG 在重建保真度、结构准确性和代码效率方面一致优于现有基线，代码已开源。
Conclusion: 将外部渲染反馈与闭环自我纠错引入图像到 SVG 生成可有效缓解开环推理的误差问题；该工作已在 ACM MM 2026 录用，并包含完整补充材料。

papers.title: Guiding Large Language Models with Genetic Programming-Evolved Heuristic Knowledge for Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: In dynamic multi-mode project scheduling, activities have alternative execution modes and uncertain durations, while precedence relations and limited resources constrain their execution. Heuristic priority rules support fast online decisions, but their design requires substantial domain expertise. Genetic programming (GP) hyper-heuristics can automatically evolve such rules. Large language models (LLMs), meanwhile, provide a flexible interface for interpreting scheduling information and explaining decisions. However, zero-shot LLM decisions may lack domain knowledge, consume many tokens, and vary across repeated queries. GP-evolved rules therefore provide a potential source of scheduling knowledge for guiding LLM decisions. Unlike existing LLM--GP hybrids that use LLMs to support heuristic evolution, we transfer knowledge in the reverse direction, using knowledge extracted from high-quality GP rules to guide an online LLM decision maker. We extract knowledge from high-quality GP rules and inject it through Feature Selection, Feature Hint, Rule Reference, and Rule Follow. These mechanisms are evaluated in terms of scheduling performance, token consumption, decision stability, and the feature focus expressed in generated rationales. GP-derived guidance generally improves the unguided LLM, but its representation matters. Simplifying the decision context or supplying explicit decision logic is more effective than highlighting important features. Feature Selection offers the best token efficiency, whereas Rule Follow achieves strong performance at greater token cost. Guidance also improves decision stability and changes the features expressed in generated rationales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态多模式项目调度问题，提出用遗传规划（GP）进化出的高质量优先规则来引导大语言模型（LLM）在线决策，知识传递方向与常见的 LLM–GP 混合方法相反。作者从 GP 规则中提取知识，通过特征选择、特征提示、规则参考和规则跟随四种机制注入 LLM，并在调度性能、token 消耗、决策稳定性和生成理由的特征关注度上评估。结果显示 GP 引导通常能改善未引导的 LLM，但表示形式很重要：简化决策上下文或提供显式决策逻辑比突出重要特征更有效。
Motivation: 动态多模式项目调度中活动有多种执行模式和不确定工期，启发式优先级规则支持快速在线决策但需要大量领域专家知识；零样本 LLM 决策缺乏领域知识、token 消耗大且多次查询结果不稳定。
Method: 反向传递知识：从高置信度 GP 规则中提取调度知识，通过四种注入机制引导在线 LLM 决策，包括 Feature Selection、Feature Hint、Rule Reference 和 Rule Follow，并系统比较这些表示方式的效果。
Result: GP 规则引导总体优于未引导的 LLM；Feature Selection 的 token 效率最佳，Rule Follow 在更大 token 代价下取得强性能；引导还提高了决策稳定性并改变了生成理由中表达的特征侧重点。
Conclusion: 作者强调 GP 进化知识向 LLM 传递时，表示形式比知识本身更关键，简化决策上下文或显式决策逻辑比单纯突出重要特征更有效。

papers.title: GyRot: Leveraging Hidden Synergy between Rotation and Fine-grained Group Quantization for Low-bit LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization is essential for efficient LLM inference, and both rotation and fine-grained group quantization have shown individual promise. However, their combination often leads to accuracy degradation or hardware overhead due to a mismatch between the global nature of rotation and the localized behavior of group scaling. We propose GyRot, a quantization framework and hardware accelerator that bridges this gap through algorithm-hardware co-design. GyRot introduces Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping (CoRFiG) and Harmonic-Aligned Permutation (HAP) to enable cooperative integration of rotation and group quantization, enhancing quantizability while relaxing scaling factor precision. To further reduce hardware cost, we reformulate asymmetric quantization and introduce a zero-point rounding strategy that enables fully integer dequantization. Implemented on an INT4-based tensor PE architecture, GyRot achieves state-of-the-art 4-bit accuracy across LLaMA-family models, while delivering up to 3.4x speedup and 3.6x energy efficiency over baseline LLM accelerators. These results validate GyRot's practical effectiveness for scalable and energy-efficient LLM deployment.

papers.journal_ref: Proc. 2026 IEEE Int. Symp. High-Performance Computer Architecture (HPCA), 2026, pp. 1-15
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GyRot，一个针对低比特 LLM 推理的量化框架与硬件加速器，通过算法-硬件协同设计解决旋转 (rotation) 与细粒度分组量化 (group quantization) 组合时的精度下降和硬件开销问题。GyRot 引入 Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping (CoRFiG) 与 Harmonic-Aligned Permutation (HAP)，并配合零点多舍入策略实现全整数反量化。在 INT4 张量 PE 架构上，GyRot 在 LLaMA 系列模型上达到 4-bit SOTA 精度，并相对基线 LLM 加速器获得最高 3.4 倍加速和 3.6 倍能效提升。
Motivation: 低比特量化对高效 LLM 推理至关重要，旋转和细粒度分组量化各自有效，但二者组合常因旋转的全局特性与分组缩放的局部行为不匹配而导致精度下降或硬件开销增加。
Method: 提出 GyRot 算法-硬件协同设计框架，包含 CoRFiG 与 HAP，使旋转和分组量化能够协同工作并放宽缩放因子精度；同时重构非对称量化并引入零点多舍入 (zero-point rounding) 策略，实现完全整数的反量化过程，并基于 INT4 张量 PE 架构实现硬件加速。
Result: 摘要报告 GyRot 在 LLaMA 系列模型上取得 4-bit 量化的最优精度，相对基线 LLM 加速器最高实现 3.4 倍加速和 3.6 倍能效提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果验证了 GyRot 在可扩展且节能的 LLM 部署中的实际有效性。

papers.title: Recall Before You Rank: Similarity-Guided Top-$K$ Reuse for Efficient Long-Context Attention
papers.abstract_en: Top-$K$ sparse attention reduces the cost of Softmax and value aggregation by attending to only a small subset of key--value (KV) entries. However, identifying this subset still requires scoring the current query against the full KV cache and performing global Top-$K$ selection, leaving selector cost linear in context length and limiting the practical efficiency of sparse attention for long-context decoding. In this paper, we introduce ReTopK, a training-free method that accelerates dynamic Top-$K$ attention by reusing historical retrieval decisions. ReTopK builds on the observation that similar queries often attend to overlapping supports and that partially overlapping supports can still preserve most of the Exact Top-$K$ attention mass. For each attention head, it maintains a bounded cache of historical query--support pairs, retrieves the most similar cached queries for each new query, unions their stored supports with a recent window, and reranks only the resulting compact candidate set using exact current-query scores. A similarity-based fallback invokes full-history Exact Top-$K$ when reuse is unreliable, while periodic exact refreshes limit cache drift. ReTopK retains the complete KV cache and reuses only selected indices, rather than historical scores, attention weights, or outputs. Across 16K--128K contexts, ReTopK achieves the lowest PG19 perplexity and the highest NIAH and LongBench scores among the evaluated approximate methods. At 128K with $K=512$, ReTopK incurs only a 0.50\% perplexity increase over Exact Top-$K$ while accelerating attention computation by $3.07\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReTopK，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力加速方法。针对动态 Top-K 注意力中“先对所有 KV 打分再做全局 Top-K 选择”导致选择器开销随上下文线性增长的问题，ReTopK 复用历史查询的检索决策：对每个注意力头维护有界的历史 query-support 对缓存，用相似缓存查询的支撑集并集加近期窗口构成紧凑候选集，再仅用当前查询的精确分数重排序。相似度回退机制在复用不可靠时恢复全历史 Exact Top-K，周期性精确刷新限制缓存漂移；它保留完整 KV 缓存，只复用索引而非历史分数或输出。在 16K–128K 上下文中，ReTopK 在 PG19 上取得最低困惑度，在 NIAH 与 LongBench 上取得最高分数；128K、K=512 时相对 Exact Top-K 仅增加 0.50% 困惑度，注意力计算加速 3.07 倍。
Motivation: 现有 Top-K 稀疏注意力虽能降低 Softmax 与值聚合成本，但识别子集仍需要对完整 KV cache 打分并执行全局 Top-K 选择，选择器成本随上下文长度线性增长，限制了稀疏注意力在长上下文解码中的实际效率。
Method: 提出 ReTopK，基于相似查询倾向于关注重叠支撑集的观察，为每个注意力头维护有界的历史 query–support 对缓存；新查询先检索最相似的缓存查询，合并其支撑集与近期窗口，再用当前查询的精确分数在紧凑候选集上重排序。相似度低于阈值时回退到全历史 Exact Top-K，并周期性执行精确刷新以限制缓存漂移；仅复用选中索引，不复用历史分数、注意力权重或输出。
Result: 在 16K–128K 上下文下，ReTopK 在所有被评估的近似方法中取得最低 PG19 困惑度以及最高 NIAH 和 LongBench 分数；在 128K 上下文、K=512 时，相对 Exact Top-K 仅增加 0.50% 困惑度，同时将注意力计算加速 3.07 倍。

papers.title: LabEvolver: Training-Free Experience Evolution for Safe and Grounded Wet-Lab Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LabEvolver, a training-free framework that equips safe and grounded wet-lab agents with episodic memory from execution experience. LabEvolver couples a state-grounded inner trial loop for adaptive perception, online planning, and safety validation with an outer evolution loop that distills completed trajectories into reusable skill, strategy, and safety experience. On robotic solution-preparation tasks, LabEvolver demonstrates real-world feasibility, reducing pH-regulation completion time and safety-gate intercepts by 48.2% and 60.0%, respectively. On ALFWorld, it further improves cumulative success rate within 20 steps from 76.2% with ReAct to 91.4% over 500 continual tasks, showing generality beyond wet-lab settings. These results support learn-by-doing experience evolution as a feasible path toward closed-loop automated scientific discovery. The project page is available at https://github.com/AndyGao6186/LabEvolver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LabEvolver，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的框架，为湿实验室 (wet-lab) 智能体配备基于执行经验的情景记忆。框架将状态锚定的内部试验循环（自适应感知、在线规划、安全验证）与外部进化循环（把完成轨迹蒸馏为可复用的技能、策略与安全经验）耦合。在机器人溶液配制任务与 ALFWorld 基准上验证了可行性。
Motivation: 湿实验室自动化智能体需要安全、可落地地完成实验操作，但现有智能体缺乏从实际执行经验中积累和复用知识的能力，难以支撑闭环的自动化科学发现。
Method: LabEvolver 采用双层结构：内层是状态锚定 (state-grounded) 的试验循环，负责自适应感知、在线规划与安全验证；外层进化循环将完成的轨迹蒸馏为技能、策略和安全经验，形成可复用的情景记忆。整体无需训练。
Result: 在机器人溶液配制任务上，pH 调节完成时间降低 48.2%，安全门拦截次数降低 60.0%；在 ALFWorld 上，20 步内累计成功率从 ReAct 的 76.2% 提升至 500 个持续任务中的 91.4%，表明该方法具有超越湿实验室的泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为边做边学 (learn-by-doing) 的经验进化是走向闭环自动化科学发现的可行路径，并给出了项目主页链接。

papers.title: Rehearse: Stepping Back from the Confidence Cliff in Self-Improving Autoresearch
papers.abstract_en: Autoresearch improves machine-learning code by proposing changes, running full training jobs, and keeping changes that improve the metric. The efficiency of this loop depends not only on generating ideas, but also on the agent's ability to decide, before spending a training run, whether a proposed modification is likely to work. We study how the reliability of this pre-execution judgment changes over the course of an autoresearch trajectory. In public AutoSOTA logs (Li et al., 2026; Tsinghua FIB Lab, 2026), the fraction of helpful modifications falls from 70% in the first two iterations to 43% by iteration 6+. On 296 same-baseline modification pairs from 39 paper-derived AutoSOTA tasks, each containing one modification that improved the metric and one that did not, with measured outcomes hidden, an LLM judge given candidate rationales but no prior-attempt history reaches 79.5% accuracy on the pairs where strict consensus returns a verdict. On the full 366-pair benchmark, however, this ability weakens substantially late in the loop. As successful changes accumulate, selective accuracy - accuracy conditioned on a strict-consensus verdict - falls from 82.8% to 56.9%, while the judge remains willing to decide. We call this operational pattern the confidence cliff. Rehearse implements the loop change as a lightweight skill for autoresearch loops: propose several ideas, compare them before execution, run the most promising, and judge with a focused memory of similar past attempts and outcomes. This focused outcome memory raises late selective accuracy to 83.5%. Across 4,000 budgeted training runs over three loops, Rehearse improves the endpoint under the same training-run budget on nanochat, image classification, and time-series forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自改进自动研究 (autoresearch) 循环中，智能体在执行完整训练前判断改动是否有效的能力如何随轨迹退化。基于 AutoSOTA 日志与 296/366 对同基线改动数据，作者发现 LLM 判断器的选择性准确率 (selective accuracy) 从 82.8% 降到 56.9%，并将该模式命名为置信度悬崖 (confidence cliff)。提出的 Rehearse 技能通过预执行比较候选想法并维护聚焦的历史结果记忆，将后期的选择性准确率提升到 83.5%，并在同等训练预算下改善三类任务的终点指标。
Motivation: autoresearch 循环的效率不仅取决于生成改动想法，还取决于智能体在花费训练资源前判断改动是否有效的可靠性；现有循环中这种预执行判断能力随成功改动累积而显著下降，造成无效训练浪费。
Method: Rehearse 是一个轻量级技能：先提出多个候选想法，在执行前互相比较，选择最有希望的改动运行，并使用聚焦的相似历史尝试与结果记忆 (focused outcome memory) 来做判断，从而缓解置信度悬崖。
Result: 摘要报告在公共 AutoSOTA 日志中，有用改动比例从前两次迭代的 70% 降至第 6 次后的 43%；LLM 判断器在严格共识返回裁定的配对子集上准确率为 79.5%，而选择性准确率从 82.8% 降至 56.9%；Rehearse 将后期选择性准确率提升至 83.5%，并在 4,000 次预算训练运行下改善 nanochat、图像分类和时间序列预测的终点结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Rehearse 的聚焦结果记忆能够有效抵御置信度悬崖，以轻量方式提升自动研究循环在固定训练预算下的最终效果。

papers.title: Evaluating and Pricing Advertisements in AI-Generated Responses
papers.abstract_en: As search increasingly shifts toward LLM-driven answer engines, advertising is becoming embedded within the generated response itself and should therefore be evaluated for both user utility and commercial value. The key challenge is click-through intent: behavioural logs are unavailable, human annotation resists calibration, and frontier LLM judges conflate intent with linguistic fluency. These gaps compound, as principled pricing presupposes a continuous intent signal, while generating such a signal presupposes supervision that is currently unavailable. We construct the missing supervision through a psychologically grounded agent simulation framework, and distil it into a parameter-efficient evaluator that predicts click-through intent, together with the three companion dimensions of ad quality, as smooth, differentiable estimates. Validated through sign-certain behavioural perturbations, the evaluator surpasses frontier zero-shot judges on relevance sensitivity (79% versus 60-67%), tracks graded content degradation, generalises without error to 103 fictional products, and agrees with human preference in 86% of pairwise judgements across five annotators, with agreement rising in the evaluator's confidence. Upon its estimates we build the pricing layer directly, deriving the unique payment rule under which truthful bidding is optimal, demonstrating it on a best-of-k allocation, and extending the mechanism to non-monotone allocations. The same differentiable signal stands ready as a training objective for ad generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 驱动的答案引擎中内嵌广告的评估与定价问题，提出通过心理学基础的智能体模拟 (agent simulation) 构造缺失的监督信号，并将其蒸馏为参数高效的评估器，以平滑可微的估计预测点击意图 (click-through intent) 及三个广告质量维度。摘要报告该评估器在相关性敏感性上优于前沿零样本 judge（79% 对 60-67%），能跟踪分级内容退化，在 103 个虚构产品上无误差泛化，并与五名标注者的人类偏好在 86% 成对判断中一致。作者还在该估计之上构建定价层，推导出诚实出价最优的唯一支付规则，并在 best-of-k 分配及非单调分配上给出机制。
Motivation: 搜索向 LLM 答案引擎转移后，广告嵌入生成式回复内部，需要同时评估用户效用与商业价值；但行为日志不可得、人工标注难以校准、前沿 LLM judge 会把意图与语言流畅性混为一谈。由于合理定价需要连续的意图信号，而生成该信号又需要当前缺失的监督，这些缺口相互叠加。
Method: 通过心理学基础的智能体模拟框架构建缺失的监督，并将其蒸馏为参数高效的评估器，输出点击意图和三个广告质量维度的平滑可微估计；随后在该估计之上直接构建定价层，推导诚实出价最优的唯一支付规则，先在 best-of-k 分配上演示，再推广到非单调分配。
Result: 经验验证显示评估器在相关性敏感性上达到 79%（前沿零样本 judge 为 60-67%），能跟踪分级内容劣化，在 103 个虚构产品上无误差泛化，而且在五名标注者的成对判断中 86% 与人类偏好一致，且一致性随评估器置信度提高而上升。
Conclusion: 该可微的意图信号可直接作为广告生成的训练目标，而基于它的定价层实现了诚实出价激励相容；摘要强调这一监督构造与评估框架填补了意图信号缺失的空白。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Event-Structured Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differentiable Critical Clearing Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: Transient-stability assessment determines whether a power system can recover after a disturbance and is therefore essential to preventing generator trips and cascading outages. A key metric is the critical clearing time (CCT), which specifies the maximum time available to clear a fault before synchronism is lost. Reliable CCT estimation is challenging because complicated fault-clearing dynamics require repeated simulations over many fault severities and clearing times. We propose an event-structured physics-informed neural network (ES-PINN) that aligns its representation with the pre-fault, fault-on, and post-clearing swing dynamics and enforces exact state chaining across event interfaces. A smooth trajectory-induced stability margin defines a differentiable approximation of the CCT boundary, enabling accurate boundary extraction, local sensitivity analysis, and optional direct CCT prediction through a distilled readout. We further prove a local residual-to-trajectory-to-CCT error estimate, in which exact event chaining eliminates separate state-interface defect terms. Experiments on IEEE 9-, 14-, and 30-bus systems show that ES-PINN consistently improves held-out trajectory and stability-boundary accuracy over matched neural-surrogate baselines across mechanical and electrical contingencies with multiple clearing configurations. Additional full-network DAE validation, multi-fault experiments, and runtime analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出事件结构化物理信息神经网络 (ES-PINN)，用于电力系统暂态稳定评估中的临界切除时间 (CCT) 与临界清除边界 (CCB) 估计。该网络将表示与故障前、故障期间和故障后清除摆动动态对齐，并在事件界面间强制执行精确的状态链接。论文还证明了局部残差到轨迹再到 CCT 的误差估计，并在 IEEE 9、14、30 节点系统上验证了较神经代理基线的精度提升。
Motivation: 可靠估计电力系统的临界切除时间 (CCT) 很困难，因为故障清除动态复杂，需要针对多种故障严重程度和清除时间重复仿真；现有代理方法难以同时获得准确边界提取、灵敏度和直接预测能力。
Method: 提出事件结构化物理信息神经网络 (ES-PINN)，将表示对齐到 pre-fault、fault-on 和 post-clearing 三个阶段，并通过精确状态链接实现事件界面间的严格衔接；用平滑的轨迹诱导稳定性边际 (trajectory-induced stability margin) 构造可微的 CCT 边界逼近，支持边界提取、局部敏感性分析和可选的直接 CCT 预测。
Result: 在 IEEE 9、14、30 节点系统上的实验表明，ES-PINN 在多个机械和电气故障场景及多种清除配置下，持续优于匹配的神经代理基线，提升了保留轨迹和稳定性边界的精度；额外的全网络 DAE 验证、多故障实验和运行时间分析进一步确认了有效性与计算效率。
Conclusion: 论文指出，通过事件结构的显式建模和精确状态链接，可以消除状态界面缺陷项并获得残差-轨迹-CCT 误差估计，从而为电力系统暂态稳定边界提供更准确、可微且计算高效的神经求解框架。

papers.title: Tight Sample Complexity for Low-Rank Adaptation: Matching Bounds and Rank Selection
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard mechanism for fine-tuning large pretrained models, yet its statistical properties remain only partially understood. Existing generalization results provide upper bounds of the form O~(sqrt(rd/n)) or O~(rd/n), but a matching lower bound is missing, and the question of how to choose the LoRA rank r has no formal answer. Both gaps are closed here. A local Rademacher argument establishes an upper bound of O~(rd/n) on the excess risk of the empirical risk minimizer over rank-r LoRA, whenever the target adaptation has rank at most r. A matching minimax lower bound of Omega(rd/n) is then proved via a Fano-type packing of the rank-r subspace of R^{d x d}; the bound applies to any estimator whose output lies in the rank-r LoRA class. Combining the two yields a rank-selection dichotomy. For the constrained empirical risk minimizer, the optimal rank equals the intrinsic rank r*, and over-ranking strictly hurts. For adaptive estimators of the nuclear-norm-then-truncate type, over-ranking is harmless and the rate saturates at Theta~(r* d / n) regardless of r. Taken together, the three results characterize the statistical complexity of LoRA fine-tuning within the well-specified locally quadratic regime, and identify the empirically observed over-parameterization penalty as a property of unregularized empirical risk minimization rather than of the LoRA class itself. Predictions of the theory are verified on a synthetic trace-regression benchmark and on real LoRA fine-tuning across three (model, task) configurations covering DistilBERT and RoBERTa on SST-2 and MRPC. All configurations exhibit the predicted U-shape in validation loss, with two showing statistically significant loss inflation at large ranks (paired permutation p = 0.016).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在局部二次损失框架下刻画 LoRA 微调的样本复杂度。作者用局部 Rademacher 论证证明经验风险最小化器在秩不超过 r 的目标适配上的超额风险上界为 O~(rd/n)，并用 Fano 型装填给出匹配的极小极大下界 Omega(rd/n)。结合上下界得到秩选择二分法：约束 ERM 的最优秩等于内在秩 r*，而过参差秩严格有害；对核范数截断型自适应估计器过参差无害。理论预测在合成迹回归和 DistilBERT/RoBERTa 的 SST-2/MRPC 微调中得到验证。
Motivation: LoRA 已成为微调大模型的标准方法，但其统计性质仅部分被理解：现有泛化结果只给出 O~(sqrt(rd/n)) 或 O~(rd/n) 的上界，缺少匹配下界，且 LoRA 秩 r 的选择没有形式化答案。
Method: 采用局部 Rademacher 复杂度论证建立经验风险最小化器在秩-r LoRA 类上的超额风险上界 O~(rd/n)；通过 Fano 型方法构造 R^{d x d} 的秩-r 子空间装填，证明对输出落在秩-r LoRA 类中的任意估计器成立 Omega(rd/n) 的极小极大下界；进而推导约束 ERM 与核范数-截断型自适应估计器的秩选择二分法。
Result: 摘要报告上界 O~(rd/n) 与下界 Omega(rd/n) 匹配，总速率在指定局部二次域内为 Theta~(r* d / n)。合成迹回归与三个 (模型, 任务) 配置（DistilBERT 和 RoBERTa 在 SST-2、MRPC 上）均显示预测的验证损失 U 形曲线，其中两个配置在大秩下出现统计显著的损失膨胀（配对置换检验 p = 0.016）。
Conclusion: 作者认为三个结果联合刻画了指定局部二次域内 LoRA 微调的统计复杂度，并把经验上观察到的过参数化惩罚归因于未正则化的经验风险最小化，而非 LoRA 类本身的性质。

papers.title: Stop Shipping AI Agents on Faith: Capability Is Not Production Readiness
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are moving into production workflows where they retrieve information, call tools, maintain state, and act on behalf of users or organizations, but many release decisions still rely on capability signals, demos, or behavioral tests that do not show whether an agent is ready to operate under production constraints. Capability is therefore not production readiness. This paper introduces the ProofAgent Index (PAI), a governance readiness index for AI agents. PAI combines four dimensions of deployment evidence: Evaluation, Context, Compliance, and Governance. Evaluation measures observed behavior, Context measures the operating environment that shapes that behavior, Compliance measures alignment with applicable rules and controls, and Governance measures whether the organization can authorize, monitor, audit, and control the agent during operation. PAI is implemented inside ProofAgent Harness, an open source infrastructure for auditable AI agent evaluation and governance. Validation across two heavily regulated domains, healthcare and finance, shows that PAI carries held out readiness signal and separates higher risk from lower risk configurations. The results show that context engineering strongly changes reliability, capability improves behavior but does not determine readiness, and governance evidence must remain visible rather than averaged away. PAI reframes agent release from a faith based deployment decision into an auditable readiness decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论 AI 智能体在生产环境中的发布决策问题，指出能力信号、演示或行为测试不足以证明智能体在真实生产约束下可用，主张“能力不等于生产就绪”。作者提出 ProofAgent Index (PAI)，一种面向 AI 智能体的治理就绪度指数，从 Evaluation、Context、Compliance、Governance 四个维度衡量部署证据，并在开源基础设施 ProofAgent Harness 中实现。在医疗和金融两个强监管领域的验证表明，PAI 能携带留出就绪度信号并区分高风险与低风险配置。
Motivation: AI 智能体正进入生产工作流，承担检索信息、调用工具、维护状态并代表用户或组织行动，但许多发布决策仍依赖能力信号、演示或行为测试，无法证明智能体是否能在生产约束下运行，因而需要一种将发布从基于信念的决策转变为可审计就绪度决策的评估框架。
Method: 提出 ProofAgent Index (PAI)，一个治理就绪度指数，组合四类部署证据：Evaluation（衡量观察到的行为）、Context（衡量塑造行为的环境）、Compliance（衡量与适用规则和控制的符合程度）、Governance（衡量组织在运行期间能否授权、监控、审计和控制智能体）。PAI 实现在开源基础设施 ProofAgent Harness 中，用于可审计的智能体评估与治理。
Result: 在医疗和金融两个强监管领域的验证显示，PAI 携带留出的就绪度信号，并能区分高风险与低风险配置；结果还表明上下文工程会强烈改变可靠性，能力改善行为但并不决定就绪度，治理证据必须保持可见而不应被平均掉。
Conclusion: PAI 将智能体发布从基于信念的部署决策重构为可审计的就绪度决策，强调生产就绪需要评估、环境、合规与治理四类证据的结合，而不仅是能力表现。

papers.title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: Jigsaw puzzle solving requires jointly reasoning about visual content and geometric constraints, yet existing benchmarks use rectangular cuts that create ambiguous ground truth in texture-repeated regions. We introduce \textit{\ours{}}, a benchmark with tab-and-blank interlocking pieces where geometric constraints provide strong local compatibility requirements that, combined with visual content, yield unambiguous ground truth. Across 95K instances at four grid densities (4$\times$4 to 16$\times$16), we find that \textbf{zero-shot VLMs largely lack geometric reasoning}: only one of five frontier models (GPT-5.5) exceeds random baseline on 4$\times$4 puzzles, while all others perform at chance level. While supervised fine-tuning achieves $>$97\% on 4$\times$4, \textbf{all models collapse on larger grids}: GPT-5.5 drops from 70\% to near-random on 8$\times$8, and even fine-tuned models fall below 5\% on 12$\times$12. This ``scaling cliff'' suggests current architectures cannot maintain consistent constraint satisfaction as the number of pieces increases. \ours{} establishes scalable geometric reasoning as an open challenge for vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JigShape，一个基于互锁拼图块的视觉几何推理基准，旨在消除矩形切割在纹理重复区域带来的标注歧义。基准包含 95K 个实例、四种网格密度（4×4 到 16×16），评测发现零样本 VLM 普遍缺乏几何推理能力，且所有模型在大网格上出现明显的性能崩溃（scaling cliff）。
Motivation: 现有拼图基准使用矩形切割，在纹理重复区域会产生模糊的真值，难以严格评估模型是否真正同时推理视觉内容与几何约束。作者希望构建一个几何约束足够强、能提供无歧义真值的基准，以检验 VLM 的视觉几何推理能力。
Method: 提出 tab-and-blank 互锁拼图块，使几何约束提供强局部兼容性要求，并与视觉内容结合产生无歧义真值。基准覆盖 4×4 到 16×16 四种网格密度，共 95K 个实例，用于评测零样本和微调 VLM 的拼图求解能力。
Result: 零样本评测中，五个前沿模型里只有 GPT-5.5 在 4×4 上超过随机基线，其余模型达到随机水平；监督微调可在 4×4 上达到 >97%，但所有模型在大网格上崩溃：GPT-5.5 从 70% 降至 8×8 上的近随机水平，微调模型在 12×12 上低于 5%。
Conclusion: 研究表明当前 VLM 架构无法在拼图块数量增加时维持一致的约束满足，出现 scaling cliff，表明可扩展的几何推理仍是视觉语言模型的开放挑战。

papers.title: Witness Evidence Portfolios: Single-Prefill Risk Detection for Closed Multimodal Answers
papers.abstract_en: Reliable deployment of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires deciding whether a confident visual answer should be trusted, reviewed, or routed to a stronger system. Confidence scores capture candidate margins, but not where the estimated signed visual readouts associated with those margins come from or how they are distributed. We study inference-time risk detection for closed visual answers using the same white-box prefill path that produces the answer. Witness Evidence Portfolios (WEP) first estimates, layer by layer, which visual contributions support or contradict the predicted candidate. It summarizes these contributions through two interpretable route families: question-related evidence provenance and signed evidence concentration. Nested grouped validation chooses the more reliable family and a sparse top-k route portfolio, which is fused with candidate confidence. WEP needs no image perturbation, decoding change, backward pass, or external verifier. Across three MLLMs and four binary-answer benchmarks, WEP improves mean error AP by 0.134. All 12 model--dataset gains are positive, and image-cluster bootstrap intervals are strictly positive on 10 pairs. WEP targets white-box closed-answer systems and uses a labeled calibration slice.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures; includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SouthWinter/WEP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Witness Evidence Portfolios (WEP)，一种面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的推理期风险检测方法，用于判断置信的视觉答案应被信任、复核还是转交更强系统。WEP 沿产生答案的白盒 prefill 路径逐层估计支持或反驳预测候选的视觉贡献，并通过两种可解释路由族（question-related evidence provenance 与 signed evidence concentration）做稀疏 top-k 汇总，再与候选置信度融合。摘要报告在三个 MLLM 和四个二值答案基准上平均 error AP 提升 0.134，且所有 12 个模型-数据集组合均有正增益。
Motivation: 现有置信度分数只能刻画候选答案的 margin，无法揭示这些 margin 对应的视觉读出来源与分布，难以支撑可靠的视觉答案部署决策。
Method: WEP 使用与答案生成相同的白盒 prefill 路径，逐层估计视觉贡献的正负方向，形成 question-related evidence provenance 与 signed evidence concentration 两条路由族；通过嵌套分组验证 (nested grouped validation) 选择更可靠的路由族与稀疏 top-k 路由组合，并与候选置信度融合。方法无需图像扰动、解码改动、反向传播或外部验证器。
Result: 在三个 MLLM 和四个二值答案基准上，WEP 将平均 error AP 提升 0.134；全部 12 个模型-数据集组合的增益为正，其中 10 个组合的图像聚类 bootstrap 区间严格为正。
Conclusion: 摘要将方法定位为面向白盒封闭答案系统 (white-box closed-answer systems) 的推理期风险检测，并依赖带标签的校准切片 (labeled calibration slice) 进行选择与融合。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FedOGL: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Federated Open-World Multimodal Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated graph learning enables collaborative training over decentralized graph data without sharing raw graph information. As such risks evolve, clients must learn emerging classes from private multimodal graph streams, retain historical categories, and reject samples outside the known class space. In this setting, clients must learn emerging classes from private multimodal graph streams while preserving historical categories and rejecting samples outside the current known class space. The core challenge is catastrophic forgetting, which in federated multimodal graphs is not merely a classifier-level failure: old knowledge can be erased through modality-semantic overwriting, topology-induced structural erosion, and federated memory fragmentation. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{FedOGL}, a semantic-structural memory preservation framework. On the client side, FedOGL preserves historical decision behavior through replay and task-start distillation, while protecting graph-propagation memory via projection onto a globally shared structure basis. On the server side, FedOGL maintains and transfers compact category prototypes to facilitate cross-client knowledge sharing without exposing raw graph data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with the best-performing baselines, FedOGL reduces performance degradation caused by catastrophic forgetting by \textbf{42.67\%}, while maintaining or improving performance on downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedOGL，一个面向联邦开放世界多模态图学习 (federated open-world multimodal graph learning) 的语义-结构记忆保留框架，用于缓解客户端在学习新类、保留旧类并拒绝已知类空间外样本时的灾难性遗忘。客户端侧通过重放与任务起始蒸馏保留历史决策行为，并通过向全局共享结构基投影保护图传播记忆；服务端维护并传递紧凑类别原型以进行跨客户端知识共享。实验表明，相比最佳基线，FedOGL 将灾难性遗忘造成的性能下降减少 42.67%，同时保持或提升下游任务性能。
Motivation: 联邦图学习中，客户端需从私有多模态图流持续学习新类别、保留历史类别并拒绝已知类空间外的样本；核心挑战是灾难性遗忘，且在该场景下不仅表现为分类器层面的失败，还会通过模态语义覆盖、拓扑诱导的结构侵蚀和联邦记忆碎片化三种途径抹除旧知识。
Method: 提出 FedOGL 语义-结构记忆保留框架：客户端侧采用重放 (replay) 和任务起始蒸馏 (task-start distillation) 保留历史决策行为，并利用在全局共享结构基上的投影保护图传播记忆；服务端侧维护并传递紧凑的类别原型 (category prototypes)，在不暴露原始图数据的前提下促进跨客户端知识共享。
Result: 摘要报告，在广泛实验中，与最优基线相比，FedOGL 使灾难性遗忘导致的性能下降减少 42.67%，同时保持或提升下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能缓解联邦多模态图学习中的灾难性遗忘，并兼顾跨客户端知识共享与数据隐私保护；摘要未给出具体数据集或任务基准细节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Understanding Submodular Information Measure Based Objectives for Representation Learning: A Variance and Separation Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Submodular Information Measures (SIMs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for representation learning and multimodal learning. In particular, the SCORE framework~\cite{majee2024score} demonstrated that SIMs can serve as effective objectives for supervised contrastive learning. Despite their empirical success, however, the geometric and statistical properties induced by different submodular information measures remain poorly understood. In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework connecting SIMs to classical concepts in representation learning and statistical pattern recognition. We show that Total Information (TI) objectives characterize intra-class structure: Graph Cut TI recovers within-class variance, LogDet TI recovers generalized variance and covariance volume, and Facility Location TI induces imbalance-aware separation that emphasizes rare and confusable classes. We further show that Mutual Information (MI) objectives capture complementary notions of inter-class structure: Graph Cut MI is closely related to centroid separation and Fisher-style discrimination, LogDet MI captures covariance-aware separation through Mahalanobis distance, and Facility Location MI measures nearest-mode representational overlap. We validate these theoretical characterizations using controlled synthetic experiments that independently vary variance, covariance, class imbalance, class separation, and multimodal overlap. Across all settings, the empirical behavior closely matches the proposed theory. Our results provide the first unified geometric and statistical understanding of submodular information measures and offer principled guidance for selecting and designing SIM-based objectives for representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发展了一个统一的理论框架，将子模信息测度 (Submodular Information Measures, SIMs) 与表示学习及统计模式识别中的经典概念联系起来，试图解释不同 SIM 目标所诱导的几何与统计性质。摘要声称该框架分别刻画了类内结构与类间结构，并通过受控合成实验验证了理论与经验行为的一致性，为选择 SIM 目标提供指导。
Motivation: SIMs 已被用于监督对比学习等表示学习任务并取得经验成功，但不同子模信息测度诱导的几何与统计性质仍缺乏理论理解。
Method: 提出统一理论框架，从方差与分离 (variance and separation) 两个视角分析 SIMs。具体将 Total Information (TI) 目标与类内结构对应，将 Mutual Information (MI) 目标与类间结构对应，并分别刻画 Graph Cut、LogDet、Facility Location 三类测度的作用。
Result: 摘要报告：Graph Cut TI 恢复类内方差，LogDet TI 恢复广义方差与协方差体积，Facility Location TI 诱导不平衡感知的分离；Graph Cut MI 与质心分离和 Fisher 式判别相关，LogDet MI 通过马氏距离 (Mahalanobis distance) 捕获协方差感知分离，Facility Location MI 度量最近模式表示重叠。受控合成实验在方差、协方差、类不平衡、类分离和多模态重叠等设置下与理论相匹配。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首次对子模信息测度给出统一的几何与统计理解，并为表示学习中选择和设计 SIM 目标提供原则性指导。验证主要基于受控合成实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Color Grading, No Photo Sharing: Federated Aesthetic Preference Learning for Personalized Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Personalized image enhancement should reflect individual aesthetic taste, yet learning such preferences commonly depends on private photos and ratings that are unsuitable for centralized collection. The task must infer preference from sparse, heterogeneous feedback and translate it into natural-looking color transformations on resource-constrained user devices. We introduce FedPAIE, a federated personalized aesthetic image enhancement framework for user-adaptive color grading without centralizing raw photos or ratings. FedPAIE trains a lightweight dual-cue aesthetic scorer, calibrates it into a personalized scorer on a small local support set, and freezes it to guide regularized adaptation of a lightweight CLUT enhancer from unpaired local photographs. Fidelity constraints and an excess-gap penalty regularize scorer-guided adaptation to limit proxy-score over-optimization while preserving content and natural appearance. Training remains lightweight throughout the pipeline: scorer learning updates at most 0.787M parameters, enhancer adaptation updates 0.265M, and inference retains only a 0.293M-parameter personalized enhancer. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and Flickr-AES demonstrate effective open-world personalization and a favorable balance between user preference and image fidelity. FedPAIE thus connects decentralized preference learning with efficient personalized image transformation without requiring paired user retouches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedPAIE，一个联邦个性化美学图像增强框架，用于在不集中收集原始照片或评分的情况下学习用户自适应的色彩分级。框架训练轻量级双线索美学评分器，在小型本地支持集上校准为个性化评分器，然后冻结该评分器指导轻量级 CLUT 增强器在无配对本地照片上做正则化适应；全程保持轻量，评分器学习最多更新 0.787M 参数，增强器适应更新 0.265M，推理仅保留 0.293M 参数的个性化增强器。实验在 MIT-Adobe FiveK 和 Flickr-AES 上展示了开放世界个性化能力以及用户偏好与图像保真度之间的平衡。
Motivation: 个性化图像增强需要反映个体审美偏好，但学习此类偏好通常依赖不适合集中收集的私密照片与评分，且任务需从稀疏异构反馈中推断偏好并转换为资源受限设备上的自然色彩变换，缺乏不共享原始数据的联邦式解决方案。
Method: 提出 FedPAIE，训练一个轻量级双线索 (dual-cue) 美学评分器，在小规模本地支持集上将其校准为个性化评分器，并冻结该评分器以引导轻量级 CLUT (color lookup table) 增强器从无配对的本地照片进行正则化适应；引入保真度约束和 excess-gap 惩罚来限制代理分数过度优化，同时保持内容与自然外观。
Result: 摘要报告在 MIT-Adobe FiveK 和 Flickr-AES 上的实验表明该方法实现了有效的开放世界个性化，并在用户偏好与图像保真度之间取得良好平衡，且全程参数更新量很小（评分器 0.787M、增强器 0.265M，推理模型仅 0.293M 参数）。
Conclusion: FedPAIE 将去中心化的偏好学习与高效的个性化图像变换连接起来，无需配对用户重触 (paired user retouches) 即可实现个性化色彩分级；摘要未提及明显局限性，但强调其轻量性与无需集中数据的特点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers create a useful train- and test-time compute axis by reusing the same Transformer block over recurrent depth, increasing effective depth at a fixed parameter count. However, that shared block must then govern an entire trajectory of varying hidden states over trained and extrapolated depths. Furthermore, in additive-injection looped Transformers, an input-conditioned signal is reintroduced at every recurrent step, so applying the shared transition at an input-conditioned reference can still move the hidden state. In this paper, we propose Source-Centered State Evolution (SCSE), which is designed to reconcile input conditioning with reference-preserving shared recurrence. Specifically, SCSE retains input dependence through its learned anchor and initial deviation, allows nonzero deviations to drive recurrent computation while mapping zero deviation to zero, and guarantees exact anchor invariance through its zero-deviation mask. The designated anchor is thereby a one-step fixed point by construction. The zero-deviation forcing bias is the next deviation produced from the anchor itself and vanishes in SCSE, while nonzero deviations remain active and support state-dependent recurrent computation. Our theory shows that the zero-deviation forcing bias is a design degree of freedom whose task effect can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial; SCSE resolves this choice in favor of exact anchor invariance by setting the bias to zero. Across WikiText-2, WikiText-103, direct web-corpus pretraining, held-out web-text transfer, and LAMBADA completion, SCSE improves the controlled recurrent quality frontier. Ablation studies identify the learned anchor and the anchor-coordinate deviation recurrence as the primary contributors to the gain, and a trained-model case study grounds the anchor-response diagnostic in observed recurrent motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Source-Centered State Evolution (SCSE)，用于改进循环 Transformer (looped Transformer) 的共享循环计算。SCSE 通过学习的锚点 (learned anchor) 与初始偏差保留输入依赖，并利用零偏差掩码保证锚点是精确的一步不动点。理论分析表明零偏差强迫偏差是可设计自由度，SCSE 将其设为零以换取精确锚点不变性；实验在 WikiText-2、WikiText-103、网络语料预训练、留出网络文本迁移和 LAMBADA 上提升了受控的循环质量前沿。
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过在不同循环深度复用同一 Transformer 块来增加有效深度，但共享块需要管理训练和推断深度上变化的隐藏状态轨迹；在加性注入 (additive-injection) 的循环 Transformer 中，输入条件信号每一步都被重新引入，因此在输入条件参考点上应用共享转移仍可能移动隐藏状态。
Method: SCSE 通过学习的锚点和初始偏差保留输入依赖，令非零偏差驱动循环计算而零偏差映射为零，并通过零偏差掩码保证精确的锚点不变性，使锚点成为构造上的一步不动点。零偏差强迫偏差被设为零，从而使共享循环在锚点处保持中性，而非零偏差仍保持活跃以支持依赖状态的循环计算。
Result: 理论部分刻画了零偏差强迫偏差这一设计自由度对任务的影响可为有害、中性或有益，SCSE 选择设为零以获得精确锚点不变性。实验在 WikiText-2、WikiText-103、直接网络语料预训练、留出网络文本迁移和 LAMBADA 补全任务上提升了受控的循环质量前沿；消融显示学习的锚点和锚点坐标偏差循环是主要贡献，训练模型案例研究将锚点响应诊断与观测到的循环运动联系起来。
Conclusion: SCSE 通过精确锚点不变性调和了输入条件化与保持参考的共享循环，整体上改善了循环 Transformer 的受控循环质量前沿；摘要未声明明显局限。

papers.title: Evaluation Protocols and Cross-Subject Generalization in EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Reported accuracy in electroencephalography (EEG) emotion recognition depends on the complete evaluation procedure, not only the classifier. We separate the target quantity, development procedure, and reporting rule, then use one archived dynamical graph convolutional neural network (DGCNN) pathway on SEED and SEED-IV as an illustrative case. In a protocol-matched subject-dependent check, the SEED result was within 1.47 percentage points of the public reference value; the 3.40-point SEED-IV difference remained unresolved. Across 30 matched SEED subject-session trajectories, checkpoint selection based on repeated test-set evaluation increased mean window accuracy from 0.7855 at epoch 80 to 0.8892. Under five-fold subject-disjoint evaluation, validation-selected checkpoints achieved training-participant trial accuracies of 0.9990 on SEED and 0.9920 on SEED-IV. Accuracy for entirely held-out participants was 0.5348 (95% conditional subject-level bias-corrected and accelerated [BCa] interval [0.4667, 0.5985]) on SEED. The SEED-IV estimate was 0.3954 ([0.3343, 0.4648]) and is reported only as secondary sensitivity evidence because its protocol-matched compatibility check remained unresolved. The observed train-to-held-out-subject gaps are inconsistent with simple optimization underfitting, but they do not isolate subject identity from implementation, preprocessing, representation, or distributional factors. Supporting analyses further showed that participant rankings depended on representation and time scale, while a development-selected tail-risk ensemble did not establish a positive gain in a separate final evaluation. Subject-dependent, subject-disjoint, and cross-session results should therefore be reported as answers to different questions.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables including supplementary information. Submitted to Applied Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究EEG情绪识别中报告精度由完整评估流程而非仅分类器决定这一现象，并将目标量、开发流程和报告规则分离，以存档的动态图卷积神经网络（DGCNN）通路在SEED和SEED-IV上作为示例。协议匹配的subject-dependent检查中SEED结果与公开参考值相差1.47个百分点，SEED-IV相差3.40点且未解决；基于重复测试集评估的checkpoint选择使平均窗口准确率从0.7855（epoch 80）提升到0.8892。五折subject-disjoint评估下validation选择的checkpoint在训练参与者上达到SEED 0.9990、SEED-IV 0.9920，但完全held-out参与者仅SEED 0.5348、SEED-IV 0.3954。作者认为训练到held-out受试者的差距不能用简单欠拟合解释，但无法隔离个体身份与其他因素，并建议将subject-dependent、subject-disjoint和cross-session结果作为回答不同问题的证据分别报告。
Motivation: EEG情绪识别中报告的准确率取决于完整评估流程而非仅分类器，但现有研究常混淆目标量、开发流程和报告规则，导致跨研究比较不可靠。该论文旨在系统分离这些成分，并检查跨受试者泛化与评估协议选择之间的关系。
Method: 使用一个存档的DGCNN通路在SEED和SEED-IV上作为示例，分别进行协议匹配的subject-dependent检查、30条匹配SEED受试者-会话轨迹的checkpoint选择分析，以及五折subject-disjoint评估；还使用95%条件subject-level偏差校正加速（BCa）置信区间、参与者排名分析和开发选择的tail-risk ensemble作为支持性分析。
Result: SEED协议匹配检查与公开参考值相差1.47个百分点，SEED-IV差3.40点且未解决；重复测试集评估的checkpoint选择将平均窗口准确率从0.7855提升到0.8892。validation选择的checkpoint在训练参与者上的试次准确率SEED为0.9990、SEED-IV为0.9920，而完全held-out参与者SEED为0.5348（BCa区间[0.4667,0.5985]）、SEED-IV为0.3954（[0.3343,0.4648]）。参与者排名依赖表示和时间尺度，且开发选择的tail-risk ensemble未在单独最终评估中建立正增益。
Conclusion: 训练到完全held-out受试者的准确率差距与简单优化欠拟合不一致，但该设计不能将个体身份与实现、预处理、表示或分布因素隔离开。论文强调subject-dependent、subject-disjoint和cross-session结果应被视为回答不同问题的不同答案并分别报告。

papers.title: From Single- to Cross-Document: Benchmarking Multi-Granularity Event Analysis of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Event analysis is an essential and fundamental direction of information extraction, involving various event-centric tasks at different granularity of documents. While large language models (LLMs) have preliminarily achieved promising performance in part of these tasks individually, their capability in event analysis still lacks comprehensive understanding due to restricted document granularity, task designs, and data source of existing benchmarks. To address these limitations, we introduce MiGUE-Bench, a systematic benchmark for assessing the performance of LLMs in multi-granularity event analysis. To support large-scale evaluation, we first develop an LLM-driven self-correcting annotation framework called MiGUE-Pipeline, enabling scalable acquisition of high-quality source data of events with automatic labels. Then, we design four core tasks in our benchmark, i.e., event detection, relation reasoning, structure induction, and future prediction, to probe model competence at different levels, from atomic event details to complex cross-document narratives. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods delineate the current capability boundary and identify critical deficiencies, providing insights into the future improvement of LLMs in challenging event analysis tasks.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '26), pp. 3464-3472, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiGUE-Bench，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在多粒度事件分析（从单文档到跨文档）能力的系统基准。作者先构建了 LLM 驱动的自校正标注框架 MiGUE-Pipeline，用于大规模获取带自动标签的高质量事件数据，再设计事件检测、关系推理、结构归纳与未来预测四个核心任务。对现有 SOTA LLM 与检索增强生成（RAG）方法的广泛实验描绘了当前能力边界，并指出了关键不足。
Motivation: 现有事件分析基准在文档粒度、任务设计和数据来源上受限，导致对 LLM 事件分析能力的理解不全面。
Method: 提出 MiGUE-Bench 基准，包含 LLM 驱动的自校正标注框架 MiGUE-Pipeline，以及覆盖从原子事件细节到复杂跨文档叙事的四个核心任务：事件检测、关系推理、结构归纳和未来预测。
Result: 在 SOTA LLM 与 RAG 方法上的大量实验刻画了当前能力边界，并识别出关键缺陷，为后续改进提供了洞察。
Conclusion: 作者指出 LLM 在具有挑战性的事件分析任务上仍存在明显不足，并强调这些结果为未来提升 LLM 事件分析能力提供了方向。

papers.title: Certifying when decision-time information justifies adaptive experimentation
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive laboratories choose measurements during experiments, yet most methods begin after adaptation is permitted. We introduce Opportunity-aware Policy Authorization for Laboratories (\OPAL{}), a framework that decides whether adaptation should be enabled at all. \OPAL{} uses a precommitted contract to require non-trivial adaptation, controlled target risk and positive executed value after cost. We establish an impossibility boundary: source outcomes and unlabelled target covariates cannot uniformly support non-trivial authorization under unrestricted conditional outcome shift, and derive a target-calibrated recovery. Applied to an unseen 11,265-compound Cell Painting partition, the frozen gate selected 595 compounds, captured 384 positive opportunities and achieved strictly positive executed value under least-favourable completion; its 5.18\% false-activation upper bound remained below a 7.5\% limit. Among six methods, only \OPAL{} combined non-zero activation with this risk control. Locked pharmacogenomic and finite-campaign studies distinguish policy misalignment from non-certifiability, establishing authorization as a distinct layer for safe adaptive science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Opportunity-aware Policy Authorization for Laboratories (OPAL)，一个在实验开始前决定是否允许自适应（adaptation）的框架，而非像大多数方法那样在允许自适应之后才介入。OPAL 使用预承诺契约要求非平凡自适应、受控目标风险以及扣除成本后的正执行价值，并建立了一个不可能性边界：在无约束的条件结果偏移下，源结果与未标记目标协变量无法一致支持非平凡授权，作者由此推导出目标校准的恢复方案。在 11,265 化合物 Cell Painting 分区上，冻结门控选择了 595 个化合物，捕获 384 个正向机会，并在最不利完成情形下实现严格为正的执行价值。
Motivation: 自适应实验室会在实验中动态选择测量，但大多数方法都假设自适应已被允许；论文针对的是更早的问题：何时才应启用自适应本身。作者希望为安全自适应科学增加一个授权（authorization）层，避免策略错配与不可认证性被混淆。
Method: OPAL 是一个授权框架，通过预承诺契约同时要求非平凡自适应、受控的目标风险和扣除成本后的正执行价值；论文还给出目标校准的恢复方法以应对无约束条件结果偏移下的不可能性边界。
Result: 在未见过的 11,265 化合物 Cell Painting 分区上，冻结门控选出 595 个化合物，捕获 384 个正向机会，并在最不利完成情形下保持严格为正的执行价值；假激活上界为 5.18%，低于 7.5% 的限制。在六种方法中，只有 OPAL 同时实现了非零激活与风险控制。
Conclusion: 论文通过锁定的药物基因组学与有限活动研究区分了策略错配与非可认证性，主张授权应作为安全自适应科学中的一个独立层次。

papers.title: Robust Wavelength Selection for Partial Least Squares Sugar Content Estimation Using Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Wavelength selection is one of the important preprocessing methods in near-infrared spectroscopy to improve prediction accuracy and interpretability of spectral data. We formulate wavelength-region selection for sugar content estimation as a binary black-box optimization problem and propose a method based on Bayesian optimization. The proposed method constructs a sparse quadratic surrogate model and sequentially extracts interested wavelength regions by Thompson sampling. Minimizing an acquisition function is performed as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem by simulated or quantum annealing. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the prediction accuracy of partial least squares regression and yields more consistent wavelength regions than genetic-algorithm-based selection and simulated annealing. Under one-bit local perturbations, the selected wavelength regions show minimal fluctuations in root mean square errors between observed and predicted values of a validation set. This local stability suggests that our method converges to a smoother error landscape and avoids isolated overfitted solutions. These results indicate that combinatorial Bayesian optimization is a useful framework for robust feature selection in spectroscopic prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将近红外光谱中糖含量估计的波长区域选择建模为二元黑箱优化问题，并提出基于贝叶斯优化的方法：构造稀疏二次替代模型，通过 Thompson 采样依次提取感兴趣的波长区域，并把采集函数最小化转化为二次无约束二元优化问题，用模拟退火或量子退火求解。实验表明该方法在偏最小二乘回归上的预测精度优于遗传算法和模拟退火，所选波长区域更一致，且在单位比特局部扰动下验证集 RMSE 波动极小，说明收敛到更平滑的误差景观并避免孤立的过拟合解。
Motivation: 波长选择是近红外光谱中提升预测精度和光谱数据可解释性的重要预处理步骤；糖含量估计需要更稳健的特征选择方法，而非仅依赖传统启发式算法。
Method: 提出一种组合贝叶斯优化框架：构建稀疏二次替代模型，用 Thompson 采样顺序提取感兴趣的波长区域，并将采集函数最小化写成 QUBO（quadratic unconstrained binary optimization）形式，通过模拟退火或量子退火求解。
Result: 实验显示该方法比基于遗传算法的选择和模拟退火带来更高的 PLS 回归预测精度和更一致的波长区域；在单位比特局部扰动下，验证集观测值与预测值的 RMSE 波动很小，表明解位于更平滑的误差景观上。
Conclusion: 作者认为组合贝叶斯优化是光谱预测任务中进行稳健特征选择的有效框架，可避免孤立过拟合的波长区域解。
Relevance: 5
