papers.title: Critic Architecture Matters: Dual vs. Unified Critics for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective reinforcement learning for humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation within a single policy. A natural design choice is whether to use a single (unified) critic that estimates the combined value of all objectives, or separate (dual) critics with disjoint reward signals. We compare the two on the Unitree G1 humanoid (23 active DoF, of which 17 are policy-controlled) in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, training loco-manipulation policies through sequential curricula that progress from stationary reaching to walking with variable-orientation targets. Under a matched compute budget, the dual-critic run reaches targets 3.5x faster (6.5 vs. 22.6 simulation steps), achieves 2x higher throughput (14.3 vs. 7.0 validated reaches per 1,000 steps), and attains a higher validated reach rate (65.2% vs. 53.8%) than the unified-critic run in a standardized evaluation. Adding five anti-gaming reward mechanisms on top of the dual critic yields no further improvement (60.9% vs. 65.2%). We report this as an efficiency gap between two trained policies rather than an isolated effect of the critic: the two runs also differ in curriculum schedule, arm action dimensionality and one locomotion reward weight, and each is a single seed. The results are nonetheless suggestive for the emerging paradigm of RL fine-tuning of imitation-learned policies, where a unified critic may suppress pre-trained arm behavior through competing locomotion gradients. We argue that critic architecture deserves explicit treatment as a design variable in multi-objective humanoid RL, and specify the single-variable ablation required to establish its causal contribution. Code, trained checkpoints and a project page are available at https://mturan33.github.io/critic-architecture-matters/
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Reinforcement Learning for Imitation Learning (RL4IL), Vienna. 5 pages, 2 figures. v2: corrects the unified-critic run's curriculum level (10 of 40) and per-run environment counts, adds a Confounding Factors section, and softens the causal framing; measurements unchanged. https://mturan33.github.io/critic-architecture-matters/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Unitree G1 人形机器人（23 个主动自由度，其中 17 个由策略控制）上对比多目标强化学习中的两种 critic 架构：统一 critic（unified critic）与分离 critic（dual critic）。在 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 中通过从静止抓取到变方向目标行走的序列课程训练 loco-manipulation 策略，在匹配计算预算下，dual-critic 达到目标的速度快 3.5 倍、吞吐量高 2 倍且验证到达率更高。作者强调该结果是两个训练策略之间的效率差距而非 critic 的孤立效应，并呼吁将 critic 架构视为多目标人形机器人 RL 中的显式设计变量。
Motivation: 人形机器人的多目标强化学习需要在一个策略内协调 locomotion 和 manipulation，而一个自然的设计选择是使用单一统一 critic 还是分离的 dual critics。该选择对训练效率和最终策略行为的影响缺乏明确证据，尤其对模仿学习策略的 RL 微调范式而言，统一 critic 可能通过竞争的 locomotion 梯度抑制预训练的机械臂行为。
Method: 在 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 中，对 Unitree G1 人形机器人训练 loco-manipulation 策略，采用从静止到达发展到带变方向目标的行走的序列课程（sequential curricula）。在匹配计算预算下比较统一 critic 与分离 dual critics，并额外测试在 dual critic 上叠加五个反博弈奖励机制（anti-gaming reward mechanisms）的效果。作者还指出两个运行在课程调度、手臂动作维度和一个 locomotion 奖励权重上存在差异，并提出了建立因果贡献所需的单变量消融设定。
Result: 在标准化评估中，dual-critic 运行比 unified-critic 运行达到目标快 3.5 倍（6.5 对比 22.6 模拟步），吞吐量高 2 倍（每 1000 步 14.3 对比 7.0 次验证到达），验证到达率更高（65.2% 对比 53.8%）。在 dual critic 上叠加五个反博弈奖励机制没有带来进一步改进（60.9% 对比 65.2%）。
Conclusion: 作者将结果报告为两个训练策略之间的效率差距，而非 critic 架构的孤立效应，因为两个运行在课程调度、手臂动作维度、一个 locomotion 奖励权重上不同且均为单种子（single seed）。结论是批评家架构值得作为多目标人形机器人 RL 中的显式设计变量加以对待，并需要单变量消融来确立其因果贡献。

papers.title: Numbers Beat Words: A Rigorous On-Premise Benchmark for Coupled MIMO Controller Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Tuning controllers for strongly coupled multi-input multi-output (MIMO) processes is difficult because decentralized auto-tuning ignores loop interaction and local optimization is start-sensitive. We benchmark whether on-premise open-weight large language models (LLMs) provide useful structural priors, while testing classical alternatives that may make them unnecessary. On a single-loop CSTR, relay-feedback tuning outperforms the LLM. On a pathological quadruple-tank, naive relay, naive LLM, and balanced-start local optimization fail, whereas a scaffolded LLM finds a reliable asymmetric basin and, after local refinement, reaches J = 12.0 +/- 0.16 in 10/10 runs. However, an ablation shows that this reliability depends more on an answer-shaped prompt example than on reasoning over coupling data. A direct data-driven alternative, Virtual Reference Feedback Tuning (VRFT), uses one open-loop experiment and no LLM; with the same refinement it succeeds in 10/10 runs and improves the result to J = 11.12 +/- 0.05. Although VRFT requires a reference-model time constant tau, a deterministic median-tau rule matches or exceeds LLM-guided selection at no extra cost. Across four structurally different plants, the relative gain array computed from step tests predicts when a structural prior is worth using; optimizer start-sensitivity provides a confirming second signal. The resulting boundary is clear: use classical tuning on benign plants, prefer VRFT when informative open-loop data are available, and reserve LLMs for structural initialization when direct routes are unavailable. The benchmark shows that the LLM's value is structural rather than numerical, and that on the central case, numbers beat words.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个针对强耦合 MIMO 过程控制器整定的本地基准，比较了开源大语言模型 (LLM) 与经典自动整定方法的实际效用。在单回路 CSTR 上，继电器反馈整定优于 LLM；在病态四水箱系统上，脚手架式 LLM 通过提供结构先验并结合局部优化达到 J = 12.0 ± 0.16，但消融显示其可靠性更多来自按答案塑形的提示示例而非对耦合数据的推理。无 LLM 的数据驱动方法 VRFT 使用一次开环实验即可在相同精修下 10/10 次成功，并将结果改进至 J = 11.12 ± 0.05。
Motivation: 强耦合多输入多输出过程的控制器整定困难，因为分散式自整定忽略回路交互，局部优化对初值敏感。作者希望判断开箱即用的开源 LLM 是否能提供有用的结构先验，同时检验可能使 LLM 变得不必要的经典替代方案。
Method: 在四个结构不同的过程上构建基准，对比继电器反馈整定、朴素 LLM、带脚手架提示的 LLM、平衡初值局部优化以及无 LLM 的 VRFT 数据驱动方法；并用阶跃测试计算的相对增益阵列 (relative gain array) 和优化器初值敏感性来预测何时值得使用结构先验。
Result: 在中心案例四水箱上，带脚手架 LLM 在 10/10 次运行中找到可靠的对称盆地，精修后达到 J = 12.0 ± 0.16；而 VRFT 以相同精修在 10/10 次中成功并将结果提升到 J = 11.12 ± 0.05。消融表明 LLM 的可靠性主要依赖答案塑形的提示示例；确定性的中位时间常数规则在选择参考模型时间常数 tau 上匹配或超过 LLM 引导的选择。
Conclusion: 作者给出清晰的边界：良性过程使用经典整定，有信息丰富的开环数据时优先使用 VRFT，仅在直接路线不可用时才将 LLM 保留为结构初始化工具。LLM 的价值是结构性的而非数值性的，在核心案例上数字胜过语言。

papers.title: Explaining Data Mixing Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Recent research has established empirical scaling laws to predict model performance on multi-domain data mixtures. However, a theoretical understanding of these model loss behaviors remains absent. In this work, we propose a unified framework to explain the underlying mechanics of data mixing. Our approach extends theoretical perspectives originally developed for standard neural scaling laws (e.g., Kaplan and Chinchilla) to the multi-domain setting. Based on the distributional assumption that domains overlap on fundamental skills while diverging on specialized skills, we identify two key factors that govern the domain losses of models trained on different data mixtures: \textit{Capacity Competition}, where the allocation of finite model capacity couples domain losses globally, and \textit{Noise Reduction}, where optimal weights shift toward harder-to-learn domains to minimize overall noise. Empirical evaluations show that our framework outperforms existing baselines by fitting the loss landscape with a lower Mean Relative Error and identifying higher-performing training mixtures. Most importantly, our model successfully extrapolates across scales, predicting highly effective mixtures for large, unseen scales using parameters fitted on smaller ones. In addition, our model achieves these results using significantly fewer parameters compared to previous empirical laws. Our code is available at https://github.com/meiqwq/Explaining-Data-Mixing-Scaling-Laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，从理论上解释多领域数据混合（data mixing）的缩放律（scaling laws）。作者将标准神经缩放律（如 Kaplan 和 Chinchilla）的视角扩展到多领域设定，在“领域在基础技能上重叠、在专门技能上分化”的分布假设下，识别出两个主导因素：容量竞争（Capacity Competition）和噪声降低（Noise Reduction）。实验表明，该框架能以更低的平均相对误差（Mean Relative Error）拟合损失曲面，并用小规模拟合的参数外推到未见过的大规模，预测高效的训练混合，同时所需参数数量明显少于既有经验定律。
Motivation: 现有研究已建立多领域数据混合的经验缩放律来预测模型性能，但对这些损失行为缺乏理论理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 基于领域在基础技能上重叠、在专门技能上分化的分布假设，将原本用于标准神经缩放律的理论视角推广到多领域设定，提出由容量竞争（有限模型容量在全球范围内耦合各领域损失）和噪声降低（最优权重向更难学习领域偏移以最小化整体噪声）两个因素控制的统一框架。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在拟合损失曲面上优于现有基线，取得更低的平均相对误差，并能识别更高性能的训练混合；最重要的是，它能用较小规模拟合的参数外推到大规模未见过设定，预测高效混合，且使用的参数远少于先前经验定律。
Conclusion: 该框架为数据混合中的模型损失行为提供了理论解释，并以更少的参数实现跨尺度外推；代码已开源。

papers.title: Averaged Evaluation Masks Capability Trade-Offs: Multi-Source Calibration for High-Sparsity LLM Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Calibration data are often treated as a minor implementation detail in post-training LLM pruning because averaged evaluations suggest only modest effects. We show that this conclusion is an averaging artifact: at 60\% SparseGPT sparsity, calibration strategies separated by only 2.85 points in averaged commonsense accuracy differ by 51.9 points in Code retention. Across 15 sources, capability-decomposed analysis reveals an opposing pattern: calibration perplexity is positively associated with General retention but negatively associated with Math or Code retention, leaving no evaluated single source uniformly strong across capabilities. This finding motivates capability-balanced multi-source calibration. Under the same calibration budget, a balanced real-data mixture outperforms every evaluated single source on LLaMA-3.1-8B, beating C4 by 18.8 points; the advantage grows with sparsity and persists on LLaMA-3.1-70B. Because the original pretraining data of advanced LLMs are often inaccessible, we further introduce Information-Guided Self-Calibration for Pruning (IGSP). Using only the base model and evaluation taxonomy, IGSP generates capability-stratified pools and selects low-redundancy samples within capability-specific perplexity ranges, outperforming Self-Cal and SGS by up to 4.8 points. Together, these results recast calibration as a capability-coverage problem and identify multi-source design as a practical principle for preserving capabilities in high-sparsity LLM pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出后训练 LLM 剪枝中校准数据常被当作次要细节，原因是平均指标掩盖了能力间的权衡：在 60% SparseGPT 稀疏度下，平均常识准确率仅差 2.85 分的校准策略，其代码保留率竟相差 51.9 分。作者提出能力均衡的多源校准，并在同一校准预算下使混合真实数据源在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上优于所有单一数据源、比 C4 高 18.8 分；同时提出仅依赖基座模型与评估分类法的 IGSP 方法，将校准重新定义为能力覆盖问题。
Motivation: 平均化评估掩盖了不同校准策略对模型能力的差异化影响，且没有任何单一数据源在通用、数学、代码等能力上同时表现强，而先进 LLM 的原始预训练数据通常不可获取，因此需要在不访问预训练数据的前提下实现能力覆盖式校准。
Method: 提出能力均衡的多源校准（capability-balanced multi-source calibration），在相同校准预算下混合多个真实数据源；并引入 Information-Guided Self-Calibration for Pruning (IGSP)，利用基座模型和评估分类法生成按能力分层的候选池，在特定能力困惑度区间内挑选低冗余样本。
Result: 在多源校准下，LLaMA-3.1-8B 的均衡混合数据源优于每个被评估的单一数据源，比 C4 高 18.8 分，且优势随稀疏度增大并在 LLaMA-3.1-70B 上保持；IGSP 相比 Self-Cal 和 SGS 最高提升 4.8 分。
Conclusion: 校准应被视为能力覆盖问题，多源设计是保持高稀疏度 LLM 剪枝中各能力保留的实用原则。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Linear Strategic Classification with Endogenous Improvements
papers.abstract_en: Strategic classification studies settings in which agents respond to a deployed classifier by modifying observable features at a cost. Classical models typically treat such responses as cosmetic: features may change, but true labels remain fixed. We study an improvement-aware variant in which strategic responses can induce genuine changes in outcome-relevant features. Agents choose post-deployment feature vectors strategically, and labels are then generated according to a stable conditional outcome law that preserves the relationship between features and outcomes. We formalize this problem for linear classifiers under a single-index qualification model and linear-decomposable costs. We show that the strategic-optimal classifier is obtained by a parallel shift of the Bayes-optimal decision boundary, and that it provides a better surrogate for the improvement-aware objective than the Bayes classifier. Since improvement-aware learning requires post-deployment labels, which are typically unavailable before deployment, we provide PAC-style guar- antees under an oracle model, propose a practical plug-in algorithm, establish its generalization bound, and evaluate it on synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究“改进感知”（improvement-aware）的战略分类（strategic classification）问题：代理不仅为了通过分类器而修饰可观测特征，其战略响应还会真实地改变结果相关特征。作者在单指标资格模型（single-index qualification model）与线性可分解成本下证明，战略最优线性分类器是贝叶斯最优决策边界的平行移位，并比贝叶斯分类器更好地逼近改进感知目标；同时提供 oracle 模型下的 PAC 风格保证、plug-in 算法及其泛化界，并在合成与真实数据集上评估。
Motivation: 经典战略分类模型假设代理的响应只改变特征、真实标签保持不变；若战略响应能内生地提升结果相关特征，最优分类器的结构与可学习性问题会发生变化。本文试图在线性分类器框架下，为这类“内生改进”设置建立理论刻画与学习保证。
Method: 在单指标资格模型和线性可分解成本下将问题形式化为线性分类器的选择，推导战略最优分类器的解析形式（贝叶斯最优边界的平行移位）；由于改进感知学习需要部署后标签，作者在 oracle 模型下给出 PAC 风格保证，提出实用的 plug-in 算法并建立其泛化界。
Result: 摘要报告：战略最优分类器可通过贝叶斯最优决策边界的平行移位得到；相比贝叶斯分类器，该分类器是改进感知目标下更好的代理；所提出的 plug-in 算法在合成和真实数据集上得到了评估。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调，改进感知目标下分类器的设计需考虑代理响应带来的真实特征改进；由于部署后标签在训练阶段通常不可得，oracle 模型与 plug-in 算法提供了可操作的解决方案。摘要未展开讨论方法在不同数据分布或非线性模型下的局限。

papers.title: AI From the Margins (AIM): Rethinking Participatory AI Design Through the Lived Experience of Minoritized Communities
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) can reproduce and amplify the structural inequities faced by minoritized communities. Participatory AI has been proposed as a response, but participation typically starts after problem definitions and success criteria have been set, leaving limited room for minoritized communities to reshape what an AI system is for. We propose AI From the Margins (AIM): a methodological stance that articulates the conditions under which lived experiences of minoritized communities can be elicited, centered, and carried forward to inform participatory AI design. AIM is not a fixed protocol; it articulates a set of preconditions that can be enacted through different techniques in different settings. We applied AIM in a Dutch healthcare context in eight sessions with 13 women and non-binary people of color and five municipal policy workers, namely through (1) narrative elicitation using the Biographic Narrative Interpretive Method (BNIM); (2) co-constructed rule-making; (3) participants' determination of whether, where, and how AI should be involved; and (4) translating lived experience into AI policy through dialogue with policymakers. In their reflections on the sessions, participants described the engagement as substantive and called for its continuation, demonstrating how preparatory orientation fundamentally grounded in lived experience shapes what participatory AI design is for.
papers.comment: Accepted at AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI From the Margins (AIM)，一种参与式 AI 设计的方法论立场，旨在让少数族裔社区的生活经验在 AI 系统设计的目的设定阶段就被纳入，而不是在问题定义和成功标准已经确定之后才参与。作者在荷兰医疗健康场景中进行了 8 次会议，参与者包括 13 名有色人种女性及非二元性别者与 5 名市政政策工作者，通过叙事引导、共同制定规则、参与者决定 AI 介入方式、与政策制定者对话等方法展开。参与者在反思中认为这种参与是实质性的，并希望继续推进。
Motivation: 现有参与式 AI（participatory AI）通常在问题定义与成功标准已设定后才邀请社区参与，导致少数族裔社区很难重塑 AI 系统本身的目的，因而可能继续放大结构性不平等。
Method: AIM 不是固定协议，而是提出一组可通过不同技术在情境中实现的前置条件。在本案例中，具体通过四种方式实施：使用 Biographic Narrative Interpretive Method (BNIM) 进行叙事引导、共同制定规则、由参与者决定 AI 是否/何处/如何介入，以及通过与政策制定者的对话把生活经验转化为 AI 政策。
Result: 在 8 次会议后，参与者反馈将这种参与视为实质性的，并呼吁持续开展；摘要以此说明以生活经验为基础的准备性导向可以改变参与式 AI 设计的目标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，AIM 阐明了在参与式 AI 设计中引出、中心化并传续少数族裔社区生活经验的条件，但其具体实施依赖于情境中的不同技术选择。

papers.title: Toward a More Ethical Facial Age Estimation: A Generalized Zero-Shot Benchmark Without Training on Children's Data
papers.abstract_en: Age estimation from facial images typically relies on training data that includes images of minors, a practice that raises ethical, legal, and privacy concerns and that child-data governance frameworks explicitly advise against. While the task remains relevant (e.g., for detecting child sexual abuse imagery), we advocate against using data from minors entirely and quantify what the exclusion costs in accuracy. We formalize age estimation without children's training data as a generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL) problem: age intervals present during training are seen classes and withheld intervals are unseen, with models evaluated jointly on both. The generalized setting, rather than conventional zero-shot evaluation on unseen classes alone, is the appropriate one here because a deployed estimator must operate across the entire lifespan, not only on the interval withheld from it. Revisiting six widely used datasets, we introduce standardized splits with strict age-group separation. For datasets with identity annotations, subject-age-exclusive splits prevent identity leakage across the seen/unseen boundary. Evaluating nine state-of-the-art age estimation methods under this protocol reveals that all of them fail to generalize to unseen age groups, suffering substantial degradation --- on average 46.4%, and up to 52.8% --- relative to the supervised baseline. Moreover, models do not simply degrade: they systematically anchor predictions for unseen ages to nearby seen classes, a manifestation of the well-known seen-class bias in generalized zero-shot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张面部年龄估计模型不应使用未成年人图像作为训练数据，并量化这一排除带来的精度代价。作者将不含儿童数据的年龄估计形式化为广义零样本学习（GZSL）问题，在六个常用数据集上引入严格的年龄组分离的标准化划分，并评估九种最新年龄估计方法。结果表明所有方法都无法泛化到未见过的年龄组，平均退化 46.4%、最高达 52.8%，且预测会系统性地偏向邻近的已见类。
Motivation: 现有年龄估计通常依赖包含未成年人图像的训练数据，这引发伦理、法律与隐私问题，且儿童数据治理框架明确不建议这样做；但该任务本身仍有需求（如检测儿童性虐待图像）。因此作者主张完全不使用未成年人数据，并量化这种排除的精度代价。
Method: 将不含儿童训练数据的年龄估计定义为广义零样本学习问题：训练中出现的年龄区间为已见类，被扣留的区间为未见类，模型需同时在两类上评估。作者重新审视六个常用数据集，引入严格年龄组分离的标准化划分；对带身份标注的数据集，采用 subject-age-exclusive 划分以防止身份信息跨已见/未见边界泄漏。
Result: 在统一协议下评估九种最新年龄估计方法，所有方法都无法泛化到未见年龄组，相对监督基线平均退化 46.4%、最高 52.8%。模型并非单纯退化，而是将未见过年龄的预测系统性地锚定到邻近的已见类，体现出广义零样本学习中典型的 seen-class bias。
Conclusion: 作者认为广义设置而非仅评估未见类的传统零样本设置，更适合部署场景，因为实际估计器必须覆盖整个生命周期。论文强调排除儿童数据的代价是可量化的，但当前方法在未见年龄组上的泛化失败说明仍需新的方法设计。

papers.title: DenoiseRL: Bootstrapping Reasoning Models to Recover from Noisy Prefixes
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement. In this paper, we introduce DenoiseRL, a reinforcement learning framework that substitutes external supervision with recovery-oriented optimization over failures from weak models. Instead of relying on stronger supervision or carefully engineered data, DenoiseRL learns directly from noisy reasoning prefixes by converting them into opportunities for improvement, while exercising fine-grained control over the noise intensity, making training more scalable and effective. This yields a richer and more diverse learning signal, improving exploration efficiency by leveraging imperfect model behavior. Empirically, DenoiseRL consistently outperforms strong on-policy RL baselines across competitive mathematical reasoning tasks and interactive decision-making tasks, while promoting stronger self-corrective behavior as training difficulty increases, highlighting an effective and scalable pathway for improving agentic reasoning capabilities of large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DenoiseRL 提出一种不依赖更强教师模型或精心策划的困难数据集的强化学习框架，从弱模型的失败与带噪推理前缀 (noisy reasoning prefixes) 中构造恢复导向的优化信号，并对噪声强度做细粒度控制。实验表明，在竞争性数学推理任务与交互式决策任务上，它持续优于强 on-policy RL 基线，且随训练难度提升表现出更强的自我纠正行为。
Motivation: 现有强化学习提升大模型推理能力的方法大多依赖更强教师模型或经过精心挑选的困难数据集，限制了能力提升的可扩展性。
Method: 以恢复导向 (recovery-oriented) 的优化替代外部监督，直接从弱模型产生的带噪推理前缀中学习，把噪声转化为改进机会，并通过细粒度控制噪声强度来生成更丰富多样的学习信号，从而提升探索效率。
Result: 在竞争性数学推理任务和交互式决策任务上，该方法一致优于强 on-policy RL 基线；训练难度加大时，模型展现出更强的自我纠正 (self-corrective) 行为。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一条无需强监督、可扩展的途径来增强大语言模型的智能体推理 (agentic reasoning) 能力。

papers.title: A Policy-Driven Runtime Layer for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems have become the dominant production workload, but the serving stack was not built for them. The agent framework above knows agent identities, role, schemas, and dispatch structure but never sees an engine-level event; the serving engine below sees every event but knows nothing about agents. A surprising number of cross-cutting policies depend on both: prefix caching, batch shaping, speculative execution, fairness, tool-result memoization, safety enforcement, and more. Each lives in the seam between the two layers and is currently solved by a one-off patch into one neighbor or the other. We argue this seam is best addressed by an architectural change rather than point fixes: insert a third tier, an agent runtime layer, between the framework and the engine, exposing four primitives (observe, score, predict, act) into which any agent-aware policy plugs, with agent identity as the shared coordinate. We map nine concrete policies onto the layer and validate the abstraction in depth on the one with the largest immediate serving-cost lever: KV caching across sessions, instantiated as CacheScout, which learns the per-workload agent transition matrix online and uses it for survival-based eviction and between-step prefetch. Preliminary results on five real multi-agent workloads show +13 to +37 pp cache hit-rate lift, 12% to 29% lower mean TTFT, and 6% to 14% higher throughput over an unmodified serving stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为现有多智能体 (multi-agent) LLM 系统的服务栈并非为其设计：上层的 agent 框架掌握 agent 身份、角色、schema 与调度结构却看不到引擎级事件，下层的 serving engine 看到所有事件却对 agent 一无所知。作者主张用架构变更而非点修复来解决这一接缝问题：在框架与引擎之间插入第三层 agent runtime layer，暴露 observe、score、predict、act 四个原语，并以 agent identity 作为共享坐标。论文将九个具体策略映射到该层，并重点用 CacheScout 实例验证了跨会话的 KV caching 策略：在线学习每个工作负载的 agent 状态转移矩阵，用于基于存活的驱逐 (survival-based eviction) 与步骤间预取 (between-step prefetch)。
Motivation: 当前多 agent 工作负载已主导生产环境，但 serving 栈并非为此构建；前缀缓存、batch shaping、投机执行、公平性、工具结果记忆化、安全执行等横切策略都存在于框架与引擎之间的接缝处，目前只能通过临时补丁分别打入某一侧来解决。
Method: 提出在 agent 框架与 serving engine 之间加入第三个架构层级 (agent runtime layer)，暴露 observe、score、predict、act 四个原语，使任何 agent-aware 策略都能以 agent identity 为共享坐标接入；将九个具体策略映射到该层，并以跨会话 KV caching 为最大即时服务成本杠杆进行深入验证，实例化为 CacheScout——在线学习每个工作负载的 agent 状态转移矩阵，据此做存活度驱动的驱逐和步骤间预取。
Result: 在五个真实多 agent 工作负载上的初步结果显示，相比未修改的 serving 栈，cache hit-rate 提升 13 到 37 个百分点，平均 TTFT 降低 12% 到 29%，吞吐量提高 6% 到 14%。
Conclusion: 作者论证框架与引擎之间的接缝应通过架构级变更而非点修复来解决，并用 CacheScout 在跨会话 KV caching 上验证了该抽象的有效性；结果属于初步验证，且深度验证集中于服务成本杠杆最大的 KV 缓存策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the MiniMax-M2 series, a family of Mixture-of-Experts language models built around the principle that mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence. The flagship M2 contains 229.9B total parameters with only 9.8B activated per token. Designed end-to-end for agentic deployment, the M2 series rests on three components: (i) agent-driven data pipelines producing large-scale, verifiable trajectories across agentic coding and agentic cowork, each grounded in an executable workspace and an artifact-aligned reward; (ii) Forge, a scalable agent-native RL system that adapts to long-horizon agent trajectories, paired with windowed-FIFO scheduling, prefix-tree merging, inference optimization, and a clean training-inference-agent decoupling that supports both white-box and black-box agents; (iii) the latest M2.7 checkpoint takes an early step toward self-evolution -- autonomously debugging training runs and modifying its own scaffold. Across M2 through M2.7, this combination translates a mini-activation footprint into frontier-tier performance on agentic coding, deep search, office-task, and reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MiniMax-M2 系列，一个围绕“小激活量释放最大现实智能”原则构建的 Mixture-of-Experts 语言模型家族。旗舰 M2 共有 229.9B 总参数，而每个 token 仅激活 9.8B 参数。该系列专为 agentic 部署端到端设计，包含 agent 驱动数据管线、名为 Forge 的 agent-native 强化学习系统，以及 M2.7 检查点中朝向自我进化（self-evolution）的初步探索。摘要称该组合在 agentic coding、deep search、office-task 和 reasoning 基准上以极小激活足迹达到前沿水平。
Motivation: 目标是为现实世界中的 agentic 部署构建大规模语言模型，解决长程 agent 轨迹的训练数据可规模化获取、奖励信号一致性以及自主调试与自我改进等关键问题。
Method: 方法由三部分组成：(i) agent 驱动的数据管线，在可执行工作区中产出大规模、可验证的 agentic coding 与 agentic cowork 轨迹，并与 artifact-aligned reward 对齐；(ii) Forge，一个可适配长程 agent 轨迹的 agent-native 强化学习系统，采用 windowed-FIFO 调度、prefix-tree merging、推理优化，并实现训练-推理-agent 解耦以同时支持白盒与黑盒 agent；(iii) M2.7 检查点首次尝试自我进化，可自主调试训练运行并修改自身 scaffold。
Result: 摘要报告从 M2 到 M2.7，该系列在 agentic coding、deep search、office-task 和 reasoning 基准上达到前沿性能，同时维持每 token 仅激活 9.8B 参数的小激活足迹。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将微小的激活预算与 agent-native 的数据、强化学习和自我进化组件相结合，足以让小激活模型在现实智能相关基准上取得顶尖表现。作为技术报告，摘要未讨论明确的局限或失败案例。

summary_sections.motivation: 目标是为现实世界中的 agentic 部署构建大规模语言模型，解决长程 agent 轨迹的训练数据可规模化获取、奖励信号一致性以及自主调试与自我改进等关键问题。
summary_sections.method: 方法由三部分组成：(i) agent 驱动的数据管线，在可执行工作区中产出大规模、可验证的 agentic coding 与 agentic cowork 轨迹，并与 artifact-aligned reward 对齐；(ii) Forge，一个可适配长程 agent 轨迹的 agent-native 强化学习系统，采用 windowed-FIFO 调度、prefix-tree merging、推理优化，并实现训练-推理-agent 解耦以同时支持白盒与黑盒 agent；(iii) M2.7 检查点首次尝试自我进化，可自主调试训练运行并修改自身 scaffold。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告从 M2 到 M2.7，该系列在 agentic coding、deep search、office-task 和 reasoning 基准上达到前沿性能，同时维持每 token 仅激活 9.8B 参数的小激活足迹。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，将微小的激活预算与 agent-native 的数据、强化学习和自我进化组件相结合，足以让小激活模型在现实智能相关基准上取得顶尖表现。作为技术报告，摘要未讨论明确的局限或失败案例。

papers.title: Rao-Blackwellized Score Matching on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: We study denoising score matching (DSM) when data are drawn from an embedded manifold $M \subset \mathbb{R}^D$. We show that under ambient Gaussian corruption, the target has variance that diverges as the noise scale decreases and correct for it by regressing against the conditional expectation given the nearest point projection on the manifold: the $L^2$-optimal Rao-Blackwellized target. We then compute the small-noise expansion of this target and show that it recovers the true intrinsic Riemannian score to first order, with a second-order bias from a Tweedie term and two geometric terms dependent on how the manifold is embedded in ambient space: a curvature operator acting on the intrinsic score, and an additive drift generated by the spatial variation of the embedding's second fundamental form. On hyperspheres, we derive a simplified formula and show that both geometric terms vanish exactly on $S^2$, offering a theoretical explanation for why ambient DSM performs comparably to intrinsic methods on real Earth science spherical data in prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究嵌入流形 $M \subset \mathbb{R}^D$ 上的去噪分数匹配 (DSM)，指出环境高斯噪声下回归目标的方法差会随噪声尺度减小而发散，并提出以流形最近点投影条件下的期望作为 $L^2$ 最优的 Rao-Blackwellized 目标。摘要进一步给出该目标的小噪声展开，证明其一阶项恢复真实内蕴 Riemannian score，二阶偏差包含 Tweedie 项和两个依赖嵌入方式的几何项。作者在超球面上推导简化公式，并说明这两个几何项在 $S^2$ 上精确消失，从而解释先前工作中环境 DSM 在真实地球科学球面数据上表现接近内蕴方法的原因。
Motivation: 环境高斯扰动下的去噪分数匹配在处理流形分布时，其回归目标方差随噪声尺度减小而发散，导致内在 Riemannian score 难以被准确估计；作者希望修正这一目标并理解小噪声极限下偏差的来源。
Method: 提出将目标修正为给定流形最近点投影的条件期望，即 $L^2$ 最优的 Rao-Blackwellized 目标；随后推导该目标的小噪声展开，分析一阶与二阶项。在超球面情形下给出简化表达式并讨论几何项的消失条件。
Result: 该 Rao-Blackwellized 目标在噪声趋于零时一阶恢复真实内蕴 Riemannian score；二阶偏差由 Tweedie 项和两个几何项构成，分别来自作用在内蕴 score 上的曲率算子以及嵌入第二基本形式空间变化产生的附加漂移。在 $S^2$ 上两项精确为零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果从理论上解释了为何在真实地球科学球面数据上，环境 DSM 的表现可与内蕴方法相当；论文为流形上的分数匹配目标选择提供了理论依据。

papers.title: MinerU-Popo: Universal Post-Processing Model for Structured Document Parsing
papers.abstract_en: VLM-based OCR models have become the de facto choice for document parsing, as they can accurately extract page-level elements (e.g., paragraphs within individual pages) together with their bounding boxes and textual content. However, downstream applications such as RAG require coherent document-level information, whereas these models often break cross-page continuity and fail to recover disrupted structures, such as paragraphs and tables truncated by page boundaries. Such relationships are not confined to a single page; instead, they require joint analysis of titles, paragraphs, tables, and images spanning multiple pages. A natural solution is therefore to reuse existing OCR outputs and reconstruct document-level logical structures through post-processing. To this end, we propose MinerU-Popo, a lightweight and universal framework for POst-Processing OCR outputs, which converts page-level results from diverse parsers into coherent document-level structures. MinerU-Popo decomposes the problem into four focused subtasks: text truncation recovery, table truncation recovery, title hierarchy reconstruction, and image-text association. To address these effectively, we build a task-oriented data engine with task-specific input filtering, and use the generated data (30K) to fine-tune a lightweight post-processing model (Qwen3-VL-4B). To support long documents, we introduce dynamic chunking with overlap-based synchronization, which aligns chunk-level outputs from the fine-tuned model and preserves global consistency. Finally, we assemble the aligned outputs into a tree-structured document representation, further enriched with node chunking and summaries for downstream retrieval and analysis. Empirical results show MinerU-Popo improves title-hierarchy TEDS by at least 20% across all five tested OCR models, improves RAG accuracy and reduces per-query latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MinerU-Popo，一个轻量且通用的文档解析后处理框架，将不同 OCR/解析器输出的页面级结果转换为文档级连贯结构。该方法把问题分解为文本截断恢复、表格截断恢复、标题层级重建和图文关联四个子任务，用 30K 生成数据微调 Qwen3-VL-4B 模型，并引入动态分块与重叠同步以支持长文档。实验表明在五种 OCR 模型上标题层级 TEDS 至少提升 20%，同时改善 RAG 准确率并降低每查询延迟。
Motivation: 基于 VLM 的 OCR 模型擅长提取页面级元素，但破坏跨页连续性，导致依赖文档级信息的下游任务（如 RAG）难以恢复被页边界截断的段落、表格等结构。
Method: 构建任务导向的数据引擎并生成 30K 训练数据，微调轻量级模型 Qwen3-VL-4B 处理四个子任务；通过动态分块与基于重叠的同步对齐分块输出以保持全局一致性，最终组装为带节点分块和摘要的树状文档表示。
Result: 在五种测试的 OCR 模型上，标题层级 TEDS 至少提升 20%；同时提升 RAG 准确率并降低每次查询的延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调复用现有 OCR 输出并做文档级后处理是恢复跨页逻辑结构的有效途径，MinerU-Popo 提供了一种轻量、通用的实现方式。

papers.title: PhysOmni: Physics-Grounded Multi-Object Scene Generation from a Single Image with Real-Time Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Recent generative video models achieve impressive visual quality but remain constrained by limited physical consistency and controllability. Existing video generation methods provide minimal physical control, and single-image-to-3D conversion approaches often suffer from object interpenetration. Furthermore, physics-based scene-level 3D generation methods exhibit spatial misalignment, stylized artifacts, and inconsistencies with the input data, restricting their use in realistic interactive video synthesis. We propose PhysOmni, a training-free framework that converts a single image into a physically consistent and controllable video through holistic scene-level 3D reconstruction. By rep?resenting the full scene geometry in a unified spatial coordinate system, PhysOmni resolves object penetration and alignment ambiguity. Unlike prior methods, this formulation enables accurate scene?level multi-object interactions and introduces richer, complex control types for advanced mechanics?based manipulation. By decoupling simulation from rendering, PhysOmni bypasses latency-heavy priors, achieving real-time physical interaction previews paired while preserving photorealistic visual fidelity. Experimental results demonstrate that PhysOmni substantially outperforms prior methods in physical fidelity, spatial coherence, and controllability. Project Page: https://physomni.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysOmni，一个无需训练（training-free）的框架，通过场景级 3D 重建将单张图像转换为物理一致且可控的视频。该方法在统一空间坐标系中表示完整场景几何，以解决物体穿透和对齐歧义，并将模拟与渲染解耦，从而实现实时物理交互预览，同时保持照片级视觉保真度。实验表明 PhysOmni 在物理保真度、空间一致性和可控性上显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有生成视频模型视觉质量高但物理一致性和可控性有限；单图转 3D 方法常出现物体穿插；基于物理的场景级 3D 生成方法则存在空间错位、风格化伪影和与输入数据不一致的问题，限制了它们在现实交互式视频合成中的应用。
Method: 提出训练无关框架，通过统一空间坐标系中的全场景几何重建消除物体穿插与对齐歧义，从而支持准确的场景级多物体交互和更丰富的力学操控。通过解耦模拟与渲染，绕过延迟高的先验，实现实时物理交互预览并保持高保真渲染。
Result: 实验结果表明，PhysOmni 在物理保真度、空间连贯性和可控性方面大幅优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需训练即可将单图转化为物理一致、可控且支持实时交互的视频，并指出其在场景级多物体交互方面的优势。

papers.title: Thinking in Scales: Accelerating Gigapixel Pathology Image Analysis via Adaptive Continuous Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Traditional whole slide image (WSI) analysis methods typically rely on the multiple instance learning (MIL) paradigm, which extracts patch-level features at high magnification and aggregates them for slide-level prediction. However, such exhaustive patch-level processing is computationally expensive, severely limiting the efficiency and scalability of WSI analysis. To address this challenge, we propose PathCTM (a Pathology-oriented Continuous Thought Model) that enables token-efficient scale-space continuous reasoning for gigapixel WSIs. PathCTM formulates diagnostic inference as a dynamic sequential information pursuit. It progressively transitions from low-magnification global to high-magnification local inspection, and adaptively terminates inference when sufficient evidence is gathered to effectively bound decision uncertainty. Specifically, it uses conditional computation for dynamic scale switching with attention-guided region pruning, coupled with confidence-aware early stopping. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with standard MIL-based methods, PathCTM reduces the number of required image patches by 95.95% and shortens inference time by approximately 95.62%, while maintaining AUC without degradation. Code is available at https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PathCTM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PathCTM（Pathology-oriented Continuous Thought Model），面向十亿像素级全切片图像（WSI）分析，将诊断推断建模为动态顺序信息追求过程：从低倍率全局观察逐步过渡到高倍率局部检查，并在证据足够时自适应终止，从而在保持决策确定性的同时显著降低计算开销。摘要报告该方法相比标准 MIL 方法减少约 95.95% 的所需图像块数量，并缩短约 95.62% 的推理时间，同时 AUC 无明显下降。代码已公开。
Motivation: 传统 WSI 分析方法通常依赖多实例学习（MIL）范式，需要在高倍率下逐块提取 patch 特征并聚合，这种穷举式的 patch 级处理计算开销巨大，严重制约了 WSI 分析的效率与可扩展性。
Method: PathCTM 将诊断推理形式化为动态的顺序信息追求，使用条件计算（conditional computation）实现动态尺度切换，配合注意力引导的区域剪枝（attention-guided region pruning）和置信度感知的早停（confidence-aware early stopping），在充分收集证据后自适应终止推理。
Result: 在与标准 MIL 方法的对比中，PathCTM 将所需图像块数量减少 95.95%，推理时间缩短约 95.62%，同时 AUC 没有下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PathCTM 实现了 WSI 分析中的 token 高效尺度空间连续推理（token-efficient scale-space continuous reasoning），为十亿像素病理图像提供更高效的诊断推断途径；未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Topological Data Analysis combined with Machine Learning for Predicting Permeability of Porous Media
papers.abstract_en: Flow in porous media is difficult to address using standard analytical or numerical methods due to its complexity. However, since synthetic representations of porous media are easy to produce and data from physical experiments are becoming more widely available, the problem is well-suited to studies that include machine learning (ML) techniques. We discuss a number of features that can be extracted from such data, and their utility as input variables into a standard ML algorithm. These features include structural measures describing the geometry of the porous media, topological measures describing the connectivity, and network measures obtained by modeling the porous media as simplified pore networks. These features enable the prediction of the permeability of the considered (synthetic) porous materials using ML techniques that also leverage the separately computed exact permeability (ground truth). Comparing results obtained using different input variables helps develop a better understanding of the utility of various measures for predicting permeability based on the porous media structure. We show, in particular, that topological data analysis (TDA) provides a useful set of features that can be easily combined with ML to yield meaningful results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用机器学习预测多孔介质的渗透率 (permeability)。作者从合成多孔介质数据中提取结构、拓扑和网络三类特征，作为标准 ML 算法的输入，并以精确计算的渗透率作为真值进行训练。摘要特别指出，拓扑数据分析 (TDA) 提供的特征易于与 ML 结合，能够得到有意义的预测结果。
Motivation: 多孔介质中的流动因复杂性难以用标准解析或数值方法处理，而合成多孔介质数据容易生成、物理实验数据也日益可得，因此适合引入机器学习方法来研究渗透率预测问题。
Method: 提取描述几何的结构测度、描述连通性的拓扑测度，以及将多孔介质建模为简化孔隙网络 (pore networks) 得到的网络测度，将这些特征作为标准 ML 算法的输入变量；同时利用单独计算的精确渗透率作为 ground truth 进行监督学习。
Result: 摘要未给出定量指标，但报告通过比较不同输入变量的预测结果来评估各类测度的效用，并特别表明 TDA 特征与 ML 结合能产生有意义的结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TDA 为渗透率预测提供了一组有用且易于与 ML 结合的特征；研究范围限于合成多孔材料，摘要未涉及真实物理数据的验证。

papers.title: Orchard: An Open-Source Agentic Modeling Framework
papers.abstract_en: Agentic modeling aims to transform LLMs into autonomous agents capable of solving complex tasks through planning, reasoning, tool use, and multi-turn interaction with external environments. We present Orchard, an open-source framework for scalable agentic modeling. At its core is Orchard Env, a lightweight Kubernetes-native environment service that provides reusable primitives for sandbox lifecycle management across task domains, agent harnesses, and training stages. On top of Orchard Env, we build three agentic modeling recipes. Orchard-SWE targets software engineering agents. We introduce credit-assignment supervised fine-tuning and a progression of RL signals: Balanced Adaptive Rollout (BAR) for sparse-reward optimization, on-policy distillation (OPD) and rubric-based process reward (RPR) for dense supervision, and historical experience distillation, which compresses rollouts from prior experiments into a compact value model for inference-time reranking. Built on the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B backbone, Orchard-SWE reaches 69.7% with RPR-based RL and 73.0% with value-model reranking on SWE-bench Verified, setting a new state of the art among open-source methods while approaching frontier systems over 10x larger. Orchard-GUI trains a 4B vision-language computer-use agent using only 0.4K distilled trajectories and 2.2K open-ended tasks, achieving 68.4% average success across WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and DeepShop, making it the strongest open-source model while remaining competitive with proprietary systems. Orchard-Claw targets personal assistant agents. Trained with only 0.2K synthetic tasks, it achieves 59.6% pass@3 on Claw-Eval and 73.9% when paired with the stronger ZeroClaw harness. Collectively, these results demonstrate that a lightweight, open, harness-agnostic environment layer enables reusable agentic data, training recipes, and evaluation protocols across domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Orchard，一个开源的规模化智能体建模（agentic modeling）框架。核心是 Orchard Env，一个 Kubernetes 原生的轻量环境服务，提供跨任务领域、agent harness 和训练阶段的沙箱生命周期管理原语。在此之上构建了三个训练配方：Orchard-SWE（软件工程智能体）、Orchard-GUI（4B 视觉语言计算机操作智能体）与 Orchard-Claw（个人助理智能体），分别在不同基准上达到开源 SOTA 或与专有系统相当的水平。作者认为轻量、开放且与 harness 无关的环境层可以跨领域复用智能体数据、训练配方和评估协议。
Motivation: 智能体建模旨在把 LLM 变成能通过规划、推理、工具使用和与外部环境多轮交互来解决复杂任务的自主智能体，但缺少可扩展、可复用且跨领域一致的建模框架和环境基础设施。
Method: 以 Kubernetes 原生的 Orchard Env 作为统一环境服务，提供沙箱生命周期管理；在此基础上给出三种配方。Orchard-SWE 引入 credit-assignment supervised fine-tuning 以及一系列 RL 信号：用于稀疏奖励优化的 Balanced Adaptive Rollout (BAR)、用于密集监督的 on-policy distillation (OPD) 和 rubric-based process reward (RPR)，并用历史经验蒸馏把先前实验的 rollout 压缩成用于推理时重排序的 value model。Orchard-GUI 只用 0.4K 蒸馏轨迹和 2.2K 开放式任务训练 4B 视觉语言计算机操作智能体。Orchard-Claw 用 0.2K 合成任务训练个人助理智能体。
Result: 基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的 Orchard-SWE 在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到 69.7%（RPR 类 RL）和 73.0%（加入 value-model 重排序），刷新开源方法 SOTA，并接近规模大 10 倍以上的前沿系统；Orchard-GUI 在 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web 和 DeepShop 上平均成功率 68.4%，是最强开源模型且可与专有系统竞争；Orchard-Claw 在 Claw-Eval 上达到 59.6% pass@3，配合更强的 ZeroClaw harness 时为 73.9%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，轻量、开放、与 harness 无关的环境层使得智能体数据、训练配方和评估协议可以跨领域复用；这些结果共同验证了该框架的可扩展性与通用性。

papers.title: PROVE: A Perceptual RemOVal cohErence Benchmark for Visual Media
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating object removal in images and videos remains challenging because the task is inherently one-to-many, yet existing metrics frequently disagree with human perception. Full-reference metrics reward copy-paste behaviors over genuine erasure; no-reference metrics suffer from systematic biases such as favoring blurry results; and global temporal metrics are insensitive to localized artifacts within edited regions. To address these limitations, we propose RC (Removal Coherence), a pair of perception-aligned metrics: RC-S, which measures spatial coherence via sliding-window feature comparison between masked and background regions, and RC-T, which measures temporal consistency via distribution tracking within shared restored regions across adjacent frames. To validate RC and support community benchmarking, we further introduce PROVE-Bench, a two-tier real-world benchmark comprising PROVE-M, an 80-video paired dataset with motion augmentation, and PROVE-H, a 100-video challenging subset without ground truth. Together, RC metrics and PROVE-Bench form the PROVE (Perceptual RemOVal cohErence) evaluation framework for visual media. Experiments across diverse image and video benchmarks demonstrate that RC achieves substantially stronger alignment with human judgments than existing evaluation protocols. Project page: https://xiaomi-research.github.io/prove/.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACMMM 2026. Project Page: https://xiaomi-research.github.io/prove/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PROVE 评估框架，面向图像与视频中的物体移除 (object removal) 任务。框架包含一对感知对齐指标 RC（RC-S 用滑动窗口特征比较衡量空间一致性，RC-T 用相邻帧共享恢复区域内的分布追踪衡量时间一致性），以及两层级真实世界基准 PROVE-Bench（PROVE-M 为 80 段带运动增强的配对视频，PROVE-H 为 100 段无真值的难点视频）。实验表明 RC 与人类判断的一致性显著强于现有评估协议。
Motivation: 物体移除本质上是 one-to-many 任务，而现有指标常与人类感知不一致：全参考指标会奖励复制粘贴而非真正擦除，无参考指标存在偏向模糊结果等系统偏差，全局时间指标对编辑区域内的局部伪影不敏感。
Method: 提出 RC（Removal Coherence）指标对：RC-S 通过掩膜区域与背景区域的滑动窗口特征比较衡量空间连贯性；RC-T 通过追踪相邻帧共享恢复区域内的分布变化衡量时间一致性。并构建 PROVE-Bench 两层级真实世界基准来验证指标并支持社区评测。
Result: 在多种图像和视频基准上，RC 与人类判断的一致性显著优于现有评估协议。
Conclusion: RC 指标与 PROVE-Bench 共同构成面向视觉媒体的感知移除一致性（perceptual removal coherence）评估框架，并已提供项目页面资源。

papers.title: Rethinking Event-Based Object Detection through Representation-Level Temporal Aggregation and Model-Level Hypergraph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras provide microsecond-level temporal resolution, low latency, and high dynamic range, offering potential for perception under fast motion and challenging illumination conditions. However, existing Event-based Object Detection (EOD) methods face limitations at both the representation and model levels: prior event representations usually encode temporal information indirectly through redundant structures, while detection models struggle to explicitly aggregate fragmented event responses into coherent high-order object features. To address these limitations, we present \textbf{Event Dual Temporal-Relational Aggregation Detector (Ev-DTAD)}, a unified EOD framework that integrates representation-level temporal encoding with model-level temporal-hypergraph reasoning. Specifically, we introduce \textbf{Hierarchical Temporal Aggregation (HTA)}, a compact three-channel pseudo-RGB representation that explicitly embeds temporal information across intra- and inter-window events. To further enhance detection under sparse and fragmented event responses, we propose \textbf{Frequency-aware Hypergraph Temporal Fusion (FHTF)}, which refines multi-scale event features through temporal evolution modeling and high-order relational reasoning. Extensive experiments on Gen1 (\textbf{+0.8 mAP}), 1Mpx/Gen4 (\textbf{+0.5 mAP}), and eTraM (\textbf{+3.0 mAP}) demonstrate that Ev-DTAD achieves a competitive accuracy--efficiency trade-off, validating the complementarity between compact temporal representation and temporal-hypergraph feature reasoning (Fig.~\ref{fig:bubble}). The code is available at: https://github.com/meisenwang/Ev-DTAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对事件相机目标检测 (Event-based Object Detection, EOD) 提出统一框架 Ev-DTAD，将表示层的时间编码与模型层的时序超图推理结合。具体包含层级时间聚合 (HTA)，一种紧凑的三通道伪 RGB 表示，显式嵌入窗口内与窗口间事件的时间信息；以及频率感知超图时间融合 (FHTF)，通过时间演化建模与高阶关系推理细化多尺度事件特征。在 Gen1、1Mpx/Gen4、eTraM 上分别取得 +0.8、+0.5、+3.0 mAP 的提升，并实现有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有 EOD 方法在表示层和模型层均存在局限：已有事件表示通常通过冗余结构间接编码时间信息，而检测模型难以将碎片化的事件响应显式聚合为连贯的高阶物体特征。
Method: 提出 Event Dual Temporal-Relational Aggregation Detector (Ev-DTAD)，集成表示层的 HTA 与模型层的 FHTF；HTA 构建紧凑的三通道伪 RGB 表示以显式嵌入时间信息，FHTF 在稀疏碎片化事件响应下通过时间演化建模和高阶关系推理精化多尺度特征。
Result: 在 Gen1、1Mpx/Gen4 与 eTraM 数据集上分别提升 +0.8、+0.5、+3.0 mAP，验证了紧凑时间表示与时间超图特征推理的互补性，并取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调紧凑时间表示与时间超图特征推理在 EOD 任务中的互补价值，并公开代码；研究范围限定于事件相机目标检测，不涉及降水或天气预报领域。

papers.title: MDL-GBG: A Non-parametric and Interpretable Granular-Ball Generation Method for Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Existing granular-ball generation methods are still mainly driven by handcrafted quality measures and heuristic splitting or stopping criteria, which may weaken the transparency of local generation decisions in clustering. To address this issue, this paper proposes Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Generation (MDL-GBG), a non-parametric and interpretable granular-ball generation method for clustering. MDL-GBG reformulates granular-ball generation as a local model selection problem under the Minimum Description Length principle. For each granular ball, three candidate explanations are compared, namely a single-ball model, a two-ball model, and a core-ball-residual model, and the model with the shortest description length is selected. In this way, ball retention, splitting, and residual peeling are unified within a common coding-theoretic framework. A residual reassignment mechanism is further introduced to re-evaluate peeled-off boundary samples after stable granular balls are formed. Experiments on 20 UCI datasets show that the stable granular balls generated by MDL-GBG provide an effective upstream representation for clustering. In particular, MDL-GBG+AC achieves the highest average ARI, ACC, and NMI values among the compared methods, while the Friedman-Nemenyi analysis further supports its favorable average ranking. These results indicate that MDL-GBG offers a principled and interpretable alternative to heuristic granular-ball generation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于最小描述长度原理的非参数、可解释粒球生成方法 MDL-GBG，用于聚类。该方法将粒球生成重新表述为局部模型选择问题，在单球模型、双球模型和核心球-残差模型之间选择描述长度最短者，从而统一球保留、分裂和残差剥离。在 20 个 UCI 数据集上的实验表明，MDL-GBG 生成的稳定粒球作为聚类上游表示有效，MDL-GBG+AC 在平均 ARI、ACC 和 NMI 上优于对比方法。
Motivation: 现有粒球生成方法主要依赖手工设计的质量度量和启发式分裂或停止准则，可能削弱聚类中局部生成决策的透明性。本文目标是用原则性的编码理论框架替代启发式策略，提高可解释性。
Method: 提出 MDL-GBG，将粒球生成视为最小描述长度原则下的局部模型选择问题；对每个粒球比较单球模型、两球模型和核心球-残差模型三种候选解释，选择描述长度最短者。还引入残差重分配机制，在稳定粒球形成后重新评估被剥离的边界样本。
Result: 在 20 个 UCI 数据集上的实验表明，MDL-GBG 生成的稳定粒球为聚类提供有效的上游表示；MDL-GBG+AC 在平均 ARI、ACC 和 NMI 上取得最高值，Friedman-Nemenyi 分析支持其有利的平均排名。
Conclusion: MDL-GBG 为启发式粒球生成策略提供了有原则且可解释的替代方案。摘要未明确提及局限性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于最小描述长度原理的非参数、可解释粒球生成方法 MDL-GBG，用于聚类。该方法将粒球生成重新表述为局部模型选择问题，在单球模型、双球模型和核心球-残差模型之间选择描述长度最短者，从而统一球保留、分裂和残差剥离。在 20 个 UCI 数据集上的实验表明，MDL-GBG 生成的稳定粒球作为聚类上游表示有效，MDL-GBG+AC 在平均 ARI、ACC 和 NMI 上优于对比方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有粒球生成方法主要依赖手工设计的质量度量和启发式分裂或停止准则，可能削弱聚类中局部生成决策的透明性。本文目标是用原则性的编码理论框架替代启发式策略，提高可解释性。
summary_sections.method: 提出 MDL-GBG，将粒球生成视为最小描述长度原则下的局部模型选择问题；对每个粒球比较单球模型、两球模型和核心球-残差模型三种候选解释，选择描述长度最短者。还引入残差重分配机制，在稳定粒球形成后重新评估被剥离的边界样本。
summary_sections.result: 在 20 个 UCI 数据集上的实验表明，MDL-GBG 生成的稳定粒球为聚类提供有效的上游表示；MDL-GBG+AC 在平均 ARI、ACC 和 NMI 上取得最高值，Friedman-Nemenyi 分析支持其有利的平均排名。
summary_sections.conclusion: MDL-GBG 为启发式粒球生成策略提供了有原则且可解释的替代方案。摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: From Synthetic to Real: Toward Identity-Consistent Makeup Transfer with Synthetic and Real Data
papers.abstract_en: Makeup transfer aims to apply the makeup style of a reference portrait to a source portrait while preserving identity and background. Early methods formulate this task as unsupervised image-to-image translation, relying on surrogate objectives and often yielding limited performance. Recent diffusion- and flow-based approaches instead exploit synthetic data for supervised training, leading to significant improvements. However, these methods still face two critical challenges: synthetic supervision frequently fails to faithfully preserve identity, and the domain gap between synthetic and real data limits generalization, resulting in degraded performance in complex real-world scenarios. To address these issues, this paper first proposes ConsistentBeauty, a novel data curation pipeline that ensures makeup fidelity and strict identity consistency within the synthesized data. Second, we propose RealBeauty, a synthetic-to-real post-training framework. Beyond supervised learning on curated synthetic data, we further adapt the model to real-world scenarios through reinforcement learning and design novel verifiable rewards tailored to the makeup transfer task. It allows the model to further benefit from real makeup patterns beyond synthetic supervision. In addition, we establish a new diverse benchmark for makeup transfer, covering a wide range of skin tones, ages, genders, poses, and makeup styles, thereby enabling a more comprehensive evaluation of model performance under diverse real-world conditions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks and demonstrates clear advantages in identity preservation and performance on complex real-world cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对妆容迁移 (makeup transfer) 中合成监督数据难以保持身份一致性以及合成到真实域差距导致泛化受限的问题，提出 ConsistentBeauty 数据筛选流程和 RealBeauty 合成到真实的后训练框架，并构建覆盖多种肤色、年龄、性别、姿态与妆容风格的新基准。摘要报告该方法在多个基准上达到当前最优，并在身份保持和复杂真实场景上表现明显优势。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散或流模型的妆容迁移方法利用合成数据做监督训练，但合成监督常无法忠实保持身份，且合成与真实数据之间的域差距限制了模型在复杂真实场景下的泛化能力。
Method: 提出两条技术路径：一是 ConsistentBeauty，一种保证合成数据中妆容保真与严格身份一致性的数据筛选流程；二是 RealBeauty，一种合成到真实的后训练框架，在合成数据监督之外通过强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 让模型适配真实场景，并为妆容迁移任务设计新的可验证奖励 (verifiable rewards)。此外构建了一个新的多样化妆容迁移基准。
Result: 摘要称该方法在多个基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并在身份保持以及复杂真实世界案例上有明显优势。
Conclusion: 作者强调结合严格身份一致的合成数据筛选与面向真实数据的强化学习后训练，能够超越单纯合成监督，提升妆容迁移在真实场景中的表现和身份保持能力。

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Imitation Learning with Human Guidance: A Privileged Information Approach
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning is widely used for learning to act in complex environments. While pure neural-based methods handle high dimensional data effectively, they suffer from the requirement of large number of samples and are prone to overfitting. Pure symbolic approaches, while generalize well, do not handle high-dimensional data effectively. We propose a neurosymbolic approach that achieves the best of both worlds, i.e, handling high-dimensional data while achieving generalization. The key advantage of our approach is that it can effectively exploit additional privileged information that is available only during training (in our case, gaze data). Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency and the generalization capability of our proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号模仿学习 (neurosymbolic imitation learning) 方法，目标是在处理高维数据的同时获得良好的泛化能力。其核心优势在于能利用仅在训练阶段可用的特权信息 (privileged information)，具体为凝视数据 (gaze data)。实验评估展示了该方法在有效性、效率和泛化能力上的表现。
Motivation: 纯神经网络的模仿学习方法虽然能有效处理高维数据，但需要大量样本且容易过拟合；纯符号方法泛化能力好却难以处理高维数据。
Method: 提出一种结合神经与符号方法的神经符号模仿学习框架，并在训练中利用额外的特权信息（凝视数据）来提升学习效果。
Result: 摘要报告实验评估证明了所提方法在有效性、效率和泛化能力方面均表现出优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法的关键优势在于能够有效利用仅在训练时可用、测试时不可用的特权信息。未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Quadratic Objective Perturbation: Curvature-Based Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Objective perturbation is a standard mechanism in differentially private empirical risk minimization. In particular, Linear Objective Perturbation (LOP) enforces privacy by adding a random linear term, while strong convexity and stability are ensured by an additional deterministic quadratic term. However, this approach requires the strong assumption of bounded gradients of the loss function, which excludes many modern machine learning models. In this work, we introduce Quadratic Objective Perturbation (QOP), which perturbs the objective with a random quadratic form. This perturbation induces strong convexity and enforces stability of the problem through curvature, thereby enabling privacy and allowing sensitivity to be controlled through spectral properties of the perturbation rather than assumptions on the gradients. As a result, we obtain $(\varepsilon, δ)$-differential privacy under weaker \red{gradient} assumptions. Furthermore, we extend the analysis to account for approximate solutions, showing that privacy guarantees are preserved under inexact solves. Additionally, we derive utility guarantees in terms of empirical excess risk, and provide a theoretical and numerical comparison to LOP, highlighting the advantages of curvature-based perturbations. Finally, we discuss algorithmic aspects and show that the resulting problems can be solved efficiently using modern splitting schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出二次目标扰动 (Quadratic Objective Perturbation, QOP) 作为差分隐私经验风险最小化的一种新机制，用随机二次型扰动目标，通过曲率而非梯度有界假设来控制灵敏度，从而在更弱的梯度假设下获得 (ε, δ)-差分隐私。摘要还覆盖了近似求解情形下的隐私保持、基于经验超额风险的效用保证，以及与线性目标扰动 (Linear Objective Perturbation, LOP) 的理论和数值对比。
Motivation: 线性目标扰动 (LOP) 依赖损失函数梯度有界这一强假设，该假设排除了许多现代机器学习模型。作者希望引入一种不依赖梯度界、而依赖问题曲率的扰动方式，以扩大差分隐私机制的适用范围。
Method: QOP 用随机二次型扰动目标函数，该扰动本身引入强凸性，并通过曲率保证问题稳定性，从而利用扰动的谱性质而非梯度假设来控制灵敏度。作者还将分析扩展到近似解情形，证明不精确求解不破坏隐私保证，并讨论用现代分裂方案高效求解所得优化问题。
Result: 论文在比 LOP 更弱的梯度假设下获得 (ε, δ)-差分隐私，并给出经验超额风险的效用保证；与 LOP 的理论和数值比较显示曲率扰动具备优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于曲率的扰动可以在更宽松的梯度假设下保持隐私，允许近似求解，且所得问题可用现代分裂方法高效求解。

papers.title: Region-adaptable retrieval of coastal biogeochemical parameters from near-surface hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance using physics-aware meta-learning
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral in situ sensing has shown promise in retrieving aquatic biogeochemical (BGC) parameters, such as total suspended solids, dissolved organic carbon, and total chlorophyll-a, for cost-effective monitoring of coastal water quality. However, generalising such retrieval algorithms across water bodies remains challenging, as the relationship between remote sensing reflectance (Rrs) and BGC parameters can vary considerably from one region to another due to regional distinctions in environmental conditions and biogeochemistry that lead to different BGC ranges and bio-optical properties. In this study, we propose a two-stage physics-aware meta-learning framework for retrieving coastal BGC parameters from near-surface Rrs observations. In the first stage, a bio-optical forward model is used to generate a large synthetic dataset based on an in situ bio-optical spectral library with broad representativeness of Australian coastal waters. This dataset is then used to pretrain a region-agnostic base model with meta-learning, allowing the model to learn fundamental physical relationships. In the second stage, the pretrained base model is fine-tuned for specific regions with local samples. We collected in situ hyperspectral Rrs and BGC measurements from five geographically distinct sites in Australian coastal waters. Our experimental results suggest: (1) the BGC parameters and their corresponding hyperspectral Rrs signatures exhibited clear regional distinctions among the experimental sites; (2) the synthetic dataset was physically plausible and closely aligned with real-world samples in both parameter distributions and inter-parameter correlations; (3) the proposed approach outperformed five benchmark models in BGC retrieval; and (4) time series of in situ measured and model-predicted BGC parameters showed good agreement in both magnitude and temporal dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段物理感知元学习（physics-aware meta-learning）框架，用于从近水面高光谱遥感反射率（Rrs）反演沿海水体生物地球化学（BGC）参数（总悬浮物、溶解有机碳、叶绿素-a 等）。第一阶段利用生物光学前向模型基于澳大利亚沿海水域的原位生物光学光谱库生成大规模合成数据，预训练区域无关的基础模型；第二阶段用各区域局部样本微调。作者在澳大利亚五个地理位置不同的沿海站点进行了实验，结果显示该方法优于五个基准模型，且模型预测的时间序列与实测在幅度和动态上吻合。
Motivation: 高光谱原位传感技术有望以低成本监测沿海水质，但 Rrs 与 BGC 参数之间的关系因区域环境条件和生物地球化学差异而显著不同，导致检索算法难以跨水体泛化。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先用基于原位生物光学光谱库的合成数据集结合元学习预训练一个区域无关的基础模型，使其学习底层物理关系；再针对特定区域使用局部样本对基础模型进行微调。
Result: 实验显示：各站点的 BGC 参数及其高光谱 Rrs 特征存在明显区域性差异；合成数据在参数分布和参数间相关性上接近真实样本；所提方法在 BGC 反演上优于五个基准模型；原位实测与模型预测的 BGC 参数时间序列在幅度和动态上吻合良好。
Conclusion: 作者认为该物理感知元学习框架能够适应不同沿海区域，利用合成数据和局部样本实现区域可适应的 BGC 参数反演。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning the Helmholtz equation operator with DeepONet for non-parametric 2D geometries
papers.abstract_en: This paper deals with solving the 2D Helmholtz equation on non-parametric domains, leveraging a physics-informed neural operator network, the DeepONet framework. We consider a 2D square domain with an inclusion of arbitrary boundary geometry at its center. It acts as a scatterer for an incoming harmonic wave. The aim is to learn the operator linking the geometry of the scatterer to the resulting scattered field. A signed distance function to the boundary of the inner inclusion evaluated in several points on the domain is used to encode its geometry. It serves as input for the branch part of the DeepONet architecture and local information as the input for the trunk part. This approach enables the encoding of arbitrary geometries, whether they are parameterized or not. The evaluation of the model on unseen geometries was compared to its finite element method (FEM) equivalent to test its generalization capabilities. The trained network weights implicitly embed the local physics and their interaction with the domain geometry. If the training space sufficiently covers the target evaluation space, the model can generalize accordingly. Furthermore, it can be refined to extend to another region of interest without retraining from scratch. This framework also avoids the need to remesh the domain for each geometry. The proposed approach delivers a computationally lighter surrogate model than FEM alternatives and avoids relying on FEM generated training data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用物理信息驱动的 DeepONet 框架求解非参数化二维域上的 Helmholtz 方程，中心含任意边界几何的散射体。几何由域内若干采样点上的符号距离函数 (signed distance function) 编码，作为分支网络输入，局部信息作为主干网络输入，从而可编码任意参数化或非参数化几何。训练好的网络权重隐式嵌入局部物理及其与几何的相互作用，在未见几何上的泛化依赖于训练空间对评估空间的覆盖，并可在不重新训练的情况下细化为扩展到其他感兴趣区域。该代理模型比有限元方法 (FEM) 计算更轻量，且避免了为每个几何重新网格化以及依赖 FEM 生成的训练数据。
Motivation: 求解含任意内嵌散射体几何的二维 Helmholtz 方程时，传统有限元方法需要为每个几何重新划分网格且计算成本高；需要一个能直接学习几何到散射场映射、并避免逐几何重网格化的轻量代理模型。
Method: 采用物理信息驱动的 DeepONet 算子学习框架，用散射体边界的符号距离函数在域内多个点的取值编码几何并作为 branch 输入，局部坐标信息作为 trunk 输入，直接学习从几何到散射场的算子；训练过程中利用物理信息而不依赖 FEM 生成的训练数据。
Result: 模型在未见几何上的评估与其 FEM 等效结果进行对比；当训练空间充分覆盖目标评估空间时可实现相应泛化，且模型可被精化以扩展到其他感兴趣区域而不必从头重新训练，同时避免为每个几何重新网格化，计算负担低于 FEM。

papers.title: Defusing the Trigger: Tail-Risk-Informed Attention Rebalancing for LLM Backdoor Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) exhibit attacker-specified behavior at inference time while retaining normal performance on benign inputs. Existing mitigations often require parameter updates and trusted clean data, or rely on auxiliary generation and repeated model execution, complicating deployment. Across diverse backdoor mechanisms, successful activations exhibit stronger tail concentration in attention over semantic-content tokens than benign inputs and unsuccessful trigger activations. This pattern provides a sample-internal control signal to selectively regulate suspicious attention dynamics. We propose TIARA, a tail-risk-informed attention rebalancing approach for inference-time LLM backdoor mitigation. TIARA filters structural attention sinks, aggregates sparse high-concentration events across rows and heads, and converts the risk signal into selective content-domain power smoothing and adaptive attention-mass reallocation. A constrained reconstruction writes valid attention distributions back before value aggregation. TIARA requires no parameter updates, auxiliary generation, additional target-model passes, or deployment-time clean reference sets. We evaluate TIARA across four backdoor paradigms on dense, reasoning-oriented, and sparse mixture-of-experts LLMs. Across three model families, TIARA reduces average macro ASR to 11.5%, outperforming the strongest no-update inference-time baseline by 7.2 percentage points while limiting clean-task degradation to at most 3.8 percentage points. Under standardized profiling, TIARA adds 12.9% end-to-end latency over a matched eager-attention baseline; the current unfused path is 23.3% slower than fused SDPA. Overall, TIARA establishes sample-conditional attention rebalancing as a practical inference-time control layer for mitigating attention-concentrated LLM backdoors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIARA，一种面向推理阶段的 LLM 后门缓解方法。作者观察到，与良性输入和未成功触发相比，成功触发的后门激活在语义内容 token 的注意力上呈现更强的尾部集中，并利用这一样本内部信号选择性调节可疑注意力动态。TIARA 不需要参数更新、辅助生成、额外模型执行或部署时的干净参考集，在多种后门范式与模型家族上显著降低攻击成功率，同时限制对干净任务的影响。
Motivation: 现有后门缓解方法往往需要参数更新和可信干净数据，或依赖辅助生成与重复模型执行，部署复杂。本文的目标是在不更新参数、不引入外部干净数据的前提下，实现实用的推理时后门缓解。
Method: TIARA 先过滤结构性注意力汇 (attention sinks)，再跨行和跨注意力头聚合稀疏的高集中事件，将尾部风险信号转化为选择性内容域功率平滑与自适应注意力质量再分配，并通过约束重建在值聚合前写回合法的注意力分布。
Result: 在四种后门范式上，针对密集、推理导向和稀疏 MoE 三类 LLM 家族，TIARA 将平均宏 ASR 降至 11.5%，比最强的无更新推理时基线低 7.2 个百分点，同时将干净任务退化限制在最多 3.8 个百分点。标准化剖析显示，TIARA 相比匹配的 eager-attention 基线引入 12.9% 的端到端延迟增加，当前未融合路径比融合 SDPA 慢 23.3%。
Conclusion: TIARA 表明样本条件式注意力再平衡可以作为实用的推理时控制层，用于缓解注意力集中型的 LLM 后门；摘要未讨论其对非注意力集中型后门的适用性或更广泛的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Topological Trouble With Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers encode structure in sequences via an expanding contextual history. However, their purely feedforward architecture fundamentally limits dynamic state tracking. State tracking -- the iterative updating of latent variables reflecting an evolving environment -- involves inherently sequential dependencies that feedforward networks struggle to maintain. Consequently, feedforward models push evolving state representations deeper into their layer stack with each new input step, rendering information inaccessible in shallow layers and ultimately exhausting the model's depth. While this depth limit can be bypassed by dynamic depth models and by explicit or latent thinking that externalizes state representations, these solutions are computationally and memory inefficient. In this article, we argue that temporally extended cognition requires refocusing from explicit thought traces to implicit activation dynamics via recurrent architectures. We introduce a taxonomy of recurrent and continuous-thought transformer architectures, categorizing them by their recurrence axis (depth versus step) and their ratio of input tokens to recurrence steps. Finally, we outline promising research directions, including enhanced state-space models and coarse-grained recurrence, to better integrate state tracking into modern foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论 Transformer 的纯前馈架构在动态状态追踪（state tracking）上的根本局限：每一步输入都会把演化中的状态表示推向更深层网络，导致浅层信息不可用并最终耗尽模型深度。作者据此提出一个关于循环和连续思考（continuous-thought）Transformer 架构的分类体系，按循环轴（深度 vs 时间步）与输入 token 数对循环步数的比值来区分架构，并展望了状态空间模型增强与粗粒度循环等研究方向。
Motivation: 前馈 Transformer 难以维护随环境演变而迭代更新的隐状态，因为状态追踪包含本质上顺序化的依赖；现有绕过深度限制的手段（动态深度模型、显式或隐式思考）在计算和内存上效率低下。
Method: 文章提出一种架构分类学（taxonomy），依据循环发生位置（深度维 vs 时间步维）以及输入 token 与循环步的比例来组织循环式与连续思考式 Transformer；并论证应把关注点从显式思维轨迹转向循环架构中的隐式激活动力学（implicit activation dynamics）。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或定量结果；本文主要是论证性分析与架构归类。
Conclusion: 作者主张，时间上延展的认知需要把状态追踪通过循环架构整合进现代基础模型，并给出了包括增强状态空间模型和粗粒度循环在内的未来方向；全文定位为观点/论述性文章。

papers.title: S-GRPO: Unified Post-Training for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Current post-training methodologies for adapting Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) generally fall into two paradigms: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). Despite their prevalence, both approaches suffer from inefficiencies when applied in isolation. SFT forces the model's generation along a single expert trajectory, often inducing catastrophic forgetting of general multimodal capabilities due to distributional shifts. Conversely, RL explores multiple generated trajectories but frequently encounters optimization collapse - a cold-start problem where an unaligned model fails to spontaneously sample any domain-valid trajectories in sparse-reward visual tasks. In this paper, we propose Supervised Group Relative Policy Optimization (S-GRPO), a unified post-training framework that integrates the guidance of imitation learning into the multi-trajectory exploration of preference optimization. Tailored for direct-generation visual tasks, S-GRPO introduces Conditional Ground-Truth Trajectory Injection (CGI). When a binary verifier detects a complete exploratory failure within a sampled group of trajectories, CGI injects the verified ground-truth trajectory into the candidate pool. By assigning a deterministic maximal reward to this injected anchor, S-GRPO enforces a positive signal within the group-relative advantage estimation. This mechanism reformulates the supervised learning objective as a high-advantage component of the policy gradient, compelling the model to dynamically balance between exploiting the expert trajectory and exploring novel visual concepts. Theoretical analysis and empirical results demonstrate that S-GRPO gracefully bridges the gap between SFT and RL, drastically accelerates convergence, and achieves superior domain adaptation while preserving the base model's general-purpose capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S-GRPO (Supervised Group Relative Policy Optimization)，一个统一的大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 后训练框架，将模仿学习引导整合进偏好优化的多轨迹探索。针对直接生成式视觉任务，S-GRPO 引入条件真值轨迹注入 (CGI)：当二元验证器检测到采样轨迹组完全探索失败时，将验证过的真值轨迹注入候选池并赋予确定性最大奖励，从而在组相对优势估计中提供正信号。理论分析和实验表明该方法能弥合 SFT 与 RL 的差距，加速收敛并保持基础模型的通用能力。
Motivation: 现有 LVLM 后训练主要有 SFT 和 RL 两种范式，但单独使用均存在效率问题：SFT 沿单一专家轨迹生成，因分布偏移易导致多模态通用能力灾难性遗忘；RL 虽探索多条生成轨迹，但在稀疏奖励视觉任务中常遭遇优化崩溃，未对齐模型难以自发采样到有效轨迹。
Method: 提出统一后训练框架 S-GRPO，将模仿学习指导融入偏好优化的多轨迹探索。核心机制为条件真值轨迹注入 (CGI)：当二元验证器发现一组采样轨迹完全探索失败时，CGI 将验证后的真值轨迹注入候选池，并分配确定性最大奖励，使该注入锚点在组相对优势估计中成为正信号，从而将监督学习目标重构为策略梯度中的高优势分量，动态平衡利用专家轨迹与探索新视觉概念。
Result: 摘要报告理论与实证结果显示 S-GRPO 能优雅地弥合 SFT 与 RL 之间的差距，大幅加速收敛，并在取得更优域适应的同时保留基础模型的通用能力；摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调 S-GRPO 通过动态平衡专家轨迹利用与新概念探索，为直接生成式视觉任务的 LVLM 后训练提供统一方案，可缓解 RL 的冷启动问题和 SFT 的遗忘问题。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Tight Bounds for Learning Polyhedra with a Margin
papers.abstract_en: We give an algorithm for PAC learning intersections of $k$ halfspaces with a $ρ$ margin to within error $\varepsilon$ that runs in time $\textsf{poly}(k, \varepsilon^{-1}, ρ^{-1}) \cdot \exp \left(O(\sqrt{n \log(1/ρ) \log k})\right)$. Notably, this improves on prior work which had an exponential dependence on either $k$ or $ρ^{-1}$ and matches known cryptographic and Statistical Query lower bounds up to the logarithmic factors in $k$ and $ρ$ in the exponent. Our learning algorithm extends to the more general setting when we are only promised that most points have distance at least $ρ$ from the boundary of the polyhedron, making it applicable to continuous distributions as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带间隔 (margin) 的 k 个半空间交集 (intersection of k halfspaces) 的 PAC 学习问题，给出运行时间为 poly(k, ε^{-1}, ρ^{-1}) · exp(O(√(n log(1/ρ) log k))) 的算法。该结果改进了先前对 k 或 ρ^{-1} 呈指数依赖的工作，并在指数中的对数因子内匹配已知的密码学与 Statistical Query 下界。算法还推广到仅保证多数点距边界至少 ρ 的更一般设置，适用于连续分布。
Motivation: 学习 k 个半空间的交集是经典的高维概念学习问题，先前的算法在间隔或概念数量上存在指数依赖，而理论下界表明指数依赖可能不可避免；作者目标是给出匹配下界的紧界算法。
Method: 提出一种 PAC 学习算法，其时间复杂度的指数部分为 exp(O(√(n log(1/ρ) log k)))，并处理更弱的间隔保证：只需要大多数样本点距多面体边界至少 ρ，从而支持连续分布。
Result: 摘要报告运行时间 poly(k, ε^{-1}, ρ^{-1}) · exp(O(√(n log(1/ρ) log k)))，相比以往对 k 或 ρ^{-1} 的指数依赖有显著改进，且与已知下界在指数部分仅差对数因子。
Conclusion: 作者强调该算法在更强的间隔假设和更弱的“大多数点有间隔”假设下均成立，后者使其适用于连续分布；结果在指数部分达到紧界。

summary_sections.method: 提出一种 PAC 学习算法，其时间复杂度的指数部分为 exp(O(√(n log(1/ρ) log k)))，并处理更弱的间隔保证：只需要大多数样本点距多面体边界至少 ρ，从而支持连续分布。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告运行时间 poly(k, ε^{-1}, ρ^{-1}) · exp(O(√(n log(1/ρ) log k)))，相比以往对 k 或 ρ^{-1} 的指数依赖有显著改进，且与已知下界在指数部分仅差对数因子。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该算法在更强的间隔假设和更弱的“大多数点有间隔”假设下均成立，后者使其适用于连续分布；结果在指数部分达到紧界。

papers.title: How Can We Synthesize High-Quality Pretraining Data? A Systematic Study of Prompt Design, Generator Model, and Source Data
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data is a standard component in training large language models, yet systematic comparisons across design dimensions, including rephrasing strategy, generator model, and source data, remain absent. We conduct extensive controlled experiments, generating over one trillion tokens, to identify critical factors in rephrasing web text into synthetic pretraining data. Our results reveal that structured output formats, such as tables, math problems, FAQs, and tutorials, consistently outperform both curated web baselines and prior synthetic methods. Notably, increasing the size of the generator model beyond 1B parameters provides no additional benefit. Our analysis also demonstrates that the selection of the original data used for mixing substantially influences performance. By applying our findings, we develop \textbf{\textsc{FinePhrase}}, a 486-billion-token open dataset of rephrased web text. We show that \textsc{FinePhrase} outperforms all existing synthetic data baselines while reducing generation costs by up to 30 times. We provide the dataset, all prompts, and the generation framework to the research community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对合成预训练数据的设计维度进行了系统研究，覆盖改写策略、生成器模型和源数据选择，并生成了超过一万亿 token 的受控实验数据。结果显示结构化输出格式（如表、数学题、FAQ 和教程）持续优于精选网页基线和既有合成方法，且将生成器模型扩大到 1B 参数以上并无额外收益，源数据的选择对性能影响显著。基于这些发现，作者构建了 486B token 的开放数据集 FinePhrase，其性能超过现有合成数据基线，同时生成成本最多降低 30 倍。
Motivation: 合成数据已成为训练大语言模型的标准组件，但此前缺乏跨设计维度（包括改写策略、生成器模型和源数据）的系统性比较，导致高质量合成预训练数据的生成方式缺乏可靠依据。
Method: 作者开展大规模受控实验，生成超过一万亿 token 的合成数据，系统比较改写策略、生成器模型规模、源数据混合等维度；并在此基础上提出 FinePhrase，一个 486B token 的重写网页文本开放数据集及其生成框架。
Result: 摘要报告结构化输出格式（表格、数学题、FAQ、教程）一致优于精选网页基线和先前合成方法；生成器模型超过 1B 参数没有额外收益；源数据选择显著影响性能；FinePhrase 在性能上超过所有现有合成数据基线，并将生成成本降低最多 30 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些发现可用于高效合成高质量预训练数据，并向研究社区提供 FinePhrase 数据集、全部提示词和生成框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Targeted Interpretable Safety Neuron Enhancement for Multilingual Vision-Language Large Models
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread deployment of vision-language large models (VLLMs), their safety alignment faces dual challenges across languages and modalities. Existing methods model multilingual and multimodal safety separately, overlooking coupled risks between low-resource-language instructions and visual contexts, which hinders the detection of cross-lingual and cross-modal harmful intent and the formation of robust safety boundaries. To address this, we propose a neuron-level interpretable safety alignment framework that identifies safety neurons and performs neuron-targeted safety tuning to jointly mitigate multilingual and multimodal risks. Specifically, we compare FFN representations elicited by harmful requests and benign inputs to identify neuron activation strengths associated with safety refusals. Next, we jointly model neuron activations and corresponding down-projection columns to derive neuron-level saliency, separating general multilingual and multimodal neurons from safety neurons responsible for model defense. Finally, neuron-targeted gradient masking restricts parameter updates to the safety subspace spanned by the identified neurons, enabling precise and interpretable safety enhancement. Extensive experiments show that our method enhances multilingual and multimodal safety by tuning only a few safety neurons, while preserving general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言大模型（VLLM）中跨语言与跨模态的安全对齐耦合风险，提出一个神经元级别的可解释安全对齐框架。该框架先通过比较有害请求与良性输入引发的 FFN 表示来识别与安全拒绝相关的神经元，再联合建模神经元激活与下投影列得出神经元级显著性，最后用神经元定向梯度掩码把参数更新限制在安全子空间内。实验表明仅调优少量安全神经元即可增强多语言和多模态安全性，同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有方法将多语言安全与多模态安全分开建模，忽略了低资源语言指令与视觉上下文之间的耦合风险，导致难以检测跨语言和跨模态的有害意图，也无法形成稳健的安全边界。
Method: 提出神经元级可解释安全对齐框架：先对比有害请求和良性输入下的 FFN 表示，识别与安全拒绝相关的神经元激活强度；再联合建模神经元激活及对应的 down-projection 列，计算神经元级显著性，区分通用多语言/多模态神经元与负责防御的安全神经元；最后用神经元定向梯度掩码（neuron-targeted gradient masking）将参数更新限制在识别出的安全神经元张成的子空间内。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法仅需调优少量安全神经元即可同时提升多语言和多模态安全性，并保持模型的通用能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过神经元级别的可解释调优可以有效缓解低资源语言指令与视觉上下文耦合带来的跨语言、跨模态安全风险，并在增强安全性的同时不损害一般能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SyncBreaker:Stage-Aware Multimodal Adversarial Attacks on Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based audio-driven talking-head generation enables realistic portrait animation, but also introduces risks of misuse, such as fraud and misinformation. Existing protection methods are largely limited to a single modality, and neither image-only nor audio-only attacks can effectively suppress speech-driven facial dynamics. To address this gap, we propose SyncBreaker, a stage-aware multimodal protection framework that jointly perturbs portrait and audio inputs under modality-specific perceptual constraints. Our key contributions are twofold. First, for the image stream, we introduce nullifying supervision with Multi-Interval Sampling (MIS) across diffusion stages to steer the generation toward the static reference portrait by aggregating guidance from multiple denoising intervals. Second, for the audio stream, we propose Cross-Attention Fooling (CAF), which suppresses interval-specific audio-conditioned cross-attention responses. Both streams are optimized independently and combined at inference time to enable flexible deployment. We evaluate SyncBreaker in a white-box proactive protection setting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SyncBreaker more effectively degrades lip synchronization and facial dynamics than strong single-modality baselines, while preserving input perceptual quality and remaining robust under purification. Code: https://github.com/kitty384/SyncBreaker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SyncBreaker，一种面向扩散式音频驱动说话头生成（audio-driven talking head generation）的阶段性多模态对抗保护框架，同时对肖像图像和音频输入施加扰动。图像流采用多区间采样（Multi-Interval Sampling, MIS）的空化监督以引导生成趋向静态参考肖像，音频流则提出跨注意力欺骗（Cross-Attention Fooling, CAF）来抑制音频条件跨注意力响应。在白盒主动保护设置下，实验表明 SyncBreaker 比单模态基线更能降低唇形同步和面部动态质量，同时保持输入感知质量并对净化（purification）具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 扩散式音频驱动说话头生成虽能生成逼真的人像动画，但也带来欺诈和虚假信息等滥用风险；现有保护方法大多局限于单一模态，仅图像或仅音频的攻击无法有效抑制语音驱动的面部动态。
Method: 提出阶段感知的多模态保护框架 SyncBreaker：图像流使用多区间采样（MIS）的空化监督，跨扩散阶段聚合多个去噪区间的引导，使生成趋向静态参考肖像；音频流提出跨注意力欺骗（CAF），压制特定区间内由音频条件引起的跨注意力响应。两个流独立优化，推理时组合，便于灵活部署。
Result: 在白盒主动保护设置的实验中，SyncBreaker 相比强单模态基线能更有效地降低唇形同步和面部动态质量，并保持输入感知质量，且对净化操作具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为阶段感知的多模态扰动能更有效地抑制语音驱动的面部动态，摘要强调该方法在白盒主动保护场景下的有效性，并提供了代码仓库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Personalized RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models with Human Aligned Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Pluralistic alignment has emerged as a critical frontier in the development of Large Language Models (LLMs), with reward models (RMs) serving as a central mechanism for capturing diverse human values. While benchmarks for general response quality are prevalent, evaluating how well reward models account for individual user preferences remains an open challenge. To bridge this gap, we introduce Personalized RewardBench, a novel benchmark designed to rigorously assess reward models' capacity to model personalized preferences. We construct chosen and rejected response pairs based on strict adherence to (or violation of) user-specific rubrics, ensuring that preference distinctions are uniquely tailored to the individual. In particular, human evaluations confirm that the primary discriminative factor between pairs is strictly personal preference, with both responses maintaining high general quality (e.g., correctness, relevance and helpfulness). Extensive testing reveals that existing state-of-the-art reward models struggle significantly with personalization, peaking at an accuracy of just 75.94%. Crucially, because an effective reward model benchmark should predict a reward model's performance on downstream tasks, we conduct experiments demonstrating that our benchmark exhibits a significantly higher correlation with downstream performance in both Best-of-N (BoN) sampling and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) compared to existing baselines. These findings establish Personalized RewardBench as a robust and accurate proxy for evaluating reward models' performance in downstream applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Personalized RewardBench，一个用于评估奖励模型 (reward model) 建模个性化用户偏好能力的基准。基准依据用户特定规则 (rubric) 的严格遵守或违反来构造 chosen/rejected 响应对，确保响应间的区分仅源于个人偏好，同时两个响应都保持较高的通用质量。测试发现现有 SOTA 奖励模型在该基准上准确率最高仅为 75.94%，且该基准对下游 Best-of-N (BoN) 采样和 Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) 性能的相关性显著高于现有基线。
Motivation: 多元化对齐 (pluralistic alignment) 已成为 LLM 发展的关键前沿，奖励模型是捕捉多样人类价值的核心机制，但现有基准大多评估通用响应质量，如何评估奖励模型对个体用户偏好的建模能力仍是开放问题。
Method: 构建 Personalized RewardBench 基准，基于用户特定的严格规则构造 chosen 与 rejected 响应对；人为评估确认两响应间的首要区分因素是个人偏好，并保证两者在正确性、相关性和帮助性等通用质量上保持一致。
Result: 摘要报告现有 SOTA 奖励模型在个性化偏好建模上表现显著不足，准确率最高仅 75.94%；该基准与下游 BoN 采样和 PPO 性能的相关性显著高于现有基准。
Conclusion: 作者将该基准定位为评估奖励模型在下游应用中性能的稳健且准确的代理 (proxy)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Large Language Model Predicates to Logic Tensor Networks: Neurosymbolic Offer Validation in Regulated Procurement
papers.abstract_en: We present a neurosymbolic approach, i.e. combine symbolic and subsymbolic artificial intelligence, to validating offer documents in regulated public institutions. We employ a language model to extract information and then aggregate it with an LTN (Logic Tensor Network) to make an auditable decision. In regulated public institutions, decisions must be made in a manner that is both factually correct and legally verifiable. Our neurosymbolic approach allows existing domain-specific knowledge to be linked to the semantic text understanding of language models. The decisions resulting from our pipeline can be justified by predicate values, rule truth values, and corresponding text passages. Our experiments on a real corpus show that the proposed pipeline achieves performance comparable to existing models, but its key advantage lies in its interpretability, modular predicate extraction, and explicit support for XAI (Explainable AI).
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, extended version, with appendix
papers.journal_ref: In Diedrich Wolter and Gesina Schwalbe, editors, KI 2026: Advances in Artificial Intelligence -- 49th German Conference on AI, LNAI 16830, pages 236--243, Bremen, Germany, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号方法，将语言模型的信息提取与逻辑张量网络（LTN）聚合相结合，用于受监管公共机构中的报价文件验证，目标是做出既事实正确又法律可审计的决策。实验表明，该流水线在真实语料上性能与现有模型相当，主要优势在于可解释性、模块化谓词提取以及对可解释人工智能（XAI）的显式支持。
Motivation: 受监管公共机构的决策必须既事实正确又法律上可验证，而现有模型在解释性和审计性方面不足。
Method: 采用语言模型从报价文件中提取信息，再通过逻辑张量网络（LTN）进行聚合，将领域特定知识与语言模型的语义文本理解相结合；决策可由谓词值、规则真值和对应文本段落来论证。
Result: 摘要报告该流水线在真实语料上取得与现有模型相当的性能，关键优势是可解释性、模块化谓词提取和明确的XAI支持。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法能为受监管环境提供可审计的决策，并以可解释性作为核心卖点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Can an Actor-Critic Optimization Framework Improve Analog Design?
papers.abstract_en: Analog design often slows down because even small changes to device sizes or biases require expensive simulation cycles, and high-quality solutions typically occupy only a narrow part of a very large search space. While existing optimizers reduce some of this burden, they largely operate without the kind of judgment designers use when deciding where to search next. This paper presents an actor-critic optimization framework (ACOF) for analog sizing that brings that form of guidance into the loop. Rather than treating optimization as a purely black-box search problem, ACOF separates the roles of proposal and evaluation: an actor suggests promising regions of the design space, while a critic reviews those choices, enforces design legality, and redirects the search when progress is hampered. This structure preserves compatibility with standard simulator-based flows while making the search process more deliberate, stable, and interpretable. Across our test circuits, ACOF improves the top-10 figure of merit by an average of 38.9% over the strongest competing baseline and reduces regret by an average of 24.7%, with peak gains of 70.5% in FoM and 42.2% lower regret on individual circuits. By combining iterative reasoning with simulation-driven search, the framework offers a more transparent path toward automated analog sizing across challenging design spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于模拟电路尺寸设计（analog sizing）的 actor-critic 优化框架（ACOF），将优化过程分为提议与评估两个角色：actor 提议设计空间中有希望的区域，critic 评估这些选择、强制设计合法性并在进展受阻时重新引导搜索，同时保持与标准仿真流程的兼容性。在测试电路上，ACOF 将 top-10 品质因数（figure of merit, FoM）相对最强基线平均提升 38.9%，后悔值（regret）平均降低 24.7%，单个电路上峰值增益为 70.5% 的 FoM 提升和 42.2% 的 regret 降低。
Motivation: 模拟电路设计效率低的根源在于，即使是微小的器件尺寸或偏置变化也需要昂贵的仿真循环，而高质量解往往只占据极大搜索空间的狭窄区域；现有优化器虽减轻部分负担，但基本不具备设计师在决定下一步搜索方向时所使用的判断力。
Method: ACOF 将提议与评估分离：actor 负责提议设计空间中的有希望区域，critic 负责审查这些区域、强制设计合法性并在搜索受阻时重定向；该方法不把优化当作纯黑盒搜索，而是结合迭代推理与仿真驱动搜索，使搜索过程更审慎、稳定且可解释。
Result: 在测试电路上，ACOF 相对最强竞争基线将 top-10 FoM 平均提升 38.9%，regret 平均降低 24.7%；在单个电路上，FoM 最高提升 70.5%，regret 最低降低 42.2%。
Conclusion: 该框架通过将迭代推理与仿真驱动搜索结合，为跨挑战性设计空间的自动化模拟尺寸设计提供了一条更透明的路径。
Relevance: 0
